title: RBS-Attention: Radius-Bounded Sparse Prefill for Long-Context Large Language Models
summary: Long-context large language model inference is increasingly limited by prefill, where dense self-attention processes the entire prompt before generation begins. Sparse block selection can reduce this cost, but a block centroid may hide a highly relevant token among many irrelevant ones. We call this failure mode mean dilution and propose RBS-Attention, a training-free sparse-prefill method with two complementary selection branches. A centroid base branch captures average relevance, while a rescue branch uses the maximum key-block radius and its prompt-, layer-, and head-dependent distribution to identify blocks at risk of underestimation. Independently thresholding the two branches and combining their masks controls the contribution of rescue blocks while preserving regular block-sparse FlashAttention execution. On H100 GPUs, RBS-Attention achieves 20.65$\times$ standalone prefill-attention speedup, 11.92$\times$ vLLM prefill-attention speedup, and 5.97$\times$ end-to-end time-to-first-token speedup at 128K on Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-FP8. On the dense Qwen3-32B model, it obtains 88.65 overall RULER accuracy versus 89.52 for dense attention; LongBench-v2, InfiniteBench, and Video-MME provide additional quality evaluation. Supporting experiments measure actual retention, compare selectors at matched density, and characterize block-size, threshold, and memory behavior. Together, these results support radius-adaptive dual-branch selection as an effective approach to long-context prefill.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种免训练的稀疏预填充方法 RBS-Attention，通过双分支块选择缓解长上下文推理中预填充注意力开销大的问题，并在 H100 上取得显著加速且保持较高精度。
AI.motivation: 长上下文大语言模型推理受预填充阶段密集自注意力计算限制，现有稀疏块选择用块质心表示相关性，可能掩盖块内高度相关但被大量无关 token 稀释的 token，作者称该失败模式为均值稀释。
AI.method: 提出 RBS-Attention，一种免训练稀疏预填充方法，包含两个互补选择分支：质心基础分支捕捉平均相关性，救援分支利用最大 key 块半径及其随提示、层、头变化的分布识别可能被低估的块。两分支独立阈值化并合并掩码，控制救援块贡献，同时保持规则块稀疏 FlashAttention 执行。
AI.result: 在 H100 GPU 上，128K 上下文下 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-FP8 上实现 20.65 倍独立预填充注意力加速、11.92 倍 vLLM 预填充注意力加速和 5.97 倍端到端首 token 时间加速。在密集 Qwen3-32B 上，RULER 总体准确率为 88.65，对比密集注意力 89.52；并在 LongBench-v2、InfiniteBench 和 Video-MME 上提供额外质量评估。
AI.conclusion: 半径自适应双分支选择是长上下文预填充的有效方法，可在显著加速的同时保持与密集注意力相近的生成质量。

authors: S. J. A. M. van den Eijnden
title: Incremental Stability and Convergence Properties of Discrete-Time Projected Control Systems
summary: Projection-based controllers can overcome fundamental limitations of classical linear time-invariant control by modifying the controller's input-output behavior via projection. A key example is given by the hybrid integrator-gain system, a projected integrator, which has recently found successful application in several industrial systems. While prior work on analysis and design of projection-based control systems has primarily focused on the continuous-time setting and non-incremental analysis, a more refined incremental analysis in discrete-time is needed to better reflect actual digital implementation and obtain more accurate (robust) performance assessment. To address this need, this paper considers incremental stability and convergence analysis of discrete-time projection-based control systems. Our first methodology is based on showing that such controllers preserve the quadratic incremental stability of their nominal (unprojected) dynamics, if the projection metric is well-designed. Building on this, we derive a small-gain condition guaranteeing incremental input-to-state stability for interconnections of projected controllers with general nonlinear plants. A second approach is grounded in a direct Lyapunov-based method for verifying incremental stability in input-affine piecewise-smooth systems, which can be seen as an extension of the classical discrete-time Demidovic conditions. We illustrate our results through several examples, and demonstrate performance quantification via nonlinear Bode plots, with a special focus on first-order projection elements.

AI.tldr: 本文研究离散时间投影型控制系统的增量稳定性与收敛性分析，提出了基于二次增量稳定保持和直接Lyapunov方法的理论工具，并给出小增益条件与性能量化示例。
AI.motivation: 现有投影型控制器（如混合积分器-增益系统）的分析与设计主要针对连续时间且多为非增量分析，难以准确反映实际数字实现并评估鲁棒性能，因此需要离散时间下的增量分析。
AI.method: 首先证明在投影度量设计良好时，投影控制器可保持其标称未投影动力学的二次增量稳定性；据此推导出投影控制器与一般非线性对象互联时的增量输入到状态稳定性小增益条件。其次，提出一种直接Lyapunov方法，用于验证输入仿射分段光滑系统的增量稳定性，可视为经典离散时间Demidovic条件的扩展。
AI.result: 建立了离散时间投影型控制系统的增量稳定性与收敛性分析框架，给出了小增益条件，并通过多个示例及非线性Bode图进行性能量化，特别关注一阶投影环节。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为离散时间投影型控制系统提供了更精细的增量稳定性分析工具，有助于更准确地评估数字实现下的鲁棒性能，并扩展了相关Lyapunov分析方法。

title: Optimal Day-Ahead Scheduling of Fast EV Charging Station With Multi-Stage Battery Degradation Model
summary: The paper proposes a day-ahead scheduling framework with a novel multi-stage battery degradation modeling method for an electric vehicle (EV) fast charging station (FCS) equipped with a battery energy storage system (BESS). Unlike previous studies, which employ a single battery degradation model to represent the aging process, this paper proposes a novel multi-stage battery degradation modeling method to accurately capture the degradation process across the whole lifespan. Subsequently, the multi-stage model is explicitly integrated into the proposed adaptive optimization framework in a computationally tractable way, thus having important practical implications in the field. The paper provides case studies to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed modeling method on a selected cycle aging model in reducing the operation cost of FCS with BESS operating in different stages. As a result, the overall operation cost with the multi-stage model is around 2.1% on average lower than the single-stage model counterpart. In addition, results show that with the increasing number of divided stages, the model error decreases and becomes stable, while the reduced operation cost compared with the single-stage model increases and saturates. Finally, we apply the multi-stage framework considering other conventional degradation models to show the superiority of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文针对配备电池储能系统（BESS）的电动汽车快速充电站，提出了一种日前调度框架，并引入新颖的多阶段电池退化建模方法。
AI.motivation: 以往研究通常采用单一电池退化模型来描述老化过程，难以准确刻画电池全生命周期内的退化变化，因此需要更精细的建模方法。
AI.method: 提出多阶段电池退化建模方法，并将其以计算上可处理的方式显式集成到自适应优化框架中；通过案例研究，在选定的循环老化模型上验证该方法，并进一步结合其他常规退化模型进行对比。
AI.result: 多阶段模型使快速充电站整体运行成本平均比单阶段模型低约2.1%；随着阶段数增加，模型误差下降并趋于稳定，而相比单阶段模型降低的运行成本先增加后饱和；在其他常规退化模型下也表现出优越性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的多阶段电池退化建模方法能更准确反映电池全生命周期退化过程，并有效降低配备BESS的快速充电站运行成本，具有重要实际应用价值。

title: A Mean-Field Approach for Safe Routing of Multi-Destination Urban Air Mobility Networks
summary: As Urban Air Mobility (UAM) systems scale toward high-density operations, managing autonomous Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) traffic requires control frameworks that are both tractable and safety-critical. This paper presents a principled optimal control-theoretic foundation for routing in multi-destination UAM networks subject to vertiport capacity and flow constraints. We first model the network as a destination-conditioned Continuous-Time Markov Chain (CTMC) to capture the stochastic transitions between queueing, service, and flight states. To ensure tractability, we employ a mean-field fluid approximation and derive the underlying system dynamics as a set of coupled ordinary differential equations. A key contribution of this work is the formal proof of the positive invariance of the queue-free state space. We demonstrate that under specific underloaded conditions, a system initialized without queues will remain queue-free indefinitely. This result allows us to transform a complex, infinite-dimensional continuous-time optimal control problem into a tractable, finite-dimensional algebraic optimization. The resulting framework jointly optimizes for travel time and multi-hop efficiency while ensuring network-wide stability. We validate the approach by characterizing the steady-state flow equilibria and providing sufficient conditions for safe, congestion-free operation in large-scale mobility systems.

AI.tldr: 本文为多目的地UAM网络中的无人机路由提出基于最优控制的理论框架，在垂直起降场容量与流量约束下，结合CTMC建模、平均场流体近似和队列无状态正不变性证明，将复杂连续时间最优控制转化为有限维代数优化。
AI.motivation: 随着城市空中交通向高密度运行扩展，自主无人机交通管理需要既易于处理又满足安全关键要求的控制框架。
AI.method: 将网络建模为目的地条件连续时间马尔可夫链以刻画排队、服务和飞行状态间的随机转移；采用平均场流体近似，导出耦合常微分方程；证明队列无状态空间的正不变性；在欠载条件下将无限维连续时间最优控制问题转化为有限维代数优化，并联合优化旅行时间与多跳效率。
AI.result: 证明了在特定欠载条件下，若系统初始无队列，则将持续保持无队列；刻画了稳态流量均衡，并给出大规模移动系统中安全、无拥堵运行的充分条件。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为受垂直起降场容量和流量约束的多目的地UAM路由提供了具有原则性的最优控制基础，可确保网络级稳定性，并支持安全、无拥堵的大规模运行。

title: TAPe+ML: A Compact Structured Representation for Multi-Task Computer Vision
comment: 39 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://ml.comexp.net
summary:
We present TAPe+ML v3, a compact computer vision system based on TAPe (Theory of Active Perception), a structured representation that encodes relations among perceptual elements before recognition. Instead of operating directly on pixel tensors, the system uses a shared TAPe representation and a modular recognition architecture for image classification, object detection, and instance segmentation.
  TAPe+ML v3 combines background and contour processing, local object localization, prototype-based classification, and a coordinator for specialized submodels. Across the reported experiments, it uses fewer than 100,000 parameters. On COCO object detection, it obtains 84.7 mAP50 and 65.3 mAP50-95. On COCO instance segmentation, it obtains 80.7 mask mAP50 and 58.4 mask mAP50-95. In classification experiments, it reaches 92 percent validation accuracy on Imagenette under an identical-training comparison with a raw-pixel baseline, and 89.9 percent Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-Real. We also evaluate compactness in video scene detection and adaptation under distribution shift in an industrial pilot. The results suggest that shifting part of the modeling burden from network parameters to a structured input representation can support compact multi-task vision systems with reduced data, memory, and compute requirements.

AI.tldr: 提出基于TAPe主动感知理论的紧凑计算机视觉系统TAPe+ML v3，使用结构化TAPe表示和模块化识别架构，统一支持图像分类、目标检测和实例分割。
AI.motivation: 减少对海量网络参数、数据、内存和计算的依赖，将部分建模负担从网络参数转移到结构化的输入表示上。
AI.method: 采用共享TAPe表示与模块化识别架构，结合背景与轮廓处理、局部目标定位、基于原型的分类，以及用于协调专用子模型的协调器。
AI.result: 参数量少于100,000；COCO检测达到84.7 mAP50和65.3 mAP50-95；COCO实例分割达到80.7 mask mAP50和58.4 mask mAP50-95；Imagenette验证准确率92%，ImageNet-Real Top-1准确率89.9%；还评估了视频场景检测的紧凑性和工业试点中的分布偏移适应。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将部分建模负担转移到结构化输入表示，可支持紧凑的多任务视觉系统，并降低数据、内存和计算需求。

title: Source--Grid Coupling in Power System Oscillations: Observational Equivalence, Feedback Detectability, and Modal Interaction
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Power Systems
summary: The conventional distinction between forced and natural oscillations treats the oscillation source as external to a fixed power-system boundary. This paper develops a coupling-aware dynamical interpretation by explicitly accounting for the directionality of source-grid coupling. It examines when prescribed forcing and a one-way autonomous source are observationally equivalent, and when grid measurements can distinguish the presence of grid-to-source feedback. Matched interface signals yield exact equivalence under the same deterministic grid initial-value problem and measurement map. Bidirectional feedback enables source-grid eigenvalue interaction in the augmented autonomous model, while a reduced two-mode model shows that the interaction depends jointly on loop coupling and complex modal separation. The resulting framework establishes source-grid coupling directionality as a feedback-based dynamical boundary and clarifies when feedback can be inferred from grid-side measurements and why weak feedback may remain unresolved. Simulation studies on a two-area system demonstrate feedback detection within a calibrated source family, while source-model mismatch can be confounded with feedback. A WECC 243-bus system study demonstrates feasibility on a large system and shows that feedback detection need not require exact candidate selection.

AI.tldr: 本文从源-网耦合方向性出发，重新审视强迫振荡与自然振荡的区分，研究何时外部强迫与单向自治源在观测上等价，以及电网侧量测何时能辨识源到网的反馈。
AI.motivation: 传统强迫/自然振荡划分默认振荡源位于固定电力系统边界之外，忽略了源与网之间耦合的方向性和反馈作用，因此需要建立耦合感知的动态解释框架。
AI.method: 将源-网耦合方向性建模为反馈式动态边界；比较规定强迫与单向自治源在相同确定性电网初值问题和量测映射下的观测等价性；在增广自治模型中分析双向反馈引起的源-网特征值交互，并用降阶双模态模型研究回路耦合与复模态分离的共同影响；通过两区域系统和WECC 243节点系统仿真验证。
AI.result: 匹配界面信号时，规定强迫与单向自治源可精确等价；双向反馈会产生源-网特征值交互，其作用取决于回路耦合和复模态分离。两区域仿真可在标定源族内检测反馈，但源模型失配会与反馈混淆；WECC 243节点系统表明大规模系统可行，且反馈检测不要求精确候选源选择。
AI.conclusion: 源-网耦合方向性可被确立为基于反馈的动态边界，该框架明确了电网侧量测推断反馈的条件，并解释了弱反馈为何可能难以辨识。

title: Do small language models know what they don't know?
summary: We explore whether entropy-based confidence signals can be leveraged to improve the accuracy of Small Language Models (SLMs) with fewer than 3 billion parameters, running entirely on consumer hardware. We evaluate seven distinct approaches, including token-level entropy early stopping, semantic entropy estimation, and uncertainty-aware routing to larger expert models, across 7 model pairs and 5 standard NLU benchmarks. Our key finding is that token-level entropy is effectively blind in SLMs: in 91% of dataset-model combinations, mean token entropy is near zero regardless of answer correctness, rendering token-based confidence signals unusable at this scale. We demonstrate that semantic entropy, computed by generating multiple samples, clustering answers by meaning, and measuring distributional uncertainty, recovers a viable confidence signal. Using semantic entropy to selectively route uncertain queries to a larger expert model yields accuracy improvements of up to +50 percentage points. Notably, cross-family routing (e.g., SmolLM 360M to Phi-3.5-mini) averages +22.0% improvement compared to +6.8% for same-family routing, revealing that expert model quality matters more than architectural compatibility. Our results suggest that the value proposition for entropy-based methods in SLMs is not computational savings but intelligent compute allocation: spending more tokens where they matter most.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨熵基置信信号能否提升小于30亿参数的小语言模型在消费级硬件上的准确率，发现token级熵无效，而语义熵可用于路由至更大专家模型，实现显著准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 探索在消费级硬件上运行的小语言模型（<3B）中，熵基置信信号能否用于提升准确率。
AI.method: 评估七种方法，包括token级熵早停、语义熵估计、不确定性感知路由至更大专家模型，在7个模型对和5个NLU基准上测试。
AI.result: token级熵在SLM中近乎无效（91%组合均值近零），语义熵可恢复有效置信信号；路由不确定查询至更大专家模型准确率提升最高+50个百分点；跨家族路由平均+22.0%，同家族+6.8%，专家模型质量比架构兼容性更重要。
AI.conclusion: 熵基方法在SLM中的价值不在于计算节省，而在于智能计算分配：在最需要的地方投入更多token。

title: WM-VS: Progress-Aligned World Models for Closed-Loop Visual Servoing
summary: Closed-loop visual servoing requires predictions that indicate whether an action reduces task error, not only whether the action is plausible. We call this gap the prediction-control mismatch and introduce WM-VS, a target-centric progress-aligned world-model framework for closed-loop visual servoing. Offline target-region DINOv2 correspondences define a signed four-dimensional servo coordinate for translation, scale, and in-plane rotation. Stage 1 aligns action-conditioned latent transitions with this coordinate; Stage 2 freezes the world model and trains a reactive joint-velocity policy with action imitation, consequence supervision, and short imagined rollouts that favor error contraction. Deployment is RGB-only and reactive, without online trajectory optimization. On a real 7-DoF eye-to-hand system, WM-VS reaches a corner RMSE no larger than 10 percent of its initial value in 30/30 trials and retains this criterion at the final valid frame in 25/30 (83.33 percent). Removing future-error alignment reduces retention to 26.67 percent. The learned progress signal agrees with an external AprilTag corner error not used for training or control (mean Spearman rho = 0.8778). Without retraining, two unseen 3D targets achieve translation-error reductions of 86.48 percent and 90.27 percent and rotation-error reductions of 70.01 percent and 65.70 percent. These results link progress-aligned action consequences to repeated closed-loop correction and transfer. Code and data will be released as open source.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 WM-VS，一种面向闭环视觉伺服的目标中心、进度对齐世界模型框架，用于解决预测与控制不匹配问题，使动作预测不仅合理，还能判断是否降低任务误差。
AI.motivation: 闭环视觉伺服中，传统预测往往只关注动作是否合理，而未明确预测该动作能否减小任务误差，这导致预测与控制目标不一致，即 prediction-control mismatch。
AI.method: 利用离线目标区域 DINOv2 对应关系定义平移、尺度和面内旋转的带符号四维伺服坐标。第一阶段让动作条件潜在转移与该坐标对齐；第二阶段冻结世界模型，训练反应式关节速度策略，结合动作模仿、后果监督和短时想象 rollout，偏好误差收缩。部署时仅用 RGB、反应式控制，无需在线轨迹优化。
AI.result: 在真实 7-DoF eye-to-hand 系统上，WM-VS 在 30/30 次试验中使角点 RMSE 不超过初始值的 10%，最终有效帧保持该标准的比例为 25/30（83.33%）。去掉未来误差对齐后，保持率降至 26.67%。学习到的进度信号与未用于训练或控制的 AprilTag 外部角点误差一致，平均 Spearman rho=0.8778。无需重新训练，两个未见 3D 目标分别实现平移误差降低 86.48% 和 90.27%，旋转误差降低 70.01% 和 65.70%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将动作后果与进度对齐可支持重复闭环校正和迁移，为闭环视觉伺服提供了有效的世界模型框架，代码和数据将开源发布。

title: Uncertainty-driven training for three-dimensional calibrated lung nodule classification
summary: In this work, we present an uncertainty-driven training framework for three-dimensional computed tomography (CT) lung nodule classification, where validation-based uncertainty estimates guide loss reweighting to enhance predictive performance and probability calibration. Two Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) methods are considered: Monte Carlo Dropout (MCD) and Evidential Deep Learning (EDL). Both provide per-class uncertainty estimates that modulate the loss and encourage focus on hard or unreliable classes. The framework is evaluated with ResNet, DenseNet, EfficientNet, Vision Transformer (ViT), and Swin Transformer backbones on two datasets: the clinical LIDC-IDRI cohort and the NoduleMNIST3D benchmark. Uncertainty-driven training achieves classification performance similar to conventional training while substantially improving calibration, with an expected calibration error (ECE) reduced by up to 65% on LIDC-IDRI. EDL attains competitive performance on shallower architectures with single-pass inference, whereas MCD is more robust on deeper networks. Analysis across architectural families reveals that uncertainty-driven training benefits convolutional backbones more consistently than transformer-based architectures: EDL in particular degrades on ViT, suggesting that the Dirichlet evidence parameterisation may interact unfavourably with attention-based architectures at lower input resolutions. A posteriori temperature scaling proves highly effective across all configurations, indicating that a simple scalar calibration can be competitive even without explicit uncertainty-aware training. Our results indicate that integrating UQ into the training loop can significantly improve probabilistic calibration and support more trustworthy deployment of three-dimensional medical imaging models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种不确定性驱动的3D CT肺结节分类训练框架，利用基于验证集的不确定性估计对损失进行重加权，以提升预测性能和概率校准。
AI.motivation: 3D CT肺结节分类模型需要可信的概率校准，而常规训练可能校准不足；将不确定性量化引入训练可促使模型关注难分类或不可靠类别，支持更可信的临床部署。
AI.method: 采用MCD和EDL两类不确定性量化方法，提供逐类不确定性以调制损失；在LIDC-IDRI和NoduleMNIST3D数据集上，使用ResNet、DenseNet、EfficientNet、ViT和Swin Transformer骨干进行评估，并比较后验温度缩放。
AI.result: 不确定性驱动训练在分类性能上与常规训练相近，但显著改善校准，LIDC-IDRI上ECE最多降低65%。EDL在浅层架构和单次推理下具竞争力，MCD在深层网络更稳健；卷积骨干比Transformer更稳定受益，EDL在ViT上退化；温度缩放对所有配置均有效。
AI.conclusion: 将不确定性量化整合进训练循环可显著改善概率校准，支持3D医学影像模型更可信部署；同时需注意架构与UQ方法的交互，简单标量校准仍具竞争力。

title: MemeTAG: Keyword-Driven Meme Classification through Tag Embedding Reconstruction
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures; published in the Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV), 2026
summary: The proliferation of harmful internet memes poses a significant societal threat, yet their automated classification remains a formidable algorithmic challenge due to the nuanced, multimodal nature of their content. To address this, we introduce MemeTAG, a novel dual-objective framework that pioneers a keyword-aware approach to meme classification. Our core innovation is a two-part semantic guidance mechanism: first, we leverage a pretrained Vision-Language Model to generate a set of descriptive keywords, that capture the high-level semantics. Second, we introduce the Aggregated Tag Inference Network (ATIN), an attention-based module that distills these keywords into a single, rich semantic embedding. This embedding serves as a target for a novel auxiliary reconstruction loss, which compels the model to learn deeply aligned visual and textual features. This approach, combined with an efficient three-stage training strategy, establishes a new state-of-the-art on the HarMeme, Hateful Memes Challenge (HMC), and PrideMM datasets, decisively outperforming existing state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 MemeTAG，一种面向有害网络模因分类的关键词感知双目标框架，在多个基准数据集上取得新的最优结果。
AI.motivation: 有害网络模因泛滥并构成社会威胁，但其内容具有多模态和语义细微的特点，导致自动化分类仍十分困难。
AI.method: 利用预训练视觉语言模型生成描述性关键词；提出基于注意力的聚合标签推理网络 ATIN，将关键词蒸馏为单一丰富语义嵌入；引入辅助重构损失，促使模型学习深度对齐的视觉与文本特征；并采用高效的三阶段训练策略。
AI.result: 在 HarMeme、Hateful Memes Challenge（HMC）和 PrideMM 数据集上达到新的 state-of-the-art，明显优于现有最优方法。
AI.conclusion: 关键词感知的语义引导机制与辅助重构损失能有效提升有害模因的多模态分类性能，验证了 MemeTAG 框架的有效性。

title: Adaptive Color Grading
summary: Independent control of tonescale regions (e.g., shadows, highlights) is essential for painters, photographers and cinematographers to bring 2D images to life. In image manipulation software this is most directly addressed by color grading modules, which use intensity thresholds to segment distinct illumination regions for local manipulation. In this work we develop an open source color grading tool and use it to annotate a large dataset of video frames with tonescale region thresholds. Using these thresholds we conduct modeling experiments with strategies based on both practitioners' conventional wisdom and machine learning. Results show that K-nearest neighbors is an effective prediction strategy, outperforming state-of-the-art end-to-end methods for image enhancement. This outcome demonstrates the benefit of focusing on a compact set of core parameters when modeling creative stylization processes. Our adaptive color grading interface and data are available at https://github.com/SamsungLabs/adaptive-color-grading.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个开源颜色分级工具，用于标注视频帧中的色调区域阈值，并比较传统经验与机器学习建模策略，发现K近邻在预测阈值上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 在绘画、摄影和电影制作中，独立控制阴影、高光等色调区域对增强2D图像表现力至关重要，而现有颜色分级模块依赖强度阈值分割光照区域进行局部调整。
AI.method: 作者开发开源颜色分级工具，用其标注大量视频帧的色调区域阈值；基于这些阈值，采用从业者传统经验和机器学习两种策略进行建模实验，并比较K近邻与端到端图像增强方法。
AI.result: 实验表明K近邻是一种有效的预测策略，优于当前最先进的端到端图像增强方法。
AI.conclusion: 在建模创造性风格化过程时，聚焦一小组核心参数是有益的。作者公开了自适应颜色分级界面和数据。

title: HERMES: Contrast-Aware Knowledge Graph Reasoning from Clinical Notes for Patient Outcome Prediction
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, The 15th Conference on Information Technology and its Applications
summary: Clinical predictive models often rely on structured Electronic Health Record data, such as time-series and procedure codes. While recent approaches have begun leveraging unstructured clinical notes, they typically encode them as flat sequences, which may lose explicit relational and temporal structure present in clinical narratives. In response, we propose HERMES, a graph-based framework that operates exclusively on clinical text while preserving clinical relationships. This approach builds on two key ideas. First, personalized Knowledge Graphs (KGs) are constructed through Large-Language-Model-guided extraction from clinical notes with Contrastive Logic Modeling that explicitly captures temporal dynamics and treatment failures and changes in outcomes. Second, a Graph Attention Network synthesizes patient representations through graph-based learning over the KGs. Experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV for in-hospital mortality and 30-day readmission prediction show that HERMES consistently outperforms strong text-only baselines. Our findings demonstrate that explicit relational modeling with Contrastive Logic Modeling significantly advances predictive performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HERMES，一个仅基于临床文本的图框架，通过构建个性化知识图谱并利用图注意力网络学习患者表示，用于临床预测任务，并在MIMIC-III/IV上优于纯文本基线。
AI.motivation: 现有临床预测模型多依赖结构化电子健康记录，或虽使用非结构化临床笔记但将其编码为扁平序列，可能丢失临床叙述中的显式关系和时间结构。
AI.method: HERMES包含两个核心：一是利用大语言模型引导从临床笔记中抽取个性化知识图谱，并结合对比逻辑建模显式捕捉时间动态、治疗失败及结局变化；二是使用图注意力网络在知识图谱上进行图学习，合成患者表示。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV的院内死亡率和30天再入院预测任务上，HERMES持续优于强纯文本基线。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过对比逻辑建模进行显式关系建模能显著提升临床预测性能。

title: Distribution-Free Budgeted Stealthy Attack Scheduling for Remote State Estimation
summary: This letter addresses budgeted stealthy false-data-injection (FDI) scheduling against remote state estimation, where a resource-constrained adversary may corrupt at most a fraction $\barΓ$ of transmissions. Existing event-triggered schedulers invert a Gaussian innovation tail to set the firing threshold and certify stealth by covariance matching; both are exact only under Gaussianity, which real cyber-physical residuals routinely violate. We propose a distribution-free scheduler pairing the worst-case FDI action with a split-conformal calibrated trigger, requiring neither the plant matrices nor any distributional model. We establish exact pathwise stealth against every magnitude-measurable detector, for any firing rule and innovation law; a finite-sample distribution-free bound on the mean firing rate, with almost-sure budget attainment under stationarity and ergodicity; and a steady-state degradation identity linear in a single scalar energy capture $ψ$, maximized by the same order statistic that delivers the budget guarantee. A conditional sign-symmetry condition delimits when the certificate extends to sign-sensitive detectors, the residual exposure being governed by a fourth cumulant that vanishes under Gaussian noise. Monte-Carlo studies and a heavy-duty truck CAN record confirm the bounds and quantify what the Gaussian assumption costs outside its regime.

AI.tldr: 本文研究资源受限对手在远程状态估计中最多污染比例 Γ̄ 传输的预算隐蔽 FDI 调度，提出不依赖分布和系统模型的分裂共形校准调度器，并给出隐蔽性、触发率预算与稳态性能退化保证。
AI.motivation: 现有事件触发调度器依赖高斯创新尾部反演阈值，并通过协方差匹配证明隐蔽，但这些结论仅在 Gaussian 假设下精确，而真实 CPS 残差常违反高斯性。
AI.method: 将最坏情况 FDI 动作与 split-conformal 校准触发阈值配对，无需已知系统矩阵或分布模型；并从理论上分析路径级隐蔽性、平均触发率、预算达到及稳态退化。
AI.result: 证明对任意幅度可测检测器具有精确路径隐蔽性；给出有限样本无分布平均触发率上界，并在平稳遍历下几乎必然达到预算；稳态退化线性依赖于能量捕获 ψ，且由同一次序统计量最大化；条件符号对称下可扩展至符号敏感检测器，残余暴露由四阶累积量控制，Gaussian 时消失。Monte-Carlo 与重型卡车 CAN 数据验证了边界。
AI.conclusion: 仿真和实测确认了理论边界，并量化了高斯假设在非高斯情形下带来的代价。

title: WS-NeRF: A Mamba-Driven World-State-Aware Adaptive Deblurring Neural Radiance Field
comment: Main paper (6 pages). Accepted for publication by IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics 2026 (IEEE SMC 2026)
summary: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) have attracted extensive attention in recent years due to their strong capability for high-quality 3D reconstruction and novel view synthesis from multi-view images. Existing methods usually rely on high-quality sharp inputs, while real-world image acquisition is highly susceptible to blur degradation, which severely affects the reconstruction quality of NeRF. In this paper, we propose a novel Mamba-driven world-state-aware adaptive deblurring neural radiance field, termed WS-NeRF, to address image degradation and 3D inconsistency. We formulate the alternating optimization of radiance fields as a dynamic evolution process with temporal memory, and jointly exploit comprehensive multi-dimensional world states and a mixture-of-experts mechanism to dynamically adjust the confidence of deblurring priors. Experimental results show that WS-NeRF significantly improves blurry radiance field reconstruction quality, achieving better performance on PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, while exhibiting more stable iterative recovery behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于Mamba、世界状态感知的自适应去模糊神经辐射场WS-NeRF，用于提升模糊输入下的三维重建与新视角合成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有NeRF方法通常依赖高质量清晰输入，但真实场景图像采集易受模糊退化影响，严重降低重建质量，并带来三维不一致问题。
AI.method: 将辐射场的交替优化建模为具有时序记忆的动态演化过程；利用Mamba驱动机制、综合多维世界状态以及混合专家机制，动态调整去模糊先验的置信度。
AI.result: 在模糊辐射场重建任务上显著提升质量，在PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS指标上取得更好表现，并展现出更稳定的迭代恢复行为。
AI.conclusion: WS-NeRF能够有效应对图像退化与三维不一致问题，提高模糊输入条件下NeRF的重建性能与稳定性。

title: AeRove: A Compact Bimodal Aerial-Terrestrial Drone with Rapid Bistable Reconfiguration for Close-Range Pipeline Inspection
summary: Close-proximity pipeline inspection is challenging for standard drones due to high hovering power consumption, airflow sensitivity, and propeller wash interference with gas sensing. To address this, we present AeRove, a compact bimodal aerial-terrestrial robot. AeRove uses its propeller guards as wheels to roll along pipes and employs a spring-loaded bistable mechanism to reconfigure between ground and flight modes in 200 ms without continuous actuator power to maintain either state. The converging propeller-guard geometry also improves measured thrust efficiency. By reserving flight for obstacle hopping and using ground rolling for continuous traversal, current draw is reduced 14x compared to continuous flight (0.7 A vs. 10 A), extending estimated travel distance from 144 m to 2057 m. Autonomous trials on a 51 cm diameter steel pipe demonstrated navigation on straight and curved sections, obstacle jumping, and leak detection of simulated inspection markers. Separate CO2 sensing experiments evaluated gas-detection performance under perched and aerial operating conditions. Perched inspection produced a substantially larger concentration response than hovering under the tested conditions. During flight, an underbody propeller-intake configuration produced a faster and stronger gas-detection response than an extended probe by leveraging propeller-induced airflow. Code and designs are released under the CC-BY license.

AI.tldr: AeRove 是一种紧凑型双模态空中-地面机器人，利用螺旋桨护罩作为轮子沿管道滚动，并通过弹簧加载双稳态机构在 200 ms 内切换飞行与地面模式，以降低巡检功耗并提升气体检测性能。
AI.motivation: 标准无人机在近距离管道巡检中面临悬停功耗高、气流敏感以及螺旋桨下洗气流干扰气体传感等问题，因此需要一种能兼顾地面连续移动和空中越障的巡检机器人。
AI.method: 将螺旋桨护罩设计为轮子用于管道滚动；采用弹簧加载双稳态机构实现地面与飞行模式切换，且维持状态无需持续驱动功耗；利用收敛型护罩几何提升推力效率；飞行仅用于越障，地面滚动用于连续行进；在 51 cm 直径钢管上开展自主导航、越障和泄漏检测试验，并单独进行 CO2 传感实验，比较栖停与悬停、机身底部螺旋桨进气与延伸探头配置。
AI.result: 地面滚动相比持续飞行将电流从 10 A 降至 0.7 A，降低 14 倍，估计行程从 144 m 延长至 2057 m；200 ms 内完成模式切换且无需持续驱动维持；自主试验实现直管和弯管导航、越障及模拟检测标记泄漏检测；CO2 实验中栖停检测响应明显大于悬停，飞行时底部螺旋桨进气配置比延伸探头响应更快更强。
AI.conclusion: AeRove 表明将地面滚动与空中越障结合可显著降低巡检功耗、延长行程，并通过栖停和螺旋桨诱导气流改善气体检测，适用于近距离管道巡检；代码和设计以 CC-BY 许可发布。

title: Attention-Aware Routing: Coupling Routing and Attention in MoEs
summary: In Mixture-of-Experts language models, the router typically selects and weights experts based on the token's hidden state, utilizing limited contextual information. We propose Attention-Aware Routing (AAR), which augments the router with temporal and spectral features extracted from a sliding window of attention weights that represent a summary of the model's contextual state, disentangled from the hidden state. Keeping the base transformer entirely frozen, we train only the routing parameters, isolating routing as the sole variable. AAR improves GSM8K by +3.37 pp over a routing-only SFT baseline on OLMoE. Beyond performance, we show that routing and attention form a coupled circuit: routing changes at layer l propagate through the residual stream to amplify attention sinks at layer l+1, reshaping attention without any direct update to the attention mechanism itself. Further, AAR reduces long diverging generation, with incorrect answers getting shorter, while correct answers remain unchanged in length. Finally, AAR is strongly depth-sensitive: applying it indiscriminately across layers can degrade factual retrieval, whereas mathematical reasoning gains persist when it is introduced deeper in the network. This sensitivity exposes a retrieval--reasoning tension across depth and makes layer-selective AAR a controlled probe of the routing-relevant information carried by attention at different layers.

AI.tldr: 论文提出注意力感知路由（AAR），利用注意力权重滑动窗口提取的时序与频谱特征增强MoE路由，在冻结基础Transformer、仅训练路由参数下提升GSM8K，并揭示路由与注意力的耦合关系及深度敏感性。
AI.motivation: MoE语言模型的router通常仅依据token隐藏状态选择并加权专家，所利用的上下文信息有限。
AI.method: 提出AAR：从注意力权重滑动窗口中提取时序和频谱特征，作为模型上下文状态的总结，并与隐藏状态解耦；保持基础Transformer冻结，仅训练路由参数。
AI.result: 在OLMoE上，AAR较仅路由SFT基线将GSM8K提升+3.37个百分点。路由与注意力形成耦合电路：第l层路由变化经残差流传播，放大第l+1层注意力汇，重塑注意力而不直接更新注意力机制。AAR减少长发散生成，错误答案变短，正确答案长度不变。AAR对深度敏感：在所有层 indiscriminately 应用可能损害事实检索，而数学推理增益在更深层引入时仍保持。
AI.conclusion: AAR体现检索与推理在深度上的张力，层选择性AAR可作为受控探针，研究不同层注意力所携带的路由相关信息。

title: Stochastic MPC under Heavy-Tailed Disturbances: An Extreme Value Theory Approach
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, submitted to Systems and Control Letter
summary: Safety-critical control systems must contend with disturbances whose extreme deviations occur far more frequently than classical light-tailed models predict. Existing stochastic MPC (SMPC) formulations tighten constraints using an assumed distribution, a moment bound, or a finite scenario sample, each of which degrades under an unknown heavy-tailed disturbance. This paper develops an SMPC formulation for linear systems under heavy-tailed disturbances that is only assumed to be regular varying, replacing these approaches with an explicit extreme value theory (EVT) characterization of the tube error tail that is asymptotically exact. We further show that closed-loop dynamics induce temporal clustering of rare excursions across the prediction horizon, and characterize this clustering through a closed-form extremal index estimable from data. The resulting $θ$-corrected constraint bounds the probability of a rare-event episode over the horizon, rather than only the marginal per-step exceedance probability. Simulation on a nonlinear unicycle navigating past an obstacle under Student-$t$ disturbances validates both approaches and demonstrates reduced frequencies of safety constraint violations.

AI.tldr: 本文针对未知重尾扰动下的线性系统，提出一种基于极值理论（EVT）的随机模型预测控制（SMPC）方法，并利用极值指数刻画稀有越界事件的时间聚集性，从而更准确地约束预测时域内的安全违规概率。
AI.motivation: 现有SMPC依赖假定分布、矩界或有限场景采样，在未知重尾扰动下性能退化；极端偏差比经典轻尾模型预测的更频繁，因此需要更精确的重尾扰动建模与安全约束方法。
AI.method: 假设扰动为正规变化重尾分布，用EVT对管道误差尾部进行渐近精确刻画；进一步分析闭环动力学导致的稀有越界时间聚集，并用可从数据估计的闭式极值指数θ进行校正，形成约束预测时域内稀有事件发生概率的θ校正边界。
AI.result: 在Student-t扰动下，非线性独轮车避障仿真验证了所提方法，表明安全约束违规频率降低。
AI.conclusion: 基于EVT和极值指数的SMPC能更有效处理重尾扰动，并比传统边际逐步超越概率约束更好地保障预测时域内的整体安全。

title: Image-Derived PM10 Estimation in Cattle Feedlot Using Machine Learning: Addressing Concentration Ranges Beyond Existing Digital Imaging Methods
summary: Affordable dust monitoring remains a pressing need for the cattle feedlot industry, yet camera-based PM estimation, despite its growing body of research in urban air quality settings, has not been evaluated under the extended concentration ranges characteristic of intensive livestock operations. This study developed an image-based approach using contrast panel features and machine learning to estimate PM10 concentrations in a commercial cattle feedlot, where hourly average PM10 ranged from 250 to 1,000 ug/m^-3 and instantaneous concentrations reached 5,000 to 20,000 ug/m^-3. Grayscale images were captured during the evening dust peak period, and features including panel contrast, black and white panel pixel values, and overall image brightness were extracted. The model also incorporated recent past values from preceding images and solar zenith angle as predictors. Among the candidate models evaluated, XGBoost achieved the highest predictive performance, with an R^2 of 0.792 and a median absolute error of 103 ug/m^-3. Feature importance analysis revealed that (a) panels positioned farthest from the camera contributed most strongly to predictions and (b) that black panel pixel values were more sensitive than white panel values to changes in PM10 concentration. Prediction accuracy during the sunset transition, which coincides with the onset of the feedlot evening dust peak, remains an area for further refinement. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of image-based PM10 estimation across PM concentration ranges substantially exceeding those reported in prior urban studies and provide practical guidelines for future deployment in feedlot environments.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一种基于图像对比面板特征和机器学习的PM10估计方法，用于商业牛饲养场，浓度范围远高于以往城市研究；XGBoost表现最佳，R²为0.792，中位绝对误差为103 µg/m³。
AI.motivation: 牛饲养场需要低成本的粉尘监测方案，而基于相机的PM估计虽在城市空气质量研究中逐渐增多，但尚未在集约化畜牧作业的高浓度范围下得到评估。
AI.method: 在商业牛饲养场傍晚粉尘高峰期间采集灰度图像，提取面板对比度、黑白面板像素值和整体亮度等特征，并加入前序图像近期值和太阳天顶角作为预测变量；比较多种机器学习模型，其中XGBoost预测性能最高，并进行特征重要性分析。
AI.result: 研究期间PM10小时均值范围为250至1000 µg/m³，瞬时浓度可达5000至20000 µg/m³；XGBoost取得R²=0.792和中位绝对误差103 µg/m³。特征重要性显示，距离相机最远的面板贡献最大，黑色面板像素值比白色面板值对PM10变化更敏感；日落过渡期即饲养场傍晚粉尘峰值开始时的预测精度仍有待改进。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明基于图像的PM10估计可适用于远超以往城市研究的PM浓度范围，并为未来在饲养场环境中的实际部署提供了实用指南。

title: Shake to Learn: Dynamic Interrogation of Hidden Object Physics for Robotic Manipulation with Physical Reservoir Computing
summary: Many physical properties relevant to robotic manipulation are hidden from vision. A sealed object, for example, may reveal little about its center of mass (COM) or internal contents until it is lifted, shaken, or otherwise dynamically perturbed. This study shows that such interactions can enable a new modality of robotic perception and learning, in which interaction-induced dynamic responses are used to infer object physics that is inaccessible to conventional sensing. We implement this idea using an origami-inspired soft robotic arm that functions as a physical reservoir computer. After grasping an object, the arm is excited by a fixed shaking input at its base, and the resulting ringdown response is recorded through either camera tracking or embedded sensors. Because the input is held constant across trials, hidden object properties, such as the COM position, are encoded through their effect on the dynamics of the coupled robot-object system. A lightweight linear readout can then decode these dynamics to recover interpretable information about the hidden object physics. Using this framework, the soft robotic arm reservoir completed three tasks of increasing difficulty: inferring the orientation of the object's hidden COM, inferring the COM distance from the grasp point, and using the inferred COM information to guide a subsequent regrasp. We further develop a dynamic summary representation of the ringdown response that improves prediction accuracy. Together, these results establish shake-to-learn mechanical interrogation as a promising strategy for robotic systems to convert brief physical interactions into actionable cues about hidden object properties for downstream manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用折纸启发软体机械臂作为物理储层计算机，通过固定摇晃输入和环形响应推断隐藏物体物理属性（如质心位置），并用于后续重抓取。
AI.motivation: 许多与机器人操作相关的物理属性无法从视觉中获取。例如，密封物体在被提起、摇晃或动态扰动之前，几乎无法揭示其质心或内部内容。因此，研究动机是通过交互引起的动态响应来推断传统传感无法获取的物体物理属性。
AI.method: 使用折纸启发的软体机械臂作为物理储层计算机。抓住物体后，在基部施加固定摇晃输入，通过相机跟踪或嵌入式传感器记录环形响应。由于输入恒定，隐藏物体属性（如质心位置）通过其对机器人-物体耦合系统动力学的影响被编码。然后使用轻量级线性读出解码这些动力学，恢复可解释的隐藏物体物理信息。还开发了环形响应的动态摘要表示以提高预测精度。
AI.result: 软体机械臂储层完成了三个难度递增的任务：推断隐藏质心的方向、推断质心与抓取点的距离、以及利用推断的质心信息指导后续重抓取。动态摘要表示提高了预测准确性。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果确立了“摇晃学习”机械询问作为一种有前景的策略，使机器人系统能够将短暂的物理交互转化为关于隐藏物体属性的可操作线索，用于下游操作。

title: CaLR: Causal Latent Revision for Robust Diffusion Reasoning
summary: Autoregressive (AR) models suffer from local greediness, while diffusion language models (DLMs) often lack the strict causal structure required for reasoning. To combine the advantages and overcome the drawbacks of the dual, we propose Causal Latent Revision (CaLR), a framework that reformulates reasoning as constrained latent optimization. By adopting a causal topology matrix (CTM) from an expert model and implicit differentiation, CaLR performs gradient-guided ``thought revision" to enforce logical consistency, enabling dynamic self-correction of intermediate steps during parallel generation. Empirically, CaLR achieves SOTA DLM performance on complex benchmarks, surpassing strong AR baselines and demonstrating superior robustness in constrained tasks like Sudoku.

AI.tldr: 提出Causal Latent Revision (CaLR)框架，将推理重构为受约束的潜在优化，结合自回归与扩散语言模型优势，实现并行生成中的动态自我纠错。
AI.motivation: 自回归模型存在局部贪婪问题，而扩散语言模型常缺乏推理所需的严格因果结构，因此需要结合二者优势并克服各自缺陷。
AI.method: 采用专家模型的因果拓扑矩阵（CTM）和隐式微分，进行梯度引导的“思维修订”，以强制逻辑一致性，并在并行生成过程中动态自校正中间步骤。
AI.result: 在复杂基准上取得SOTA的扩散语言模型性能，超越强自回归基线，并在Sudoku等约束任务中展现出更优鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CaLR能有效融合自回归与扩散语言模型的优势，提升扩散模型在复杂推理和约束满足任务中的表现，表明受约束潜在优化可增强并行生成的自校正能力。

title: TALON: A Temporally Aware Longitudinal Framework for Radiology Report Generation
summary: Current radiology report generation (RRG) models usually produce descriptive reports based on a single examination or only the most recent prior examination, limiting their ability to perform accurate and meaningful longitudinal comparisons and detect subtle interval changes. Although recent approaches have begun to incorporate multiple prior examinations, they usually aggregate a fixed-length history without explicitly modeling the role-dependent relevance of each prior examination before fusion. To address this, we propose TALON, a Temporally Aware LONgitudinal RRG framework that adaptively integrates variable-length patient histories. The underlying Dual-Channel Temporal Fusion Module (DCTFM) compares the current examination with each prior examination through complementary similarity and change channels to capture persistent findings and interval changes, respectively. The specially designed channel-specific attention estimates the relevance of each prior examination, while a learned prior-specific gate adaptively integrates informative longitudinal evidence and suppresses redundancy. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR show that TALON outperforms the current state-of-the-art method on various clinical efficacy and graph-based metrics. When more prior examinations become available, TALON's performance on these metrics improves even further, emphasizing the strength of TALON's DCTFM in modeling longitudinal RRG across longer and more complex patient histories than existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出TALON，一种时间感知的长纵向放射报告生成框架，通过双通道时序融合模块自适应整合变长病史，在MIMIC-CXR上超越当前最优方法。
AI.motivation: 现有放射报告生成模型通常只基于单次检查或最近一次既往检查，难以进行准确的纵向比较并检测细微间隔变化；已有方法虽引入多次既往检查，但多聚合成固定长度历史，未在融合前显式建模各既往检查的角色依赖相关性。
AI.method: TALON框架包含双通道时序融合模块DCTFM：通过相似性和变化两个互补通道，将当前检查与每个既往检查比较，分别捕捉持续发现和间隔变化；采用通道特定注意力估计每个既往检查的相关性；并利用学习的既往特定门控自适应整合有效纵向证据、抑制冗余。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-CXR数据集上，TALON在多种临床效能和基于图的指标上优于当前最先进方法；当可用既往检查更多时，这些指标进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: TALON的DCTFM能有效建模纵向放射报告生成，并在比现有方法更长、更复杂的患者病史中展现优势。

title: Minimizing Bid Cost Recovery for Energy Storage with Uniform Pricing
comment: Accepted to the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC 2026)
summary: We study in-market uniform pricing and out-of-market bid cost recovery (BCR) payments in rolling-window dispatch for real-time power system operations with energy storage resources (ESRs). Due to intertemporal state-of-charge (SOC) constraints, ESR operations are temporally coupled, and existing in-market locational marginal pricing (LMP) may fail to compensate ESR's intertemporal opportunity costs, thereby triggering out-of-market BCR payments. We show that positive BCR is unavoidable when dispatched generators or ESRs have supply-side bids higher than the demand-side bid. We further identify an intertemporal coupling indicator associated with binding SOC constraints and demonstrate empirically that positive BCR arises only when this indicator is active, revealing that BCR is fundamentally driven by intertemporal coupling. In the simulation, we compare a BCR-minimizing uniform pricing scheme (UP-BCR) with existing real-time pricing methods under forecast uncertainty and show that UP-BCR substantially reduces BCR and demand payments relative to LMP while maintaining zero merchandising surplus in a copper-plate model.

AI.tldr: 本文研究含储能资源（ESR）的实时电力系统滚动窗口调度中，市场内统一定价与市场外投标成本回收（BCR）支付问题，并提出UP-BCR统一定价方案以降低BCR和需求支付。
AI.motivation: ESR受荷电状态（SOC）跨时段约束影响，其运行具有时间耦合性，现有LMP可能无法补偿ESR的跨时段机会成本，从而引致市场外BCR支付。
AI.method: 分析市场内统一定价和市场外BCR支付；证明当被调度发电机或ESR的供给侧报价高于需求侧报价时正BCR不可避免；识别与SOC约束绑定相关的跨时段耦合指标；在预测不确定性下将BCR最小化统一定价方案（UP-BCR）与现有实时定价方法进行仿真比较。
AI.result: 正BCR仅在该跨时段耦合指标激活时出现，表明BCR根本上由跨时段耦合驱动；在铜板模型仿真中，UP-BCR相对于LMP显著降低了BCR和需求支付，同时保持零 merchandising surplus。
AI.conclusion: BCR问题源于ESR跨时段SOC约束导致的时间耦合，UP-BCR能在维持市场结算平衡的同时有效减少BCR和需求支付。

title: Opportunistic Conditional Entropy Coding with Frozen Analysis and Synthesis Transforms
summary: In many delivery settings, a receiver may already hold a lower-quality or lower-resolution representation of an image, obtained through an independent transmission. Conventional codecs encode a subsequently requested higher-quality representation without exploiting this incidental side information, whereas conditional codecs generally assume a prescribed source of side information that is always available. We instead consider an opportunistic setting in which side information may or may not be present. We introduce a single entropy model that conditions on a previously decoded latent when available and falls back to a standard hyperprior otherwise. The proposed adapter maps the side-information latent to the prior signal required by the entropy model, allowing the same model to support multiple target and side-information quality combinations. The analysis and synthesis transforms remain frozen, enabling retrofitting of an existing learned codec while preserving its latent representation and reconstruction path. When the receiver holds the quality immediately below the target, the proposed method reduces the rate of the subsequent transmission by up to 46%, or by 52% when an additional hyper-latent is transmitted. In the absence of side information, the rate penalty remains below 4%, and the reconstructions are bit-identical across the conditional and fallback modes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种机会性条件图像编码方法，当接收端已有低质量图像作为边信息时利用其降低后续传输码率，否则退化为标准超先验编码，且重建结果与条件模式完全一致。
AI.motivation: 传统编解码器在接收端偶然持有低质量图像时不会利用这一边信息，而条件编解码器通常假设边信息始终存在。实际场景中边信息可能时有时无，因此需要一种能自适应利用机会性边信息且不牺牲无侧信息时性能的方案。
AI.method: 提出单一熵模型：当先前解码的潜在表示可用时以其为条件，否则回退到标准超先验。设计适配器将边信息潜在表示映射为熵模型所需的先验信号，从而同一模型支持多种目标质量与边信息质量组合。分析与合成变换保持冻结，可对现有学习型编解码器进行改造，同时保留其潜在表示与重建路径。
AI.result: 当接收端持有的质量恰低于目标质量时，所提方法将后续传输码率最多降低46%；若额外传输超潜在表示，则最多降低52%。在无侧信息时，码率惩罚低于4%，且条件模式与回退模式的重建结果比特级完全相同。
AI.conclusion: 该机会性条件编码框架能有效利用可选的边信息，在低质量图像可用时显著节省码率，同时在边信息缺失时几乎不损失性能，并支持对现有学习型编解码器的即插即用式改造。

title: Fragment-Aware Vision Transformers for Fresco-Fragment Style Classification
summary: Artistic style classification is usually studied on complete artworks, where models can exploit global composition, spatial organisation, and iconographic structure. In archaeological settings, however, artworks often survive only as fragmented remains, forcing recognition from incomplete, irregular, and context-limited visual evidence. We study fresco-fragment style classification using a progressive transformer-based framework. Starting from a ViT-B/16 baseline, we introduce foreground-guided masking to suppress background-only tokens, inpainting-based geometric regularisation to align irregular fragment supports with the ViT patch grid, and a supervised contrastive objective that operates on predictive distributions through a Kullback-Leibler similarity and consistently improves every branch. We combine the branches with a deliberately simple learnable logit ensemble. Experiments on CLEOPATRA and POMPAAF show that fragment-aware modelling improves over the standard ViT baseline, with the ensemble increasing accuracy from 0.604 to 0.656 and macro-F1 from 0.596 to 0.648 on CLEOPATRA, and outperforming the best single branch in four of six fragmentation settings on POMPAAF. We additionally evaluate a more complex graph-fusion variant and find that it matches the simple ensemble on POMPAAF while offering only a small, dataset-specific gain on CLEOPATRA, which does not justify its added complexity. Beyond these empirical gains, our contribution is twofold: a distribution-level contrastive objective that consistently sharpens single-branch recognition, and an interpretability analysis that verifies the models exploit genuine painted evidence, while quantifying that the inpainting-based branch draws part of its attribution from the synthesised surround.

AI.tldr: 本文研究考古壁画碎片（fresco fragment）的艺术风格分类问题。由于碎片往往不完整、形状不规则且缺乏上下文，作者提出一个渐进式 Transformer 框架，在 ViT-B/16 基础上结合前景引导掩码、基于修复（inpainting）的几何正则化以及分布级对比学习，并采用简单的可学习 logit 集成。在 CLEOPATRA 与 POMPAAF 数据集上，碎片感知建模优于标准 ViT 基线。
AI.motivation: 传统艺术风格分类通常基于完整艺术品，模型可利用全局构图、空间组织与图像志结构；但在考古场景中，艺术品往往只以碎片形式留存，视觉证据不完整、不规则且上下文受限，因此需要专门针对碎片特性的识别方法。
AI.method: 以 ViT-B/16 为基线构建渐进式 Transformer 框架，包含三个分支：（1）前景引导掩码，抑制仅含背景的 token；（2）基于 inpainting 的几何正则化，使不规则碎片支撑区域与 ViT 的 patch 网格对齐；（3）监督对比目标，通过 KL 相似度作用于预测分布。三分支以刻意简单的可学习 logit 集成方式组合，并与更复杂的图融合（graph-fusion）变体进行对比。
AI.result: 在 CLEOPATRA 上，集成将准确率从 0.604 提升至 0.656，macro-F1 从 0.596 提升至 0.648；在 POMPAAF 的六种碎片化设置中有四种优于最佳单分支。图融合变体在 POMPAAF 上与简单集成持平，在 CLEOPATRA 上仅取得数据集相关的微小提升，不足以证明其额外复杂度合理。
AI.conclusion: 碎片感知建模相比标准 ViT 基线有稳定提升，简单的 logit 集成已足够有效。本文的两点核心贡献为：一是分布级对比目标能持续锐化单分支识别性能；二是可解释性分析验证模型确实利用了真实的绘画证据，同时量化出 inpainting 分支的部分归因来自合成填补区域。

title: LoRA Enhanced Contrastive Learning with SAS Vision Transformers
summary: Automatic target recognition (ATR) with synthetic aperture sonar (SAS) supports advanced naval capabilities, but deep learning is constrained by scarce target imagery, background clutter, and human-in-the-loop assessment. We adapt DINOv3 Vision Transformer (ViT) models to underwater SAS ATR using a three-stage parameter-efficient framework. Stage 1 uses Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) while freezing the ViT backbone, bridging the gap between natural-image pretraining and underwater acoustic propagation. Stage 2 uses hard-negative mining to strengthen the decision boundary against acoustic mimics, including rocks and sediment formations resembling man-made targets. Stage 3 uses Supervised Contrastive Learning (SupCon) to separate target and clutter representations. We evaluate at-sea SAS data using a mission-level geographic split, compare all arms at 85 percent test recall, and repeat each comparison over three random seeds. LoRA accounts for the primary effect, increasing area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) from 0.300 to 0.679 +/- 0.027 using the same frozen backbone. Rank 4 achieves this result while training only 0.26 percent of weights. Neither refinement stage exceeds its matched control: hard-negative mining changes AUPRC by -0.0045 +/- 0.0119 versus an equal-size random curriculum, and SupCon changes AUPRC by +0.0002 +/- 0.0096 versus the preceding stage. These null results indicate that mining occurred on data the encoder had already fit and that supervised stages had already imposed most target-clutter geometry. One efficient adaptation stage is sufficient; stacked refinement is not.

AI.tldr: 该论文将DINOv3 ViT模型用于合成孔径声呐自动目标识别，提出三阶段参数高效适配框架，发现仅LoRA适配即可显著提升性能，后续硬负样本挖掘和监督对比学习未带来额外增益。
AI.motivation: 水下SAS目标识别对海军能力很重要，但目标图像稀少、背景杂波强且依赖人工评估，深度学习应用受限，因此需要高效的迁移适配方法。
AI.method: 采用三阶段框架：第一阶段冻结ViT骨干，仅用LoRA适配自然图像预训练与水下声学传播之间的差距；第二阶段用硬负样本挖掘增强对岩石、沉积物等声学混淆物的决策边界；第三阶段用监督对比学习分离目标与杂波表示。在海上SAS数据上按任务级地理划分评估，在85%测试召回率下比较各分支，并用三个随机种子重复。
AI.result: LoRA是主要有效因素，将AUPRC从0.300提升到0.679±0.027，且Rank 4仅训练0.26%权重。硬负样本挖掘相比等规模随机课程使AUPRC变化-0.0045±0.0119，SupCon相比前一阶段变化+0.0002±0.0096，均未超过匹配对照。
AI.conclusion: 后续精炼阶段无效，说明挖掘发生在编码器已拟合的数据上，且监督阶段已基本塑造了目标-杂波几何结构。因此一个高效适配阶段已足够，堆叠式精炼并非必要。

title: From Discharge Notes to Patient Understanding: Persona-Grounded, Open-Ended Simulation of LLMs as Discharge Educators
summary: Hospital discharge education is an interactive teaching task: a clinician adapts a discharge plan to a patient's literacy, recall, and personality. Existing LLM evaluations target static or artifact-generation tasks and do not measure patient understanding under open-ended dialogue. We introduce DischargeBench, a persona-grounded simulation in which a candidate LLM educator conducts a multi-turn session with a Virtual Patient, while an Education Monitor Agent regulates patient realism without modifying the educator, protecting the evaluation signal. We curate MIMIC-IV-Ext-DischargeBench, 477 cases over 24 ICD chapters with persona axes (personality, education level, health literacy, past-medical-history recall) for stratified analysis. Each simulation is scored on four axes -- Conversation Quality, Topic Checklist, Comprehension, and Factual Consistency -- by an LLM-as-a-Judge aligned against physician annotations. Across closed- and open-source LLMs, aggregate scores conceal clinically relevant variation across ICD chapters and patient personas; difficult personas expose coverage failures, comprehension gaps, and reduced source-answer agreement. LLM evaluation for discharge education should center patient understanding, not text quality or answer accuracy alone.

AI.tldr: 提出DischargeBench，一个基于虚拟病人的模拟评估框架，用于评估LLM在医院出院教育中的表现，强调患者理解而非文本质量或答案准确性。
AI.motivation: 出院教育是互动教学任务，需临床医生根据患者的识字水平、记忆力和性格调整出院计划。现有LLM评估多针对静态或生成任务，无法衡量开放式对话中患者理解程度。
AI.method: 引入DischargeBench：候选LLM教育者与虚拟患者进行多轮对话，教育监测代理在不修改教育者的情况下调节患者真实性，保护评估信号。构建MIMIC-IV-Ext-DischargeBench，包含477个病例、24个ICD章节，并设置性格、教育水平、健康素养、既往病史回忆等人设轴。每个模拟由LLM-as-a-Judge从对话质量、主题清单、理解、事实一致性四个维度评分，并与医生标注对齐。
AI.result: 在闭源和开源LLM上，总体分数掩盖了ICD章节和患者人设间的临床相关变异；困难人设暴露了覆盖失败、理解差距以及源-答案一致性降低的问题。
AI.conclusion: 针对出院教育的LLM评估应聚焦患者理解，而不仅仅是文本质量或答案准确性。

title: PIVOT: Physically Informed Vision-Language Off-Road Traversability for Field Robot Navigation
summary: Terrain assessment is a critical capability for off-road mobile robots, enabling safe and reliable navigation through unstructured and geometrically complex environments. Conventional geometry-based terrain assessment is fast to compute but often overly conservative in unstructured environments. We present PIVOT: a Physically Informed Vision-Language Off-Road Traversability navigation system that augments conventional geometry-based planning with vision-language-model (VLM)-based semantic reasoning for field robots. To physically ground this assessment, we quantify how strongly the VLM's predicted traversal energy cost, robot vibration, and wheel slip correlate with real-world measurements and introduce a unified traversability score that weights each modality by its prediction-measurement correlation. For efficiency, we design a two-level navigation architecture that retains geometry-based planning as the nominal mode and invokes semantic replanning only when that mode fails to find a path. Across five repeated closed-loop trials on a mixed-terrain route totalling around $6.4$ km, the proposed system increases overall autonomy from $59.6\%$ to $97.0\%$, reduces human interventions from $11$ to $3$, and increases the mean distance between interventions (MDBI) from $69.2$ m to $412.9$ m compared with geometry-only navigation. These results demonstrate that physically grounded VLM-based terrain assessment can substantially extend autonomous navigation beyond the limitations of geometry alone, while preserving efficient geometric planning as the nominal mode.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 PIVOT，一种物理信息引导的视觉-语言越野可通行性导航系统，用 VLM 语义推理增强传统几何规划，并在真实越野路线中显著提升自主导航能力。
AI.motivation: 传统基于几何的地形评估计算快，但在非结构化环境中往往过于保守，难以充分发挥越野移动机器人的自主导航能力。
AI.method: 将几何规划作为常规模式，并引入 VLM 语义推理；量化 VLM 预测的通行能量代价、机器人振动和车轮打滑与真实测量值的相关性；按各模态预测-测量相关性加权，构建统一可通行性评分；设计两级导航架构，仅当几何规划找不到路径时触发语义重规划。
AI.result: 在总长约 6.4 km 的混合地形路线进行 5 次重复闭环试验：整体自主率从 59.6% 提升至 97.0%，人工干预从 11 次降至 3 次，平均干预间隔距离（MDBI）从 69.2 m 提升至 412.9 m。
AI.conclusion: 物理信息引导的 VLM 地形评估可显著突破纯几何导航的局限，同时保留高效几何规划作为常规模式。

title: ForeTac-VLA: A Forecasting-Based Tactile-Vision-Language-Action Model for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, yet their reliance on visual perception limits robustness in contact-rich environments, where critical physical interaction states may not be visually observable. Existing tactile-enhanced VLA methods improve physical grounding using observed tactile feedback, but most remain largely reactive rather than explicitly modeling how contact may evolve. Therefore, we propose ForeTac-VLA, a forecasting-based tactile-vision-language fusion model that predicts future tactile states to guide action generation. Specifically, ForeTac-VLA encodes recent tactile observations into temporal representations and integrates them with vision-language features through bidirectional cross-attention. Further, a transformer-based forecasting module predicts multi-step future tactile states, enabling the model to reason jointly over observed and anticipated contact. Finally, the fused multimodal representations and predicted future tactile states are fed into the VLA backbone to condition action generation. To stabilize training, a ground-truth-to-prediction curriculum is employed when early forecasts are unreliable. Across four real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, ForeTac-VLA achieves an average success rate of 95%, outperforming the fine-tuned VLA model by 36.25 percentage points and state-of-the-art tactile-enhanced VLA baselines by over 22 percentage points. ForeTac-VLA also maintains strong performance under low-illumination and visually cluttered conditions. Video demonstrations can be found on https://foretac-vla.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出ForeTac-VLA，一种基于预测的触觉-视觉-语言融合模型，通过预测未来触觉状态来指导机器人动作生成，在四个真实接触丰富操作任务中平均成功率达95%。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型依赖视觉感知，在接触丰富环境中鲁棒性不足，因为关键物理交互状态可能无法视觉观测；现有触觉增强VLA方法多为被动反应式，未显式建模接触的演化过程。
AI.method: ForeTac-VLA将近期触觉观测编码为时序表示，通过双向交叉注意力与视觉-语言特征融合；使用基于Transformer的预测模块预测多步未来触觉状态，使模型能同时推理观测和预期的接触；将融合的多模态表示和预测的未来触觉状态输入VLA骨干网络以条件化动作生成；采用真实值到预测的课程学习稳定训练。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界接触丰富操作任务上，ForeTac-VLA平均成功率达95%，比微调VLA模型高36.25个百分点，比最先进的触觉增强VLA基线高22个百分点以上；在低光照和视觉杂乱条件下也保持强性能。
AI.conclusion: ForeTac-VLA通过显式预测未来触觉状态，有效提升了接触丰富环境下的操作鲁棒性和成功率，优于现有VLA及触觉增强基线，并在视觉条件不佳时仍表现良好。

title: Model-Based Iterative Reconstruction with View-Dependent Detector Displacements for Cone-Beam CT
summary: Detector shifting is used in industrial cone-beam computed tomography to reduce ring artifacts, but the resulting detector motion can vary nonuniformly across projection views and produce detector positions that cannot be represented by fixed offsets. Although analytical reconstruction can accommodate this motion, approaches that use projection interpolation or rebinning may limit spatial resolution and introduce artifacts. MBIR provides an alternative by representing the acquisition geometry explicitly within the reconstruction model. Existing separable distance-driven MBIR formulations assume fixed detector geometry across projection views and therefore cannot directly represent nonuniform motion in both detector dimensions, as this motion changes the voxel-to-detector mapping. We extend the separable distance-driven MBIR model to incorporate recorded horizontal and vertical detector displacements into the distance-driven overlap computation while leaving measured projections unchanged. Forward-projection validation achieved an NRMSE of 0.0338 across 1080 views. The proposed model achieved a 3D SSIM of 0.9404 and NRMSE of 0.0406, compared with 0.5396 and 0.1740 for fixed-detector MBIR. A second industrial dataset showed reduced structured artifacts compared with FDK.

AI.tldr: 该文针对工业锥束CT中探测器移位导致的非均匀二维运动，提出扩展的可分离距离驱动MBIR模型，将逐视图水平与垂直探测器位移纳入重建几何建模，从而提升重建质量并减少伪影。
AI.motivation: 探测器移位常用于减少工业锥束CT的环状伪影，但探测器运动在投影视图间可能非均匀变化，无法用固定偏移表示。现有可分离距离驱动MBIR假设探测器几何固定，难以显式建模两个方向的非均匀运动，而插值或重排方法可能降低空间分辨率并引入伪影。
AI.method: 扩展可分离距离驱动MBIR模型，在距离驱动重叠计算中纳入记录的水平与垂直探测器位移，以改变体素到探测器的映射，同时保持实测投影不变，并通过前向投影验证模型。
AI.result: 前向投影在1080个视图上的NRMSE为0.0338。所提模型达到3D SSIM 0.9404、NRMSE 0.0406，而固定探测器MBIR仅为0.5396和0.1740。第二个工业数据集显示，相比FDK，结构化伪影减少。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够显式表示非均匀二维探测器运动，改善工业锥束CT重建质量，并在实际数据中减少结构化伪影。

title: Detecting Hallucination in LLMs: Tracing the Topological Signatures of Impaired Context Sharing
summary: In this work, we examine the topology of information flow patterns within attention graphs to effectively distinguish hallucinated from non-hallucinated responses. We analyze the Forman-Ricci curvature to identify structural patterns indicating information bottlenecks in attention graphs. We then introduce a method that captures both semi-local and global information-flow characteristics of attention heads associated with hallucinated responses. We evaluate our approach extensively across several LLMs and established benchmarks. Empirical results demonstrate that our proposed single-pass approach provides consistent improvements over existing attention-based and multi-response baselines across two hallucination-detection benchmarks, while achieving competitive performance across diverse LLM architectures. Further analysis reveals that impaired context sharing among tokens during causal generation is strongly associated with hallucination occurrences in LLMs. In particular, hallucinated responses are consistently characterized by an over-reliance on self-attention, diffused context retrieval from earlier tokens, or information over-squashing, especially in the final transformer layer.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析注意力图中的信息流拓扑来区分幻觉与非幻觉回答，重点使用Forman-Ricci曲率识别信息瓶颈，并提出一种单次推理方法捕获与幻觉相关的注意力头半局部和全局信息流特征。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在区分LLM幻觉与非幻觉回答时仍有不足，需要从注意力图的信息流结构角度寻找更有效的检测信号，尤其是识别注意力中的信息瓶颈和上下文共享异常。
AI.method: 分析注意力图中的Forman-Ricci曲率以识别信息瓶颈；提出一种捕获幻觉相关注意力头的半局部与全局信息流特征的方法；在多个LLM和基准上进行广泛评估，并与基于注意力及多响应基线比较。
AI.result: 所提单次推理方法在两个幻觉检测基准上持续优于现有基于注意力和多响应基线，并在多种LLM架构上取得有竞争力的性能。分析发现，因果生成中token间上下文共享受损与幻觉强相关；幻觉回答常表现为过度依赖自注意力、从早期token扩散检索上下文，或信息过度压缩，尤其在最终Transformer层。
AI.conclusion: 注意力图的信息流拓扑能有效刻画和检测LLM幻觉，幻觉与上下文共享受损密切相关；所提方法在多个模型和基准上验证了其有效性与通用性。

title: Optimal Regret for Online Storage Control via Cumulative Policies
summary: We study online control of a scalar storage system with adversarial nonnegative arrivals, known retention coefficient, and convex costs depending on both state and action. Each action must respect current resource availability and is chosen before the current arrival and cost function are revealed. For the existing simplex disturbance-action policy class, we give an exact reparameterization by cumulative allocation fractions and a decay-weighted projected subgradient update. The resulting regret bound is independent of policy memory length. For fixed retention coefficient and cost constants, the controller achieves $O(\sqrt T)$ regret against the best fixed infinite-memory policy in this class, using $O(\log T)$ memory and arithmetic operations per round and one cost-subgradient query. A storage-specific block construction gives a matching lower bound against every causal feasible controller, including randomized controllers. Writing $τ=(1-α)^{-1}$, the minimax expected regret is $Θ(\sqrt T\min\{T,τ\}^{3/2})$ for every finite-memory simplex policy class and its infinite-memory extension, when $α\in[1/2,1)$, $T\ge4$, and the positive cost constants are fixed. This identifies the joint horizon and retention-time dependence for these policy benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 研究标量存储系统在对抗性非负到达和凸成本下的在线控制，提出一种基于累计分配分数重参数化与衰减加权投影次梯度的策略，实现与策略记忆长度无关的 O(sqrt(T)) 遗憾，并给出匹配下界。
AI.motivation: 存储系统在线决策需在到达与成本函数揭示前行动，且受资源可用性约束；已有 simplex disturbance-action 策略类的遗憾可能依赖记忆长度，需明确其在保留系数、时域和记忆限制下的最优性能。
AI.method: 对现有 simplex disturbance-action 策略类进行精确重参数化，使用累计分配分数表示策略；采用衰减加权投影次梯度更新；构造存储特定的分块下界，针对所有因果可行控制器（含随机控制器）证明匹配下界。
AI.result: 控制器对固定保留系数和成本常数取得 O(sqrt(T)) 遗憾，每轮仅需 O(log T) 记忆和算术操作、一次成本次梯度查询；下界表明，当 α∈[1/2,1)、T≥4 且正成本常数固定时，对每个有限记忆 simplex 策略类及其无限记忆扩展，极小极大期望遗憾为 Theta(sqrt(T) min{T,τ}^{3/2})，其中 τ=(1-α)^{-1}。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了记忆高效且阶数最优的在线存储控制算法，并刻画了遗憾对时域 T 与保留时间 τ 的联合依赖，为相关策略基准确立了极小极大最优性。

title: MAGIC: Marginal-Guided Compression with Optimal Transport for Efficient Visual Document Retrieval
summary: Recent visual document retrieval (VDR) systems such as ColPali use multi-vector page embeddings, in which patch-level vectors enable fine-grained evidence matching but incur substantial index storage and MaxSim scoring overhead. Post-hoc merging offers a practical route to efficient VDR by reducing this cost without retraining the retriever, but its uniform reconstruction objectives are poorly aligned with the sparse, non-uniform patch usage induced by late-interaction retrieval. Under aggressive compression, this misalignment can preserve rarely used patches while concentrating retrieval activity on too few retained representatives. To address this misalignment, we propose Marginal-Guided Compression with Optimal Transport (MAGIC), a training-free post-hoc compressor for efficient retrieval with frozen multi-vector embeddings. MAGIC derives a MaxSim-induced compression surrogate and optimizes it through a two-marginal entropic optimal-transport formulation, where a retrieval-demand source marginal prioritizes high-use patches and a balanced target marginal regularizes retained-facet usage. Across ViDoRe benchmarks, keep ratios, and retrieval backbones, MAGIC consistently outperforms strong post-hoc compressors, with particularly large gains in the aggressive-compression regime; component ablations verify the complementary effects of its two marginals. We release the code at: https://github.com/xandery-geek/MAGIC.

AI.tldr: 提出 MAGIC，一种无需训练的后处理压缩方法，用于多向量视觉文档检索，通过最优传输进行边缘引导压缩，降低索引存储和 MaxSim 评分开销，同时保持检索性能。
AI.motivation: ColPali 等 VDR 系统使用 patch 级多向量嵌入，能实现细粒度证据匹配，但索引存储和 MaxSim 评分开销巨大。现有后处理合并方法虽可免训练降本，但其均匀重建目标与晚期交互检索中稀疏、非均匀的 patch 使用模式不匹配，激进压缩下会保留少用 patch，并把检索活动集中在过少代表上。
AI.method: MAGIC 冻结多向量嵌入，无需训练。它推导 MaxSim 诱导的压缩代理目标，并用双边缘熵最优传输优化：检索需求源边缘优先高使用 patch，平衡目标边缘正则化保留 facet 的使用。消融实验验证两个边缘的互补作用。
AI.result: 在 ViDoRe 基准、不同保留率和检索骨干上，MAGIC 持续优于强后处理压缩器，尤其在激进压缩场景提升显著。
AI.conclusion: MAGIC 能有效缓解后处理压缩与晚期交互检索使用分布不匹配的问题，实现高效 VDR，并已开源代码。

title: Rate-cost Trade-offs in H-infinity Control with Initial State Uncertainty
summary: We consider the problem of H-infinity control in the presence of a digital communication channel between the observer and the controller and investigate the fundamental trade-off between the required communication data rate and H-infinity performance. The system follows linear dynamics and has no additive internal noise, so that the uncertainty is confined to the initial state. For the scalar system, using a deterministic time-zero covering argument, we establish a lower bound on the required data rate for a given H-infinity cost and demonstrate why logarithmic quantization (Elia, 2000) is a natural choice. We further develop an achievability scheme and show that, for the scalar system, its rate matches the converse asymptotically in the high-data-rate limit.

AI.tldr: 研究数字通信信道下观测器与控制器之间的H∞控制，揭示所需通信数据率与H∞性能之间的基本权衡。
AI.motivation: 通信带宽受限，需要明确给定H∞性能所需的最小数据率；系统为线性动态且无内部加性噪声，不确定性仅来自初始状态。
AI.method: 针对标量系统，采用确定性零时刻覆盖论证推导数据率下界，并分析对数量化的自然性；进一步设计可达编码与控制方案。
AI.result: 建立了给定H∞代价下所需数据率的下界；说明对数量化是自然选择；提出可达方案，并证明标量系统在高数据率极限下其速率渐近匹配下界。
AI.conclusion: 数字信道下的H∞控制存在基本速率-性能权衡；对数量化具有合理性，且所提方案在高码率下渐近最优。

title: Beyond WER: Entity and Disfluency Recall in Accented Conversational ASR
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 1 table, accepted at Interspeech 2026
summary: ASR systems optimised for Word Error Rate (WER) often miss named entities and filled pauses in accented conversational English, both critical for language-learning feedback. We present a three-stage pipeline for speakers from India, Indonesia, and Latin America: (1) heuristic SQL filters curating entity-rich training data at 2.8x the entity density of random sampling, (2) regional LoRA adapters fine-tuned on Qwen2.5-Omni-3B producing both verbatim and corrected transcripts in a single forward pass, and (3) a six-category error taxonomy validated by an LLM-based judge (83.8% agreement, 210 human-labelled samples). The pipeline achieves 80-85% entity recall (up from 53-55%), 76-86% filler recall (up from <5%), and 6-10% WER across 6k test utterances, outperforming Whisper and a commercial ASR on entity recall while matching a zero-shot 30B model with 10x fewer parameters. Paired bootstrap tests confirm that curation alone accounts for 2.8-4.2 pp of entity recall gain (p<0.0001).

AI.tldr: 提出一套三阶段 ASR 流水线，面向印度、印尼和拉美口音的会话英语，提升命名实体与填充停顿识别，同时保持较低 WER，以支持语言学习反馈。
AI.motivation: 优化 WER 的 ASR 系统常遗漏命名实体和填充停顿，而这两类信息对口音会话英语的语言学习反馈至关重要。
AI.method: 采用三阶段流程：(1) 用启发式 SQL 过滤筛选实体丰富训练数据，实体密度为随机采样的 2.8 倍；(2) 基于 Qwen2.5-Omni-3B 微调区域 LoRA 适配器，一次前向生成逐字与纠正转写；(3) 构建六类错误分类法，并用 LLM 评判验证，与 210 个人工标注样本达到 83.8% 一致性。
AI.result: 在 6k 条测试话语上，实体召回从 53-55% 提升至 80-85%，填充词召回从 <5% 提升至 76-86%，WER 为 6-10%；实体召回优于 Whisper 和商用 ASR，并以少 10 倍参数匹配零样本 30B 模型；配对 bootstrap 显示仅数据筛选即带来 2.8-4.2 个百分点实体召回增益（p<0.0001）。
AI.conclusion: 该三阶段流水线能有效改善口音英语 ASR 对命名实体和填充停顿的识别，并表明数据筛选与区域 LoRA 适配可显著提升语言学习相关反馈质量。

title: Do Spinning Radar Doppler Velocity Measurements Improve Vehicle Detection and Tracking?
summary: Spinning frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radars have been gaining popularity in autonomous vehicle perception on account of their robustness to adverse weather conditions and 360° field of view. Recently, scanning radars have also been shown capable of generating per-azimuth Doppler velocity. In this paper, we investigate whether these Doppler velocity measurements improve spinning radar vehicle detection and tracking performance. For detection, we estimate the ego motion and use it to undo the Doppler range distortion of the radar image before passing it to a network. For tracking, we propose a new way to estimate a per-vehicle velocity and use it as a prior for the tracker's motion model. Since Doppler-enabled spinning radar data is not available in any dataset with ground-truth dynamic object labels, our first contribution is an automatic labelling pipeline that uses an ensemble of fine-tuned off-the-shelf lidar detectors to label all 643 km of the Boreas Road Trip dataset. We then transfer detections to radar, and use over 250 km of vehicle-dense sequences as ground-truth training data. By training and evaluating two state-of-the-art detectors, we show that Doppler undistortion can improve detection accuracy by up to $2.37$ points on mean average precision. Furthermore, we show that the Doppler velocity prior can improve tracking accuracy by $13.68$ points on multi-object tracking accuracy (MOTA) versus the zero-velocity initialization baseline, while achieving $99.7\%$ of the MOTA obtained using ground-truth velocities as the prior.

AI.tldr: 本文研究旋转式FMCW雷达的逐方位多普勒速度测量能否提升车辆检测与跟踪性能，并提出利用多普勒信息进行去畸变和运动先验的方法。
AI.motivation: 旋转FMCW雷达因对恶劣天气鲁棒且具备360°视场，在自动驾驶感知中日益流行，且扫描雷达可提供逐方位多普勒速度，因此有必要验证这些多普勒测量是否有助于提升旋转雷达的车辆检测与跟踪。
AI.method: 检测方面，估计自车运动以消除雷达图像中的多普勒距离畸变，再输入网络；跟踪方面，提出估计每辆车速度并作为跟踪器运动模型先验的新方法。由于缺少带动态目标真值标签的多普勒旋转雷达数据，作者构建自动标注流程，使用微调的现成激光雷达检测器集成标注Boreas Road Trip数据集的全部643 km，再将检测结果迁移到雷达，并使用超过250 km车辆密集序列作为真值训练数据，训练和评估两种最先进检测器。
AI.result: 多普勒去畸变可将检测平均精度（mAP）最高提升2.37个点；多普勒速度先验可将多目标跟踪精度（MOTA）相较零速度初始化基线提升13.68个点，同时达到使用真值速度作为先验时MOTA的99.7%。
AI.conclusion: 多普勒速度测量能够有效改善旋转雷达的车辆检测与跟踪性能，所提出的去畸变和速度先验方法具有实用价值。

title: Decoupling Internal Representational Changes and Causal Importance in Fine-Tuned Large Language Models
summary: Fine-tuning has emerged as a widely adopted approach for adapting LLMs to a variety of downstream tasks. However, how it reshapes their internal mechanisms remains poorly understood. To address this, we investigate how fine-tuning alters internal representations in LLMs, including attention patterns and layer-wise activations, and examine whether these changes are linked to task-relevant components identified by EAP (e.g., attention heads and logit-level activations) that drive task performance. We find that EAP-identified components are concentrated within specific layers, indicating a degree of functional localisation in how models internalise task-specific behavior. Notably, the distribution of these components across layers is largely uncorrelated with the layers undergoing the most substantial representational changes during fine-tuning. Furthermore, we observe that overlap in EAP-identified components across tasks does not translate into cross-task performance transfer if the tasks are different in nature (e.g. classification vs. generative tasks). More specifically, fine-tuning on one task can lead to a degradation of performance on another when the two tasks exhibit a high degree of overlap in their EAP-identified components.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究微调如何改变LLM内部表示，并分析这些变化与EAP识别的任务关键组件之间的关系。
AI.motivation: 微调已被广泛用于适配LLM到下游任务，但其如何重塑模型内部机制仍缺乏理解。
AI.method: 作者考察微调后LLM的注意力模式和逐层激活变化，并使用EAP识别任务相关组件（如注意力头和logit级激活），进而比较这些组件与表示变化层及跨任务重叠情况。
AI.result: EAP识别的组件集中在特定层，表明存在一定功能定位；但这些组件的层分布与微调中表示变化最大的层基本不相关。跨任务的EAP组件重叠并不一定带来跨任务性能迁移，尤其当任务性质不同（如分类 vs. 生成）时；若两个任务在EAP组件上高度重叠，微调一个任务可能导致另一个任务性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 微调对LLM内部表示的重塑与任务关键组件并不简单对应，任务间组件重叠可能引发负迁移，提示需更细致理解微调机制与跨任务影响。

title: A Distributed Step-by-step Finite-time Consensus Design for Heterogeneous Battery Energy Storage Devices with Droop Control
summary: As all generators are distributed in different areas among large scale power systems, the cooperative manipulation of the multi-generator system cannot be done well without consideration of the distance information of the generators, A distributed step-by-step finite-time consensus scheme for the heterogeneous Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) is proposed in this paper, where the coordinated consensus can be come into reality within a limited time, which is appealing for the electrical engineering community. To be concrete, at first, all BESSs are classified into several clusters according to their locations, and in each cluster, there is an active leader in charge of information receiving from outside. Then after, in order to coordinate the multi BESSs, five inputs, which are function oriented, were used to achieve energy level balancing, active/reactive power sharing, and voltage/frequency synchronization of the multi BESSs. To be further, the frequency and voltage restoration to the nominal values of the main grid was made possible by the introduction of a virtual leader, which is actually an external leader. Compared with the centralized methods, this control scheme is entirely distributed, and each BESS only utilizes the information of its own and its neighbors. Besides, this control is robust to the load perturbation and the plug-and-play of the communication topology. Finally, some simulation experiments are executed on the modified IEEE 57-bus system to verify the suggested scheme.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向异构电池储能系统（BESS）的分布式逐步有限时间一致性控制方案，可在有限时间内实现多BESS协调，并通过改进IEEE 57节点系统仿真验证。
AI.motivation: 大规模电力系统中发电机分布在不同区域，若不考虑距离信息，多发电机系统难以实现良好协同控制；同时相比集中式方法，需要更分布式、快速且鲁棒的控制策略。
AI.method: 先按位置将BESS分簇，每簇设一个主动领导者负责接收外部信息；采用五个功能导向输入实现能量水平平衡、有功/无功功率共享以及电压/频率同步；引入虚拟外部领导者实现频率和电压恢复到主网额定值；控制完全分布式，各BESS仅利用自身及邻居信息。
AI.result: 该方案能在有限时间内实现协调一致性，实现多BESS的能量平衡、功率共享和电压/频率同步，并可恢复频率与电压至额定值；对负载扰动和通信拓扑即插即用具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所提分布式有限时间一致性控制方案有效，仿真实验在改进IEEE 57节点系统上验证了其可行性和优势。

title: SAGE: Schema-Guided LLMs for Grant Review
summary: Grant reviewers must apply detailed criteria to application forms, budgets, and supporting documents while producing assessments that colleagues can inspect. We present SAGE, Schema-Guided Aspect-Based Grant Evaluation, a system that translates a grant rubric into structured checks and links its judgements to evidence from the application package. We evaluate SAGE in two stages on 35 nonprofit grant applications. A post-factum comparison with 105 reviews from the original competition shows fair ordinal agreement (kappa = 0.29). The foundation then conducted a criterion-level re-review after inspecting SAGE, producing 202 assessments. In this assisted round, SAGE reached kappa = 0.58 and outperformed a one-prompt-per-criterion baseline (kappa = 0.33 on the common subset), with higher rank correlation and lower error. A claim-level audit further identifies confirmed, disputed, and unaddressed parts of the structured draft. SAGE operationalizes the review methodology by producing a detailed, evidence-linked, and auditable draft for expert correction.

AI.tldr: SAGE 是一个将资助评审标准转化为结构化检查，并把判断与申请材料证据关联的系统，用于生成可供专家审核和修正的评审草稿。
AI.motivation: 资助评审人员需要依据详细标准审查申请表、预算和支持材料，并给出可供同事检查的评估；因此需要一种结构化、可审计且证据可追溯的评审支持方法。
AI.method: 提出 SAGE（Schema-Guided Aspect-Based Grant Evaluation），将资助评审规则转化为结构化检查，并将判断链接到申请材料中的证据。在 35 份非营利资助申请上进行两阶段评估：先与原始竞赛的 105 份评审进行事后比较，再由基金会在查看 SAGE 后进行标准级复审并产生 202 份评估；同时与每标准单提示基线比较，并进行主张级审计。
AI.result: 事后比较中，SAGE 与原始评审达到中等序数一致性（kappa = 0.29）。在辅助复审轮中，SAGE 达到 kappa = 0.58，优于每标准单提示基线（共同子集上 kappa = 0.33），并具有更高排名相关性和更低误差。主张级审计还能识别结构化草稿中被确认、争议和未处理的部分。
AI.conclusion: SAGE 将评审方法操作化，能够生成详细、证据关联且可审计的评审草稿，供专家修正，从而支持资助评审流程。

title: MarsFM: Shading-Regularized Flow Matching for Martian Relief Estimation
summary: We present MarsFM, an image-conditioned latent flow-matching model for local Martian relief estimation from single-band HiRISE RED orthoimagery. The method combines a pretrained generative prior with stereo-derived geometric supervision and a differentiable Lunar--Lambert shading objective. Relief, normal, gradient, curvature, and ordinal terms constrain complementary aspects of terrain structure, while a positive-affine-invariant image comparison constrains rendered appearance. An evaluation comprising 2024 gathered patch records per integration-step count yields mean affine-aligned RMSE between 0.0935 and 0.0957 in normalized signed-log relief space for one to twenty Euler steps. These scores measure agreement with VAE-reconstructed references on positive-reference support. Their narrow range supports low-step inference under this protocol. Spatial, differential, and spectral diagnostics show broad terrain correspondence alongside smoothing, amplitude compression, and boundary mismatch. MarsFM provides a framework for combining learned terrain priors with image-based constraints; establishing improved physical terrain resolution requires matched baselines and independent high-resolution reference data. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/SuperComputer/mars_hirise_dtm_processed-6aa9b66ba461e07f; code: https://github.com/Marius-Juston/MarsRecon.

AI.tldr: MarsFM 是一个图像条件潜在流匹配模型，用于从单波段 HiRISE RED 正射影像估计局部火星地形起伏。它结合预训练生成先验、立体派生几何监督和可微 Lunar-Lambert 阴影目标，并用多种地形与外观约束进行训练。评估显示 1 至 20 步欧拉积分下 RMSE 为 0.0935 至 0.0957，范围较窄，支持低步数推理；诊断显示整体地形对应较好，但存在平滑、振幅压缩和边界不匹配。
AI.motivation: 从单波段火星正射影像估计局部地形起伏，需要结合学习到的地形先验与基于图像的物理约束，以弥补直接反演几何信息的困难。
AI.method: 提出 MarsFM：图像条件潜在流匹配模型；结合预训练生成先验、立体派生几何监督和可微 Lunar-Lambert 阴影目标；使用起伏、法线、梯度、曲率和序数项约束地形结构，并用正仿射不变图像比较约束渲染外观；在 1 至 20 个欧拉积分步下评估。
AI.result: 每个积分步数收集 2024 个 patch 记录，评估得到归一化 signed-log 起伏空间中平均仿射对齐 RMSE 为 0.0935 至 0.0957。这些分数衡量在正参考支撑上与 VAE 重建参考的一致性；较窄的范围支持该协议下的低步数推理。空间、微分和光谱诊断显示整体地形对应较好，同时存在平滑、振幅压缩和边界不匹配。
AI.conclusion: MarsFM 提供了一个结合学习地形先验与图像约束的框架；若要建立更好的物理地形分辨率，还需要匹配的基线和独立的高分辨率参考数据。

title: Iterative Single-Loop Coordination of Transmission and Distribution Systems and DER Aggregators with Limited Information Sharing
summary: The growing integration of DERs underscores the importance of unified coordination across TSO, DSO, and aggregator levels. This paper proposes a coordination method between TSO, DSOs and DER aggregators, based on a transparent, well-scalable, and decentralized single-loop iterative mechanism with limited information sharing. The approach enables iterative price-based coordination between adjacent levels, where the higher-level entities provide price signals and the lower-level ones respond with desired power schedules. The proposed method uses the proximal-gradient-based iterative co-optimization algorithm extended to a three-level case, which enjoys convergence characteristic of proximal algorithms. The performance of the proposed approach is compared with both a centralized formulation and a sequential reference formulation based on fixed transmission-level energy prices. The results demonstrate that the proposed coordination achieves outcomes very close to those obtained with the centralized formulation, while significantly improving performance relative to the sequential reference, particularly at higher levels of DER flexibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向TSO、DSO与DER聚合商的三层协调方法，采用透明、可扩展、去中心化的单循环迭代机制，在有限信息共享下实现基于价格的迭代协调。
AI.motivation: 随着分布式能源（DERs）占比不断提高，跨TSO、DSO和聚合商层级的统一协调变得愈发重要，但集中式优化面临信息共享和可扩展性限制。
AI.method: 提出相邻层级间基于价格的迭代协调机制：上层提供价格信号，下层反馈期望功率计划；采用近端梯度迭代协同优化算法，并将其扩展到三层场景，利用近端算法的收敛特性。
AI.result: 与集中式方法和基于固定输电级电价的顺序参考方法相比，所提协调方法的结果非常接近集中式优化，同时显著优于顺序参考方法，且在DER灵活性较高时提升更明显。
AI.conclusion: 所提去中心化单循环迭代机制能够在有限信息共享下实现接近集中式的协调效果，并具有良好可扩展性和收敛性，适合TSO-DSO-聚合商多层协调。

title: 4DGS-Fixer: Generative Sparse-View 4D Gaussian Splatting with Iterative Refinement Guided by Video Diffusion Priors
summary: This paper addresses the challenges of dynamic scene synthesis from sparse-view videos. Existing methods employ geometric priors, adaptive optimization, or density-control strategies to improve 4D Gaussian modeling under sparse observations.
