However, they cannot fundamentally resolve the ill-posed problem caused by insufficient observations and missing scene information. Moreover, sparse-view 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) often suffers from poor geometric initialization: with only a few input views, COLMAP typically reconstructs sparse and incomplete point clouds, leaving large scene regions without sufficient Gaussian support and making them difficult to recover through subsequent optimization. To address these limitations, we propose a novel iterative refinement framework based on a video diffusion model to improve the completeness and consistency of dynamic 4D scenes. Specifically, we first estimate multi-view depth maps and fuse them into dense point clouds to provide more complete geometric initialization for a dynamic 4DGS representation. We then employ a pretrained video restoration model to refine sequences rendered along novel camera trajectories at different time steps. The restored sequences serve as pseudo-supervision to regularize and iteratively refine the 4DGS representation. Experiments on a widely used benchmark dataset demonstrate that our method substantially outperforms existing baselines, achieving nearly a 2 dB PSNR improvement over the previous best-performing method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于视频扩散模型的迭代精炼框架，用于从稀疏视角视频合成动态4D场景，以提升场景完整性和一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏视角4D高斯泼溅方法依赖几何先验、自适应优化或密度控制，但无法从根本上解决观测不足和场景信息缺失导致的病态问题；同时，COLMAP在少视角下只能重建稀疏、不完整点云，导致大量区域缺乏足够高斯支撑，后续优化难以恢复。
AI.method: 首先估计多视角深度图并融合成稠密点云，为动态4DGS表示提供更完整的几何初始化；然后使用预训练视频修复模型，对不同时间步沿新相机轨迹渲染的序列进行精炼；最后将修复后的序列作为伪监督，正则化并迭代精炼4DGS表示。
AI.result: 在广泛使用的基准数据集上，该方法显著优于现有基线，相比此前最佳方法取得接近2 dB的PSNR提升。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，通过稠密几何初始化和视频扩散/修复模型提供的伪监督，可以有效改善稀疏视角下动态4D场景重建的完整性与一致性。

title: TinyCeNN-LM: Quality-Gated Conversion of Pretrained Attention with CeNN-Inspired Cellular-Recurrent Layers
summary: Replacing attention in a pretrained language model is a compatibility problem: a plausible substitute may alter representations expected by later layers. TinyCeNN-LM introduces a \emph{quality-gated post-training conversion} framework using CeNN-inspired cellular-recurrent layers with bounded local processing, compact recurrent memory, routing, fusion, and accept-or-rollback validation. Three implementations are studied: Integrated Memory, MemoryFusion, and PDelta3-GDN2-CLVR+Local32. Strict PDelta3 conversion accepts a layer only when representation and NLL criteria pass fixed thresholds. On SmolLM2-135M, layers 0-2 are accepted with cumulative $Δ\mathrm{NLL}=+0.01209$, while layer 3 is rejected despite acceptable NLL because representation fidelity fails. On Qwen3.5-0.8B, full-attention layers 3, 7, and 11 are accepted with final $Δ\mathrm{NLL}=+0.02073$. Integrated Memory keeps perplexity within $-0.07\%$ to $+0.93\%$ while reducing total cache by up to $6.01\%$. A sampled 200-item downstream sanity check gives $28.5\%$--$32.0\%$ overall accuracy for converted Qwen releases. The results support conservative, quality-gated structural conversion rather than universal attention replacement or speedup.

AI.tldr: 提出 TinyCeNN-LM，一种质量门控的后训练转换框架，用受 CeNN 启发的细胞循环层替换预训练语言模型中的注意力，并通过严格的表示与 NLL 验证决定是否接受转换。
AI.motivation: 在预训练语言模型中替换注意力本质上是兼容性问题：看似合理的替代层可能改变后续层所期望的表示，因此需要谨慎的验证机制来避免破坏模型行为。
AI.method: 采用质量门控的后训练转换框架，使用具有有界局部处理、紧凑循环记忆、路由、融合以及接受或回滚验证的细胞循环层。研究了三种实现：Integrated Memory、MemoryFusion 和 PDelta3-GDN2-CLVR+Local32；其中严格 PDelta3 转换仅在表示和 NLL 指标通过固定阈值时才接受该层。
AI.result: 在 SmolLM2-135M 上，第 0–2 层被接受，累计 ΔNLL=+0.01209，而第 3 层虽 NLL 可接受却因表示保真度不达标被拒绝。在 Qwen3.5-0.8B 上，全注意力层 3、7、11 被接受，最终 ΔNLL=+0.02073。Integrated Memory 将困惑度控制在 -0.07% 至 +0.93% 之间，同时总缓存最多减少 6.01%。对转换后 Qwen 版本进行 200 项下游抽样检查，总体准确率为 28.5%–32.0%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持采用保守的、质量门控的结构转换，而非普遍性的注意力替换或加速。

title: Project SCOUT: Interceptor Drone for Perimeter Defense
summary: The rapid proliferation of unauthorized unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) has created a growing need for robust, jamming-resistant counter-UAV systems for perimeter defense. This paper presents \textbf{SCOUT} (Spatial Computation for Optimized UAV Tracking), a ROS-integrated onboard perception and control framework for real-time aerial defense against incoming UAVs. SCOUT performs visual detection, target association, track filtering, and control command generation directly onboard the defender UAV, without relying on external sensing infrastructure or ground-station computation. To provide stable control inputs, the perception pipeline combines TensorRT-accelerated drone detection with ByteTrack-based association and a lightweight track-retention state machine. The state machine rejects abrupt target jumps and maintains short-term target continuity during temporary detection degradation, reducing unstable control responses caused by false detections or target switching. We evaluate the proposed architecture through an integrated hardware deployment executing a planar ``goalkeeping'' interception strategy. In this setting, the defender UAV tracks the incoming target and adjusts its motion to maintain a blocking configuration near the protected boundary. Real-world flight results show that SCOUT maintains valid target detections for 92.2\% of frames while operating at real-time onboard detection rates, demonstrating the feasibility of visual tracking and closed-loop control for UAV perimeter defense. A video demonstration of the end-to-end perimeter defense operation is available online. https://figshare.com/s/497befc033091fc0b84f

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SCOUT，一个集成ROS的机载感知与控制框架，用于实时无人机防御。它结合TensorRT加速的检测、ByteTrack关联和轻量级轨迹保持状态机，在真实飞行中实现了92.2%的有效检测率。
AI.motivation: 未经授权的无人机迅速增多，对鲁棒且抗干扰的反无人机周界防御系统需求日益增长。
AI.method: SCOUT框架在防御无人机上直接进行视觉检测、目标关联、轨迹滤波和控制命令生成。感知流程包括TensorRT加速的无人机检测、ByteTrack关联和轻量级轨迹保持状态机，状态机拒绝突变目标并保持短期连续性。通过硬件部署执行平面“守门”拦截策略进行验证。
AI.result: 真实飞行结果表明，SCOUT在实时机载检测速率下，92.2%的帧保持有效目标检测，证明了视觉跟踪和闭环控制用于无人机周界防御的可行性。
AI.conclusion: SCOUT展示了机载视觉跟踪与闭环控制用于无人机周界防御的可行性，并提供了在线视频演示。

title: SPARROW: Survival-POMCP for Adaptive Robot Routing, Observation, and Waiting
summary: Temporary obstacles that may block a robot's planned route create a sequential navigation problem: a robot must decide whether to wait for a blockage to clear, reroute, or acquire more information about the obstacle before acting. We formulate graph navigation among temporary obstacles as a partially observable semi-Markov decision process and introduce SPARROW, a belief-space planner built on Partially Observable Monte Carlo Planning (POMCP). SPARROW searches over traversal, observation, and finite-duration waiting actions while maintaining a particle belief over latent obstacle classes and clearance times. Class-conditioned survival models are learned online from both clearance observations and right-censored encounters where the robot reroutes before clearance is observed. A generative model simulates obstacle arrivals and clearances as each action unfolds, so the planner can account for blockages that may occur along alternative routes. We further introduce a value-of-learning criterion that trades the immediate cost of collecting labelled survival data against its expected reduction in future navigation regret. Across two simulation graphs and multiple obstacle-class settings, SPARROW reduces mean time-to-goal by 12-26% relative to OSCAR, a recent survival-based method for the same problem. On a physical mobile robot, SPARROW reduces mean time-to-goal by 20.5% relative to OSCAR while selectively observing, waiting, and rerouting as environment conditions change.

AI.tldr: 论文研究机器人在临时障碍物下的序贯导航问题，提出基于POMCP的信念空间规划器SPARROW，决定等待、绕行或获取更多信息，并在仿真和真实机器人上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 机器人规划路径中可能出现临时障碍，是否等待障碍清除、绕行或先观测获取信息，构成序贯决策问题，需要在不完全可观测条件下权衡导航时间与信息收集成本。
AI.method: 将临时障碍物下的图导航建模为部分可观测半马尔可夫决策过程，提出SPARROW规划器，基于POMCP在遍历、观测和有限时长等待动作上搜索，并维护关于潜在障碍类别和清除时间的粒子信念。在线学习类别条件生存模型，利用清除观测和未观测到清除即绕行的右删失遭遇。生成模型模拟障碍到达和清除。引入学习价值准则，权衡收集标注生存数据的即时成本与未来导航后悔的预期降低。
AI.result: 在两个仿真图和多种障碍类别设置下，SPARROW相比近期基于生存模型的OSCAR方法，平均到达目标时间减少12-26%。在物理移动机器人上，SPARROW相比OSCAR平均到达目标时间减少20.5%，并能随环境条件变化选择性地观测、等待和绕行。
AI.conclusion: SPARROW能有效处理临时障碍下的序贯导航，通过信念空间规划和在线生存学习，在仿真与真实机器人中均优于OSCAR，说明结合信息获取、等待与绕行决策可提升导航效率。

title: Reviser: Revision-Capable Text Generation via Autoregressive Cursor Actions
summary: Revision-capable generation is appealing because it can insert or revise earlier content, but many non-autoregressive and edit-based approaches obtain this flexibility through repeated sequence-level computation. We propose Reviser, a decoder-only Transformer that generates a response as a sequence of cursor-relative actions on a mutable canvas. At each step, Reviser predicts exactly one action token: INSERT(token), MOVE($Δ$), or STOP, and is autoregressive over edit-history actions rather than final text order. This design enables genuinely non-monotonic generation while preserving a simple next-action interface. On a continuation benchmark, Reviser is strongly preferred to SEDD and MDLM in our arena evaluations, and trajectory statistics confirm that the model performs frequent backward moves and mid-canvas insertions rather than merely emulating end-append decoding. Against size-matched autoregressive baselines, Reviser is competitive at both the 100M and 300M scales. Under our shared FLOPs convention, Reviser also requires substantially less inference compute than representative multi-pass refinement and diffusion-style baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 Reviser：一种 decoder-only Transformer，在可变画布上以光标相对动作序列生成回复。每步只预测 INSERT(token)、MOVE(Δ) 或 STOP，并按编辑历史而非最终文本顺序自回归，从而实现非单调生成。
AI.motivation: 具备修订能力的生成很有吸引力，因为可以插入或修改早前内容；但许多非自回归和基于编辑的方法需要通过反复的序列级计算来获得这种灵活性，代价较高。
AI.method: Reviser 使用可变画布和光标相对动作：每步预测一个动作 token，包括插入、移动和停止；模型自回归于编辑历史动作，而非最终文本顺序。论文在 continuation benchmark 上与 SEDD、MDLM 及同规模自回归基线比较，并分析轨迹统计和共享 FLOPs 约定下的推理计算。
AI.result: 在 arena 评估中，Reviser 显著优于 SEDD 和 MDLM；轨迹统计确认其频繁执行向后移动和画布中间插入，而非仅模拟末端追加解码。在 100M 和 300M 规模上，与同规模自回归基线相比具有竞争力；在共享 FLOPs 约定下，推理计算显著少于代表性多轮细化与扩散式基线。
AI.conclusion: Reviser 通过动作级自回归在可变画布上实现灵活修订式生成，同时保持简单的下一动作接口；结果表明其能兼顾生成质量与推理效率，是替代反复序列级计算方法的有力方案。

title: Can Agents Design Better Chips with a Higher Level Abstraction?
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly being explored for chip design, but most existing approaches operate directly at RTL. We ask whether agents can design better chips by leveraging higher-level abstractions. We compare Direct RTL Design, Agent-based HLS Design, Post-Compiler HLS Refinement, and Post-HLS RTL Refinement, and combine Agent-based HLS Design with Post-HLS RTL Refinement as Agent-based HLS with RTL Refinement (AHRR). We use FPGAs as a practical, easy-to-deploy platform for end-to-end evaluation, but note that the design-flow tradeoffs we study are largely independent of the target technology. Across a diverse 11-tasks benchmark suite, AHRR achieves a 2.6$\times$ geometric-mean speedup over Direct RTL Design across our benchmark suite. Case studies show that HLS distills design knowledge into abstractions that agents can leverage, while RTL refinement recovers lower-level optimization opportunities. Together, these results make AHRR a promising workflow for agentic chip design. The code and evaluation artifacts are available at https://github.com/ZijD/AHRR.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM智能体能否借助更高层抽象来设计芯片，提出将基于智能体的HLS设计与HLS后RTL精炼相结合的AHRR流程，并在11个任务的FPGA基准上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体用于芯片设计时大多直接在RTL层面操作，作者希望探究利用更高层抽象能否让智能体设计出更好的芯片。
AI.method: 比较直接RTL设计、基于智能体的HLS设计、编译器后HLS精炼、HLS后RTL精炼四种方式，并将基于智能体的HLS设计与HLS后RTL精炼组合为AHRR；使用FPGA作为端到端评估平台，在11个多样化任务上评测。
AI.result: AHRR在基准套件上相对直接RTL设计取得2.6倍几何平均加速；案例研究表明HLS能将设计知识蒸馏为智能体可利用的抽象，而RTL精炼可恢复低层优化机会。
AI.conclusion: AHRR是面向智能体芯片设计的一种有前景的工作流，代码与评估工件已开源。

title: Model-Free Control for Residential Heating: Deployment and Simulation of Nonlinear Data-Enabled Predictive Control
summary: Residential heating accounts for a large share of building energy use, and predictive control strategies can reduce it by anticipating rather than reacting to the room temperature alone. The usual manner of implementing predictive control, model predictive control (MPC), requires an accurate model of each individual residential unit for heating control. Obtaining this model is time-consuming to obtain manually or even impossible, and such models do not transfer across a heterogeneous building stock. Data-enabled predictive control (DeePC) removes this modeling step by designing the controller directly using measured trajectories of the system. The foundations of DeePC, however, are built on the class of deterministic linear time-invariant systems, which is an unrealistic assumption for residential heating. This work applies three recently proposed nonlinear extensions of DeePC, collectively referred to as data-driven predictive control (DPC): Select-DPC, gain-scheduling DPC, and linear parameter-varying DPC. These are compared against standard DeePC and the hysteresis controller, the industry standard in residential heating. The comparison runs over a full heating season on a calibrated digital twin of an occupied research unit, the NEST research building in Switzerland, assessed by heating energy and comfort-band violation. Moreover, gain-scheduling DPC was deployed on the real residential apartment and validated the conclusions from the simulations. Each of the DPC controllers consumes significantly less energy than the hysteresis controller, amounting to roughly $11\%$ over the season, validating the use of DPC. The nonlinear methods further outperform linear DeePC in all assessed scenarios, and we analyze the relative costs and benefits of each nonlinear method.

AI.tldr: 本文研究住宅供暖中的数据驱动预测控制（DPC），比较三种非线性DPC扩展与标准DeePC及行业常用滞环控制器的性能，并在瑞士NEST研究建筑的仿真与真实公寓中进行验证。
AI.motivation: 住宅供暖能耗占比高，预测控制可节能，但传统MPC需要为每个住宅单元建立精确模型，耗时且难以在异构建筑中迁移。DeePC虽免去建模，但其基于确定性线性时不变系统假设，不符合住宅供暖实际。
AI.method: 采用三种非线性DeePC扩展：Select-DPC、gain-scheduling DPC和线性参数变化DPC（统称DPC），与标准DeePC和滞环控制器对比。在瑞士NEST研究建筑中一个有人居住单元的校准数字孪生上，进行整个供暖季仿真，以供暖能耗和舒适带违反为指标；并将gain-scheduling DPC部署到真实住宅公寓验证仿真结论。
AI.result: 各DPC控制器相比滞环控制器在整个供暖季显著节能，约减少11%能耗。所有非线性方法在评估场景中均优于线性DeePC，并分析了各非线性方法的相对成本与收益。
AI.conclusion: 验证了DPC在住宅供暖中的有效性，非线性DPC相比线性DeePC更具优势，且gain-scheduling DPC在真实公寓中的部署支持了仿真结论。

title: Clinician-Grounded Quality Assurance for AI-Assisted Psychiatric Intake
summary: Before patients can use AI-assisted psychiatric intake systems, health systems need practical ways to routinely evaluate these tools against their clinical standards for quality assurance. Because clinicians may use different intake styles, evaluation for this task must (1) support comparison across interviewing approaches, (2) minimize clinician burden, and (3) measure clinically relevant performance for health systems deploying these technologies. We present a clinician-grounded evaluation platform built around a memory-augmented patient simulator for open-ended AI interviewing, InterviewPlayground. We created interactive patients using InterviewPlayground with our expert-authored vignettes, constructed a simulated intake platform for the interviews, and designed evaluation modalities relevant to intake. In a pilot of 6 clinicians in a 25-minute assessment compared to a GPT-based LLM intake interviewer, the LLM recovered more of the clinically relevant items embedded in the patient vignettes (88.0% vs. 38.9%), but made more clinical inferences not based on the interview (56.8% vs. 27.8%), and characterized identified safety concerns less often (33.3% vs. 66.7%), setting the stage for deployed quality assurance for this task.

AI.tldr: 提出并试点评估一个基于记忆增强患者模拟器的临床医生主导评估平台 InterviewPlayground，用于开放式AI精神科接诊访谈的质量保证。
AI.motivation: AI辅助精神科接诊系统在临床应用前，健康系统需要可常规对照临床质量标准进行评估的方法；且需兼容不同访谈风格、减少临床医生负担并衡量临床相关表现。
AI.method: 构建 InterviewPlayground：以专家撰写的情景病例生成交互式患者，搭建模拟接诊平台，设计接诊相关评估维度。6名临床医生在25分钟评估中与基于GPT的LLM接诊访谈者对比。
AI.result: LLM比临床医生恢复更多临床相关条目（88.0% vs 38.9%），但也产生更多非基于访谈的临床推断（56.8% vs 27.8%），且更少描述已识别的安全问题（33.3% vs 66.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 该平台为AI精神科接诊访谈的部署后质量保证奠定基础，但初步试点显示LLM在安全关切表述等方面仍需改进。

title: Towards Effective Visual-Inertial SLAM with Passive-Only Sensors for Low-Cost Autonomous Underwater Vehicles
summary: Improvements to Visual-Inertial Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (VI-SLAM) for low-cost autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) are critical for transitioning advanced marine robotics from specialized labs to broader research and hobbyist applications. While high-end AUVs typically rely on expensive sensor suites - such as Doppler Velocity Logs (DVLs) and Ultra-Short Baseline (USBL) systems - this work demonstrates that robust, high-quality navigation is achievable using a sub-$10, 000(USD) platform equipped only with inexpensive consumer-grade sensors. By leveraging a similarly priced, open-source AUV, we evaluate the performance of stereo cameras, Micro-electromechanical System (MEMS)-based IMUs, and depth sensors in a fully unconstrained 6-degree-of-freedom (6-DOF) underwater environment. We analyze the efficacy of off-the-shelf SLAM packages and propose optimizations for sensor fusion to mitigate the visual and physical challenges of untethered underwater operation. Our results prove that a usable SLAM solution can be accessible to the masses, providing a benchmark for expectations in demanding, real-time maritime missions without the financial barrier of industrial-grade hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文证明使用低于1万美元的消费级传感器平台可在水下实现可用的视觉惯性SLAM。
AI.motivation: 推动先进海洋机器人从专业实验室走向更广泛的研究和爱好者应用，高端AUV依赖昂贵传感器（如DVL和USBL），需要低成本替代方案。
AI.method: 使用开源AUV和消费级传感器（立体相机、MEMS IMU、深度传感器），在完全无约束的6自由度水下环境中评估，分析现成SLAM包，并提出传感器融合优化以应对水下视觉和物理挑战。
AI.result: 结果表明，仅用低成本平台即可实现稳健、高质量的导航，使SLAM解决方案能为大众所用。
AI.conclusion: 为要求苛刻的实时海洋任务提供了期望基准，消除了工业级硬件的财务障碍。

title: Recursive Language Models Generalize Out of Domain
summary: We study when limiting what a language model can see improves learning. We compare standard CoT, the more general learner that reads the full trace, with recursive language models, which restricts itself by solving each subtask in an isolated context. In-distribution, this generality comes for free: CoT can efficiently simulate the recursive rule, so the IID generalization guarantee changes only by a constant factor, and recursion does not offer much. But out of domain, CoT can fit training by relying on context outside the current subtask, i.e. a shortcut that breaks once those tokens change; recursive context isolation rules out this failure mode. Even though CoT's class still covers the recursive rule, simplicity bias picks the shortcut over the truth. Thus, to go beyond distributional accuracy and truly reason, covering the right rule is not enough; this contrasts with classical learning theory.

AI.tldr: 研究限制语言模型可见上下文何时有助于学习；比较标准 CoT 与递归语言模型，发现分布内差异小，分布外递归隔离可避免捷径，表明真正推理不仅需要覆盖正确规则，还需克服简单性偏差。
AI.motivation: 探究限制语言模型可见范围为何能提升学习，以及标准 CoT 的通用性与递归上下文隔离在分布外泛化上的差异。
AI.method: 理论比较标准 CoT（读取完整推理轨迹）与递归语言模型（将每个子任务放在隔离上下文中求解），分析 IID 与 OOD 泛化保证及简单性偏差。
AI.result: IID 下 CoT 可高效模拟递归规则，泛化保证仅差常数因子，递归优势不大；OOD 下 CoT 可利用当前子任务外上下文形成捷径，分布变化后失效，而递归隔离消除该失败模式；尽管 CoT 假设类覆盖递归规则，简单性偏差仍会选择捷径而非真规则。
AI.conclusion: 要超越分布精度并真正推理，仅覆盖正确规则不够，还需避免因简单性偏差选择捷径；这与经典学习理论不同。

title: Hand-Aware Transition Modeling for Bimanual Procedural Anomaly Detection
summary: Procedural anomaly detection in bimanual assembly requires judging each hand action against the execution so far. A corrective action may look unusual in isolation, while a visually plausible action can violate the order of the procedure. We present HACT, a transition model over predicted per-hand events. A role-preserving history keeps the concurrent responsibilities of both hands, and a marked temporal point process assigns each observed transition a semantic and temporal surprisal. A supervised evidence head and a two-state filter convert these surprisals into per-hand anomaly posteriors. A recovery-aware protocol on predicted events and participant-disjoint folds reports the recovery false-positive rate at an operating point selected on validation participants. On two bimanual power-tool procedures HACT has the highest AUPRC and F1 among the compared methods and the fewest recovery alarms. Applied without retraining to a different assembly order of the same product, it retains the highest AUPRC and F1. The source code is available at https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/HACT.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 HACT，一种面向双手装配过程异常检测的转移模型。它基于预测的单手事件，结合角色保持历史、标记时间点过程、监督证据头和双状态滤波器，输出每只手的异常后验。在两种双手电动工具装配流程上取得最高 AUPRC 和 F1，恢复报警最少，并能不重新训练地迁移到同一产品的不同装配顺序。
AI.motivation: 双手装配中的过程异常检测需要结合当前执行历史来判断每只手的动作。单独看可能正常的纠正动作，或视觉上合理的动作，都可能违反操作顺序，因此需要同时考虑双手职责、语义和时序异常。
AI.method: HACT 是一个基于预测单手事件的转移模型。它使用角色保持历史记录双手并发职责，并用标记时间点过程为每次观察到的转移分配语义和时序意外度；再通过监督证据头和双状态滤波器将这些意外度转化为每只手的异常后验。评估采用基于预测事件的恢复感知协议和参与者不相交折，并在验证参与者上选择操作点后报告恢复假阳性率。
AI.result: 在两个双手电动工具装配流程上，HACT 相比对比方法取得最高 AUPRC 和 F1，且恢复报警最少。将其不重新训练地应用到同一产品的不同装配顺序时，仍保持最高 AUPRC 和 F1。
AI.conclusion: HACT 能有效进行双手装配过程异常检测，并具有良好的跨装配顺序泛化能力；源码已在 GitHub 公开。

title: OnomatoBridge: Onomatopoeia Translation and Rendering Pipeline in Manga
summary: Manga is a comic drawn by black and white paints gaining popularity around the world. Onomatopoeia in Manga specifically appeals to the audience with its unique visual styles, which convey sound, motion, and emotion. Visual onomatopoeia translation requires the clean replacement of Japanese onomatopoeia with onomatopoeia in the other language while preserving their visual style. Existing approaches often produce residual artifacts or style inconsistency when removing the Japanese onomatopoeia and rendering stylized English onomatopoeia. To approach these problems, we present OnomatoBridge, a filtering pipeline for visual onomatopoeia translation. We evaluate OnomatoBridge from Japanese to English on the Manga109 onomatopoeia dataset and compare it with baseline image editing models. Experimental results show that the filtered outputs by the proposed method outperform those of conventional methods. OnomatoBridge improves English text correctness by roughly 10 to 25 points and reduces residual Japanese text by about 20 to 50% in relative terms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OnomatoBridge，一种用于视觉拟声词翻译的过滤流程，旨在将日语拟声词替换为英语拟声词并保持视觉风格。在Manga109数据集上，该方法优于基线图像编辑模型。
AI.motivation: 漫画中的拟声词具有独特的视觉风格，能传达声音、动作和情感。视觉拟声词翻译需要干净地替换日语拟声词并保留视觉风格，但现有方法在去除日语拟声词和渲染风格化英语拟声词时会产生残留伪影或风格不一致。
AI.method: 提出了OnomatoBridge，一个用于视觉拟声词翻译的过滤流程。在Manga109拟声词数据集上从日语到英语进行评估，并与基线图像编辑模型进行比较。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提方法过滤后的输出优于传统方法。OnomatoBridge将英语文本正确率提高约10到25个百分点，并将残留日语文本相对减少约20%到50%。
AI.conclusion: OnomatoBridge能有效改善视觉拟声词翻译中的文本正确性和残留问题，性能优于基线方法。

title: Response Time Stochastic Analysis for Fixed-Priority Stable Real-Time Systems
summary: In this paper, we prove that a mean system utilization smaller than one is a necessary condition for the feasibility of real-time systems. Such systems are defined as stable. Stable systems have two distinct states: a transient state, followed by a steady-state where the same distribution of response times is repeated infinitely for each task. We prove that the Liu and Layland theorem holds for stable probabilistic real-time systems with implicit deadlines, we provide an analytical approximation of response times for each of those two states and a bound of the instant when a real-time system becomes steady.

AI.tldr: 本文研究稳定概率实时系统，证明平均系统利用率小于1是系统可行性的必要条件，并给出瞬态与稳态响应时间的解析近似及进入稳态时刻的界。
AI.motivation: 实时系统可行性分析通常依赖利用率条件，但概率实时系统在瞬态与稳态下的响应时间行为仍需进一步刻画。
AI.method: 将实时系统定义为稳定系统，区分瞬态与稳态；证明稳定性与可行性条件；将Liu and Layland定理推广到带隐式截止期的稳定概率实时系统；给出两种状态下响应时间的解析近似以及系统进入稳态时刻的界。
AI.result: 证明平均系统利用率小于1是可行性的必要条件；稳定系统的响应时间分布最终会重复；Liu and Layland定理对稳定概率实时系统成立；获得瞬态和稳态响应时间的解析近似，并给出进入稳态时刻的上界。
AI.conclusion: 平均利用率条件与Liu-Layland结论可扩展至稳定概率实时系统，且可用解析方法近似响应时间并界定稳态到达时刻。

title: Catch Me If You Can: Real-Time Feedback Denoising for Responsive VLAs
comment: 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026), Austin TX, USA
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong generalization in robotic manipulation by combining semantic knowledge from pretrained vision-language models with expressive action-generation policies. Diffusion-based action generators are particularly effective for modeling temporally coherent action chunks, but these chunks are typically executed open-loop after inference. This limits responsiveness when objects move, contacts change, or the scene evolves during execution. We propose VLA-Feedback, a two-timescale architecture that combines low-frequency diffusion planning with high-frequency visual feedback. Rather than fully denoising an action chunk before execution, VLA-Feedback retains its final denoising step as a lightweight feedback interface, allowing each action to be corrected using the latest observation before it is executed. This design preserves the expressiveness of the diffusion planner while enabling real-time action correction without rerunning the full vision-language diffusion model. VLA-Feedback matched GR00T on static LIBERO tasks while improving average success on dynamic simulation tasks from 27.5% to 85.0%. On real-robot tasks, it improved average success from 51% to 73%. Additional materials can be found on our project page: https://vla-feedback.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出VLA-Feedback，一种双时间尺度架构，将低频扩散动作规划与高频视觉反馈结合，在执行前用最新观测修正每个动作，从而提升动态场景和真实机器人任务的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型中，基于扩散的动作生成器虽能生成时序连贯的动作块，但通常在推理后开环执行，难以应对执行过程中物体移动、接触变化或场景演变，导致响应能力受限。
AI.method: VLA-Feedback保留扩散规划最终去噪步作为轻量级反馈接口，使每个动作在执行前可根据最新观测进行修正；采用低频扩散规划与高频视觉反馈的双时间尺度设计，无需重新运行完整的视觉-语言-扩散模型。
AI.result: 在静态LIBERO任务上与GR00T表现相当；动态仿真任务平均成功率从27.5%提升至85.0%；真实机器人任务平均成功率从51%提升至73%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在保留扩散规划器表达能力和动作生成质量的同时，实现了实时动作修正，显著增强了动态环境和真实机器人任务中的鲁棒性与成功率。

title: TatBLiMP: A Benchmark of Linguistic Minimal Pairs for Tatar
summary: We introduce TatBLiMP, the first benchmark of linguistic minimal pairs for Tatar (tt, ISO 639-3 tat), a Qypchaq Turkic language written in Cyrillic. To our knowledge it is the first grammaticality evaluation for Tatar language models of any kind, since even the 101-language MultiBLiMP does not include Tatar. TatBLiMP covers 16 morphosyntactic phenomena in 1248 sentence pairs. Each pair differs by a single morpheme, one grammatical and one ungrammatical. A model passes a pair when it assigns higher probability to the grammatical member. Scoring compares probabilities the model already assigns, so the benchmark needs no text generation and no parser, and it runs on base models and on mid-training checkpoints. TatBLiMP adapts the phenomenon inventory and single-morpheme breaking operations of TurBLiMP to Tatar and adds one phenomenon specific to Tatar, bare-noun number after numerals and quantifiers. The grammatical member of every pair is an attested sentence from Tatar literary prose. The ungrammatical member is produced by a deterministic single-morpheme perturbation with the apertium-tat transducer. Every pair is ratified by a native speaker. A plausibility principle governs construction, so the ungrammatical member is a plausible real-world error rather than an arbitrary corruption. Across from-scratch Tatar models, cross-lingual adaptations, and frontier multilingual LLMs, the benchmark tracks focused Tatar training rather than parameter scale. A 478M from-scratch model and a 125M monolingual model lead near 0.97, a 7B adaptation trails, frontier LLMs of 30-120B parameters fall to 0.80-0.92, and a lightly tuned multilingual model is weakest. We close with the benchmark's main limitation. Its inherited taxonomy omits the morphophonology, vowel harmony and consonant assimilation, that is most salient to native speakers, and we sketch a native second layer that would add it.

AI.tldr: 提出TatBLiMP，首个鞑靼语（Tatar）语言最小对立对基准，覆盖16种形态句法现象、1248对句子，用于评估语言模型的语法性，无需文本生成或句法分析器。
AI.motivation: 鞑靼语此前缺乏任何语法性评估基准，连覆盖101种语言的MultiBLiMP也未收录鞑靼语；需要一种可直接比较模型概率、适用于基础模型和中间检查点的评估工具。
AI.method: 改编TurBLiMP的现象清单与单语素破坏操作，新增鞑靼语特有现象（数词/量词后裸名词的数）；语法句取自鞑靼语文学散文，非语法句由apertium-tat进行确定性单语素扰动生成，并由母语者审核；通过比较模型对语法与非语法句子的概率进行评分，遵循合理性原则确保非语法句为合理的真实错误。
AI.result: 基准能追踪针对鞑靼语的训练程度而非参数规模：478M从头训练模型和125M单语模型接近0.97，7B适配模型落后，30-120B前沿多语言LLM降至0.80-0.92，轻度微调的多语言模型最弱。
AI.conclusion: TatBLiMP可作为鞑靼语语法性评估的有效基准，但其继承的分类体系遗漏了母语者最关注的形态音系（元音和谐、辅音同化），论文提出构建原生第二层来补充这些现象。

title: Transsion's Speaker-Attributed Multilingual ASR System for the MLC-SLM 2026 Challenge
summary: This paper presents the Transsion Speech Team submission to Task 1 of the MLC-SLM 2026 Challenge, which focuses on speaker-attributed transcription for multilingual conversational speech. We propose a cascaded framework consisting of three components: a speaker diarization module, a long-form multilingual ASR module, and a speaker-transcription fusion module. The diarization module is built upon DiariZen and produces speaker-homogeneous segments through local speaker activity estimation and global speaker clustering. The ASR module is based on Qwen3-Omni and generates multilingual transcriptions, while an external CTC-based alignment model provides precise word- and character-level timestamps. Finally, the fusion module combines diarization outputs with timestamped transcriptions to generate speaker-attributed STM outputs. Experimental results on the official evaluation set demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework. The submitted system achieves a tcpMER of 15.41% and ranks second among all participating teams.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 Transsion Speech Team 参加 MLC-SLM 2026 Challenge Task 1 的系统，任务为多语言对话语音的说话人属性转写。系统采用级联框架，在官方评测集上取得 tcpMER 15.41%，排名第二。
AI.motivation: 面向多语言对话语音中同时进行说话人分离与语音转写的需求，解决说话人属性转写这一挑战任务。
AI.method: 提出三级级联框架：基于 DiariZen 的说话人日志模块生成说话人同质片段；基于 Qwen3-Omni 的长语音多语言 ASR 模块生成转写；外部 CTC 对齐模型提供词级和字符级时间戳；最后融合模块结合日志输出与带时间戳转写，生成说话人属性 STM 输出。
AI.result: 在官方评测集上验证了框架有效性，提交系统取得 15.41% 的 tcpMER，并在所有参赛队伍中排名第二。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的级联说话人属性转写框架能够有效处理多语言对话语音，并取得具有竞争力的性能。

title: Multi-viewpoint Geo-localization with Event Cameras
summary: Robot localization is an ongoing challenge that demands mapping and positioning systems that are tolerant to viewpoint change. Event cameras are attracting increasing interest and adoption in robotics; however, dealing with viewpoint variance is an under-investigated problem in existing event-based localizers. In addition, event-based datasets that emphasize viewpoint variance for challenging localization situations are scarce. Here, we introduce an event-based visual place recognition (VPR) system that performs robustly under viewpoint changes. We converted five large-scale geo-tagged datasets, conventionally used to train frame-based localization systems, into synthetic event streams using Image-to-Event (I2E) conversion, and used them to fine-tune a pre-trained event-based vision transformer backbone with a multi-loss function, yielding a system we call MegaEvent that learns viewpoint-robust features for place recognition. We achieved an average Recall@1 of 82% across three existing event-based localization datasets, leading the next best event-based method by 20 recall points, and frame-based VPR models applied directly to event frames by 8 to 26 recall points. We introduce a new, challenging dataset - Springfield-Event-VPR - which features a 3.7km walking route recorded in three camera orientations for a total of 11.1km, which MegaEvent outperforms the strongest baseline by 9 recall points. The code for MegaEvent is available at https://github.com/AdamDHines/megaevent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MegaEvent，一种对视角变化鲁棒的事件相机视觉位置识别（VPR）系统。作者将五个大规模地理标记数据集转为合成事件流，微调预训练事件视觉Transformer，并在现有事件定位数据集和新数据集Springfield-Event-VPR上验证了其优越性能。
AI.motivation: 机器人定位需要容忍视角变化的建图与定位系统。事件相机在机器人领域日益受关注，但现有事件定位器对视角变化的鲁棒性研究不足，且强调视角变化的挑战性事件数据集稀缺。
AI.method: 使用Image-to-Event（I2E）转换，将五个常用于训练帧基定位系统的大规模地理标记数据集转为合成事件流；用多损失函数微调预训练的事件视觉Transformer骨干网络，得到MegaEvent，学习用于位置识别的视角鲁棒特征。
AI.result: 在三个现有事件定位数据集上平均Recall@1达82%，比次优事件方法高20个召回点，比直接用于事件帧的帧基VPR模型高8至26个召回点。新提出的Springfield-Event-VPR数据集包含3.7km步行路线、三种相机朝向，总计11.1km，MegaEvent比最强基线高9个召回点。
AI.conclusion: MegaEvent能够有效实现视角鲁棒的事件基视觉位置识别，并显著优于现有事件基和帧基方法；同时，Springfield-Event-VPR为挑战性视角变化下的定位研究提供了新基准。代码已开源。

title: Adaptive Uncertainty-Aware Modeling and Stochastic Radial Basis Function Predictive Control for Personalized Fluid Resuscitation
summary: This paper presents a novel framework integrating Bayesian physiological modeling with optimal control strategies to achieve uncertainty-aware, personalized hemodynamic regulation during fluid resuscitation. An uncertainty-aware variational autoencoder state-space model (UVAE-SSM) was first developed to capture the dynamical relationship between mean arterial pressure (MAP) and fluid infusion using limited data, while explicitly modeling aleatoric uncertainty (i.e., randomness in the measurements, such as sensor noise). Then, a Bayesian nonlinear state-space model (BNSSM) was developed by utilizing Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) to capture epistemic uncertainty arising from physiological and patient-specific variability, enabling the creation of a virtual patient generator (VPG). Building on this uncertainty-aware modeling framework, a stochastic radial basis function model predictive control (sRBF-MPC) algorithm was designed to track the MAP target while satisfying physiological constraints. Finally, an online fine-tuning algorithm was developed to adapt the nominal UVAE-SSM using streaming VPG data, enabling progressive personalization during closed-loop therapy. Simulation results across unseen animal subjects and an independent human clinical dataset demonstrated the strong predictive accuracy and cross-population generalizability of the UVAE-SSM and BNSSM models. Closed-loop evaluations confirmed that the proposed sRBF-MPC framework achieved stable MAP regulation while providing better risk-aware control compared to quadratic MPC (Q-MPC) and stochastic quadratic MPC (sQ-MPC). Overall, the proposed framework accounts for inter- and intra-patient variability through online model adaptation, offering a promising step toward uncertainty-aware, personalized hemodynamic modeling and control in critical care.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个集成贝叶斯生理建模与最优控制的框架，用于液体复苏中实现不确定性感知、个性化的血流动力学调控。
AI.motivation: 液体复苏中患者间和患者内生理差异、测量噪声及模型不确定性会影响平均动脉压（MAP）调控的安全性和个性化，因此需要能够显式建模不确定性并在线适应的建模与控制方法。
AI.method: 首先开发不确定性感知变分自编码器状态空间模型（UVAE-SSM），利用有限数据捕捉MAP与输液之间的动态关系并建模偶然不确定性；随后构建贝叶斯非线性状态空间模型（BNSSM），使用贝叶斯神经网络（BNN）建模认知不确定性并生成虚拟患者（VPG）；在此基础上设计随机径向基函数模型预测控制（sRBF-MPC）以跟踪MAP目标并满足生理约束；最后提出在线微调算法，用流式VPG数据自适应名义UVAE-SSM，实现闭环治疗中的渐进个性化。
AI.result: 在未见动物受试者和独立人体临床数据集上的仿真表明，UVAE-SSM和BNSSM具有较强预测准确性和跨群体泛化能力；闭环评估显示，sRBF-MPC可实现稳定的MAP调节，并且相比二次型MPC（Q-MPC）和随机二次型MPC（sQ-MPC）具有更好的风险感知控制性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过在线模型适应处理患者间和患者内变异，为重症监护中不确定性感知、个性化的血流动力学建模与控制提供了有前景的解决方案。

title: SpecOpt: Contact-Diff Reasoning for Agentic Molecule Optimization Toward Binding Specificity
summary: Off-target protein binding is a major source of adverse effects for small-molecule drugs, yet most structure-based molecular design methods focus on generating selective compounds de novo rather than improving the selectivity of existing, well- characterized drugs. We introduce specificity optimization (SpecOpt), a molecular design task that seeks constrained structural modifications to an existing compound that increase its binding preference for an intended target over known off-targets while preserving its structural identity and drug-like properties. To enable systematic evaluation, we construct a ChEMBL-derived benchmark from compound-target interaction data, identifying intended targets through curated drug-mechanism annotations and off- targets through measured activities. We then develop an agentic framework that docks each compound against its intended target and off-targets, compares the resulting poses through residue-aware atom-protein contacts, and provides these differential interactions to a large language model to propose targeted structural modifications. Candidates are retained only if they satisfy molecular similarity, ADMET, and target-off-target docking selectivity criteria. On 915 compounds, the agent improves the target- off-target binding gap for 84.8% of compounds, shifting the mean gap from -0.72 to +0.47 kcal/mol while maintaining a mean Tanimoto similarity of 0.72 to the starting compounds. Ablation studies identify residue-specific contact information as the critical optimization signal: replacing residue identities with binary contact indicators eliminates improvement on all 29 ablation compounds. These results establish SpecOpt as a distinct molecular design problem and demonstrate residue-aware differential interactions as an effective signal for improving the specificity of existing compounds.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SpecOpt 任务，即对已有药物进行受约束的结构修饰，以提升其对目标靶标相对于已知脱靶靶标的选择性，同时保持结构相似性和成药性；并开发了一个基于对接、残基感知接触比较和大语言模型的智能体框架。
AI.motivation: 脱靶蛋白结合是小分子药物不良反应的主要来源，但大多数基于结构的分子设计方法侧重于从头生成高选择性化合物，而非改善已有且表征充分的药物的选择性。
AI.method: 构建 ChEMBL 衍生基准，利用药物机制注释确定 intended target、实测活性确定 off-target；开发智能体框架，将化合物与目标靶标及脱靶靶标对接，通过残基感知的原子-蛋白接触比较构象差异，并交给大语言模型提出针对性结构修饰；候选物需满足分子相似性、ADMET 和靶标-脱靶对接选择性标准。
AI.result: 在 915 个化合物上，该方法使 84.8% 的化合物目标-脱靶结合差距得到改善，平均差距从 -0.72 kcal/mol 提升至 +0.47 kcal/mol，同时与起始化合物的平均 Tanimoto 相似度为 0.72。消融实验表明，残基特异性接触信息是关键优化信号：将残基身份替换为二值接触指标后，所有 29 个消融化合物均无改善。
AI.conclusion: SpecOpt 被确立为一个独立的分子设计问题，残基感知的差异相互作用可作为提升现有化合物特异性的有效信号。

title: Adapting Rigid-Body Dynamics Derivatives for Constraint Embedding Closed-Chain Models
summary: This paper extends an existing algorithm for the first-order derivatives of rigid-body dynamics to the case of closed-chain kinematic systems modeled using constraint embed- ding. Many standard dynamics algorithms apply to both open- chain and constraint-embedded models, but existing efficient derivative methods assume joint velocity effects are locally config- uration invariant. We remove this assumption and derive adapted algorithms that extend dynamics derivatives to more general joint types, including those arising in constraint-embedded closed- chain models. Our results compare conventional pin-joint robot models with more complete actuation models that capture local closed chains. We show that the additional terms introduced by these generalizations have low computational impact when mod- eling actuation kinematics alone, but can incur higher cost when additional rigid bodies, such as motor rotors, are included in the actuation chain, or when considering non-local loops. Overall, these results enable more accurate dynamics computations for constraint-embedded actuation submechanisms to be adopted in model-predictive control and differentiable simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文将刚体动力学一阶导数算法推广到使用约束嵌入建模的闭链运动系统，并分析其计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有高效动力学导数方法假设关节速度效应在局部构型下不变，无法直接适用于更一般的关节类型和约束嵌入闭链模型；而模型预测控制与可微仿真需要更准确的动力学计算。
AI.method: 移除局部构型不变假设，推导适配算法，将动力学导数扩展到一般关节类型及约束嵌入闭链模型，并比较传统销轴关节模型与包含局部闭链的更完整驱动模型。
AI.result: 广义化引入的额外项在仅建模驱动运动学时代价较低；但当驱动链包含额外刚体（如电机转子）或考虑非局部闭环时，计算成本会更高。
AI.conclusion: 该工作使约束嵌入驱动子机构能进行更准确的动力学计算，可应用于模型预测控制和可微仿真。

title: Distributed Multiconsensus Control of BESSs Based on Centrality of Eigenvectors
summary: Secondary control and the State-of-Charge (SoC) balance control are important control objectives for battery energy storage systems (BESSs). In this brief, a communication weight allocation method based on the centrality of eigenvectors is designed for a connected and directed graph, which results in the adjacency matrix having a given eigenvector. Subsequently, a distributed secondary voltage controller and an SoC balancing controller are designed for droop-controlled BESSs to achieve voltage leader-following multiconsensus and SoC balancing, respectively. It is worth mentioning that under the designed voltage secondary control scheme, only a single leader is needed to achieve voltage multiconsensus control. In addition, the capacity information/droop coefficient does not need to be transmitted in the communication network to achieve power sharing according to capacity and SoC balance. For SoC balance control, the control gain is also well analyzed to ensure stability. The relevant simulations verify the effectiveness of the designed scheme.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于特征向量中心性的通信权重分配方法，并为下垂控制的电池储能系统设计分布式二次电压控制器与SoC平衡控制器，实现电压多共识和SoC平衡。
AI.motivation: 二次控制和SoC平衡是电池储能系统的重要控制目标，同时希望减少通信需求，例如仅需单个领导者且无需传输容量信息或下垂系数。
AI.method: 针对连通有向图，基于特征向量中心性设计通信权重分配，使邻接矩阵具有给定特征向量；在此基础上为下垂控制BESS设计分布式二次电压控制器和SoC平衡控制器，并对SoC控制增益进行稳定性分析。
AI.result: 所提方案可实现电压领导者跟随多共识和SoC平衡；电压二次控制仅需单个领导者，且无需在通信网络中传输容量信息/下垂系数即可按容量实现功率分配和SoC平衡；仿真验证了方案有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该分布式控制方案能够有效完成BESS的二次电压恢复与SoC平衡，并降低通信网络对领导者数量和参数传输的要求。

title: Implicit Rule Induction with Test-Time Task Embeddings in ARC-like Tasks
summary: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus and related benchmarks evaluate whether AI models can solve novel reasoning tasks, but often leave unclear whether success reflects inference of the intended underlying rule or reliance on shortcuts. We address this gap by studying test-time task embeddings in Vision ARC (VARC), a model in which a pre-trained backbone is complemented by a trainable embedding representing the transformation rule. In the original VARC, test-time training (TTT) is jointly applied to the backbone and task embedding. Here we introduce a novel two-step TTT protocol: first finetune only the task embedding (Embed-TTT), then freeze it and finetune the backbone. Across ARC-AGI-1, ConceptARC, and two controlled datasets with known rules, Embed-TTT consistently yields improved task embeddings, ones that align better with underlying task rules, improve embedding-based retrieval, and enable accurate linear probing of known rules. Qualitatively, Embed-TTT identifies more semantically meaningful relations between test and train tasks on ARC-AGI-1. We also show that optimizing only task embeddings (less than 0.01% of model parameters) already solves a non-trivial fraction of ARC-AGI-1, ConceptARC, and Mini-ARC tasks, while the full two-step pipeline improves final performance. Finally, we show that Embed-TTT recovers the underlying geometric structure of parametric rules and learns compositional capabilities that enable rule-wise interpolation, but not extrapolation. These findings support a clearer separation between rule induction and rule execution in ARC-like evaluations, motivating benchmarks that better distinguish in-distribution from out-of-distribution rules.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 Vision ARC（VARC）中的测试时任务嵌入，提出一种两步测试时训练协议：先仅微调任务嵌入（Embed-TTT），再冻结嵌入并微调骨干网络，以更好区分规则推断与规则执行。
AI.motivation: ARC 及相关基准测试难以判断模型成功是真正推断了底层规则，还是依赖捷径；因此需要更清晰地分离规则归纳与规则执行。
AI.method: 在 VARC 中引入两步 TTT：第一步仅训练代表变换规则的任务嵌入（Embed-TTT），第二步冻结该嵌入并微调预训练骨干网络。并在 ARC-AGI-1、ConceptARC 及两个已知规则的控制数据集上评估嵌入质量、检索、线性探测和规则泛化。
AI.result: Embed-TTT 持续产生更优任务嵌入，更符合底层规则，提升基于嵌入的检索，并能准确线性探测已知规则；在 ARC-AGI-1 上识别出更有语义的测试-训练任务关系。仅优化少于 0.01% 参数的任务嵌入即可解决部分 ARC-AGI-1、ConceptARC 和 Mini-ARC 任务，完整两步流程进一步提升性能。Embed-TTT 还能恢复参数化规则的几何结构，并支持规则级插值而非外推。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持在 ARC 类评估中更清晰地区分规则归纳与规则执行，并推动构建能区分分布内与分布外规则的基准。

title: Towards Secure Cloud-Native Computing: Unveiling Kubernetes Misconfigurations with Large Language Models
summary: In the rapidly evolving landscape of cloud-native computing, Organizations are increasingly adopting infrastructure models that emphasize scalability, flexibility, and efficiency. Kubernetes has become the de facto standard for orchestrating containerized applications in these environments. However, the inherent complexity of cloud-native ecosystems introduces significant challenges, particularly in the form of misconfigurations that can compromise both security and performance. This study explores the potential of Large Language Models (LLMs) in identifying Kubernetes misconfigurations. We introduce a comprehensive taxonomy of common misconfiguration types, offering a structured framework to better understand and categorize these issues. Additionally, we conduct an empirical evaluation of state-of-the-art detection tools to benchmark their effectiveness. Furthermore, we analyze the Kubernetes objects most prone to misconfiguration and evaluate the severity of the identified issues. By leveraging advanced machine learning techniques, including LLMs, we provide novel insights into enhancing misconfiguration detection methodologies.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨利用大语言模型识别Kubernetes配置错误，提出常见错误分类体系，评估现有检测工具，并分析易错对象及其严重性。
AI.motivation: 云原生和Kubernetes广泛采用，但生态系统复杂，配置错误会危及安全与性能，因此需要更有效的检测方法。
AI.method: 构建Kubernetes常见配置错误分类法；对最先进检测工具进行实证评估；分析最易发生配置错误的Kubernetes对象；利用包括LLM在内的先进机器学习技术。
AI.result: 基准测试了现有检测工具的有效性，识别了易配置错误的Kubernetes对象，并评估了相关问题的严重程度。
AI.conclusion: LLM等先进技术有望增强Kubernetes配置错误检测，为改进检测方法提供了新见解。

title: VGGT-CAD: Reconstructing Parametric CAD 3D Model with Geometric Grounding
summary: Parametric CAD reconstruction requires recovering both precise geometry and editable modeling operations from visual observations, making it challenging under limited and ambiguous views. Existing methods mainly rely on 2D appearance cues and lack strong multi-view geometric priors. In this work, we present VGGT-CAD, a geometry-aware framework for parametric CAD reconstruction from single- and multi-view observations. We transfer pretrained 3D geometric priors into CAD reconstruction by encoding camera parameters as condition tokens and jointly modeling them with image tokens. To handle varying numbers of viewpoints, we introduce a variable-view cross-view context aggregation module that adaptively fuses multi-view features. We further develop a training-free geometry-aware view selection strategy to select complementary and reliable frames during inference. The resulting representation is decoded into CAD command sequences using a non-autoregressive decoder. We also develop VideoCAD, a large-scale multi-view video benchmark derived from existing CAD data through multi-view re-rendering. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of VGGT-CAD for visual CAD reconstruction under different observation configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VGGT-CAD，一种几何感知的参数化CAD重建框架，能够从单视图或多视图观测中恢复精确几何与可编辑建模操作。该框架通过引入预训练3D几何先验、相机参数条件token、可变视图跨视图聚合模块、训练无关的视图选择策略及非自回归解码器生成CAD命令序列。同时构建了VideoCAD多视图视频基准，实验验证了其在不同观测配置下的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有参数化CAD重建方法主要依赖2D外观线索，缺乏强多视图几何先验，在有限且模糊的视图下难以准确重建。因此，需要利用3D几何先验来提升视觉CAD重建的鲁棒性和精度。
AI.method: 1) 将预训练3D几何先验迁移到CAD重建中，编码相机参数为条件token并与图像token联合建模；2) 提出可变视图跨视图上下文聚合模块，自适应融合多视图特征；3) 开发训练无关的几何感知视图选择策略，在推理时选择互补且可靠的帧；4) 使用非自回归解码器将表示解码为CAD命令序列；5) 构建VideoCAD大规模多视图视频基准，通过多视图重渲染生成。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，VGGT-CAD在不同观测配置（单视图和多视图）下均能有效进行视觉CAD重建，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: VGGT-CAD通过引入3D几何先验和灵活的多视图融合机制，提升了参数化CAD重建在有限视图下的性能，为视觉CAD重建提供了有效方案。

title: Multiclass Semantic Segmentation of Wildland Fire Images Using Context-Aware Centralized Copy-Paste Data Augmentation
summary: Producing accurate annotations for deep learning based image segmentation is both costly and labor intensive. This challenge is especially evident in wildland fire applications, where accurately labeled datasets are scarce due to the difficulty of collecting and annotating dynamic fire scenes. To address this problem, our previous work introduced the Centralized Copy-Paste Data Augmentation (CCPDA) method for semantic segmentation of wildland fire imagery, which generates artificial training samples by randomly pasting fire clusters from source images onto target images. However, random placement can produce contextually unrealistic scenes, such as fire burning on asphalt. In this paper, we present a context-aware strategy designed specifically to improve data quality and realism in small multiclass wildland fire datasets, ensuring that augmented samples remain contextually meaningful. The proposed method restricts fire placement to semantically valid target regions and selects the location whose Ash-Vegetation composition most closely matches the source context. This approach preserves existing fire regions in the target image, prevents unrealistic placements, and maintains contextual accuracy by generating images that resemble real wildland fire scenes. We evaluate the Context-Aware CCPDA strategy through numerical analysis and comparisons with other augmentation methods by a weighted sum-based multi-objective optimization (MOO) approach. The results confirm that the context-aware data augmentation strategy leads to improved segmentation performance and contextual realism, outperforming other augmentation procedures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向小型多类野火数据集的情境感知数据增强策略，用于改进语义分割。该方法在复制粘贴火源时限制其只能放入语义合理区域，并选择灰烬-植被组成与源上下文最匹配的位置，从而提升增强样本的真实性和分割性能。
AI.motivation: 深度学习图像分割需要大量精确标注，但标注成本高、劳动密集；野火场景动态复杂，标注数据尤其稀缺。此前提出的CCPDA通过随机粘贴火源进行增强，但随机放置可能产生不合理场景，如火烧在沥青上。
AI.method: 在CCPDA基础上提出情境感知策略：将火源放置限制在语义有效的目标区域；根据灰烬-植被组成与源上下文的匹配程度选择粘贴位置；保留目标图像中已有火区域；并通过数值分析和基于加权和的多目标优化（MOO）与其他增强方法进行比较。
AI.result: 结果表明，情境感知数据增强策略提升了分割性能，并增强了增强样本的上下文真实性，优于其他数据增强方法。
AI.conclusion: 情境感知的数据增强策略能够为小型多类野火数据集生成更真实、语义合理的训练样本，从而有效改善野火图像语义分割效果。

title: Improved Droop Control in DC Microgrids via Voltage-Locked Loop Synchronization
summary: DC microgrids are low- or medium-voltage networks designed to connect and manage DC-based sources and loads. A key challenge in operating DC microgrids is maintaining the DC voltage within certain predefined limits while ensuring its stability. Droop control, the most common method towards addressing this challenge, enables decentralized voltage control and power sharing, but suffers from poor transient performance, resulting in voltage dips and overshoots in applications with fast varying loads such as AI datacenters. This paper introduces an improved droop control method based on voltage-locked loop synchronization, which ensures DC voltage stabilization with significantly improved transient response and achieves the desired load sharing between the available source converters. The core design principle is reflected in the functional separation of the control scheme into a virtual DC machine (VDCM) that operates as a spinning wheel and a virtual current source connected in parallel. The transient response is provided by the VDCM to damp and stabilize DC bus voltage variations, while the slow droop response is provided by the virtual current source to ensure steady-state power balance. The performance of the proposed method is validated in an experimental microgrid setup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于电压锁定环同步的改进下垂控制方法，用于提升直流微电网的暂态响应并维持母线电压稳定。
AI.motivation: 传统下垂控制虽能实现分散电压控制和功率分配，但暂态性能差，在AI数据中心等负载快速变化场景下会产生电压跌落和超调。
AI.method: 将控制方案功能分离为并联的虚拟直流电机（VDCM）和虚拟电流源：VDCM 提供暂态响应，阻尼并稳定直流母线电压变化；虚拟电流源提供缓慢的下垂响应，保证稳态功率平衡。采用电压锁定环同步，并在实验微电网平台上验证。
AI.result: 所提方法能显著改善暂态响应，实现直流电压稳定，并在可用源变换器之间实现期望的负载分配。
AI.conclusion: 基于电压锁定环同步的改进下垂控制可有效解决传统下垂控制暂态性能差的问题，适用于快速变化负载的直流微电网。

title: MAPLE-RF: Efficient Probabilistic RF Source Localization in Partially Explored Environments
summary: Localizing a radio-frequency (RF) transmitter from received signals often requires a model of the environment to predict how obstacles block and reflect the signal. In many robotic applications, however, only a partial map is available, particularly when a robot localizes the source while exploring with simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). We study single-snapshot transmitter localization on such partially explored maps and compare two approaches that output a posterior over transmitter locations. The first extends a digital-twin method, which ray-traces every candidate location, to partial maps by treating unexplored space as free and training on mixed map coverage. The second, MAPLE-RF, encodes estimated path angles of arrival and signal-to-noise ratios as grid channels aligned with map knownness, occupancy, and line-of-sight visibility, and a U-Net scores all candidate positions in one pass without simulating propagation at inference. Ray-tracing simulations of indoor environments indicate that training on mixed map coverage is essential for both approaches. The digital-twin approach is more accurate on most single-snapshot metrics, while MAPLE-RF comes close at a query cost that does not depend on the propagation model and is more than two orders of magnitude below a fresh full-grid query with general-purpose ray tracing. Both outperform Gaussian and Gaussian-mixture baselines, and on exploration routes guided by its own estimates, fused MAPLE-RF posteriors place more probability near the source than the compared methods. Code and data will be released.

AI.tldr: 研究部分探索地图中的单快照射频发射器定位，比较数字孪生扩展方法与MAPLE-RF，二者均输出发射器位置后验。
AI.motivation: 机器人应用中常仅有部分地图，尤其SLAM探索时无法获得完整环境模型，因此需要不依赖完整地图的RF源定位方法。
AI.method: 提出两类方法：1）扩展数字孪生方法，将未探索空间视为自由，并在混合地图覆盖上训练，对每个候选位置进行射线追踪；2）MAPLE-RF，将估计路径到达角与信噪比编码为与地图已知度、占据和LOS可见性对齐的网格通道，用U-Net一次评分所有候选位置，推理时无需传播模拟。基于室内环境射线追踪仿真评估。
AI.result: 混合地图覆盖训练对两种方法都至关重要；数字孪生方法在多数单快照指标上更准，MAPLE-RF接近其精度，但查询成本不依赖传播模型，比通用射线追踪的全网格新查询低两个数量级以上。两者均优于高斯和高斯混合基线；在自估计引导的探索路径上，融合MAPLE-RF后验比对比方法在源附近放置更多概率。
AI.conclusion: 在部分探索地图下，数字孪生方法精度更高，MAPLE-RF以极低推理成本达到接近效果，并可融合用于探索；混合地图覆盖训练是必要环节。代码和数据将发布。

title: PhysioBench: A Unified Benchmark for Physiological Signal Question Answering
summary: Physiological signals support diverse clinical and monitoring tasks, yet existing physiological signal foundation models typically require task-specific adaptation for each task. Natural language provides a common interface for specifying different prediction objectives, but the ability of current models to follow such instructions across physiological signal modalities remains insufficiently evaluated. To address this gap, we introduce PhysioBench, a unified benchmark for physiological signal question answering. PhysioBench harmonizes annotations from 22 public datasets into 61.4 million questions across 30 tasks. Each question-answer pair is grounded in a signal segment and traceable to its source annotation. We evaluate 21 representative models, including large language models, vision-language models, time-series language models, and physiological signal foundation models under three complementary settings. The results show that none of the evaluated models achieves consistently strong performance across physiological signal modalities and tasks. The incorporation of natural language supports unified prediction across tasks, although performance remains sensitive to question formulation. Beyond these findings, PhysioBench offers an extensible platform for fine-grained analysis and future research on physiological signal understanding. Our codes are available at https://github.com/Leanna97/PhysioBench.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 PhysioBench，一个用于生理信号问答的统一基准，整合22个公开数据集、30项任务和6140万个问答对，并评测21个代表性模型。
AI.motivation: 现有生理信号基础模型通常需要针对每个任务进行特定适配，而自然语言虽可作为统一预测目标接口，但当前模型在生理信号多模态、多任务指令遵循方面的能力尚未得到充分评估。
AI.method: 构建 PhysioBench 基准：将22个公开数据集的标注统一为30项任务、6140万个问答对，每个问答对基于信号片段并可追溯至原始标注；在三种互补设置下评测21个代表性模型，包括大语言模型、视觉语言模型、时间序列语言模型和生理信号基础模型。
AI.result: 评测显示，没有任何模型能在所有生理信号模态和任务上持续表现优异；引入自然语言可支持跨任务统一预测，但性能对问题表述方式较为敏感。
AI.conclusion: PhysioBench 揭示了当前模型在生理信号理解上的不足，并提供了一个可扩展平台，用于细粒度分析和未来研究。

title: AI-GRACE: A Use-Case Operationalization Framework for Agentic AI: From Organizational Objectives and Obligations to Deployment Capabilities and Architecture
summary: Organizations deploying agentic artificial intelligence must determine more than whether a model is trustworthy; they must establish what to validate, control, and observe for a use case to deliver its intended outcome while meeting applicable obligations. This paper proposes AI-GRACE (Agentic Intelligence-Governance, Risk, Assurance, Controls, and Evidence) as a use-case operationalization framework connecting organizational governance with technical implementation. The proposal draws on professional observations and a purposive synthesis of standards and literature, using design science to frame the method contribution and situational method engineering to guide contextual tailoring and reuse. The framework establishes objectives and obligations and then assesses risks in seven proposed domains, including mission and value realization. It derives requirements for assurance before deployment, runtime controls, and evidence, which guide capability qualification, gap assessment, and a logical architecture. An Agent Operating Envelope specifies permitted actions and escalation conditions, while Risk-Aligned Independence Levels (RAIL) summarize the authorized independence. A fictional retail banking application illustrates the method. The contribution is a traceable basis for deciding what an organization must implement, what it already supports, and what remains unresolved. Empirical evaluation must establish whether it improves deployment decisions, efficiency, and reuse.

AI.tldr: 提出AI-GRACE框架，用于将组织治理与代理式AI用例的技术实施相连接，明确目标与义务、七类风险、部署前保证、运行时控制和证据要求，并以零售银行案例说明。
AI.motivation: 组织部署代理式AI时，仅判断模型是否可信并不够，还需明确在具体用例中应验证、控制和观测什么，以实现预期结果并满足适用义务。
AI.method: 基于专业观察及对标准和文献的目的性综合，采用设计科学构建方法贡献，并用情境方法工程指导情境化裁剪与复用；先确立目标与义务，再评估七个风险领域，推导保证、运行时控制与证据要求，进而指导能力资格、差距评估和逻辑架构。
AI.result: 提出AI-GRACE框架，涵盖七个风险域（包括使命与价值实现）；通过Agent Operating Envelope规定允许行动与升级条件，通过Risk-Aligned Independence Levels（RAIL）概括授权独立性；以虚构零售银行应用进行示例说明。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为组织决定需要实施什么、已支持什么以及尚有哪些未解决问题提供了可追溯基础；其是否改善部署决策、效率和复用仍需实证评估。

title: A Generative Grammar Underlying the Voynich Manuscript, the Pastiche Hypothesis: Evidence from Large Language Models
summary:
Background: The Voynich Manuscript is a fifteenth-century codex written in an unknown script whose content remains undeciphered. Previous studies suggest that its statistical properties resemble those of natural languages, while its illustrations - primarily plants - recall medieval herbals.
  Methods: We present a multidisciplinary analysis combining probabilistic modeling, phonetic decomposition, rare-event detection, and multimodal image analysis, based on a newly transliterated corpus. Word- and letter-level distributions are modeled using position-dependent probabilistic grammars, while phonetic patterns are compared across Indo-European, Semitic, and Asian languages. Image-text alignment methods based on large language models are applied to identify potential botanical correspondences.
  Results: The results indicate that Voynich symbols behave as letters rather than syllabic units, while word-length distributions resemble syllabic structures. Phonetic analyses show closer alignment with consonant-heavy languages such as Hebrew or Arabic than with Indo-European languages. Probabilistic modeling reproduces Zipf-like distributions and reveals extremely low probabilities for repeated initial-letter sequences, indicating a structured imitation of natural language. Image analysis suggests strong correspondences between Voynich plant illustrations and those found in Pseudo-Apuleius herbals from the Mediterranean tradition, consistent with an imitation of medieval medicinal books.
  Perspectives: These findings support the hypothesis that the Voynich Manuscript follows a structured generative system combining linguistic regularities and herbal knowledge, and demonstrate the value of integrating probabilistic and AI-assisted approaches in the analysis of historical manuscripts.

AI.tldr: 该论文对《伏尼契手稿》进行多学科分析，结合概率建模、语音分解、稀有事件检测和多模态图像分析，发现其符号更像字母，但词长分布类似音节结构，语音上更接近希伯来语或阿拉伯语等辅音密集语言，植物插图与地中海传统的伪阿普列乌斯药草书高度对应。
AI.motivation: 《伏尼契手稿》是十五世纪用未知文字写成的抄本，内容至今未被破译；此前研究认为其统计特性类似自然语言，插图主要为植物，类似中世纪药草书，因此需要进一步检验其语言结构和图像来源。
AI.method: 基于新转写语料，使用位置依赖的概率语法建模词和字母分布，进行语音模式比较（印欧、闪米特和亚洲语言），结合稀有事件检测，并利用大语言模型进行图文对齐以识别植物对应关系。
AI.result: 伏尼契符号表现为字母而非音节单位，但词长分布类似音节结构；语音分析显示其更接近希伯来语或阿拉伯语等辅音密集语言，而非印欧语言；概率模型重现了齐普夫式分布，并发现重复首字母序列概率极低，表明其有结构地模仿自然语言；图像分析显示其植物插图与地中海传统的伪阿普列乌斯药草书插图高度对应。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现支持《伏尼契手稿》遵循一个结合语言规律和药草知识的结构化生成系统，并证明整合概率方法和AI辅助方法在分析历史手稿中的价值。

title: SafeStyle: Calibrated Style Residual Injection for Controllable Style-Leakage Trade-off in Diffusion Stylization
summary: Reference-guided diffusion stylization aims to transfer visual style from a reference image while preserving the semantics specified by a text prompt. However, image conditioning often entangles transferable style cues with reference-specific content, leading to an inherent trade-off: stronger conditioning improves style fidelity but increases content leakage, whereas aggressive suppression reduces leakage at the cost of style expression. This challenge is further complicated by the distinct spatial organization of texture- and geometry-dominant styles. To address these issues, we propose SafeStyle, a training-free framework for calibrated style residual injection in frozen diffusion models. SafeStyle first estimates style-supported and content-associated subspaces from compact calibration sets, preserving their informative overlap while suppressing useless content variations. It then transports the purified style evidence over adaptive spatial granularity and constrains its effective influence through an explicit residual-norm budget. Experiments across texture- and geometry-dominant styles show that SafeStyle achieves a DINO style similarity of 0.432 while maintaining competitive text alignment. On a semantically disjoint leakage-stress benchmark, it further achieves a DINO style similarity of 0.474 with only 0.8\% semantic leakage, demonstrating an effective balance between style fidelity and reference-content suppression.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SafeStyle，一种无需训练的参考引导扩散风格化框架，通过校准的风格残差注入，在冻结扩散模型中平衡风格保真度与参考内容泄漏。
AI.motivation: 参考图像引导的风格迁移常将可迁移风格与参考特定内容纠缠，导致风格保真度和内容泄漏之间的权衡；同时，纹理主导与几何主导风格的空间组织不同，进一步加剧该问题。
AI.method: SafeStyle 从紧凑校准集中估计风格支持子空间和内容关联子空间，保留有用重叠并抑制无用内容变化；随后以自适应空间粒度迁移纯化后的风格证据，并通过显式残差范数预算约束其有效影响。
AI.result: 在纹理和几何主导风格上，SafeStyle 达到 0.432 的 DINO 风格相似度并保持有竞争力的文本对齐；在语义不相交的泄漏压力基准上，达到 0.474 的 DINO 风格相似度，同时仅有 0.8% 语义泄漏。
AI.conclusion: SafeStyle 能有效平衡风格保真度与参考内容抑制，在无需训练的情况下提升参考引导扩散风格化的可控性。

title: Information-Gain Rewards over Diversity-Pruned Tests: GT-Anchored Verifier Co-Training for Reliable Code Generation
summary: Self-play methods that co-train a single language model as both coder and test author promise to move code-generation RL beyond fixed test suites, but they suffer from two coupled pathologies: permissiveness collapse, where pass-rate rewards are maximised by trivial, non-discriminative tests, and concentration bias, where i.i.d. sampled tests cluster on modal inputs and inflate estimator variance. We introduce CoVer (Co-trained Coder and Verifier), a single-policy GRPO framework that addresses both failure modes. First, an information-gain (IG) reward scores each self-generated test by the mutual information between its pass/fail vector and a graded, ground-truth-anchored correctness signal y [0, 1] m, gated by the sign of their covariance so that only positively discriminative tests receive reward. Second, a three-stage diversity-aware selection step prunes a candidate pool to a behaviourally non-redundant suite (invalidity, input-string, execution-profile filtering), raising the effective sample size of the IG estimator at fixed execution budget. On five benchmarks (LiveBench, MBPP, LiveCodeBench, CodeContests, Code-Forces), CoVer raises one-shot pass@1 by +5.8 points at 7B and +7.1 points at 14B over the Qwen2.5-Instruct backbone, and achieves the highest macro-average among all compared methods at both scales. As a drop-in backbone inside the CodeT ranking pipeline, CoVer-7B adds +3.5 points, demonstrating the dual benefit of co-training for both generation and selection.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CoVer，一种单策略 GRPO 框架，联合训练代码生成模型与测试生成器，以解决自博弈中的测试过松和样本集中偏差问题，在多个代码基准上提升生成与选择性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自博弈方法让同一语言模型同时充当代码编写者和测试作者，有望摆脱固定测试集，但存在两个耦合问题：一是宽松性崩溃，即通过奖励简单、无区分度的测试来最大化通过率；二是集中偏差，即独立同分布采样测试集中于常见输入，导致估计方差增大。
AI.method: CoVer 采用单策略 GRPO 框架。首先引入信息增益奖励，用自生成测试的通过/失败向量与分级、锚定真实正确性信号 y∈[0,1]^m 之间的互信息评分，并通过协方差符号门控，只奖励有正向区分度的测试。其次使用三阶段多样性感知选择：对候选池进行无效性、输入字符串、执行画像过滤，剪枝为行为非冗余测试套件，在固定执行预算下提高信息增益估计的有效样本量。
AI.result: 在 LiveBench、MBPP、LiveCodeBench、CodeContests、CodeForces 五个基准上，CoVer 相比 Qwen2.5-Instruct 主干将 one-shot pass@1 在 7B 上提升 5.8 个百分点，在 14B 上提升 7.1 个百分点；在两个规模下均取得所有对比方法中最高的宏平均。作为 CodeT 排序流程的可替换主干，CoVer-7B 额外提升 3.5 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CoVer 通过信息增益奖励和多样性感知测试选择，缓解了自博弈中的宽松性崩溃与集中偏差，并证明联合训练对代码生成和测试选择具有双重收益。

title: Interconnections of Dissipative Networks Through a Dynamic Scattering Controller
summary: The problem of modular scattering-based design of dissipative networks is addressed. Under basic assumptions imposed on subsystems, design of a dynamic scattering-based interconnection controller is proposed which guarantees that the resulting interconnection is internally stable and possesses the same set of basic properties as the individual subsystems. This enables iterative application of the developed technique, which allows for building of large-scale dissipative networks in a modular fashion. The proposed method provides substantial flexibility in the controller design as well as in the choice of input and output signals used for interconnections.

AI.tldr: 研究耗散网络的模块化散射型设计，提出基于动态散射的互联控制器，使互联系统保持内部稳定并继承子系统的基本性质，从而可迭代构建大规模耗散网络。
AI.motivation: 需要以模块化方式构建大规模耗散网络，并确保子系统互联后仍保持内部稳定性和与单个子系统一致的基本性质。
AI.method: 在子系统满足基本假设的前提下，设计动态散射型互联控制器，用于子系统之间的互联。
AI.result: 所得互联系统是内部稳定的，并具有与单个子系统相同的基本性质；该方法可迭代应用，支持模块化构建大规模耗散网络，同时在控制器设计以及互联输入输出信号选择上具有较大灵活性。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法为耗散网络的模块化、可扩展设计提供了有效途径，并增强了互联控制器设计的灵活性。

title: Ability-Residual Decoupled Modeling for Affective Cognitive Diagnosis
summary: Cognitive diagnosis infers students' concept mastery from response logs. However, students' responses are not determined by mastery alone: non-cognitive factors such as emotion, engagement, and fatigue can also affect performance. Affective cognitive diagnosis therefore extends conventional cognitive diagnosis by incorporating affective states. Existing methods often assume that the cognitive diagnosis backbone has already explained ability, item, and concept effects, so the remaining errors can be attributed mainly to affect. We argue that this assumption can be insufficient in real educational data: item calibration bias, systematic concept bias, personalized student-concept deviations, and latent student-item matching can form stable cognitive residuals. Without an explicit modeling pathway, these residuals may leak into affective representations, producing affect contamination. To address this problem, we propose an ability-residual decoupled framework for affective cognitive diagnosis. The model first captures unmodeled cognitive residuals through student, item, concept, student-concept, and low-rank student-item components, and then uses an affective module to modulate guess/slip effects. A Q-matrix-constrained concept residual attention mechanism adaptively aggregates only item-relevant concept residuals. Experiments on ASSIST2017, ASSIST2012, ASSIST2009, and Junyi with six cognitive diagnosis backbones show response-prediction gains across the reported comparisons and generally improved affect alignment when affect labels are available. Ablation studies, leakage probes, principal component analysis visualization, long-tail analysis, and case studies further indicate that ability residuals absorb stable cognitive bias, reduce cognitive contamination in the affective branch, and enhance the robustness and predictive accuracy of cognitive diagnosis models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种能力-残差解耦框架，用于情感认知诊断，旨在避免未建模的认知残差污染情感表征，从而提升响应预测与情感对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 传统认知诊断仅从掌握程度推断学生作答，但情感、投入、疲劳等非认知因素也会影响表现。现有情感认知诊断常假设认知诊断主干已解释能力、题目和概念效应，剩余误差主要来自情感；然而真实教育数据中可能存在题目校准偏差、系统性概念偏差、个性化学生-概念偏差及潜在学生-题目匹配等稳定认知残差，若不显式建模，这些残差会泄漏到情感表示中，造成情感污染。
AI.method: 提出能力-残差解耦框架：先通过学生、题目、概念、学生-概念及低秩学生-题目组件捕捉未建模的认知残差，再用情感模块调制猜测/失误效应；并设计受Q矩阵约束的概念残差注意力机制，仅自适应聚合与题目相关的概念残差。
AI.result: 在ASSIST2017、ASSIST2012、ASSIST2009和Junyi四个数据集上，结合六种认知诊断主干模型，响应预测在报告比较中取得提升；在情感标签可用时，情感对齐总体改善。消融、泄漏探测、主成分分析可视化、长尾分析和案例研究进一步表明，能力残差吸收了稳定认知偏差，减少了情感分支中的认知污染，并提升了认知诊断模型的鲁棒性与预测准确性。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并解耦能力残差可有效防止认知偏差污染情感表示，增强情感认知诊断的预测性能、鲁棒性和可解释性。

title: DEXTERA: From a Single Image to Deployable Dexterous Manipulation via Real-to-Sim-to-Real
summary: Collecting real-world robot data for dexterous manipulation is costly and time-consuming. While high-fidelity physics simulators enable scalable data synthesis and policy learning, constructing deployment-ready digital twins manually remains labor-intensive, and residual visual, geometric, and dynamics gaps hinder reliable sim-to-real transfer. We present DEXTERA, an automated real-to-sim-to-real framework that transforms a single RGB image into deployable policies for dexterous manipulation across four unified stages: (1) single-image scene factorization into a static Gaussian background and interactive rigid or articulated assets with VLM-inferred physical parameters; (2) metric scene global alignment, object canonicalization, and morphology-balanced robot calibration; (3) scalable simulator task primitive construction, VR teleoperation, and object-centric trajectory synthesis; and (4) a shared multimodal policy interface supporting both imitation learning and reinforcement learning. We evaluate DEXTERA across 13 task-embodiment pairs, 2 dexterous robot platforms, and 6 policy architectures. Experimental results demonstrate that DEXTERA achieves superior visual fidelity and 3D geometric reconstruction compared to generative baselines, while cross-domain trajectory replays validate strong physical interaction consistency. Furthermore, simulation-only trained policies enable viable zero-shot real-robot deployment, while simulation-real co-training substantially improves mean physical policy success from 29.2% to 61.9% across diverse policy architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出DEXTERA，一个自动化实-仿-实框架，从单张RGB图像生成可部署的灵巧操作策略，包含四个统一阶段。
AI.motivation: 真实世界灵巧操作数据采集成本高、耗时长；高保真仿真器虽可扩展数据合成与策略学习，但手动构建可部署数字孪生劳动密集，且视觉、几何和动力学残差阻碍可靠的sim-to-real迁移。
AI.method: DEXTERA框架四个阶段：(1)单图像场景分解为静态高斯背景与可交互刚体/铰接资产，并用VLM推断物理参数；(2)度量场景全局对齐、物体规范化与形态平衡的机器人校准；(3)可扩展仿真任务原语构建、VR遥操作与物体中心轨迹合成；(4)共享多模态策略接口，支持模仿学习与强化学习。
AI.result: 在13个任务-本体对、2个灵巧机器人平台、6种策略架构上评估。视觉保真度和3D几何重建优于生成基线，跨域轨迹回放验证物理交互一致性。仅仿真训练策略可实现零样本真机部署，仿真-真实协同训练将平均物理策略成功率从29.2%提升至61.9%。
AI.conclusion: DEXTERA实现了自动化实-仿-实灵巧操作，减少了手动构建数字孪生的需求，有效缩小sim-to-real差距，支持零样本部署和协同训练提升性能。

title: Geometry-Aware Diffusion Guidance via Curvature-Adaptive Tubular Correction
summary: Gradient-guided diffusion samplers provide flexible priors for inverse problems and conditional generation, but strong guidance can move the sampling trajectory into regions where the learned score is poorly supported. Existing tangent-projection strategies limit first-order departure from an iso-density surface, yet discard potentially useful normal motion and overlook the second-order departure induced by tangent motion on a curved surface. We introduce curvature-adaptive tubular correction (CAT), a training-free plugin that regulates both effects within a shared, noise-dependent geometric budget. CAT decomposes the guidance gradient into normal and tangent components, charges normal displacement at first order and tangent displacement according to directional curvature, and obtains their jointly optimal magnitudes from a one-dimensional dual equation. Armijo backtracking calibrates the resulting finite step against the actual guidance objective, while matrix-free directional derivatives avoid constructing the full score Jacobian. We establish local guarantees for the tubular approximation, uniqueness of the correction, and sufficient objective decrease. Across seven inverse problems on FFHQ and ImageNet, CAT improves the evaluated pixel- and latent-space host samplers, with particularly consistent gains in perceptual metrics. It also improves black hole reconstruction on InverseBench and yields the lowest FID among the compared methods at every tested classifier-free guidance scale, while maintaining stable saturation and contrast. These results support curvature-aware tubular control as a reusable mechanism for stabilizing diffusion guidance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免训练的曲率自适应管状校正插件CAT，用于稳定扩散模型中的引导采样，在多个逆问题和条件生成任务上提升宿主采样器表现。
AI.motivation: 强引导会使扩散采样轨迹进入学习分数支撑较差的区域；现有切空间投影方法只限制一阶偏离等密度面，丢弃法向运动，并忽略切向运动在弯曲表面上引起的二阶偏离。
AI.method: CAT将引导梯度分解为法向和切向分量，在噪声相关的几何预算内，法向位移按一阶、切向位移按方向曲率计费，并通过一维对偶方程求联合最优幅度；使用Armijo回溯校准有限步长，使用无矩阵方向导数避免构造完整分数雅可比，并给出管状近似的局部保证、校正唯一性与目标充分下降。
AI.result: 在FFHQ和ImageNet的七类逆问题上，CAT提升了像素空间和潜空间宿主采样器，感知指标增益尤其一致；在InverseBench上改进黑洞重建，并在所有测试的无分类器引导尺度下取得最低FID，同时保持稳定的饱和度和对比度。
AI.conclusion: 曲率感知的管状控制是一种可复用机制，可用于稳定扩散引导，并改善逆问题与条件生成中的采样质量。

title: PlantShade: Predicting Plant Shadows for Lighting-Aware Robotic Agricultural Operation
comment: This paper has been accepted by the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Plant growth and agricultural production form the foundation of a country's sustainable development and directly impact human livelihoods. Recent advances in frontier artificial intelligence have enabled scientific agriculture with strong potential to improve crop productivity. In this paper, we identify the importance and inherent complexity of plant shade simulation, as shading is a critical factor influencing plant growth. To advance this field and promote broader societal benefits, we focus on two main contributions. First, we introduce a comprehensive plant growth and shade dataset covering four plant species, including soybean, tomato, sugarbeet, and strawberry. The dataset includes top-down viewpoints with a supplementary light along a circular trajectory, casting dynamic shadows across multiple growth stages and diverse observation complexities. Second, we propose generative shade simulation based on diffusion models, enabling realistic shade generation for unseen plants and supporting downstream robotic tasks such as perception, lighting control, and view planning. The model incorporates temporal conditioning to facilitate flexible shade simulation across different time stages. We conduct both quantitative and qualitative evaluations to assess model performance. This work provides a foundational study for plant-aware shade modeling and has meaningful implications for broader agricultural and robotic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文聚焦植物遮阴模拟，构建了包含大豆、番茄、甜菜和草莓四种植物、多生长阶段且具动态阴影的植物生长与遮阴数据集，并提出基于扩散模型的生成式遮阴模拟方法，支持未见过植物的真实感阴影生成及下游机器人任务。
AI.motivation: 植物生长和农业生产对国家可持续发展与人类生活至关重要，而遮阴是影响植物生长的关键因素。前沿人工智能为科学农业提供了提升作物生产力的潜力，因此需要推进植物遮阴模拟研究并促进更广泛的社会效益。
AI.method: 构建了一个综合的植物生长与遮阴数据集，涵盖四种植物、俯视视角、沿圆形轨迹的补充光源、多生长阶段动态阴影和多样观察复杂度；提出基于扩散模型的生成式遮阴模拟方法，并引入时间条件以实现不同时间阶段的灵活阴影生成，支持感知、光照控制和视角规划等下游机器人任务。
AI.result: 所提方法能够为未见过植物生成逼真的阴影，并适应不同时间阶段的遮阴模拟；论文通过定量和定性评估验证了模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为植物感知的遮阴建模提供了基础性研究，对农业和机器人等更广泛应用具有意义。

title: Constraint-Unified MPC for Over-Actuated Surface Vehicles with Post-Detection Fault Reconfiguration
comment: 15 pages, 10 figures. Accepted for the International Symposium of Robotics Research (ISRR) 2026
summary: Choreographed aquatic performances require small autonomous surface vehicles to track precise paths under per-thruster force and rate limits, including after thruster failures. We report a deployed system in which trajectory tracking, thrust allocation, and the per-thruster force and rate limits are resolved in a single quadratic program over the per-thruster commands, with fault reconfiguration entering through one binary flag per thruster from an external detector. The system has driven a fleet in live performances on Lake Zürich and at the Time Space Existence 2025 exhibition in Venice. The field campaign measures 1.6 cm root mean square position error in a 10-minute hold and 4.3 cm over a 10 m square at 0.6 m/s. At 0.5 m/s, losing the front thruster increases the error to 11.6 cm, while losing the starboard-side thruster increases it to 11.5 cm. Losing two thrusters simultaneously leaves the craft tracking a 0.4 m/s square with a root mean square position error of 1.25 m. Compared to our own cascaded baseline, the unified formulation tracks the nominal square to the same few centimeters and holds station more tightly with roughly half the thruster force. The architectures separate after a thruster failure, where the unified controller stays within 24 cm of the reference path while the cascade leaves it.

AI.tldr: 论文报告一个已部署的自主水面车辆编队系统，用于水上编舞表演，在推进器力与速率限制及故障下实现精确轨迹跟踪。
AI.motivation: 编舞式水上表演需要小型自主水面车辆在每推进器力和速率限制下精确跟踪路径，并且推进器故障后仍需保持可控与跟踪性能。
AI.method: 将轨迹跟踪、推力分配以及每推进器力和速率限制统一建模为关于推进器命令的单个二次规划；外部故障检测器为每个推进器提供一个二值标志以进行故障重构；并与自研级联基线对比。
AI.result: 系统已在苏黎世湖和威尼斯 Time Space Existence 2025 展览中现场部署。10分钟悬停位置RMSE为1.6 cm；以0.6 m/s跟踪10 m方形路径为4.3 cm。0.5 m/s时失去前推进器误差增至11.6 cm，失去右舷推进器增至11.5 cm；同时失去两个推进器时仍能以0.4 m/s跟踪方形，RMSE为1.25 m。与级联基线相比，统一公式名义跟踪精度相当，但悬停更紧且推进器力约减半；故障后统一控制器保持在参考路径24 cm内，而级联控制器偏离。
AI.conclusion: 统一二次规划公式可在单一框架内处理轨迹跟踪、推力分配、执行器限制和故障重构，并已在实际表演中部署；推进器故障后其性能明显优于级联基线。

title: Multi-Agent Event-Triggered LQG Control under Shared Communication Constraints
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC 2026), Honolulu, Hawaii, USA
summary: This letter studies event-triggered linear-quadratic-Gaussian (LQG) control for multi-agent systems sharing a communication network with limited per-step capacity. Although the agent dynamics are decoupled, the communication decisions are coupled through the shared network constraint, leading to a constrained multi-agent scheduling problem. We show that the optimal control law remains certainty-equivalent and decouples across agents through independent finite-horizon Riccati recursions, whereas the transmission schedule remains globally coupled. Based on this structure, we develop a centralized receding-horizon scheduling framework and reformulate the resulting problem as a mixed-integer linear program (MILP) using a closed-form characterization of the estimation-error covariance. To improve scalability, we derive a window-based skip-pruning condition that safely fixes consecutive transmission decisions to zero before solving the MILP, and we propose an auction-inspired scheduler based on one-step transmission-benefit scores. Numerical results show that the proposed model predictive control (MPC) scheduler achieves the best trade-off between control performance and communication cost, while the auction-based scheduler attains performance close to MPC with substantially lower computational complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究共享有限通信网络的多智能体系统的事件触发LQG控制，其中通信决策通过共享网络约束耦合。提出了基于滚动时域的集中式调度框架，并转化为混合整数线性规划（MILP），同时设计了可扩展的跳过剪枝条件和拍卖启发式调度器。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统中通信网络每步容量有限，虽然智能体动态解耦，但通信决策因共享网络约束而耦合，导致需要解决受约束的多智能体调度问题。
AI.method: 采用事件触发LQG控制，证明最优控制律保持确定性等价且可通过独立有限时域Riccati递归解耦；基于此提出集中式滚动时域调度框架，利用估计误差协方差的闭式刻画将问题重构为MILP；为提高可扩展性，推导基于窗口的跳过剪枝条件以安全固定连续传输决策为零，并设计基于单步传输收益分数的拍卖启发式调度器。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，所提出的模型预测控制（MPC）调度器在控制性能与通信成本之间取得了最佳权衡，而拍卖启发式调度器在计算复杂度显著降低的情况下达到了接近MPC的性能。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的调度框架和启发式方法能有效处理多智能体系统的通信受限调度问题，MPC调度器性能最优，拍卖调度器则以较低复杂度提供近优性能。

title: From Generation to Detection: Exploration of Discourse Driven Scenario based LLM Generated Fake News
summary: In this study, we examine how modern LLMs generate and detect fake news under controlled settings across four manipulation scenarios. These are open-ended generation, rewriting, manipulation prompts and attribute based prompts grounded in the journalistic discourse framework. Firstly, using seven widely adapted models, we created a synthetic fake news corpus with 14000 generated articles across these four scenarios. Then we analyzed its linguistic properties to assess how closely model-generated news resembles real news structurally and semantically. Finally, to evaluate detection performance, we conducted experiments where each model judges generated fake news, starting with a basic detection prompt and improved prompts developed through an iterative refinement process that extracts misleading patterns from real-fake pairs. Our results revealed substantial variation across models in both generating and detecting misinformation, demonstrated that the generation strategy strongly influences detectability, and show that the refined prompt does not improve and often harms detection performance. Therefore, the study provides a systematic assessment of LLMs detection capability of LLMs generated fake news across typical generation scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文在受控条件下研究现代大语言模型在四类操控场景中生成与检测假新闻的表现，并分析生成策略、语言学特征及提示优化对检测效果的影响。
AI.motivation: 为系统评估大语言模型在不同典型生成场景下制造和识别虚假信息的能力，并检验基于真实-虚假新闻对提取误导模式的改进提示是否能提升检测性能。
AI.method: 设计四类假新闻生成场景：开放式生成、改写、操控提示、基于新闻话语框架的属性提示；使用七种主流模型生成包含14000篇文章的合成假新闻语料库；分析其结构与语义上的语言学特征；再让各模型在基础提示和迭代改进提示下进行假新闻检测。
AI.result: 不同模型在生成和检测虚假信息方面差异显著；生成策略会强烈影响假新闻的可检测性；迭代改进提示并未提升检测表现，反而常常损害检测性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究对LLM在典型生成场景下检测LLM生成假新闻的能力进行了系统评估，表明检测效果受模型与生成方式影响，提示优化未必有效。

title: A Fully Differentiable Neuro-Soft-Symbolic Framework for Perceptual Task Planning
