This targeted semantic disruption yields significantly stronger black-box transferability while preserving perceptual image quality, offering a seamless integration on social media platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了多模态大推理模型（MLRM）从日常照片推断用户地理位置的隐私泄露风险，并提出一种基于扩散模型的主动防御框架，在潜空间中注入扰动以破坏地理位置相关语义信号，从而在保持图像质量的同时提升黑盒迁移性。
AI.motivation: MLRM 能通过建筑风格、植被、光照等细微视觉线索进行结构化推理并精准推断地理位置，构成严重且未被充分研究的隐私威胁；同时现有拒绝式防护易被越狱绕过，像素空间扰动防御存在黑盒迁移性差和视觉伪影等问题。
AI.method: 提出基于扩散模型的防御框架：在反向采样过程中向扩散模型潜空间注入扰动，直接作用于高层语义表示；并以与 GPS 坐标对齐的 GeoCLIP 作为代理模型引导优化，定位并破坏 MLRM 用于位置推断的地理信号。
AI.result: 实验表明，精心设计的越狱提示可使模型响应率达到 100%，说明拒绝式防护严重不足；现有像素空间防御受结构限制，黑盒迁移性下降且产生明显视觉伪影；所提方法显著增强黑盒迁移性，同时保持感知图像质量，便于社交媒体平台集成。
AI.conclusion: 针对 MLRM 地理定位隐私泄露，需从像素空间转向潜空间语义层面的主动防御；通过扩散模型潜空间扰动与 GeoCLIP 引导，可更有效地破坏地理位置推理信号，兼顾防御效果与图像可用性。

title: Enhancing Audio Reasoning via Semantic Summary Prediction
summary: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) perform well on complex question answering but often show a reasoning gap, where explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reduces accuracy compared to direct answers. We hypothesize that long reasoning sequences shift attention away from the audio input. To address this, we propose SPARE (Semantic Prediction for Audio REasoning), which introduces a register token aligned with the final conclusion using a cosine similarity loss with a Sentence-BERT embedding. This conditions the model's latent space with the target semantic goal before reasoning begins. Experiments on MMAU and MMAR with SALMONN show improved zero-shot reasoning and stronger early attention to audio without additional inference cost.

AI.tldr: 论文针对大型音频语言模型在显式思维链推理时准确率反而下降的推理鸿沟，提出SPARE方法：通过一个与最终结论对齐的寄存器token和Sentence-BERT余弦相似度损失，在推理前用目标语义条件化模型潜在空间，从而提升零样本音频推理并增强早期对音频的注意力，且不增加推理成本。
AI.motivation: LALMs在复杂问答表现好，但显式CoT相比直接回答会降低准确率，存在推理鸿沟；作者假设长推理序列使注意力偏离音频输入。
AI.method: 提出SPARE（Semantic Prediction for Audio REasoning）：引入与最终结论对齐的register token，使用与Sentence-BERT嵌入的余弦相似度损失，在推理开始前将模型潜在空间条件化到目标语义目标上。
AI.result: 在MMAU和MMAR数据集上使用SALMONN进行实验，零样本推理性能提升，对音频的早期注意力更强，且不增加额外推理成本。
AI.conclusion: SPARE可缓解LALMs的CoT推理鸿沟，通过语义目标预条件化提升音频推理表现和早期音频关注，同时保持推理效率。

title: GVPO++: Group Variance Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training and On-Policy Distillation
comment: Extended version of the NeurIPS 2025 paper "GVPO: Group Variance Policy Optimization for Large Language Model Post-Training"
summary:
Post-training plays a pivotal role in enhancing the reasoning capabilities and task-specific expertise of large language models (LLMs). Despite recent advances in post-training methods, such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), their practical deployment remains impeded by training instability arising from the reliance on importance sampling.
  We introduce Group Variance Policy Optimization (GVPO), a novel post-training method that integrates the analytical solution of KL-constrained reward maximization into its gradient weighting scheme. This formulation provides an intuitive interpretation: GVPO's gradient corresponds to the mean squared error between the central distance of implicit rewards and that of actual rewards. GVPO offers two key advantages: (1) it guarantees a unique optimal solution, exactly to the KL-constrained reward maximization objective, and (2) it enables flexible sampling distributions without requiring importance sampling.
  Beyond general post-training, we show that GVPO naturally extends to on-policy distillation (OPD). Furthermore, GVPO enables the optimization of a broad family of extended OPD objectives, providing a principled foundation for diverse objective design. By unifying theoretical guarantees with practical adaptability, GVPO establishes a new paradigm for reliable and versatile LLM post-training and on-policy distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Group Variance Policy Optimization (GVPO)，一种新的LLM后训练方法，通过将KL约束奖励最大化的解析解融入梯度加权，避免了重要性采样，提升了训练稳定性，并可自然扩展到在线策略蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练方法（如GRPO）依赖重要性采样，导致训练不稳定，阻碍了实际部署。
AI.method: GVPO将KL约束奖励最大化的解析解整合到梯度加权方案中，其梯度等价于隐式奖励与实际奖励中心距离的均方误差。该方法无需重要性采样，允许灵活采样分布，并自然扩展到在线策略蒸馏（OPD）及多种扩展OPD目标优化。
AI.result: GVPO保证唯一最优解，精确对应KL约束奖励最大化目标；无需重要性采样，支持灵活采样分布；可扩展到OPD及多种扩展OPD目标。
AI.conclusion: GVPO为可靠且通用的LLM后训练和在线策略蒸馏建立了新范式。

title: SAGE: Safety-Aligned Gradient Enforcement for Human--Robot Collaboration
summary: Multi-party human-robot collaboration poses a dual challenge: robot decisions should remain interpretable and auditable, while executed actions must satisfy safety constraints during physical interaction. Combining explainable decision-tree policies with control-barrier-function (CBF) filtering provides a promising architecture but creates two learning mismatches in multi-agent reinforcement learning. Safety projection changes the action applied to the environment, while the coupled proposal graph can misalign independently optimized actor updates with a team-level update. We present safety-aligned gradient enforcement (SAGE) to address both mismatches. Its shield-annealed internalization layer (SAIL) uses a differentiable finite-penalty proposal map while retaining the exact CBF quadratic program for execution, preserving constraint-normal sensitivity to internalize repeatedly active safety constraints. Team-averaged Lyapunov policy optimization (TALO) constructs a team-aware update reference and applies a Lyapunov half-space correction to regulate independent actor updates. Physical experiments with two humanoid robots and a human partner demonstrate deployment feasibility. Across nine simulation scenarios, SAGE achieves a 71.0% success rate with 0.5 collision steps per thousand environment steps. Ablations show that direct CBF filtering reduces collision frequency by 98.5% but decreases success from 67.3% to 59.3%. SAIL reduces proposal violation by 48.8% and proposal-execution correction by 85.2%, while TALO reduces the update-consistency gap by 50.8%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SAGE方法，用于多主体人机协作中兼顾可解释决策与物理安全约束。它通过SAIL和TALO缓解可解释决策树策略与CBF安全过滤结合时产生的两类多智能体强化学习错配，并在仿真与双人形机器人实验中验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 多主体人机协作面临双重挑战：机器人决策需可解释、可审计，同时执行动作需满足物理交互中的安全约束。将可解释决策树策略与控制障碍函数（CBF）过滤结合虽具前景，但在多智能体强化学习中产生两类学习错配：安全投影会改变实际作用于环境的动作；耦合的提议图可能使独立优化的actor更新与团队级更新不一致。
AI.method: 提出安全对齐梯度强化（SAGE）。其包含：盾退火内化层（SAIL），使用可微分有限惩罚提议映射，同时保留精确CBF二次规划用于执行，以保持约束法向敏感性并内化反复激活的安全约束；团队平均Lyapunov策略优化（TALO），构建团队感知更新参考，并用Lyapunov半空间校正调节独立actor更新。
AI.result: 在九种仿真场景中，SAGE达到71.0%成功率，每千环境步0.5次碰撞步。消融显示：直接CBF过滤将碰撞频率降低98.5%，但成功率从67.3%降至59.3%。SAIL将提议违规降低48.8%，提议-执行校正降低85.2%；TALO将更新一致性差距降低50.8%。双人形机器人与人类伙伴的物理实验证明部署可行性。
AI.conclusion: SAGE能够同时缓解安全投影导致的动作错配与独立actor更新和团队更新不一致的问题，在提升安全性的同时保持较高任务成功率，并具备真实人机协作部署可行性。

title: Risk-Aware Occupancy for Safety-Oriented End-to-End Autonomous Driving
comment: The first version of this research was completed in early 2025
summary: Sparse representation formulates the environment perception for the end-to-end driving system as a set of discrete elements like objects and lane lines. This formulation meets safety risks in crowded, occluded scenes dealing with unstructured obstacles, uncertain regions, and intricate interactions. In this paper, we propose a dense representation, risk-aware occupancy, to characterize planning-relevant risks in an explicit and uniform manner. It jointly encodes global scene occupancy, map-derived traffic constraints, and future dynamic agent occupancy into a unified BEV map. The unified BEV map captures the risk evidence for trajectory planning in both spatial and temporal dimensions. We design an E2E network, ROIDrive, to realize risk-aware occupancy. It predicts risk-aware occupancy with an independent branch and injects it into planning queries for safety-oriented trajectory generation. In addition, to quantify the safety problem, we introduce RiskOcc4D-nuScenes built upon nuscenes and occ3d-nuscenes. Our risk-aware occupancy yields relative open-loop collision reductions of 52.9% under the UniAD metric and 35.0% under the ST-P3 metric on nuScenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出风险感知占据（risk-aware occupancy）这一稠密表示，用于端到端自动驾驶规划，并设计ROIDrive网络及RiskOcc4D-nuScenes数据集，显著降低开环碰撞率。
AI.motivation: 稀疏表示将环境感知建模为对象、车道线等离散元素，在拥挤、遮挡、非结构化障碍物、不确定区域和复杂交互场景中存在安全风险，因此需要更显式、统一地刻画与规划相关的风险。
AI.method: 提出风险感知占据表示，将全局场景占据、地图交通约束和未来动态智能体占据联合编码到统一BEV地图中，在空间和时间维度捕捉轨迹规划的风险证据；设计E2E网络ROIDrive，通过独立分支预测风险感知占据，并将其注入规划查询以生成安全导向轨迹；构建基于nuScenes和Occ3D-nuScenes的RiskOcc4D-nuScenes用于量化安全问题。
AI.result: 在nuScenes上，风险感知占据在UniAD指标下实现52.9%的相对开环碰撞减少，在ST-P3指标下实现35.0%的相对减少。
AI.conclusion: 风险感知占据能够以稠密、统一的方式表达规划相关风险，并有效提升端到端自动驾驶的安全性。

title: MME-Safety: A Fine-grained Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of MLLMs
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show remarkable advancements, their cross-modal capabilities introduce complex vulnerabilities that easily bypass unimodal filters. Existing benchmarks lack fine-grained intent-related annotations and rely on unidimensional metrics, hindering comprehensive robustness evaluation. To address this, we propose MME-Safety, a rigorously verified benchmark featuring a unique four-dimensional annotation schema that categorizes risk scenarios, harm severity, and modality-specific stealth levels. Furthermore, we introduce a hierarchical evaluation framework to assess fundamental response reliability, actual risk exposure, and the structural integrity of defensive behaviors. Extensive zero-shot evaluations across 17 state-of-the-art MLLMs provide a comprehensive safety profile of current multimodal systems. Our analysis systematically investigates cross-modal input configurations and uncovers safety implications associated with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. These multifaceted findings underscore the urgent need for robust, reasoning-aware safety alignment in the multimodal landscape.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了MME-Safety基准和分层评估框架，对17个先进多模态大模型进行零样本评估，揭示了跨模态输入配置和思维链推理带来的安全隐患。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型存在跨模态漏洞，可绕过单模态过滤器；现有基准缺乏细粒度意图标注和全面度量指标，难以全面评估鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出MME-Safety基准，包含四维标注模式（风险场景、危害严重性、模态特定隐蔽级别）；引入分层评估框架，评估响应可靠性、实际风险暴露和防御行为结构完整性；对17个MLLM进行零样本评估，分析跨模态输入配置和CoT推理的安全影响。
AI.result: 提供了当前多模态系统的全面安全画像，系统分析了跨模态输入配置，并揭示了与思维链推理相关的安全影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调，在多模态领域迫切需要进行稳健且具有推理感知的安全对齐。

title: RobotEQ-Video: A Video-Centric Benchmark for Social Proactive Intelligence with World-State Taxonomy
summary: Social Proactive Intelligence (SPI) extends proactive assistance beyond task completeness to consider social appropriateness in diverse embodied scenarios. However, prior SPI research faces two key limitations. First, existing work focuses on static images, whereas dynamic videos provide crucial cues for inferring human states and needs, offering richer information than isolated images. Second, prior work often relies on free-form data collection pipelines, which fail to guarantee comprehensive coverage of diverse scenarios. To address these gaps, we introduce RobotEQ-Video, shifting the focus from image-centric to video-centric analysis. To ensure comprehensive video coverage, we construct a hierarchical world-state taxonomy organized into a four-level coarse-to-fine structure, comprising 6 domains, 20 dimensions, 142 level-1 attributes, and 816 level-2 attributes. The resulting benchmark comprises 2K+ videos with 100K+ human annotations and 16K+ labels for assessing behavior properness. Benchmark evaluation reveals that current systems remain unreliable and fall short of human performance. We further explore how world models can help tackle this task. This work advances SPI research from static images to dynamic videos and ensures more comprehensive scenario coverage during benchmarking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RobotEQ-Video，将社交主动智能（SPI）从静态图像推进到动态视频，并构建了覆盖更全面的视频基准，用于评估具身场景中主动辅助行为的社会恰当性。
AI.motivation: 现有 SPI 研究存在两点不足：一是主要基于静态图像，缺乏动态视频中推断人类状态与需求的关键线索；二是常依赖自由形式的数据收集流程，难以保证场景覆盖的全面性。
AI.method: 构建 RobotEQ-Video 视频基准；设计四层由粗到细的分层世界状态分类体系，包含 6 个领域、20 个维度、142 个一级属性和 816 个二级属性；收集 2K+ 视频、100K+ 人工标注和 16K+ 行为恰当性标签；并探索世界模型在该任务中的作用。
AI.result: 基准评估显示，当前系统仍不可靠，且表现低于人类水平；同时探索了世界模型对该任务的潜在帮助。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将 SPI 研究从静态图像推进到动态视频，并在基准测试中实现了更全面的场景覆盖。

title: Driving on Registers, Reasoning on Risk: Risk-Aware Occupancy for Register-Based End-to-End Autonomous Driving
comment: This version of this research was completed in early 2026
summary: Multimodal trajectory prediction improves behavioral coverage in end-to-end autonomous driving, but existing methods remain limited by sparse scene representations. Incomplete evidence leads to low-quality candidate generation and unreliable ranking among geometrically similar trajectories. On a register-based baseline, bad and poor candidates constitute 19.74% of the candidate set, while the oracle-best candidate ranks only 33.9th on average. We propose RRDrive, which introduces risk-aware occupancy as a dense, temporally aligned, and trajectory-queryable representation. Its global structure guides high-quality multimodal generation, while candidate-conditioned risk queries support fine-grained selection. We further construct RiskOcc4D-NAVSIM with automatic risk annotations. RRDrive achieves a selected-trajectory PDMS of 0.951, representing a 1.5% relative improvement over the baseline (0.937), and improves the average candidate PDMS by 7.7%. In challenging scenes, it improves candidate PDMS by 30.2% and increases the Spearman correlation among good candidates by 0.41, from 0.26 to 0.67. To move beyond this oracle setting, we further develop an external RiskOcc predictor, a perception module that estimates risk-aware occupancy directly from sensor inputs. The competitive performance validates the representation's feasibility.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RRDrive，通过引入风险感知占用（risk-aware occupancy）作为稠密、时序对齐且可被轨迹查询的场景表示，提升端到端自动驾驶中的多模态轨迹预测与候选轨迹排序性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态轨迹预测受限于稀疏场景表示，证据不完整导致候选轨迹生成质量低，且几何相似轨迹之间排序不可靠。基线中差/较差候选占比19.74%，oracle最优候选平均仅排第33.9位。
AI.method: 提出RRDrive，使用风险感知占用作为稠密、时序对齐、轨迹可查询的表示：全局结构引导高质量多模态生成，候选条件风险查询支持细粒度选择；构建带自动风险标注的RiskOcc4D-NAVSIM；进一步开发从传感器输入直接估计风险感知占用的外部RiskOcc预测器。
AI.result: RRDrive取得所选轨迹PDMS 0.951，较基线0.937相对提升1.5%；平均候选PDMS提升7.7%。在挑战场景中，候选PDMS提升30.2%，好候选间的Spearman相关系数从0.26提升至0.67，提升0.41。外部RiskOcc预测器也表现出有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 风险感知占用表示能有效改善多模态轨迹生成与排序，并在挑战场景中显著提升候选质量与相关性；外部RiskOcc预测器的竞争性表现验证了该表示从传感器输入估计的可行性，使其超越oracle设定。

title: $μ^2$-Bench: A Multilingual Machine Unlearning Benchmark
summary: Undesired information such as harmful content and private data propagates through Multilingual Large Language Models (LLMs) via direct training and indirect cross-linguistic spread. Multilingual Machine Unlearning (MMU) aims to remove such information, yet its evaluation remains underexplored, leaving unclear whether unlearning truly eliminates target knowledge across all languages. To bridge this gap, we introduce $μ^2$-Bench, an MMU benchmark that simulates the full pipeline of memorization, unlearning, and evaluation across diverse languages. It 1) spans a broad set of languages, 2) evaluates on both training and hold-out languages, and 3) assesses knowledge as dispersed across multiple languages. We show that successful MMU requires methods that reflect multilingual characteristics, and conduct analysis to provide deeper insights into MMU.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了多语言机器遗忘基准 μ²-Bench，用于模拟多语言大模型中信息记忆、遗忘与评估的全流程，并分析多语言遗忘的特性。
AI.motivation: 有害内容和隐私数据会通过多语言大模型的直接训练和跨语言传播扩散；多语言机器遗忘（MMU）的评估尚不充分，难以判断遗忘是否真正在所有语言中消除了目标知识。
AI.method: 构建 μ²-Bench 基准，覆盖多种语言，模拟记忆、遗忘和评估的完整流程；同时在训练语言和留出语言上评估，并考察知识分散在多种语言中的情况；基于该基准进行分析以提供深入见解。
AI.result: 研究表明，成功的多语言机器遗忘需要能够反映多语言特征的方法；该基准和分析为 MMU 提供了更深入的洞察。
AI.conclusion: μ²-Bench 填补了多语言机器遗忘评估的空白，强调多语言特征对遗忘方法的重要性，并推动更可靠的跨语言知识消除评估。

title: Diverse and Adaptable Arm Coordination for Octopus-Crawling via Diffusion-Based Uncertainty-Aware Optimization
summary: Octopus crawling motivates soft robots that exploit redundancy, yet discovering and organizing diverse coordination modes for adaptation remains challenging. To address this, we introduce a Diffusion-based Uncertainty-aware Optimization (DUO) algorithm that learns demonstration-free crawling controllers for a simulated, muscle-actuated CyberOctopus. This work represents the first application of diffusion-based control to soft multi-arm robots in contact-rich simulations. By embedding a variety of locomotion behaviors within a shared control distribution, this approach enables the simulated octopus to navigate dynamic physical constraints, demonstrating that learned coordination diversity inherently facilitates robust adaptation. The main contributions include: (i) a symmetry-structured policy representation that folds radially equivalent controllers into a canonical directional sector, (ii) an online black-box optimization strategy, the DUO algorithm, that discovers and retains diverse coordination modes, and (iii) a control editing technique that adapts existing controllers to novel actuator constraints without retraining. These results show how learned coordination diversity makes motor abundance a practical resource for adaptation in soft multi-arm robots.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于扩散的不确定性感知优化算法DUO，为模拟肌肉驱动的CyberOctopus学习无示范爬行控制器，首次将扩散控制用于软多臂机器人接触丰富仿真。通过共享控制分布嵌入多样运动行为，使模拟章鱼能应对动态物理约束，表明学习到的协调多样性有助于鲁棒适应。
AI.motivation: 章鱼爬行启发了利用冗余的软体机器人，但发现并组织多样的协调模式以实现适应仍具挑战。研究旨在让学习到的协调多样性成为软多臂机器人适应的实用资源。
AI.method: 提出DUO算法，学习无演示的爬行控制器；采用对称结构化策略表示，将径向等价控制器折叠到规范方向扇区；使用在线黑盒优化发现并保留多样协调模式；并提出控制编辑技术，无需重训练即可适配新执行器约束。
AI.result: 在接触丰富的仿真中，模拟章鱼能够应对动态物理约束，并展现出由协调多样性带来的鲁棒适应能力；控制编辑可使现有控制器适应新执行器约束而无需重新训练。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的协调多样性使运动冗余成为软多臂机器人适应的实际资源，为软体多臂机器人在动态约束下的无示范控制与适应提供了新途径。

title: JEPA Guided Diffusion: Predictive Vision-Language Conditioning for Generative Traffic Forecasting
comment: ECCV Workshop 2026, AI City Challenge 2026 Track 5
summary: Accurate traffic forecasting requires both understanding scene dynamics and synthesizing realistic future observations. Recent diffusion-based video generation models produce visually plausible predictions but require expensive end-to-end training and often entangle scene understanding with image synthesis. In this work, we propose a decoupled forecasting framework that separates future representation learning from video generation. A frozen V-JEPA encoder first extracts predictive latent representations from the observed traffic videos, capturing the underlying scene dynamics in a semantic latent space. A lightweight latent alignment module then projects these representations into the conditioning space of a frozen Cosmos diffusion module, enabling future video synthesis without retraining the large generative model. By freezing all foundation models and training only the lightweight alignment module, the proposed framework substantially reduces optimization complexity while preserving forecasting capability. Experimental results on the AI City Challenge 2026 Track 5 benchmark demonstrate that the proposed method achieved a score of 75.1297, ranking third in the competition. These results suggest that predictive world representations learned by V-JEPA can effectively guide downstream video generation, providing a practical and efficient alternative to end-to-end diffusion-based forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出一种解耦式交通预测框架：冻结V-JEPA提取预测性潜表征，再用轻量对齐模块将其映射到冻结Cosmos扩散模型的条件空间以生成未来视频，仅训练对齐模块。在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 5上得分75.1297，排名第三。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的视频生成模型虽能产生视觉合理的交通预测，但需要昂贵的端到端训练，且常将场景理解与图像合成纠缠在一起。研究希望分离未来表征学习与视频生成，降低优化复杂度并提高效率。
AI.method: 使用冻结的V-JEPA编码器从观测交通视频中提取语义潜表征，捕捉场景动态；通过轻量潜对齐模块将这些表征投影到冻结Cosmos扩散模块的条件空间；冻结所有基础模型，仅训练轻量对齐模块，从而在无需重训大型生成模型的情况下合成未来视频。
AI.result: 在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 5基准上取得75.1297分，排名第三。结果表明V-JEPA学到的预测性世界表征能有效指导下游视频生成。
AI.conclusion: 该解耦框架为端到端扩散式交通预测提供了一种实用且高效的替代方案，在降低优化复杂度的同时保持预测能力。

title: AgentVidBench: A Multi-Hop Video Question Answering Benchmark for Evaluating MLLM Agents
summary: Comprehensive video understanding is crucial for advancing artificial intelligence toward the intricate dynamics of the physical world. While recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in video understanding, existing benchmarks remain confined to simple scene-level queries or global summaries that require only single-step inference. Real-world video understanding involves more challenging tasks that require multi-hop multimodal reasoning, and there is a critical absence of video benchmarks equipped to rigorously evaluate these agentic capabilities. To bridge this gap, we introduce AgentVidBench, a multi-hop video question answering benchmark focused on evaluating the spatial, temporal, and causal reasoning capabilities of MLLM agents. Beyond standard question-answer pairs, AgentVidBench provides step-by-step solution traces to support trajectory evaluation that assesses whether agents explicitly acquire the evidence needed to justify their answers. Experiments with 12 proprietary and open-source MLLMs show that single-turn performance remains limited on AgentVidBench, while integrating these models into state-of-the-art agentic workflows generally improves performance with respect to both accuracy and trajectory scores. We further present a simple yet effective agentic strategy that serves as a competitive baseline on AgentVidBench, establishing our benchmark as a holistic testbed for future research on agentic video understanding. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/krafton-ai/agentvidbench and https://huggingface.co/datasets/agentvidbench/agentvidbench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 AgentVidBench，一个面向多跳视频问答的基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型智能体在空间、时间和因果推理上的能力，并提供分步解题轨迹以支持过程评估。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解基准多局限于简单场景查询或全局摘要，只需单步推理，无法严格评估真实世界中需要多跳多模态推理的智能体能力，因此亟需专门的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 AgentVidBench 多跳视频问答基准，除问答对外还提供逐步解题轨迹以支持轨迹评估；对12个专有和开源 MLLM 进行实验，并测试将其集成到先进智能体工作流中的效果，同时提出一个简单有效的智能体策略作为基线。
AI.result: 实验表明，单轮模型在 AgentVidBench 上性能有限；将模型集成到先进智能体工作流后，准确率和轨迹分数通常均有提升；所提简单智能体策略成为有竞争力的基线。
AI.conclusion: AgentVidBench 可作为智能体视频理解研究的综合性测试平台，推动多跳、多模态、可解释的视频推理研究。

title: Aligning with Lived Experience: Heterogeneous Benefits of Fine Tuning in Mental Health Support Generation
summary: As access to professional mental healthcare remains limited, many individuals turn to online platforms such as Reddit to seek peer support situated within human lived experience. However, a significant portion of such queries go unanswered, presenting an opportunity for using Large Language Models (LLMs) to fill this gap. While LLMs have demonstrated strong performance on clinical benchmarks, their ability to generate lived-experience informed and community-aligned peer support is underexplored. Addressing this gap, we introduce the COmmunity-centered Peer Engaged Support (COPES) dataset and a three-axis evaluation framework to assess LLM alignment with community perspectives to mental health support seeking queries. Evaluating zero-shot and post-trained (SFT and DPO) models, we show that post-training on COPES significantly improves Strategy Alignment (>50% for general-purpose models) and alignment in Emotion & Tone. However, we also observe that such improvements are heterogeneous and alignment improvements vary significantly across subreddits and requested coping strategies. Furthermore, post-training induces distributional shifts, heavily favoring problem-focused recommendations while suppressing emotion-focused strategies. Together, this work shows that while curating community-driven data improves the alignment of LLM responses, model performance remains disparate across distinct sub-communities and specific mental health needs.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出COPES数据集与三轴评估框架，用于评估大语言模型在在线心理健康同伴支持中是否与社区视角一致，并发现后训练能提升部分对齐指标但存在社区与策略差异。
AI.motivation: 专业心理医疗服务可及性有限，许多人转向Reddit等在线社区寻求基于真实生活经验的同伴支持，但大量求助无人回应，因此探索LLM能否填补这一空白；然而LLM在临床基准上表现虽好，其生成符合社区经验和社区价值观的同伴支持能力仍缺乏研究。
AI.method: 构建COmmunity-centered Peer Engaged Support（COPES）数据集，并提出三轴评估框架，衡量LLM对心理健康求助查询的回应与社区视角的一致性；评估零样本及后训练模型，包括SFT和DPO。
AI.result: 在COPES上后训练能显著提升策略对齐，通用模型提升超过50%，并改善情绪与语气对齐；但提升具有异质性，在不同subreddit和求助者所需应对策略上差异明显。后训练还带来分布偏移，过度偏向问题聚焦建议，同时抑制情绪聚焦策略。
AI.conclusion: 整理社区驱动数据可改善LLM回应的对齐程度，但模型在不同子社区和具体心理健康需求上的表现仍不均衡，说明仅靠社区数据后训练尚不足以实现普遍有效的同伴支持。

title: MA-LIPP: Cooperative Multi-Agent Load-Aware Informative Path Planning for Heterogeneous Robot Teams
summary: Field robotics missions often require physical samples to be returned to laboratories for analysis, making path planning inherently load-aware and order-dependent as accumulated samples increase payload and traversal energy costs. In single-robot Load-Aware Informative Path Planning (LIPP), this rigidly couples sensing with hauling: a solitary robot must transport every collected sample, forcing frequent depot returns that severely restrict its spatial coverage. Heterogeneous multi-robot teams can overcome this bottleneck by dividing labor---enabling high-precision samplers to collect while high-capacity carriers handle transport. However, this introduces a complex coordination challenge regarding when, where, what, and to whom handoffs should occur on top of the LIPP problem. To address this tightly coupled problem, we introduce Multi-Agent LIPP (MA-LIPP), which enables teams to cooperate through asynchronous "dead drops," allowing one robot to deposit samples for another to retrieve later without requiring synchronous rendezvous. We formulate MA-LIPP as an exact Mixed-Integer Quadratic Program (MIQP) alongside a scalable Pairwise Large-Neighborhood Search (LNS) heuristic for complex real-world applications. The heuristic matches exact optima in $95.5\%$ of certified cases and reduces weighted posterior variance by $16.1$--$19.8\%$ relative to a sequential baseline on larger instances of up to 12 robots, providing a robust framework for cooperative physical-sampling missions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MA-LIPP，面向载荷感知信息路径规划中采样与运输强耦合的问题，利用异构多机器人团队通过异步“死投”交接样本，并给出精确 MIQP 与可扩展 Pairwise LNS 启发式。
AI.motivation: 野外机器人采样需将物理样本送回实验室分析，累积样本会增加载荷和遍历能耗，使路径规划具有载荷感知和顺序依赖。单机器人 LIPP 中采样与运输不可分离，必须频繁返回 depot，严重限制覆盖范围；多机器人分工虽可缓解瓶颈，但引入何时、何地、交接何物、交给谁的协同难题。
AI.method: 将 MA-LIPP 形式化为精确 Mixed-Integer Quadratic Program（MIQP），并提出可扩展的 Pairwise Large-Neighborhood Search（LNS）启发式。方法支持异步“dead drops”，即一个机器人放置样本、另一个机器人稍后取走，无需同步会合。
AI.result: Pairwise LNS 启发式在 95.5% 的认证案例中与精确最优解匹配；在最多 12 个机器人的较大实例上，相比顺序基线将加权后验方差降低 16.1%–19.8%。
AI.conclusion: MA-LIPP 为协同物理采样任务提供了稳健框架，通过异构多机器人分工和异步样本交接，有效提升信息采集效率并缓解单机器人运输瓶颈。

title: Generative Artificial Intelligence Chatbots for Motivational Interviewing: A Scoping Review From System Design to Intervention Outcomes
summary: Motivational interviewing (MI) is a collaborative approach to elicit autonomous motivation for health behavior change. Generative AI (GenAI) offers new ways to deliver MI via conversational systems, but evidence on their design, assessment, and translation into interventions remains fragmented. This scoping review characterized evidence on GenAI-MI chatbots across system design, safety, MI quality, user perceptions, and intervention outcomes. We conducted a PRISMA-ScR scoping review. Nine datasets were searched for studies published or publicly available from January 1, 2015 to June 2, 2026 that used GenAI to generate MI chatbot responses or counselor utterances. Data were extracted using a predefined framework and synthesized descriptively. Forty-seven reports (48 studies) were included. Twenty (41.7%) focused on system design without direct participant use; 28 (58.3%) involved direct interaction. Most systems were text based and disembodied; 23 (47.9%) incorporated dynamic adaptation. Safety measures were unevenly reported. Among studies with direct use, 21/28 (75.0%) reported informed consent or user education. Thirty (62.5%) assessed MI quality, generally suggesting MI-consistent interactions. User perceptions were favorable, especially empathy, usability, helpfulness, and intention to use, though measures were heterogeneous. Eighteen (37.5%) reported intervention outcomes, mostly after a single session. Positive findings were more consistent for short-term motivation than sustained behavioral or functional change. GenAI-MI chatbots can deliver MI-consistent interactions perceived favorably, but evidence for sustained behavioral or functional change is limited. Future research should strengthen runtime safety monitoring, standardize MI quality assessment, and use longer-term comparative designs with behavioral and functional outcomes.

AI.tldr: 这篇范围综述总结了生成式AI动机性访谈聊天机器人的证据，涵盖系统设计、安全性、MI质量、用户感知和干预结果。共纳入47篇报告（48项研究），发现能提供MI一致的互动且用户评价积极，但对持续行为或功能改变的证据有限。
AI.motivation: 动机性访谈是促进健康行为改变的有效方法，生成式AI为通过对话系统提供MI提供了新途径，但相关证据在设计、评估和转化方面分散，因此需要系统综述。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA-ScR范围综述方法，检索9个数据库，时间从2015年1月1日至2026年6月2日，纳入使用生成式AI生成MI聊天机器人回应或咨询师话语的研究。使用预定义框架提取数据并进行描述性综合。
AI.result: 纳入47篇报告（48项研究）。20项（41.7%）仅关注系统设计，28项（58.3%）涉及直接互动。多数系统为文本式、无实体；23项（47.9%）具有动态适应。安全性报告不均；直接使用研究中21/28（75.0%）报告了知情同意或用户教育。30项（62.5%）评估了MI质量，普遍显示MI一致的互动。用户感知积极，尤其是共情、可用性、帮助性和使用意愿，但测量异质性大。18项（37.5%）报告了干预结果，多为单次会话后；短期动机的积极结果较一致，但持续行为或功能改变证据有限。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI-MI聊天机器人能提供MI一致的互动并获得积极评价，但对持续行为或功能改变的证据有限。未来研究应加强运行时安全监测，标准化MI质量评估，并采用更长期的比较设计，关注行为和功能结局。

title: Same World, Different Knowledge: When Isolated Audits Misjudge World-Model Repairs
summary:
A repair favored under an isolated input fault can be inferior when deployed modules share the faulty information. We introduce an information-interface
  audit for world models, distinguishing fidelity gaps, where exact inputs become estimates, from availability gaps, where inputs are missing. Fixed-weight
  interventions measure prediction error, input dependence, and paired closed-loop benefit, including dependencies introduced by reconstruction. In
  simulated quadrotor model predictive control, coupled, opposite-sign 10% mass/thrust calibration errors reduce a physics-anchored model's success from 69%
  to 8%; uncertainty training restores 65%. Wind reconstruction recovers control benefit but inherits calibration dependence. For a positive calibration
  offset, reconstruction-only corruption favors uncertainty-trained reconstruction, whereas shared corruption favors the baseline. Acceleration diagnostics
  reveal compensation between reconstruction bias and nominal-model error, also observed with a disturbance observer. Repair selection therefore depends on
  the information paths used in deployment.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出面向世界模型的信息接口审计框架，区分保真度缺口与可用性缺口，并在模拟四旋翼模型预测控制中评估不同修复策略，表明修复效果依赖于部署时的信息路径。
AI.motivation: 孤立输入故障下表现更优的修复，在部署模块共享故障信息时可能反而更差；因此需要审计世界模型的信息接口，以理解修复策略的适用条件。
AI.method: 提出信息接口审计，区分保真度缺口（精确输入变为估计值）与可用性缺口（输入缺失）；采用固定权重干预测量预测误差、输入依赖性和成对闭环收益（含重建引入的依赖）。在模拟四旋翼MPC中测试校准误差、不确定性训练、风重建等，并利用加速度诊断和扰动观测器分析。
AI.result: 耦合反号的10%质量/推力校准误差使物理锚定模型成功率从69%降至8%，不确定性训练恢复至65%；风重建可恢复控制收益但继承校准依赖。正校准偏移下，仅重建腐败时不确定性训练重建占优，共享腐败时基线占优；加速度诊断显示重建偏差与标称模型误差间存在补偿，扰动观测器亦有类似现象。
AI.conclusion: 修复策略的选择取决于部署中所使用的信息路径，需根据信息接口审计结果决定采用何种修复。

title: LogicTrack: Auditing Reasoning Trajectories of Large Language Models with Formal Logic Solvers
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has been shown to improve the performance of large language models (LLMs), yet existing optimization methods largely rely on outcome-based feedback, leaving the logical validity of intermediate reasoning steps largely unverified. To address the gap whereby LLMs arrive at correct final answers through logically flawed intermediate reasoning chains, we propose LogicTrack, a neuro-symbolic framework that audits reasoning trajectories by auto-formalizing each reasoning step into symbolic representations and verifying it with automated theorem provers. LogicTrack introduces Solver-Based Backtracking Reward (SBR), a step-wise scoring mechanism that quantifies logical soundness and guides backtracking tree search at inference time. We further extend LogicTrack to construct supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data with backtracking traces from its trajectories, enabling fine-tuned models to internalize step-wise auditing as an intrinsic capability. Extensive experiments across 8 reasoning benchmarks and 7 LLMs demonstrate that LogicTrack effectively improves both the verifiability of reasoning chains and final answer pass rate, thereby enhancing overall CoT quality and trustworthiness in high-stakes domains.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LogicTrack，一个神经符号框架，用于审计大语言模型思维链推理的中间步骤逻辑有效性，通过符号化验证、回溯搜索和微调提升推理链可验证性与最终答案准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有思维链优化多依赖结果反馈，中间推理步骤的逻辑正确性未被充分验证，导致模型可能通过逻辑有缺陷的推理链得到正确答案。
AI.method: LogicTrack将每个推理步骤自动形式化为符号表示，并用自动定理证明器验证；提出基于求解器的回溯奖励SBR，逐步量化逻辑合理性并指导推理时回溯树搜索；进一步利用回溯轨迹构建监督微调数据，使模型内化逐步审计能力。
AI.result: 在8个推理基准和7个大语言模型上实验表明，LogicTrack有效提升推理链可验证性和最终答案通过率，增强思维链整体质量与可信度。
AI.conclusion: LogicTrack有助于在高风险领域提升大语言模型思维链推理的可信性与可靠性，弥合结果正确但过程逻辑缺陷的问题。

title: A Scene Language Model for Open-Vocabulary Scene Mapping
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D scene mapping aims to build a persistent representation of the objects in an environment. Existing systems typically rely on engineered mapping pipelines to associate observations, merge information across views, and maintain a consistent scene representation over time. Many additionally store feature-rich object representations, such as embeddings or image crops, increasing the size and complexity of the persistent memory. We introduce SceneLM, a Scene-Language Model that directly maintains a textual scene map. The full scene is represented as a structured text list of objects, which serves as the model's only persistent memory. For each input image, the model reads the current scene state and updates the map by adding, editing, and removing objects. To learn this behavior, we introduce supervision tasks for iterative scene map maintenance together with an automatic annotation pipeline that generates training data from images without human labels. We evaluate SceneLM on both a language-grounded retrieval benchmark and a localization benchmark. Across both benchmarks, the model produces a scene map that achieves competitive performance with complete mapping systems built from dedicated perception and geometric modules while producing a scene representation that is 6-12x more compact. We further show that SceneLM can be run online on an edge device through experiments on a quadruped. These results show that a persistent open-vocabulary 3D scene map can be maintained directly by a single vision-language model using only a lightweight text representation. Training and inference code is available on https://goldengait.github.io/scenelm/.

AI.tldr: SceneLM 提出用单一视觉-语言模型直接维护结构化文本场景地图，通过逐帧读取并更新对象列表实现开放词汇 3D 场景建图，仅需轻量文本表示。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇 3D 场景建图依赖工程化流水线进行观测关联、跨视图融合和一致性维护，并常存储嵌入或图像裁剪等特征丰富的对象表示，导致持久内存更大、系统更复杂。
AI.method: 将完整场景表示为结构化文本对象列表，作为模型唯一持久记忆；对每张输入图像，模型读取当前场景状态并添加、编辑、删除对象。提出迭代式场景地图维护监督任务，以及无需人工标注的自动标注流水线来生成训练数据。
AI.result: 在语言检索和定位基准上，SceneLM 生成的场景地图与由专用感知和几何模块构建的完整建图系统性能相当，但表示紧凑性提升 6-12 倍；并可在四足机器人边缘设备上在线运行。
AI.conclusion: 持久化开放词汇 3D 场景地图可以直接由单个视觉-语言模型维护，仅使用轻量级文本表示即可实现有竞争力的性能与在线部署能力。

title: Geometry of Values: Task Vector Composition for Ethical Preference Alignment in Language Models
comment: Accepted at the Pluralistic Alignment Workshop @ ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea. https://icml.cc/virtual/2026/75692
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in applications that must weigh clashing moral values, yet even strong models exhibit hidden biases and brittle instruction-following across languages. We introduce a 12,000-instance dataset of two-option dilemmas covering pairwise three value conflicts: Honesty vs. Justice, Justice vs. Autonomy, and Autonomy vs. Honesty, along with their translations into Hindi, Arabic, Spanish, and Chinese, to probe cross-lingual behavior. Benchmarking on GPT-5-mini reveals that it consistently favors Honesty over Autonomy across all five languages when no policy is given. The Llama-3.2-1/3B models exhibit strong first-option bias; however, both plain fine-tuning and Direct Preference Optimization fine-tuning effectively remove this bias, increasing accuracy to greater than 98%. In order to decouple the effect of learning correlations in the dataset from abstract values, we propose a task vector transfer based experiment where after computing the task vectors for a direction of value preference we orthogonalize it with respect to the general instruction following vector. Our experiment shows that this method is effective in isolating the direction of the specific value preference that can successfully be used to conduct task arithmetic to obtain a model with the opposite stance.

AI.tldr: 论文构建了涵盖诚实、公正、自主三种价值观两两冲突的双选项道德困境数据集，共12000条，并翻译为印地语、阿拉伯语、西班牙语和中文，用于评估大语言模型的跨语言道德偏好与偏见，并探索微调和任务向量方法对价值偏好的影响。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多用于需要权衡冲突道德价值的场景，但即使强模型也存在隐藏偏见，且跨语言指令遵循能力脆弱，因此需要系统探测其道德价值偏好及跨语言行为。
AI.method: 构建包含诚实vs公正、公正vs自主、自主vs诚实三类两两价值冲突的双选项困境数据集，规模12000条，并翻译为五种语言；在GPT-5-mini和Llama-3.2-1/3B等模型上基准测试；使用普通微调和直接偏好优化（DPO）微调；提出基于任务向量迁移的实验，通过将价值偏好方向与通用指令遵循向量正交化，以分离特定价值偏好方向，并进行任务算术得到相反立场模型。
AI.result: GPT-5-mini在无政策提示时，在所有五种语言中一致偏好诚实而非自主；Llama-3.2-1/3B表现出强首选项偏见，但普通微调和DPO微调均能有效消除该偏见，准确率提升至98%以上；任务向量正交化实验能有效隔离特定价值偏好方向，并可通过任务算术获得持有相反立场的模型。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了跨语言道德困境基准，揭示了模型的价值偏好和选项位置偏见，并表明微调可缓解偏见，任务向量正交化有助于分离抽象价值偏好与数据集相关性，从而实现可控的价值立场调整。

title: SIRA: Reasoning-Aware Surgical Instrument Segmentation via Query-Anchored Alignment
summary: Surgical instrument segmentation (SIS) plays a critical role in robotic assistance and surgical workflow analysis. However, most existing SIS methods formulate segmentation as a category-driven localization problem, limiting their ability to capture procedural context and task-dependent semantics in surgical workflows. We introduce Reasoning-Aware Surgical Instrument Segmentation (RA-SIS), a task formulation that frames segmentation as query-conditioned inference under surgical context. To benchmark this setting, we construct SurgRS, a surgical reasoning segmentation dataset consisting of 41,000 image-text pairs, which aligns instance-level masks with structured query-answer supervision to enable semantic grounding at the pixel level. Based on SurgRS, we propose Surgical Instrument Reasoning and Segmentation Assistant (SIRA), a multimodal framework that disentangles target-level and query-level semantics and integrates them with visual features through query-anchored dual alignment. By aligning query semantics with spatial features and segmentation prompts, SIRA enhances semantic-visual consistency in mask prediction. Extensive experiments on SurgRS demonstrate improvements over existing reasoning-aware baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/linxir226/SIRA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出推理感知手术器械分割（RA-SIS）新任务，并构建SurgRS数据集与SIRA多模态框架，实现基于查询和手术上下文的分割。
AI.motivation: 现有手术器械分割方法多将分割视为类别驱动的定位问题，难以捕捉手术流程中的程序上下文和任务相关语义。
AI.method: 提出RA-SIS任务，将分割定义为手术上下文下的查询条件推理；构建SurgRS数据集，包含41,000个图像-文本对，将实例级掩码与结构化问答监督对齐；提出SIRA多模态框架，通过查询锚定双重对齐解耦目标级和查询级语义，并与视觉特征、分割提示对齐。
AI.result: 在SurgRS上的大量实验表明，SIRA优于现有推理感知基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 推理感知分割有助于提升手术器械分割的语义-视觉一致性，代码已开源。

title: PolyBridgeBench: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for Physics-Grounded Bridge Design
summary: Multimodal large language models, or MLLMs, perform well at visual understanding and structured generation, yet these capabilities do not establish whether an engineering design will work when executed. Existing benchmarks assess spatial reasoning, structural validity, or physics-grounded construction, but they do not determine whether MLLMs can synthesize complete load-bearing structures and repair them after simulator execution exposes a failure. We introduce PolyBridgeBench, an executable benchmark for multimodal bridge design. A model receives a visual scene and structured engineering constraints and generates a complete node--member--material topology. Deterministic legality checks gate execution in a native dynamic physics simulation. Following an execution failure, the benchmark returns temporal visual evidence from the failed rollout and evaluates repair under a fixed interaction budget. Separate measurements of deterministic validity, dynamic functional success, and post-failure recovery identify the stage at which design fails. Experiments with six representative MLLMs across 189 levels expose a substantial gap between deterministic validity and dynamic success, pronounced sensitivity to material budgets, and limited post-failure recovery under the primary strict-budget setting.

AI.tldr: 提出 PolyBridgeBench，一个可执行的多模态桥梁设计基准，用于评估 MLLM 生成完整承重结构、在物理仿真中执行并在失败后修复的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多评估空间推理、结构有效性或物理构建，但无法判断 MLLM 能否综合完整承重结构，并在仿真执行暴露失败后进行修复。
AI.method: 模型接收视觉场景和结构化工程约束，生成节点-构件-材料拓扑；通过确定性合法性检查后进入原生动态物理仿真；失败后返回失败 rollout 的时序视觉证据，并在固定交互预算下评估修复。分别测量确定性有效性、动态功能成功和失败后恢复。
AI.result: 在 189 个关卡上测试 6 个代表性 MLLM，发现确定性有效性与动态成功之间存在显著差距，对材料预算高度敏感，且在主要严格预算设置下失败后恢复能力有限。
AI.conclusion: PolyBridgeBench 能定位设计失败阶段；当前 MLLM 在可执行桥梁设计，尤其是动态成功与失败修复方面仍存在明显不足。

title: OpenRoIS: A Community-Driven Open-Source Middleware Implementing the Robotic Interaction Service (RoIS) Framework for Physical Robots and Virtual Agents
comment: Submitted for presentation at the 2027 IEEE/SICE International Symposium on System Integration (SII), Kobe, Japan
summary: Service applications for human-robot interaction are commonly written against the hardware-specific interfaces of one platform, so a change of hardware forces a rewrite of the application. The Robotic Interaction Service (RoIS) Framework 2.0, standardized by the Object Management Group (OMG), addresses this fragmentation by defining a platform-independent model in which Service Applications interact with Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) Engines through standardized interfaces and hardware-independent symbolic messages. A specification alone, however, does not provide the maintained implementation, Software Development Kits (SDKs), and adapters needed for practical adoption. This paper presents OpenRoIS, a community-driven open-source middleware providing a concrete implementation of the RoIS Framework 2.0. It takes the position that an openly developed, paradigm-neutral implementation is what carries the standard from specification to practice. OpenRoIS contributes a recursive engine architecture in which a single engine class realizes the main and sub HRI Engine roles, an internal five-method component contract distinct from the five external RoIS interfaces, a mapping of those interfaces onto JSON-RPC 2.0 over WebSocket, a single-source-of-truth type pipeline that generates three consistent language stacks, TypeScript and C# client SDKs that include web and Unity support, and a Python adapter SDK that includes ROS 2 support. Through the common RoIS interfaces, a Service Application can address physical robots and virtual agents over the internet. All source code, interface types, and documentation are released under the Apache-2.0 license and openly developed at https://openrois.org/.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了OpenRoIS，一个社区驱动的开源中间件，实现了OMG标准的RoIS框架2.0，旨在解决人机交互服务应用因硬件平台变更而需重写的问题，提供了跨平台的标准化接口和多种SDK。
AI.motivation: 服务应用通常针对特定硬件接口编写，更换硬件需重写。RoIS 2.0标准虽定义了平台无关模型，但缺乏维护实现、SDK和适配器，难以实际采用。
AI.method: OpenRoIS作为开源中间件，实现了RoIS框架2.0。其方法包括：递归引擎架构（单引擎类实现主/子HRI引擎角色）、内部五方法组件契约（区别于五个外部RoIS接口）、将接口映射到基于WebSocket的JSON-RPC 2.0、单一数据源类型管道生成三种一致语言栈、提供TypeScript和C#客户端SDK（支持Web和Unity）、以及Python适配器SDK（支持ROS 2）。
AI.result: 通过通用的RoIS接口，服务应用可以经由互联网控制物理机器人和虚拟代理。所有源码、接口类型和文档以Apache-2.0许可开源，并在https://openrois.org/开放开发。
AI.conclusion: OpenRoIS作为一个开放开发、范式中立的实现，将RoIS标准从规范推向实践，促进了人机交互服务应用的跨平台复用。

title: Quantization-Aware Kalman Estimation for Diffusion Sampling
summary: Quantization offers a practical path to deploying diffusion models with reduced memory and computation, but aggressive compression can cause quantized outputs to deviate substantially from their full-precision counterparts. Sampling-stage correction methods seek to compensate for such deviations during sampling, but existing approaches rely primarily on local information and underexploit trajectory history, limiting their ability to correct errors that propagate across timesteps. In this work, we formulate sampling with a quantized denoiser as an online estimation problem, using the history of quantized denoiser outputs to recover the underlying full-precision outputs required by the sampler. We propose QuAKE, a Quantization-Aware Kalman Estimator that combines a smooth trajectory prior with a conditional Gaussian observation model. At each sampling step, QuAKE recursively updates the posterior over the output window in closed form and feeds its posterior mean to the sampler. QuAKE is a lightweight plug-and-play corrector that requires no modification to the quantized network and naturally supports arbitrary high-order multistep ODE samplers. Experiments across W4A4-quantized text-to-image diffusion models show that QuAKE consistently outperforms existing methods in reducing the distributional discrepancy from full-precision sampling.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 QuAKE，一种面向量化扩散模型采样阶段的轻量校正器，将量化去噪器采样建模为在线估计问题，利用历史输出来恢复全精度去噪输出，从而减小量化采样与全精度采样的分布差异。
AI.motivation: 量化可降低扩散模型的内存和计算开销，但激进量化会使输出显著偏离全精度结果。现有采样阶段校正方法主要依赖局部信息，未充分利用轨迹历史，难以纠正跨时间步传播的误差。
AI.method: 将使用量化去噪器的采样表述为在线估计问题，用历史量化去噪器输出来估计采样器所需的全精度输出。提出 QuAKE（Quantization-Aware Kalman Estimator），结合平滑轨迹先验与条件高斯观测模型，在每个采样步以闭式递归更新输出窗口的后验，并将后验均值输入采样器。QuAKE 是轻量即插即用校正器，无需修改量化网络，并支持任意高阶多步 ODE 采样器。
AI.result: 在 W4A4 量化的文本到图像扩散模型实验中，QuAKE 在减小与全精度采样的分布差异方面持续优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: QuAKE 通过利用轨迹历史进行量化感知的在线估计，为量化扩散模型采样提供了一种有效、通用且无需改动网络的校正方案。

title: Robust Structureless Monocular Visual Inertial Initialization Exploiting Line Features and Vanishing Points
summary: Accurate initialization is essential for reliable visual-inertial odometry (VIO), but it is often ill-conditioned under degenerate motions. Existing methods typically require restrictive excitation motions to ensure sufficient observability or rely on computationally expensive 3D structure reconstruction, limiting efficient and practical deployment. To address these limitations, we propose SLIM-init, a structureless monocular VIO initializer that directly exploits geometric constraints from tracked 2D line features without explicit 3D landmark reconstruction. Specifically, SLIM-init leverages line-derived vanishing points (VPs) as translation-invariant orientation cues to provide robust rotation-only constraints under degenerate scenarios such as low-parallax or translation-dominant motions. It further incorporates a line epipolar residual to constrain translation and a line-normal projection residual to improve the conditioning of linear alignment, enhancing the accuracy and robustness of initial state estimation. Extensive experiments on a public benchmark and challenging custom degenerate-motion sequences demonstrate improved accuracy and robustness over state-of-the-art initialization methods. The source code is available at: https://github.com/cjunwan/SLIM-init.

AI.tldr: 提出 SLIM-init，一种无结构单目视觉惯性里程计初始化方法，利用2D线特征几何约束，在退化运动下实现更准确、鲁棒的初始化。
AI.motivation: 准确的初始化对可靠VIO至关重要，但在退化运动下往往病态。现有方法通常需要限制性激励运动以保证可观测性，或依赖计算昂贵的3D结构重建，难以高效实用部署。
AI.method: SLIM-init直接利用跟踪到的2D线特征几何约束，无需显式3D路标重建。它使用线推导的消失点作为平移不变姿态线索，在低视差或平移主导等退化场景提供旋转约束；引入线极线残差约束平移，并利用线法向投影残差改善线性对齐条件数。
AI.result: 在公开基准和具有挑战性的自定义退化运动序列上，SLIM-init相比最先进初始化方法在准确性和鲁棒性上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: SLIM-init能够在不进行显式3D重建的情况下，有效提升退化运动下单目VIO初始化的精度与鲁棒性，方法更高效实用，源代码已开源。

title: When to Waddle: A Comparative Study of Bipedal Torso-Stabilization on Low-Friction Surfaces
summary: Low-friction surfaces challenge bipedal locomotion by limiting the contact forces available during stepping. Inspired by penguin waddling, we investigate how lateral torso motion and center of mass (COM) placement affect locomotion as surface friction changes. Using a five-actuator biped, we compare an upright-gait strategy with a penguin-inspired torso-over-stance-leg strategy across multiple COM placements in simulation and hardware. In the 3-D simulator MuJoCo, we sweep through sinusoidal leg and hip actuation parameters across four friction coefficients mu = 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7. In simulation, torso-over-stance-leg motion produces more successful controllers and higher forward speeds at low friction, with the highest speed occurring for the high-COM configuration. Hardware experiments show the same low-friction speed trend: at mu=0.12, torso-over-stance-leg motion increases forward speed and reduces cost of transport at both tested COM ratios, and the higher COM also improves both measures. The high-COM penguin configuration is the fastest and most energy efficient while maintaining low sideways foot motion. At mu=0.45, the COM trend reverses: the lower-COM configurations are faster and more energy efficient, while gait strategy has little effect on forward speed but still changes sideways foot motion. These results show that the effects of lateral torso motion and COM placement depend on the available friction, and that forward speed, energy use, and slip-related foot motion can be modulated with a penguin-inspired torso motion on hardware.

AI.tldr: 受企鹅摇摆启发，研究低摩擦表面上躯干侧向运动与质心（COM）位置如何影响双足运动，并通过五执行器双足机器人的仿真与硬件实验比较直立步态和企鹅式躯干越过支撑腿策略。
AI.motivation: 低摩擦表面会限制 stepping 时可用接触力，挑战双足运动；因此需要理解侧向躯干运动和 COM 放置随摩擦变化如何影响行走速度、能效和滑移相关足部运动。
AI.method: 使用五执行器双足机器人，在 MuJoCo 仿真中扫描正弦腿部和髋部驱动参数，覆盖摩擦系数 mu=0.1、0.3、0.5、0.7；比较直立步态与企鹅式躯干越过支撑腿策略，并在多个 COM 位置下进行仿真和硬件实验，硬件测试 mu=0.12 和 mu=0.45。
AI.result: 仿真中，低摩擦下企鹅式躯干越过支撑腿运动产生更多成功控制器和更高前进速度，高 COM 配置速度最高。硬件中，mu=0.12 时该策略提高前进速度并降低运输成本，高 COM 也改善两者且侧向足部运动低；mu=0.45 时 COM 趋势反转，低 COM 配置更快更节能，步态策略对速度影响小但仍改变侧向足部运动。
AI.conclusion: 侧向躯干运动和 COM 放置的效果取决于可用摩擦；企鹅式躯干运动可在硬件上调节前进速度、能量消耗和滑移相关足部运动。

title: The Communication Bottleneck: A Round-Trip Study of Tree-Structured Expression Serialization in Language Models
summary: When language models reason in chain-of-thought or exchange free-text intermediates, they serialize structured information into natural language. How much tree-structured compositional content survives this bottleneck? We propose a round-trip protocol that answers this question empirically for tree-structured expressions. A generator converts a procedurally generated arithmetic expression into a word problem, a separate extractor recovers the expression from the word problem alone, and symbolic equivalence provides an exact oracle. Evaluating all pairwise combinations of sixteen models yields a communication matrix whose marginals separate generation quality from extraction quality. Three main findings emerge. First, the channel is lossy and asymmetric: swapping which model generates and which extracts shifts accuracy by up to 60.4 points, and the best pair reaches 92.9% by combining different models on each end rather than the same model on both. Second, at least 73.6% of round-trip failures originate at generation, and difficulty is driven by tree structure (operator count, depth, right-branching) rather than model family. Third, the channel is trainable: ~3600 fine-tuning examples that share the evaluation's operators and tree shapes lift every open-weight model above untrained Gemini-3.1-Pro, an upper bound under matched semantics. A disjoint-domain regime with new operators and vocabulary also raises every open-weight model, confirming the gain is not an artifact of matched semantics, though a gap to the frontier remains. Together these results identify tree-structured expression serialization as a primary limiting factor when models communicate hierarchical structure through natural language.

AI.tldr: 论文提出往返协议，评估语言模型将树结构算术表达式序列化为自然语言后能否被另一模型恢复，发现该通道有损、不对称、生成端为主要瓶颈，且可通过微调改善。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在链式思考或交换自由文本中间结果时，会把结构化信息序列化为自然语言。这种瓶颈会损失多少树结构组合内容尚不清楚，因此需要实证研究。
AI.method: 提出往返协议：生成器把程序生成的算术表达式转成应用题，独立提取器仅从应用题恢复表达式，符号等价提供精确评判。对16个模型的所有配对进行评估，得到通信矩阵；还使用约3600条微调样本，以及含新算子和词汇的分布外设置进行测试。
AI.result: 通道有损且不对称：生成与提取角色互换会使准确率最多变化60.4个百分点；最佳异模型配对达到92.9%。至少73.6%的往返失败源于生成端；难度主要由树结构（算子数、深度、右分支）驱动，而非模型家族。微调可使所有开源权重模型超过未训练Gemini-3.1-Pro；在新算子和词汇的分布外设置下仍有提升，但与前沿模型存在差距。
AI.conclusion: 树结构表达式序列化是模型通过自然语言交流层级结构时的主要限制因素，且该瓶颈可通过针对性训练部分缓解。

title: From Task Success to Productive Success: Evaluating Human-AI Collaboration by Quality and Cost
summary: AI productivity is often measured by task completion time, economic value, or improvements in outcome quality. However, these measures usually treat collaboration as a black box where they capture what output was produced, but not the interaction cost required to produce it. Motivated by economics literature, we introduce a productivity-oriented framework for evaluating human-AI collaboration as outcome quality relative to interaction cost. Across two datasets spanning four tasks, we show that: (1) sessions with identical quality ratings can differ by up to 70 times in interaction cost; (2) quality-cost relationships vary by task, with some tasks rewarding extended interaction and others favoring fast convergence; (3) subjective user ratings are not reliable substitutes for productivity; and (4) productive sessions are characterized by agents probing earlier and users spending less effort repairing the interaction. By distinguishing productive success from costly success, our framework makes interactional cost visible and shows how dialogue analysis can inform the evaluation and design of AI systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出以“结果质量相对交互成本”衡量人-AI协作生产力的框架，并通过两个数据集、四项任务表明交互成本是评价AI系统时不可忽视的关键维度。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生产力多用任务完成时间、经济价值或结果质量衡量，把协作过程视为黑箱，只关注产出什么，却忽略产生该产出所需的交互成本。受经济学启发，作者希望让交互成本可见，并区分高生产力成功与高成本成功。
AI.method: 提出面向生产力的评估框架，将生产力定义为结果质量相对于交互成本；在覆盖四项任务的两个数据集上分析人-AI协作对话，比较质量评分、交互成本、任务差异、主观用户评分及对话行为特征。
AI.result: 研究发现：同样质量评分的会话交互成本可相差最高70倍；质量-成本关系因任务而异，有的任务受益于延长交互，有的更倾向快速收敛；用户主观评分不能可靠替代生产力；高生产力会话中AI更早主动探查，用户用于修复交互的努力更少。
AI.conclusion: 通过区分高生产力成功与高成本成功，该框架使交互成本显性化，并表明对话分析可为人-AI系统的评估与设计提供依据。

title: Scaling Forced Alignment to End-User Devices
summary: The Viterbi algorithm has been previously used to perform forced alignment of audio to text to mine training data from online resources. However, many existing implementations have quadratic time and space complexity, scaling poorly to long input sequences. We propose two optimizations to address this issue. First, we apply the Hirschberg algorithm to perform the alignment in place using linear memory. Second, we model the alignment between speech and text as a constrained random walk, allowing us to prune the search space with arbitrary confidence while accounting for transcription errors. The Hirschberg optimization reduces memory usage from 140 GB to 5 MB for three-hour inputs while producing identical alignments in one-third the time of torchaudio when both run on a CPU. We achieve an additional 2x speedup with pruning on inputs longer than 20 minutes while preserving alignment accuracy in more than 98% of tested cases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种优化方法，用于音频与文本的强制对齐，以解决现有Viterbi算法二次复杂度的问题，显著降低内存并提升速度。
AI.motivation: 现有强制对齐实现具有二次时间和空间复杂度，难以处理长输入序列。
AI.method: 使用Hirschberg算法实现线性内存对齐；将语音与文本对齐建模为约束随机游走，以任意置信度剪枝搜索空间并处理转录错误。
AI.result: Hirschberg优化将三小时输入的内存从140 GB降至5 MB，在CPU上以torchaudio三分之一时间产生相同对齐；剪枝对超过20分钟的输入再获2倍加速，在98%以上测试案例中保持对齐精度。
AI.conclusion: 所提优化有效提升了强制对齐的可扩展性和效率，同时保持准确性。

title: Stochastic Neural Signed Swept Volume for Real-time Chance-Constrained Trajectory Optimization
summary: Collision-free motion planning requires reliable collision models from sensed environments and validation of states along a continuous trajectory. To make this tractable, most planners check for collision at discrete states along continuous trajectories against a single determinized model of the environment, introducing a trade-off between safety and computational efficiency. While continuous collision checking approaches that approximate the swept volume of the robot exist, they are computationally expensive or overly conservative. Data-driven approaches can learn the swept volume; however, these neural models are susceptible to approximation errors and are therefore often limited to serving as coarse filters for downstream collision checkers. In this work, we propose to learn a signed distance function of the swept volume as a probabilistic field, enabling quantification of epistemic uncertainty, incorporation of perception noise, and eventual integration into a chance-constrained trajectory optimization framework. We demonstrate our approach on challenging high-dimensional manipulation problems with significant sensor noise, both in simulation and on real hardware.

AI.tldr: 提出学习扫掠体积的符号距离函数作为概率场，量化认知不确定性并集成感知噪声，用于机会约束轨迹优化，在高维操作任务中验证。
AI.motivation: 传统碰撞检测在离散状态检查，权衡安全与效率；连续碰撞检测计算昂贵或过于保守；数据驱动方法学习扫掠体积但存在近似误差，通常仅作粗过滤。需要一种能处理不确定性且可集成到优化中的方法。
AI.method: 学习扫掠体积的符号距离函数作为概率场，量化认知不确定性，纳入感知噪声，并集成到机会约束轨迹优化框架中。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实硬件上，针对具有显著传感器噪声的高维操作问题进行了验证。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效处理碰撞检测中的不确定性，并成功应用于高维操作任务。

title: When Online Adaptation Hurts: Parameter-Frozen Test-Time Ensembling for Continual Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Medical image segmenters often get worse when sites, scanner vendors, or protocols change. Continual test-time adaptation (CTTA) addresses this problem without target labels, but it can be impossible to update a model on a non-stationary stream and can lead to a lot of errors. We examine a more reasonable and meaningful alternative: parameter-frozen inference enhancement(PIE). We use a source-trained segmenter that learns about anatomy-preserving scale and flip views, maps their predictions back to the native location, and averages the probabilities. We do not modify the weights of the model or the normalization statistics. On a cardiac MRI stream from M\&Ms, which is trained on vendor A and evaluated sequentially on vendors B, C, and D, PIE has 0.7786 mean Dice, compared to 0.7680 for source-only inference and 0.7388--0.7416 for five other online-adaptation baselines. The controlled ablations show that performance saturates at 28 views, and confidence weighting, class-prior correction, connected-component filtering, morphological refinement, and inter-slice smoothing have no effect or cause negative transfer. Qualitative results on cardiac MRI and fundus images are also consistent with the frozen ensemble keeping thinner and nested anatomical structures. These results provide a strong, stable baseline for medical CTTA and expose an important failure mode: adaptation and handcrafted refinement can be less reliable than carefully designed inference.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究医学图像分割在跨中心、跨设备或跨协议时的性能下降问题，提出一种无需更新模型参数的推理增强方法PIE，并在心脏MRI序列适应任务上取得优于源模型和多种在线适应基线的稳定表现。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割模型在站点、扫描仪厂商或成像协议变化时性能常下降；持续测试时适应（CTTA）虽可在无目标标签下更新模型，但在非平稳数据流上可能难以更新且容易引入错误，因此需要更合理、稳定的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出参数冻结推理增强（PIE）：使用源域训练的分割器，对输入进行解剖结构保持的尺度变换和翻转视图，将各视图预测映射回原始位置后平均概率；不修改模型权重，也不更新归一化统计量。
AI.result: 在M&Ms心脏MRI数据流上，源域为厂商A，顺序评估厂商B、C、D时，PIE平均Dice为0.7786，优于仅源域推理的0.7680和五种在线适应基线的0.7388–0.7416。消融显示性能在28个视图时饱和；置信度加权、类别先验校正、连通域滤波、形态学细化和层间平滑无效或导致负迁移。心脏MRI和眼底图像的定性结果也表明冻结集成能更好保留细薄和嵌套解剖结构。
AI.conclusion: PIE为医学CTTA提供了强而稳定的基线，并揭示一个重要失效模式：模型适应和手工设计后处理可能不如精心设计的推理策略可靠。

title: P$^3$-SAM: SAM with Perceptual Parallel Prompt for Few-Shot Strip Steel Surface Defect Segmentation
comment: Accepted by ICME 2026, 6 pages, 3 figures. Corresponding authors: Anpeng Wang and Runmin Cong
summary: Few-shot semantic segmentation (FSS) of strip steel surface defects (S$^3$D) has posed significant challenges distinct from natural scenes. Unlike natural images, S$^3$D task exhibits unique characteristics including low local contrast, uneven illumination, and complex fine-grained texture patterns. Although recent methods based on Segment Anything Model (SAM) have shown promise in FSS on natural images by leveraging SAM's powerful pre-trained representations, these unique industrial characteristics of S$^3$D images lead to performance drop when directly applying SAM to industrial defect scenarios. In this paper, we propose a novel Perceptual Parallel Prompt (P$^3$) framework that empowers SAM, creating the P$^3$-SAM model to address these challenges through two core strategies. First, we develop a Perceptual-Optimized Encoding (POE) strategy that enhances local contrast and preserves critical texture details for S$^3$D segmentation. Second, we introduce the Parallel Prompt Generator (PPG) strategy that simultaneously generates both semantic and spatial prompts, enabling comprehensive guidance for SAM's decoder across varying images. Extensive experiments on three few-shot S$^3$D benchmarks demonstrate that P$^3$-SAM achieves state-of-the-art performance, with particularly notable improvements of 12.00% in mIoU on Surface Defects-4i dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文针对带钢表面缺陷小样本语义分割（S³D）中低局部对比度、光照不均和细粒度纹理复杂等工业图像难题，提出 P³-SAM 框架，通过感知优化编码和并行提示生成器改进 SAM，在多个基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 SAM 的小样本分割方法在自然图像上表现良好，但直接迁移到工业带钢表面缺陷时，因工业图像特有的低对比度、不均匀光照和复杂细粒度纹理，性能明显下降。
AI.method: 提出 Perceptual Parallel Prompt（P³）框架，构建 P³-SAM。核心包括：1）Perceptual-Optimized Encoding（POE）策略，增强局部对比度并保留关键纹理细节；2）Parallel Prompt Generator（PPG）策略，同时生成语义提示和空间提示，为 SAM 解码器提供全面引导。
AI.result: 在三个小样本 S³D 基准上，P³-SAM 达到最先进性能，其中在 Surface Defects-4i 数据集上 mIoU 提升 12.00%。
AI.conclusion: P³-SAM 能有效适配 SAM 到工业带钢表面缺陷小样本分割任务，验证了感知优化与并行提示策略在应对工业图像特殊挑战方面的有效性。

title: Learning-to-Optimize as the Missing Architectural Layer of AI-Native Networks
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is becoming a fundamental design principle of future AI-native communication networks, enabling autonomous resource management, adaptive control, and zero-touch network operation. While current AI-native architectures increasingly embed intelligence across network functions, they provide little guidance on how optimisation knowledge should be systematically generated, transferred, and exploited by AI models. This paper argues that the Learning-to-Optimize (L2O) represents the missing architectural layer between optimisation and AI-native intelligence. Rather than viewing optimisation merely as an online decision engine, the proposed paradigm redefines optimisation algorithms as offline knowledge generators that produce high-quality supervisory information for neural surrogate models. The resulting models inherit optimisation expertise while enabling low-latency runtime inference suitable for dynamic network environments. A generic four-stage L2O workflow is introduced, comprising optimisation, knowledge generation, surrogate learning, and runtime inference. Unlike existing Learning-to-Optimize approaches, which primarily focus on algorithm acceleration, the proposed framework establishes L2O as an architectural abstraction applicable across heterogeneous communication and computing systems. The proposed paradigm is illustrated by an NR-V2X relay-selection problem, in which optimisation-generated solutions from a Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) solver are used to train a Graph Neural Network that can reproduce near-optimal decisions in real time. The presented perspective positions Learning-to-Optimize as a key architectural enabler for future AI-native networks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将Learning-to-Optimize (L2O)作为AI原生通信网络的缺失架构层，通过四阶段工作流将优化算法转化为离线知识生成器，训练神经代理模型实现实时推理。以NR-V2X中继选择为例，用MILP解训练GNN实现近最优实时决策。
AI.motivation: 当前AI原生网络架构虽嵌入智能，但缺乏对优化知识如何系统生成、迁移和利用的指导；优化仅被视为在线决策引擎，未作为知识源发挥价值。
AI.method: 提出L2O架构抽象，定义四阶段工作流：优化、知识生成、代理学习、运行时推理；将优化算法作为离线知识生成器，为神经代理模型提供监督信息；以NR-V2X中继选择为例，用MILP求解器生成解训练GNN。
AI.result: 在NR-V2X中继选择问题上，GNN能实时复现近最优决策；L2O被定位为未来AI原生网络的关键架构使能者。
AI.conclusion: L2O是连接优化与AI原生智能的缺失架构层，可作为异构通信与计算系统的通用架构抽象。

title: CoLearn: An Agentic Tutor that Learns its Learner in a Human--AI Co-Learning Loop
summary: Good tutoring adapts to the individual: it tracks what a learner knows, notices why they go wrong, and asks the next question that will help most. Most deployed tutoring tools instead serve fixed item banks and treat a wrong answer as a single bit of signal. We present CoLearn, an interactive, agentic tutor that supports an iterative tutoring loop: the learner practises, and the system builds an evidence-grounded memory of the learner's mastery and misconceptions. This memory is updated as evidence accumulates and is used to generate the next personalised question. CoLearn has three components: (i) a persistent learner-state memory that updates per-topic mastery with a soft-evidence variant of Bayesian Knowledge Tracing, where a large language model acts as a continuous observation function; (ii) adaptive question generation that targets the learner's weakest topic and recurring misconceptions; and (iii) an evidence view that makes personalisation visible and testable through live progress visualisation and blind A/B comparison. In blind A/B evaluation, questions conditioned on this memory are preferred over non-personalised ones 68-69% of the time, and in persona simulations with hidden ground-truth mastery the agent's belief converges toward the learner's true mastery.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CoLearn，一个支持迭代辅导循环的交互式智能体导师，通过证据驱动的学习者状态记忆实现个性化出题。
AI.motivation: 现有辅导工具多使用固定题库，并把答错仅视为单一信号，难以追踪学习者知识掌握与错误原因，因而无法实现真正适应个体的辅导。
AI.method: CoLearn 包含三部分：持久学习者状态记忆，用贝叶斯知识追踪的软证据变体更新各主题掌握度，并以大语言模型作为连续观察函数；自适应问题生成，针对最弱主题和反复出现的误解出题；证据视图，通过实时进度可视化和盲测 A/B 比较使个性化可见、可测试。
AI.result: 在盲测 A/B 评估中，基于该记忆条件生成的问题有 68-69% 的概率被偏好，优于非个性化问题；在隐藏真实掌握度的人设模拟中，智能体的信念会向学习者的真实掌握度收敛。
AI.conclusion: CoLearn 表明，结合持久学习者记忆与智能体式问题生成的个性化辅导能够提升问题相关性，并可通过模拟验证其学习者建模的有效性。

title: Dual-Interest Sequential Product Recommendation With Multi-Granular SSM
summary: Sequential recommendation aims to predict the next item a user will interact with based on their historical behavior. Advances in Transformers have significantly improved sequential recommendation but are still limited by cost efficiency. Although State Space Models (SSMs) have recently enabled efficient long-range modeling, most existing methods encode each item with a single static contextual role, overlooking the phenomenon of item polysemy. In fact, the same item often plays different semantic roles depending on user context, and existing methods are limited in capturing dynamic behavior across different temporal granularities. In this work, we propose DSRec, a novel dual-interest cross-SSM model that explicitly disentangles item roles across long-term and short-term semantic context. Sequential items are encoded into long-term interest embeddings that capture stable preferences via historical aggregation, and a short-term interest branch that emphasizes local session intent modulated by inter-click time intervals. These interest embeddings are processed through distinct SSM encoders: a full-sequence Mamba for long-term modeling, and a time-modulated SSM that dynamically adjusts state evolution based on temporal gaps. To enable effective cross-granularity alignment, we adopt a residual cross-fusion mechanism that exchanges contextual information between the two branches while preserving semantic independence. Experiments on public benchmarks demonstrate that DSRec outperforms other state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出DSRec，一种双兴趣跨SSM序列推荐模型，通过解耦长短期语义上下文中的物品角色，结合Mamba与时序调制SSM及残差交叉融合，在公开基准上优于现有SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: Transformer序列推荐虽有效但成本较高；现有SSM方法虽支持高效长程建模，却常将每个物品编码为单一静态上下文角色，忽略物品多义性，且难以捕捉不同时间粒度下的动态行为。
AI.method: 设计长短期双分支：长期兴趣嵌入通过历史聚合捕捉稳定偏好，短期兴趣分支由点击时间间隔调制以强调局部会话意图；分别使用全序列Mamba和时序调制SSM编码，并采用残差交叉融合机制交换上下文信息，同时保持两分支语义独立。
AI.result: 在公开基准数据集上，DSRec的实验表现优于其他最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式解耦长短期物品语义角色并进行跨粒度对齐融合，能有效提升序列推荐性能，验证了双兴趣跨SSM与时序调制建模的有效性。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Centroid-Guided Contrastive Loss for Structured Fraudulent Job Posting Detection
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Submitted to IEEE Open Journal of the Computer Society. Code: https://github.com/ali-ahmed925/CGCL_code
summary: Fraudulent job posting detection aims to identify job advertisements that are corrupted either through fake content, misleading information, or negative intent, disrupting the online eco-system of job-seekers and employers. Existing studies in this domain lack effective methods to simultaneously achieve high accuracy and meaningful structure of latent-space representations that capture subtleties among fake posts. To this end, we propose Centroid-Guided Contrastive Loss (CGCL), a loss function which unifies classification with densely formulated clustering to consistently reshape latent-space through a centroid-driven top-$k$ push-and-pull mechanism. The complementary nature of CGCL enables the model to enforce accurate decision boundaries and maintain high clustering compactness, effectively capturing both class separability and latent structure. Extensive experiments demonstrate the state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance of our method on EMSCAD, a public benchmark dataset. The code associated with this work is available at: https://github.com/ali-ahmed925/CGCL_code

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种质心引导对比损失（CGCL），用于欺诈性招聘广告检测，通过在潜在空间中结合分类与密集聚类来提升准确率并学习有意义的表示结构。
AI.motivation: 现有欺诈招聘广告检测方法难以同时实现高检测准确率和具有意义的潜在空间表示结构，难以刻画虚假招聘广告之间的细微差异。
AI.method: 提出质心引导对比损失（CGCL），将分类与密集聚类统一起来，通过基于质心的 top-k 推拉机制持续重塑潜在空间，兼顾类别可分性与聚类紧致性。
AI.result: 在公开基准数据集 EMSCAD 上进行大量实验，结果表明该方法取得了最先进（SOTA）性能。
AI.conclusion: CGCL 能有效提升欺诈招聘广告检测性能，并在潜在空间中同时保持准确决策边界和高聚类紧致度，代码已开源。

title: Think Locally, Refine Globally for Memory-Efficient 3D Reconstruction
summary: We propose LoG-VGGT, a memory-efficient framework for long-sequence 3D reconstruction that balances local temporal modeling with global camera consistency. Instead of relying on full global attention, our method introduces cross-window attention at a small subset of transformer blocks, enabling effective information propagation across adjacent temporal windows while keeping memory usage bounded. To mitigate long-term pose drift, we further design a global camera consistency refinement module, where camera tokens interact with compact register tokens via cross-attention to enforce scene-level constraints across the entire sequence. This design enables joint optimization of camera representations and significantly improves long-horizon pose stability without incurring the high cost of sequence-wide attention. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LoG-VGGT achieves improved depth accuracy and robust camera pose estimation across multiple long-sequence benchmarks, while delivering competitive streaming reconstruction performance.

AI.tldr: 提出LoG-VGGT，一种面向长序列3D重建的内存高效框架，通过局部时序建模与全局相机一致性相结合，在有限显存下提升深度精度与相机位姿稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖全局注意力进行长序列3D重建，内存开销大；同时长时序中容易产生相机位姿漂移，需要兼顾效率与全局一致性。
AI.method: 在少量Transformer块中引入跨窗口注意力，实现相邻时序窗口的信息传播并控制内存；设计全局相机一致性细化模块，让相机token通过交叉注意力与紧凑register token交互，以场景级约束优化相机表示，避免全序列注意力。
AI.result: 在多个长序列基准上取得更好的深度精度和鲁棒的相机位姿估计，同时流式重建性能具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: LoG-VGGT能够在有限内存下有效平衡局部时序建模与全局相机一致性，提升长时程位姿稳定性，适用于长序列3D重建任务。

title: Not All Irregularity Is Equal: Causally Isolating a Rare Failure Mode in Japanese Morphological Inflection
summary: Neural morphological generation systems often achieve high aggregate accuracy on benchmark datasets, yet such performance can conceal systematic errors clustered in rare morphological subclasses. We present an orthography-aware diagnosis of Japanese past-tense verb inflection, treating hiragana not merely as a transcriptional medium but as a representational system that encodes morphophonological structure. Using two character-level Transformer architectures evaluated across five random seeds, we show that although both systems exceed 97% aggregate accuracy, a single structurally specific irregular subtype, verbs whose stems end in /e/ and require gemination before the past-tense suffix and make up fewer than 1% of the data, accounts for a disproportionate 30-43% share of residual errors and contributes roughly 34-48x its prevalence to total errors. We then move from diagnosis to causal isolation: controlled ablation experiments show that removing this subtype alone produces larger accuracy gains than removing all irregular verbs combined. These findings indicate that error concentration in neural morphological learning is not driven by irregularity per se, but by the interaction between extreme low-frequency morphological patterns and specific orthographic processes. We argue that morphological evaluation should incorporate fine-grained subclass analysis, and discuss implications for data-efficient, developmentally plausible language model pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文对日语过去时动词变形进行正字法感知诊断，发现两个字符级Transformer模型虽总体准确率超97%，但一个特定不规则子类（词干以/e/结尾且需辅音重叠的动词）仅占数据不到1%，却贡献30-43%的残余错误，错误率是普遍频率的34-48倍。
AI.motivation: 神经形态生成系统在基准数据集上总体准确率高，但可能掩盖罕见形态子类中的系统性错误；研究旨在揭示错误集中并非由不规则性本身驱动，而是极端低频形态模式与特定正字法过程的交互。
AI.method: 使用两种字符级Transformer架构，在五个随机种子下评估日语过去时动词变形；将平假名视为编码形态音系结构的表征系统；进行受控消融实验，单独移除特定不规则子类，并与移除所有不规则动词对比。
AI.result: 两个系统总体准确率均超97%，但特定不规则子类（词干以/e/结尾且需辅音重叠）占数据不到1%，却贡献30-43%的残余错误，错误贡献约为其流行度的34-48倍；移除该子类的准确率增益大于移除所有不规则动词。
AI.conclusion: 神经形态学习中的错误集中由极端低频形态模式与特定正字法过程的交互驱动，而非不规则性本身；形态评估应纳入细粒度子类分析，并对数据高效、发育合理的语言模型预训练有启示。

title: ME-Dex 1.0: Bringing Heterogeneous Tactile Sensing into World Action Modeling
summary: World Action Models bring the predictive capabilities of video models into robot action generation, providing a rich foundation for modeling future visual states. Tactile sensing complements this foundation with direct measurements of physical interaction. Some existing methods use tactile features as conditioning inputs without jointly predicting future tactile states, visual observations, and actions. Our key insight is that tactile signals, like video, provide observations of the evolving world state and should be modeled as future observations alongside video. We present ME-Dex-1.0 (MachEmbodied-Dex-1.0), a unified World Action Tactile Model for joint visual, tactile, and action learning. ME-Dex-1.0 adopts a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture comprising a Video Expert, a Tactile Expert, and an Action Expert, all trained with flow matching. We use shared attention connects the experts in intermediate layers, allowing action generation to draw on learned representations of visual and tactile dynamics during joint denoising. To support multi-source heterogeneous tactile inputs, a Canonical Hand Model and a Unified Tactile Autoencoder map tactile observations from different embodiments and sensing layouts into shared spatial and latent spaces. To address the limited availability of paired visual, tactile, and action data, we develop the Agentic Tactile Data Engine, an agent-based data production platform. It supplements RoboTwin and DexJoCo with tactile data recorded directly from force sensors during trajectory replay in simulation. Experiments on the RoboTwin, DexJoCo, and ManiFeel simulation platforms, together with real robot evaluations, demonstrate improved manipulation performance using both grippers and dexterous hands equipped with tactile sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ME-Dex-1.0，一个统一的 World Action Tactile Model，通过联合建模视觉、触觉与动作进行机器人操作学习，在仿真与真机实验中均验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有 World Action Models 利用视频模型预测未来视觉状态，但缺乏对物理交互的直接测量；已有触觉方法多将触觉特征作为条件输入，而未将触觉与视觉、动作一起作为未来观测进行联合预测。作者认为触觉信号与视频一样，都是对世界状态演化的观测，应被建模为未来观测。
AI.method: 提出 ME-Dex-1.0（MachEmbodied-Dex-1.0），采用 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构，包含 Video Expert、Tactile Expert 和 Action Expert，均以 flow matching 训练；通过共享注意力在中间层连接各专家，使动作生成在联合去噪过程中利用视觉与触觉动态表示。为支持多源异构触觉输入，设计 Canonical Hand Model 与 Unified Tactile Autoencoder，将不同本体与传感布局的触觉观测映射到共享空间与潜空间。此外构建 Agentic Tactile Data Engine，基于智能体的数据生产平台，在仿真轨迹回放中直接记录力传感器触觉数据以补充 RoboTwin 与 DexJoCo。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin、DexJoCo、ManiFeel 三个仿真平台以及真机评估中，配备触觉传感的夹爪与灵巧手均展现出更优的操作性能。
AI.conclusion: 将触觉作为未来观测与视频、动作进行联合建模，能够有效提升机器人操作性能，并可通过统一架构与数据引擎解决异构触觉与数据稀缺问题。

title: Visual Navigation Transformer with Pose Attention
summary: Learned navigation policies typically consume observations as a temporally ordered history, with positional encodings tying each observation to when it was seen, making it difficult to reuse experience from earlier traversals of an environment. Systems that do reuse such experience usually construct an explicit representation, such as a map or a topological graph, and plan on it. We propose VNT-PA (Visual Navigation Transformer with Pose Attention), a transformer planner whose context is a set of depth keyframes indexed by camera pose. With camera poses as positional encoding, attention depends on the pose differences between keyframes rather than on their temporal order. VNT-PA is trained to imitate a shortest-path planner operating on the ground-truth scene mesh, predicting actions by querying the spatial context with only its current pose and the goal position. On point-goal navigation in HM3D validation scenes, VNT-PA reaches 93.3% success and 90.4% success weighted by path length (SPL), outperforming baselines that encode the same context as a temporal sequence or treat pose as an input feature, in both navigation performance and training efficiency. Because the spatial context is a pose-indexed set, frames from different trajectories can be fused at test time. The planner also degrades more gracefully under localization noise than a conventional baseline which plans on explicit maps. These results show that pose-stamped experience can serve directly as the environment representation for a learned planner, and that making attention depend on pose differences, rather than on temporal order, speeds up training and improves long-horizon navigation.

AI.tldr: 提出VNT-PA，一种基于姿态注意力的视觉导航Transformer，以姿态索引的深度关键帧集合作为上下文，注意力依赖于姿态差异而非时间顺序，在HM3D上取得93.3%成功率和90.4% SPL，优于时间序列或姿态输入基线，且能融合不同轨迹帧，对定位噪声更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 现有导航策略通常使用时序观测历史，位置编码与时间绑定，难以重用先前遍历经验；重用经验的系统需构建显式地图或拓扑图并规划。
AI.method: VNT-PA是一个Transformer规划器，上下文为按相机姿态索引的深度关键帧集合。以相机姿态作为位置编码，注意力取决于关键帧间的姿态差异而非时间顺序。训练模仿真实场景网格上的最短路径规划器，仅用当前姿态和目标位置查询空间上下文预测动作。
AI.result: 在HM3D验证场景的点目标导航中，成功率达93.3%，SPL达90.4%，在导航性能和训练效率上优于将相同上下文编码为时间序列或将姿态作为输入特征的基线。测试时可融合不同轨迹的帧，且在定位噪声下比基于显式地图规划的传统基线退化更平缓。
AI.conclusion: 带有姿态标记的经验可直接作为学习规划器的环境表示，使注意力依赖于姿态差异而非时间顺序能加速训练并改善长时程导航。

title: Safe Real-Time Policy Steering via Noise-Space Trajectory Optimization for One-Step Generative Policies
summary: Generative robot policies can represent diverse, multimodal behaviors, but adapting pretrained policies to deployment-time constraints such as collision avoidance and orientation maintenance remains challenging. Existing inference-time steering methods typically apply gradient guidance through iterative diffusion or flow processes, which can be computationally expensive for real-time control. We propose INSPO, which formulates inference-time steering of one-step generative policies as trajectory optimization in the policy's input noise space. By optimizing the input noise while evaluating constraints on the induced state trajectory, INSPO searches the policy-induced behavior space without directly modifying generated actions. The optimization includes a regularization term that encourages solutions to remain consistent with the policy's input distribution and is solved online using population-based particle optimization. We evaluate INSPO on state- and image-based task-specific policies and generalist vision-language-action policies across Push-T, Can pick-and-place, and LIBERO-Spatial. INSPO improves task success and constraint satisfaction over best-of-N sampling and action projection, while comparing favorably with gradient-guided generation at lower runtime.

AI.tldr: INSPO 提出一种针对一步生成式机器人策略的推理时引导方法，将约束满足转化为策略输入噪声空间中的轨迹优化，从而在不修改生成动作的情况下实现实时避障与姿态维持。
AI.motivation: 生成式机器人策略能表示多样、多模态行为，但预训练策略在部署时需满足避障、姿态维持等约束。现有推理时引导方法通常通过迭代扩散或流过程进行梯度引导，计算开销大，难以用于实时控制。
AI.method: INSPO 将一步生成式策略的推理时引导表述为输入噪声空间中的轨迹优化：优化输入噪声，并在诱导的状态轨迹上评估约束；通过正则项使解与策略输入分布保持一致；使用基于种群的粒子优化在线求解。
AI.result: 在 Push-T、Can pick-and-place 和 LIBERO-Spatial 上，对基于状态与图像的任务专用策略以及通用视觉-语言-动作策略进行评估。INSPO 相比 best-of-N 采样和动作投影提高了任务成功率与约束满足率，并在更低运行时间下优于梯度引导生成方法。
AI.conclusion: INSPO 为一步生成式策略提供了一种有效且高效的推理时引导方式，可在实时控制中兼顾任务性能与部署约束。

title: Fewer Steps, Better Actions: Rethinking Flow-Matching Inference for VLA Policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies based on flow matching generate action chunks through repeated evaluations of an action expert. Increasing the number of integration steps raises inference cost, but does not necessarily improve closed-loop success. We propose Coda, which reallocates part of this integration budget to a single learned endpoint correction. A frozen policy first completes a few-step noise-to-action trajectory; a lightweight Transformer then predicts a demonstration-supervised residual using the candidate action, source noise, and shared observation-prefix cache. Only the corrector is trained. On 50 RoboTwin Easy tasks, five-step Coda improves success from 71.64% to 74.68% over the matched five-step baseline, while reducing forward latency by 30.2% relative to the default ten-step policy. A two-step configuration achieves 71.88% success with a 2.12$\times$ speedup. An independent 13-task control shows a 5.69-percentage-point gain at nearly equal latency, supporting correction as an effective alternative to additional integration.
