The same design also improves frozen official SmolVLA, raising two-step success from 60.8% to 69.4%. These results show that endpoint correction improves the quality-latency trade-off of frozen flow-matching policies.

AI.tldr: 提出Coda，将流匹配VLA策略的部分积分预算重新分配给一个学习到的端点校正器，在冻结策略完成少步去噪轨迹后，用轻量Transformer预测残差，从而在降低推理延迟的同时提升闭环成功率。
AI.motivation: 基于流匹配的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通过重复评估动作专家生成动作块。增加积分步数会提高推理成本，却不一定提升闭环任务成功率，因此需要更高效地利用推理预算。
AI.method: Coda让冻结的策略先完成少步噪声到动作的轨迹生成；随后用一个轻量Transformer，基于候选动作、源噪声和共享观测前缀缓存，预测演示监督的残差进行端点校正。训练时仅更新校正器，冻结原策略。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin Easy的50个任务上，五步Coda将成功率从71.64%提升至74.68%，相比默认十步策略前向延迟降低30.2%；两步配置达到71.88%成功率，加速2.12倍。独立13任务控制实验中，在几乎相同延迟下成功率提升5.69个百分点。相同设计也提升了冻结的官方SmolVLA，将两步成功率从60.8%提升至69.4%。
AI.conclusion: 端点校正可有效替代额外积分步数，改善冻结流匹配策略的质量-延迟权衡，在多种设置下均能提升性能与效率。

title: When Better Turns Do Not Make Better Agents: Diagnosing the Gap Between Next-Turn Metrics and Workflow Success
comment: Accepted to the REALM Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Agent models are frequently evaluated one decision at a time, where the model predicts the next action based on the gold interaction history, which is scored against a reference. We investigate whether improvement under this protocol is predictive of improved autonomous workflow execution. We study pre-SFT and supervised fine-tuned (SFT) Qwen3 models at 4B and 14B parameters and Gemma 3 models at 4B and 12B parameters on multi-turn customer-support workflows. We find that SFT consistently improves text-turn success, and that overall next-turn success increases for every model under gold-history evaluation. However, these improvements do not transfer to autonomous workflow execution. Tool-specific gains also vary across metrics and models. None of the four SFT models succeeds under holistic workflow evaluation, with strict trajectory completion reaching at most 10.4% workflow success. Our results show that next-turn evaluation is not a reliable proxy for workflow success, motivating separate reporting of text quality, local action correctness, tool execution, and end-to-end task completion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究逐决策的下一动作评估是否能预测智能体自主工作流执行表现，发现监督微调提升下一轮成功率，但不能转化为端到端工作流成功。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体常基于黄金交互历史逐决策评估，但尚不清楚该评估协议下的改进是否能代表自主工作流执行能力的提升。
AI.method: 在多轮客服工作流上，评估预SFT和SFT后的Qwen3（4B、14B）与Gemma 3（4B、12B）模型，比较黄金历史下一轮评估与自主工作流/整体轨迹执行评估。
AI.result: SFT一致提升文本轮次成功，且所有模型在黄金历史下一轮成功整体上升；但改进未迁移到自主工作流执行，工具特定收益因指标和模型而异。四个SFT模型均未在整体工作流评估中成功，严格轨迹完成的工作流成功率最高仅10.4%。
AI.conclusion: 下一轮评估不是工作流成功的可靠代理，应分别报告文本质量、局部动作正确性、工具执行和端到端任务完成情况。

title: Reducing Barriers to Academic Support: Evaluating a Course-Specific RAG System for Addressing Help-Seeking Disparities in Higher Education
summary: Access to academic support is a key determinant of student success, yet students experience it unequally: some readily seek help from lecturers or tutors, while others hesitate due to anxiety, fear of judgement, uncertainty about expectations, or low confidence in their understanding. This may be especially evident in computing education, where programming tasks are cumulative and cognitively demanding. Although students increasingly turn to general-purpose generative AI tools, these can produce responses that are inaccurate, insufficiently contextualised, or misaligned with module expectations. This study presents and evaluates Beacon, a course-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system providing private, immediate, module-aligned academic support. Grounding responses in approved teaching materials, Beacon was designed to lower barriers to help-seeking while encouraging independent learning. Using a design-based research approach, Beacon was developed iteratively and evaluated via mixed methods, combining questionnaires and semi-structured interviews with students and staff at a Higher Education institution. Students described Beacon's responses as closely aligned with module content and more trustworthy than unrestricted generative AI tools, valuing its use of pseudocode and scaffolded explanations over direct solutions. Although participants remained cautious about trusting AI-generated responses without verification, they viewed the system as a valuable first point of support before consulting lecturers or official resources. The findings suggest that carefully designed course-specific AI systems may reduce barriers to academic support by occupying an intermediary space between independent study and formal support. Rather than replacing educators, educational AI may be most valuable when it broadens access to guidance while preserving the pedagogical role of lecturers.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发并评估课程专属RAG系统Beacon，提供私密、即时、与模块对齐的学术支持，以降低求助障碍并促进自主学习。
AI.motivation: 学生获取学术支持存在不平等：部分学生因焦虑、怕被评判、不确定期望或信心不足而不求助。计算教育中编程任务累积且认知负荷高，通用生成式AI又可能不准确、缺乏情境或不符合课程期望。
AI.method: 采用设计型研究，迭代开发Beacon，基于RAG并以批准教学材料为依据；使用混合方法，结合问卷与半结构化访谈，收集高校学生和教职工反馈。
AI.result: 学生认为Beacon回答更贴合模块内容、比无限制生成式AI更可信，重视伪代码和脚手架式解释而非直接答案；但仍对AI答案持谨慎态度，需验证，并将其视为咨询讲师或官方资源前的第一支持点。
AI.conclusion: 精心设计的课程专属AI可成为独立学习与正式支持之间的中介，减少学术支持障碍；它不应取代教育者，而应在保留讲师教学作用的同时扩大指导可及性。

title: Calibrating Teacher--Student Discrepancy for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves reasoning models by learning the token-level discrepancy between a stronger teacher and an on-policy student. However, this discrepancy does not purely reflect the capability gap between the teacher and the student: it also contains deviations arising from the teacher itself, which are consequently mixed into the observed teacher--student discrepancy and indiscriminately learned by standard OPD during training. This issue is further exacerbated by privileged OPD, where privileged information induces larger teacher-side likelihood shifts, thereby encouraging the student to learn more of the teacher's own deviation. We introduce \textbf{Calibrated On-Policy Distillation (Cal-OPD)}, which estimates the teacher's self-deviation region through positive and negative privileged interventions and calibrates the original teacher--student discrepancy by retaining only the component that lies beyond this region. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that, while retaining only about 52--65\% of the original teacher--student discrepancy as the optimization signal, Cal-OPD consistently outperforms standard OPD and its variants across model scales.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Cal-OPD，通过校准教师自身偏差来改进在线策略蒸馏，在数学推理任务上以更少的优化信号超越标准OPD。
AI.motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中，教师-学生差异不仅反映能力差距，还混杂了教师自身的偏差，特权OPD会进一步放大该问题，导致学生盲目学习教师的偏差。
AI.method: 通过正负特权干预估计教师的自偏差区域，并据此校准原始教师-学生差异，仅保留超出该区域的部分作为优化信号。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准上，仅保留约52-65%的原始差异作为优化信号，Cal-OPD在不同模型规模上均持续优于标准OPD及其变体。
AI.conclusion: 校准教师自偏差能有效提升蒸馏效果，验证了去除教师自身偏差对在线策略蒸馏的重要性。

title: SafeStage: Evaluating Safety Before, During, and After Vision-Language-Conditioned Robot Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-conditioned robot policies integrate perception, language understanding, and control for general-purpose manipulation. However, existing evaluations often focus on task success, isolated physical constraints, semantic refusal, or realized physical damage, providing limited insight into where safety fails during closed-loop manipulation. We introduce SafeStage, a lifecycle-structured benchmark for evaluating manipulation safety before, during, and after task execution. SafeStage contains 97 purpose-built risk scenarios organized into three stages. Initial-State Hazards captures safety-relevant relations that must be resolved before manipulating the target. Execution-Time Safety evaluates unsafe contacts, trajectories, region entries, and object interactions during execution. Final-State Hazards capture unstable or otherwise unsafe conditions remaining after nominal task completion. The benchmark evaluates realized interactions using event-based and state-based checks and reports native task success independently from stage-specific safety outcomes. We evaluate representative direct-action Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies and policies with world-model-based policies under a common closed-loop protocol. Our results demonstrate that nominal task completion frequently coexists with safety violations and that different policies exhibit distinct failure profiles across the three stages. By separating task success from safety and localizing when violations occur, SafeStage provides a unified diagnostic testbed for evaluating and improving vision-language-conditioned robot manipulation policies.

AI.tldr: 提出 SafeStage，一个按生命周期分阶段的机器人操作安全基准，覆盖任务执行前、中、后的安全风险，包含97个风险场景，用于评估视觉语言条件操作策略的安全失效。
AI.motivation: 现有评估多关注任务成功、孤立物理约束、语义拒绝或已发生的物理损伤，难以在闭环操作中定位安全失效发生的具体阶段。
AI.method: 构建 SafeStage，分为初始状态危险、执行时安全、最终状态危险三阶段；使用基于事件和状态的检查评估真实交互，并将原生任务成功与各阶段安全结果独立报告；在统一闭环协议下评估直接动作 VLA 策略和基于世界模型的策略。
AI.result: 名义任务完成常与安全违规同时存在，且不同策略在三阶段表现出不同的失败画像。
AI.conclusion: 通过分离任务成功与安全并定位违规发生时机，SafeStage 为评估和改进视觉语言条件机器人操作策略提供了统一诊断测试平台。

title: Hallucination-R1: Robustness-Oriented Paraphrase Generation for Factual Consistency
summary: Factual hallucination is commonly defined by incorrect factual outputs. We study a paraphrase-induced hallucination setting, where a model answers a factual question correctly in its original form but generates an incorrect answer under a semantically equivalent paraphrase. Such inconsistencies expose latent factual instability under semantic invariance. However, general-purpose paraphrases are often insufficient as robustness-oriented supervision: near-copy paraphrases provide weak signals, while overly diverse paraphrases may break semantic equivalence. In this paper, we propose HALLUCINATION-R1, a robustness-oriented paraphrase generation framework that learns to produce semantically faithful yet robustness-challenging paraphrases for factual consistency. Through two-stage optimization, it first stabilizes meaning-preserving and diverse paraphrasing, then rewards paraphrases that reveal factual consistency degradation in downstream QA models. Experiments on SimpleQuestions, PopQA, and TruthfulQA show that HALLUCINATION-R1 achieves a strong consistency--diversity trade-off and exposes robustness failures across multiple model families and datasets. Further analyses indicate that these failures are not reducible to surface-level artifacts or semantic drift, but reveal non-trivial factual instability under meaning-preserving variation. A lightweight fine-tuning study also shows that HALLUCINATION-R1-generated data improves robust accuracy under paraphrase variations, suggesting its utility for robustness-oriented training. Our code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/yuwenhan07/Hallucination-R1.

AI.tldr: 论文研究释义诱导幻觉：模型对原问题回答正确，但在语义等价改写后出错。提出 HALLUCINATION-R1 鲁棒性导向释义生成框架，通过两阶段优化生成语义忠实但能暴露事实不一致的释义，在多个数据集上揭示模型鲁棒性失效，并证明生成数据可用于鲁棒性微调。
AI.motivation: 通用释义作为鲁棒性监督不足：近复制释义信号弱，过度多样的释义又可能破坏语义等价。因此需要一种既能保持语义忠实、又能有效挑战模型事实一致性的释义生成方法。
AI.method: 提出 HALLUCINATION-R1 框架，进行两阶段优化：先稳定生成保义且多样的释义，再奖励那些能使下游问答模型事实一致性下降的释义。在 SimpleQuestions、PopQA、TruthfulQA 上评估。
AI.result: HALLUCINATION-R1 实现较强的一致性-多样性权衡，并暴露多个模型族和数据集上的鲁棒性失败。分析表明这些失败并非表面伪影或语义漂移，而是意义保持变化下的事实不稳定。轻量微调研究显示，其生成数据可提升释义变化下的鲁棒准确率。
AI.conclusion: 释义诱导幻觉揭示了模型潜在的事实不稳定性。HALLUCINATION-R1 能生成有效的鲁棒性测试与训练数据，代码和模型已公开。

title: CompAdapt: Adaptable Composite Motion Modeling for Physics-Consistent Text-to-Video Generation
comment: 23 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Project page: https://makapic.github.io/CompAdapt/
summary: While diffusion-based text-to-video (T2V) models have demonstrated impressive capability in generating realistic and temporally coherent videos, they often fail to respect fundamental physical dynamics. Although recent physics-constrained methods incorporate explicit dynamics priors to improve physical plausibility, they remain limited to simple single-type motions, depend on manually specified parameters, and struggle to generalize to unseen physical laws. In this work, we propose CompAdapt, a physics-consistent T2V framework for adaptable generation across complex real-world scenarios. It extends neural dynamics modeling beyond single-type motions to encompass composite physical behaviors, including coupled motions, multi-stage transitions, and multi-object collisions. Furthermore, CompAdapt translates natural language prompts into structured physical semantics, enabling end-to-end specification of motion types, temporal relations, and initial physical parameters. To generalize to novel physical environments, CompAdapt introduces dynamics-aware prior matching, achieving one-shot adaptation without retraining the core dynamics module. In addition, a physics-aware latent feature fusion module improves visual fidelity under fast and complex motion. Experiments on physics-focused T2V benchmarks demonstrate that CompAdapt improves physical consistency over both general T2V models and physics-constrained baselines, while preserving high visual quality and adaptability to unseen dynamics. The project page is available at https://makapic.github.io/CompAdapt/ .

AI.tldr: 提出CompAdapt，一种物理一致的文本到视频框架，可处理耦合运动、多阶段转换和多物体碰撞等复合物理行为，并能通过语言指定物理语义及一次性适应新物理环境。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散式文本到视频模型虽能生成逼真且时序连贯的视频，但常违反基本物理动力学；已有物理约束方法仅适用于简单单一运动、依赖手动参数，且难以泛化到未见物理规律。
AI.method: 将神经动力学建模从单一运动扩展到复合物理行为；把自然语言提示转化为结构化物理语义，以端到端指定运动类型、时序关系和初始物理参数；引入动态感知先验匹配，实现无需重训核心动力学模块的一次性适应；并设计物理感知潜在特征融合模块，提升快速复杂运动下的视觉保真度。
AI.result: 在物理聚焦的文本到视频基准上，CompAdapt在物理一致性上优于通用T2V模型和物理约束基线，同时保持高视觉质量和对未见动力学的适应能力。
AI.conclusion: CompAdapt能够面向复杂真实场景实现物理一致且可适应的文本到视频生成，兼顾物理合理性与视觉质量。

title: Beyond Reference-Based Evaluation: Reward Models for Meta-Evaluation of Grammatical Error Correction
summary: Reference-based metrics for Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) such as M$^2$ and ERRANT assume that the reference set enumerates all valid edits, and therefore often penalize corrections that are grammatical and meaning-preserving but phrased differently. We introduce RM-EVAL, a reward model trained on human preference data from SEEDA, as a reference-free meta-evaluator that predicts human-like quality judgments at both full-sequence and partial-sequence levels. Beyond evaluation, we show that the same reward model can be used as a learning signal to improve GEC generation via Reward-Guided Text Generation (RGTG), which keeps a base GEC model frozen and performs online, reward-driven decoding. Across SEEDA, RM-EVAL achieves strong agreement with human rankings, and RGTG yields consistent gains in reward and external validation, demonstrating a unified framework for both assessing and enhancing GEC systems without relying on gold references.

AI.tldr: 提出RM-EVAL，一个基于SEEDA人类偏好数据训练的奖励模型，可作为无参考元评估器预测人类质量判断，并可通过RGTG用于改进GEC生成。
AI.motivation: 现有GEC参考指标（如M²和ERRANT）假设参考集穷举所有有效编辑，常会惩罚语法正确、语义不变但表述不同的修改。
AI.method: 训练RM-EVAL奖励模型，利用SEEDA人类偏好数据进行全序列和部分序列质量评估；并将其作为学习信号，通过Reward-Guided Text Generation（RGTG）在冻结基础GEC模型的情况下进行在线奖励驱动解码。
AI.result: RM-EVAL在SEEDA上与人类排序高度一致；RGTG在奖励和外部验证上均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个无需黄金参考即可评估和增强GEC系统的统一框架。

title: When Does Reasoning Help in Machine Translation? A Hierarchical Analysis of LRM Reasoning Traces
summary: Large Reasoning Models increasingly use intermediate traces for machine translation, but it remains unclear when such reasoning helps or hurts. We analyze reasoning traces across models, languages, domains, and datasets, focusing on reasoning language, length, and structure. We find that the best reasoning language is model-specific, reasoning length has a non-monotonic relationship with quality, and traces exhibit recurring functional patterns. To uncover these patterns, we introduce Hierarchical Meta-Summarization (HMS), a scalable framework that induces coarse- and fine-grained reasoning structures without predefined taxonomies. HMS reveals a shared organization--understanding/planning, translating/drafting, and refining/verifying--alongside domain-specific variation. Our results suggest that MT reasoning should be controlled in a model-aware, length-aware, and pattern-aware manner rather than uniformly encouraged.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了大型推理模型在机器翻译中的推理轨迹，发现推理语言因模型而异、推理长度与质量呈非单调关系，并提出了层次化元摘要框架来归纳推理结构。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型在机器翻译中越来越多地使用中间推理轨迹，但何时这种推理有益或有害尚不清楚，需要系统分析推理语言、长度和结构的影响。
AI.method: 跨模型、语言、领域和数据集分析推理轨迹，关注推理语言、长度和结构；提出层次化元摘要（HMS）框架，无需预定义分类即可归纳粗粒度和细粒度的推理结构。
AI.result: 最佳推理语言因模型而异；推理长度与翻译质量呈非单调关系；推理轨迹呈现重复的功能模式。HMS揭示了共享组织结构——理解/规划、翻译/草拟、精炼/验证——以及领域特定变化。
AI.conclusion: 机器翻译中的推理应以模型感知、长度感知和模式感知的方式进行控制，而非统一鼓励使用推理。

title: Accelerating Dense LLMs via L0-regularized Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance but suffer from slow and costly inference. Existing acceleration methods often lead to noticeable performance degradation, while Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models require extensive computational resources. In this paper, we propose L0-MoE, a lightweight MoE approach using L0-regularization to accelerate dense LLMs nearly without performance loss. Our method introduces a cluster confusion matrix for domain-aware dataset curation and applies dynamic batching for efficient training. Experiments show that L0-MoE achieves up to 2.5x speedup over dense models while maintaining competitive performance, outperforming existing LLM acceleration baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 L0-MoE，一种基于 L0 正则化的轻量级混合专家方法，用于在几乎不损失性能的情况下加速稠密大语言模型。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型性能强但推理慢、成本高；现有加速方法常导致明显性能下降，而传统 MoE 需要大量计算资源。
AI.method: 提出 L0-MoE 轻量级 MoE 方法，使用 L0 正则化加速稠密 LLM；引入聚类混淆矩阵进行领域感知的数据集构建，并采用动态批处理提升训练效率。
AI.result: 实验表明，L0-MoE 相比稠密模型可实现最高 2.5 倍加速，同时保持有竞争力的性能，并优于现有 LLM 加速基线方法。
AI.conclusion: L0-MoE 能够以轻量级 MoE 方式有效加速稠密大语言模型，在保持性能的同时显著提升效率，优于现有加速方案。

title: One Prompt Does Not Fit All: Self-Meta-Evolve for Personalized Information Extraction
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for enterprise information extraction (IE), where the same document must be reorganized differently for each user. Existing prompt optimization methods, however, rely on a single prompt optimized against a global objective, which is misaligned with the inherent user heterogeneity of real workplaces. We formulate enterprise IE as per-user prompt adaptation under interaction feedback and propose Self-Meta-Evolve, a hierarchical framework that maintains a dedicated prompt for each user and continuously refines it through a dual-loop process: an inner loop that edits structured prompts based on persona-conditioned feedback, and an outer loop that evolves the meta-prompt itself by distilling successful editing patterns. To enable scalable training and evaluation, we release a persona-driven IE benchmark of 292 simulated enterprise users, paired with a reproducible persona-generation pipeline grounded in O*NET occupational taxonomies. On this benchmark, Self-Meta-Evolve achieves a 74.58% success rate, outperforming the strongest prompt-optimization baseline by 13.56 absolute points, and reaches 52.54\% within only two iterations. A double-blind human study with twenty real professionals further confirms that prompts adapted by our framework win against static baselines in 71% of pairwise comparisons.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Self-Meta-Evolve 分层框架，用于企业信息抽取中的按用户提示适配，通过双循环为每个用户维护并持续优化提示，并发布基于人物角色的企业IE基准。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多用于企业信息抽取，但同一文档常需针对不同用户以不同方式重组；现有提示优化方法依赖面向全局目标的单一提示，忽视了真实工作场景中的用户异质性。
AI.method: 将企业IE建模为交互反馈下的按用户提示适配。Self-Meta-Evolve包含双重循环：内循环根据人物角色条件反馈编辑结构化提示，外循环通过蒸馏成功编辑模式来进化元提示。同时发布包含292个模拟企业用户的persona驱动IE基准及基于O*NET职业分类的可复现人物角色生成流程。
AI.result: 在该基准上，Self-Meta-Evolve达到74.58%的成功率，比最强提示优化基线高13.56个百分点，并且仅两轮迭代就达到52.54%。二十位真实专业人员的双盲人类研究进一步表明，该框架适配的提示在71%的成对比较中优于静态基线。
AI.conclusion: 针对用户异质性的层次化、按用户、基于交互反馈的提示优化能显著提升企业信息抽取效果，并优于单一全局提示优化方法。

title: FOCAL-VLA: Subtask-Guided Geometry Distillation and Implicit World Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models built on pretrained vision-language models have demonstrated strong performance across diverse robotic manipulation tasks. However, VLA models that directly map current 2D observations to actions often lack sufficient spatial and temporal understanding, limiting their performance in precise and long-horizon manipulation. Recent methods enhance VLA models through geometric supervision and future-state prediction across the entire scene. However, these methods can suffer from redundant scene information, distracting the model from learning the geometry and dynamics relevant to the current interaction. To address this issue, we propose FOCAL-VLA, a framework that combines subtask-guided geometry distillation with implicit world modeling to learn representations of current spatial structure and future interaction dynamics. To focus geometric learning on the current subtask, we transfer geometric knowledge from VGGT to the VLA model by aligning geometry latents with features from subtask-relevant image regions. To capture the future 3D evolution of the current interaction, we incorporate implicit world modeling using Track4World features from current and future demonstration frames. The two complementary representations jointly guide action generation without running VGGT or Track4World at inference time. Experiments show that FOCAL-VLA outperforms baselines on both simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks. Project website: https://zhiyuan-gao.github.io/FOCAL-VLA/.

AI.tldr: 提出 FOCAL-VLA，通过子任务引导的几何蒸馏与隐式世界建模，增强视觉-语言-动作模型的空间与时间理解。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型直接由当前 2D 观测映射到动作，缺乏空间与时间理解；已有几何监督和未来状态预测方法使用全场景信息，存在冗余并干扰与当前交互相关的几何和动态学习。
AI.method: 结合子任务引导的几何蒸馏与隐式世界建模：将 VGGT 的几何知识迁移到 VLA 模型，通过将几何隐变量与子任务相关图像区域特征对齐；并利用当前与未来示范帧的 Track4World 特征进行隐式世界建模。两种表示共同指导动作生成，推理时无需运行 VGGT 或 Track4World。
AI.result: 在仿真基准和真实世界操作任务上，FOCAL-VLA 均优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 聚焦当前子任务相关的几何结构和未来交互动态，可有效提升 VLA 模型在精确操作和长时程操作中的表现。

title: AirSplan: Risk-Aware Motion Planning for Quadrotors in Cluttered 3D Gaussian Splats
comment: To appear in the proceedings of IROS 2026
summary: Quadrotors are increasingly deployed in applications such as agriculture, infrastructure inspection, and maintenance. In each of these applications, the robot must navigate complex scene geometry while remaining strictly collision-free. Unlike in ground domains, even minor collisions for aerial vehicles can result in the loss of the robot. This safety requirement induces a pair of technical challenges. First, the environment must be represented with sufficient fidelity to encode complex structure, even when no ground-truth obstacle data is available. Second, a motion planner must leverage this representation to determine a collision-free path to the goal. This paper proposes a system that addresses these complementary challenges. The proposed method, AirSplan, adopts a normalized variant of 3D Gaussian Splatting that encodes high-fidelity scene geometry. It then applies a novel reachability-based motion planner that leverages the differential flatness of quadrotors to compute continuous-time collision constraints that tightly overapproximate the robot's occupancy. Experiments demonstrate that AirSplan successfully finds a path in 81.2% of challenging test cases, a significant improvement over the nearest baseline method's 51.2%.

AI.tldr: AirSplan系统结合归一化3D高斯泼溅场景表示与基于可达性的运动规划，实现四旋翼在复杂场景中的无碰撞路径规划。
AI.motivation: 四旋翼在农业、巡检等应用中碰撞代价极高，必须严格无碰撞；但在缺乏真实障碍物数据时，复杂场景的高保真表示与安全运动规划仍具挑战。
AI.method: 采用归一化3D Gaussian Splatting高保真编码场景几何；提出基于可达性的运动规划器，利用四旋翼微分平坦性生成连续时间碰撞约束，紧密过近似机器人占用。
AI.result: 在挑战性测试用例中，AirSplan成功找到路径的比例为81.2%，显著高于最佳基线方法的51.2%。
AI.conclusion: AirSplan能有效应对复杂场景表示与无碰撞规划挑战，提升四旋翼安全自主导航的成功率。

title: PSEE: Progressive Sensor Event Expansion for Point-Supervised Temporal Action Localization
summary: Temporal action localization (TAL) in wearable sensor streams identifies action classes and temporal boundaries, enabling finer-grained activity understanding than conventional action recognition. However, training typically requires costly start--end annotations for every action instance. To reduce this burden, we study point-supervised TAL, where each instance is labeled with only one timestamp and its class. We propose Progressive Sensor Event Expansion (PSEE), which combines semantic activations, sensor-specific transition evidence, and adaptive temporal ownership to recover point-supervised pseudo segments. These segments supervise standard TAL detectors without modifying their inference procedures. Cross-subject experiments on four inertial-sensing benchmarks demonstrate improved pseudo-boundary quality over adapted point-supervised baselines, compatibility with different TAL detectors, and robustness to point sampling. Code is available at https://github.com/joeeeeyin/PSEE.

AI.tldr: 针对可穿戴传感器流中的时序动作定位（TAL），提出点监督方法PSEE，通过语义激活、传感器特定过渡证据和自适应时间归属生成伪片段，用于训练标准TAL检测器，在四个惯性传感基准上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统TAL需要每个动作实例的起止时间标注，成本高昂；点监督仅需一个时间戳和类别标签，但如何从点标注恢复高质量伪片段是挑战。
AI.method: 提出渐进式传感器事件扩展（PSEE），结合语义激活、传感器特定过渡证据和自适应时间归属，生成点监督伪片段，用于监督标准TAL检测器，不改变推理过程。
AI.result: 在四个惯性传感基准的跨被试实验中，PSEE生成的伪边界质量优于适配的点监督基线，兼容不同TAL检测器，并对点采样具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: PSEE能有效降低标注成本，提升点监督TAL性能，具有通用性和鲁棒性，代码已开源。

title: GUARD: Natural Forgetting in Large Reasoning Models via Guided Answer-Reasoning Distillation
summary: Recent advances in large reasoning models (LRMs) have made machine unlearning more challenging, as protected facts or unsafe rationales may surface in intermediate chain-of-thought (CoT) traces before the final answer is produced. Existing unlearning objectives typically suppress the target content or redirect internal representations, but they never specify how the post-forgetting trajectory should continue, which can lead to hallucinated substitutes, malformed boundaries, or repetitive outputs. We argue that LRM unlearning should instead learn a natural forgetting trajectory: a coherent non-disclosing CoT followed by a stable refusal-style answer that replace the original disclosure. To this end, we propose Guided Answer-Reasoning Distillation (GUARD), which converts model-generated unsafe disclosures into safe-exit trajectories, aligns a frozen LRM via guidance tokens, and distills the guided behavior into model parameters.To address the lack of metrics for replacement quality beyond leakage, we further introduce Natural Forgetting Reasoning Score (NFRS), which captures structural stability, fluency, and unsupported substitutes in forgotten outputs. Extensive experiments on R-TOFU and a STAR-1-derived harmful-intent setting show that GUARD substantially reduces unsafe and privacy disclosures across two widely adopted distilled LRMs while preserving reasoning utility. Codes are available at https://github.com/zeyu-Yan/GUARD

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 GUARD 方法，通过将不安全披露转化为安全退出轨迹，并利用引导 token 对齐与蒸馏，使大型推理模型在遗忘后产生自然的拒答式推理轨迹，同时提出 NFRS 评估替代内容质量。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型的思维链可能泄露受保护事实或不安全推理，现有遗忘目标只抑制目标内容或重定向内部表示，却未规定遗忘后的轨迹应如何继续，易导致幻觉替代、边界错误或重复输出。
AI.method: 提出 Guided Answer-Reasoning Distillation（GUARD）：将模型生成的不安全披露转化为安全退出轨迹，用引导 token 对齐冻结的 LRM，并将引导行为蒸馏到模型参数中；同时提出 Natural Forgetting Reasoning Score（NFRS），从结构稳定性、流畅性和无依据替代内容方面评估遗忘输出。
AI.result: 在 R-TOFU 和基于 STAR-1 的有害意图设定上的实验表明，GUARD 在两种常用蒸馏 LRM 上显著减少不安全与隐私披露，同时保持推理效用。
AI.conclusion: LRM 遗忘应学习自然的遗忘轨迹，即连贯且不披露的 CoT 后接稳定的拒答式答案；GUARD 能有效实现这一目标，NFRS 可补充评估遗忘替代质量。

title: Listen Before You Speak: Response Planning from Listener Facial Reactions for Conversational Speech Generation
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 2026 ECCV Workshop (11th ABAW) Best Student Paper Award
summary: Conversational speech depends on dialogue context and the listener's immediately preceding behavior. We propose ReACT-TTS, a two-stage framework that uses a one-second pre-response listener facial sequence to plan the next utterance's emotion and prosody before speech realization. On a strict dyadic MELD protocol, Temporal conditioning yields higher mean macro-F1 and VAD concordance than Text-only across ten seeds, while accuracy remains essentially unchanged. Ablations show that temporal modeling performs best among the visual variants and that an explicit early-to-late difference is unnecessary; correct listener reactions also outperform cyclic mismatches on average. In a contextual-appropriateness study with 20 speech researchers, 76% of judgments prefer Temporal, 9% Text-only, and 15% report no preference. We further connect the predicted response style to a Grad-TTS backbone for end-to-end speech realization. Overall, the results support pre-response listener dynamics as complementary cues for conversational response planning. The source code is available at https://github.com/CYJ1/ReACT-TTS_public.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReACT-TTS 两阶段框架，利用听者一秒预反应面部序列来规划对话回复的情感和韵律，再通过 Grad-TTS 实现语音合成。
AI.motivation: 对话语音依赖对话上下文和听者紧接之前的行为，已有方法可能忽略听者预反应动态这一线索。
AI.method: 在严格二元 MELD 协议下，使用一秒听者预反应面部序列进行时间条件建模；进行多种视觉消融，包括显式早晚期差异和循环错配；并连接 Grad-TTS 骨干实现端到端语音生成。
AI.result: 十个随机种子下，时间条件相比纯文本获得更高平均宏 F1 和 VAD 一致性，准确率基本不变；视觉变体中时间建模最佳，显式早晚期差异非必需，正确听者反应平均优于循环错配。20 位语音研究者情境适当性研究中，76% 偏好时间条件，9% 偏好纯文本，15% 无偏好。
AI.conclusion: 预反应听者动态可作为对话回复规划的补充线索，支持将其用于情感与韵律规划及后续语音实现。

title: From Memory to Behavior: A Behavior-Aware Role-Playing Framework for Social Media Influencers
summary: Large language models have shown strong potential as role-playing agents for real individuals, yet faithful impersonating remains challenging. Existing in-context learning-based methods fail to capture how individuals react under different situations. In addition, LLM-based evaluation is difficult for obscure individuals. To address these challenges, we propose Situation--Internal state--Behavior Persona method to incorporate situation-dependent behavioral strategies. We further design an evaluation protocol that provides LLM evaluators with references about the impersonated individual. We evaluate our approach on a newly constructed dataset for the task of generating replies on social media. Experimental results show that our proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art ICL-based baselines, while our evaluation protocol achieves moderate correlation with human judgment. Besides, experiments on fictional-character benchmarks demonstrate that our proposed method is applicable beyond the social media setting. These findings suggest that incorporating behavioral information broadly improves the fidelity of role-playing for real individuals on social media or fictional characters.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种结合情境、内部状态与行为策略的角色扮演方法，用于提升大语言模型对真实个体的拟人化模仿能力，并设计了带参考信息的评估协议。
AI.motivation: 现有基于上下文学习的方法难以刻画个体在不同情境下的反应，且对不知名人物的LLM评估较为困难。
AI.method: 提出 Situation–Internal state–Behavior Persona 方法，引入情境依赖的行为策略；设计为LLM评估者提供被模仿个体参考信息的评估协议；在新建社交媒体回复数据集上评测，并在虚构角色基准上验证泛化性。
AI.result: 所提方法优于最先进的ICL基线；评估协议与人工判断达到中等相关；在虚构角色基准上也表现有效，说明方法不限于社交媒体场景。
AI.conclusion: 引入行为信息可广泛提升对真实个体及虚构角色进行角色扮演的保真度。

title: SkillIR: Evolving Scene-Aware Skills for Agentic Image Restoration
summary: This paper studies agentic image restoration, in which multimodal agents coordinate specialized restoration tools to recover images affected by complex degradations. Existing restoration agents often derive complete tool-use plans from the original degraded image or retrieve previously successful trajectories, providing limited support for adapting individual actions to evolving intermediate restoration states. We find that accepted tool executions can change the residual degradation state and, consequently, the applicability of subsequent tools. To address this issue, we propose SkillIR, a skill-guided framework that represents restoration experience as degradation-centered action evidence rather than complete tool-use trajectories. SkillIR consolidates context-dependent action outcomes into scene-aware restoration skills that characterize applicable conditions, expected effects, and attributable failure cases. Instead of prescribing a complete restoration plan, the retrieved skills guide one bounded action at a time within a verified residual-state loop: each tool output is treated as a candidate, committed only after transition verification, and followed by reassessment of the active residual degradations. After each rollout, the resulting evidence is used to create, refine, or patch dynamic skills, enabling accumulated restoration experience to improve decision-making for subsequent inputs. Experiments on synthetic and real-world multi-degradation datasets demonstrate that SkillIR improves restoration quality and enables more reliable and effective tool use.

AI.tldr: 本文研究智能体图像恢复，提出SkillIR框架，将恢复经验表示为以退化为中心的动作证据（技能），在验证的残差状态循环中逐步指导工具使用，从而提升恢复质量与工具使用可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有恢复智能体通常从原始退化图像生成完整工具使用计划或检索历史成功轨迹，难以适应中间恢复状态的变化；研究发现已执行的工具会改变残差退化状态，进而影响后续工具的适用性。
AI.method: 提出SkillIR，将上下文相关的动作结果整合为场景感知的恢复技能（包含适用条件、预期效果、可归因失败案例）；检索到的技能在验证残差状态循环中一次指导一个受限动作，工具输出需经转移验证后才被采纳，并重新评估活跃残差退化；每次rollout后证据用于创建、精炼或修补动态技能。
AI.result: 在合成和真实多退化数据集上的实验表明，SkillIR提高了恢复质量，并实现了更可靠、有效的工具使用。
AI.conclusion: SkillIR通过技能引导和残差状态验证，能够适应动态退化状态，提升图像恢复性能与工具使用的可靠性。

title: MT-WAM: Reorienting the One-Pass Predictive Representation Toward Action Generation
summary: Fast-WAM shows that video-action co-training improves control without generating future video at inference, making the representation from a single video diffusion Transformer forward central to action generation. However, future-observation prediction does not explicitly prioritize the future dynamics and visual structure needed for control. We present MT-WAM, which retains the original training objectives and adds complementary supervision for future two-dimensional point trajectories and visual features. A lightweight dual-stream branch copied from the video backbone's final blocks provides target-specific processing, while a structured attention mask prevents cross-stream attention. Motion-stream tokens supply additional dynamics conditions to the action expert. Future visual-feature prediction provides supervision in a feature space that captures object and spatial structure. This supervision trains the video backbone to provide more informative visual context for action generation under changing visual conditions, without adding visual-feature-stream tokens to action conditioning. At inference, MT-WAM uses video and motion caches computed once per replan and skips future-video prediction. Without additional embodied policy pretraining, MT-WAM achieves 98.2% success on LIBERO and 73.7% on LIBERO-Plus, exceeding Fast-WAM by 23.8 percentage points on the latter. On RoboTwin 2.0 Clean2Rand, Random success increases from 6.30% to 19.40%; across four real-world tasks, average success increases from 67.0% to 77.8%.

AI.tldr: MT-WAM 在 Fast-WAM 的视频-动作联合训练框架上新增未来二维点轨迹与视觉特征的辅助监督，在不生成未来视频、不增加具身策略预训练的前提下显著提升机器人控制成功率。
AI.motivation: Fast-WAM 表明视频-动作联合训练可提升控制性能，但仅预测未来观测并未显式强调控制所需的未来动力学与视觉结构信息，因此需要更有针对性的监督信号。
AI.method: 保留原有训练目标，额外加入未来二维点轨迹与未来视觉特征预测监督；从视频骨干最后若干块复制出轻量双流分支进行目标特定处理，并用结构化注意力掩码阻断跨流注意力。运动流 token 为动作专家提供额外动力学条件，视觉特征预测则在捕捉物体与空间结构的特征空间中进行监督，从而训练视频骨干提供更有信息量的视觉上下文，且不将视觉特征流 token 加入动作条件。推理阶段仅使用每次重规划计算一次的视频与运动缓存，跳过未来视频预测。
AI.result: 无需额外具身策略预训练，LIBERO 成功率达 98.2%，LIBERO-Plus 达 73.7%（较 Fast-WAM 提升 23.8 个百分点）；RoboTwin 2.0 Clean2Rand 的 Random 成功率由 6.30% 提升至 19.40%；四项真实世界任务平均成功率由 67.0% 提升至 77.8%。
AI.conclusion: 引入未来轨迹与视觉特征的互补监督，可在不生成未来视频的前提下显著增强视频-动作模型的控制能力与泛化性。

title: How Many Humans Is a Judge Panel Worth?
comment: 18 pages, 10 figures, and 8 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/Chao1208/chaosnli-judge-votes
summary: How many human judgments does a panel of language models represent? The answer depends on what is matched. We audit categorical judge panels against empirical human label distributions, retaining disagreement that binary errors relative to one gold label collapse. We measure spectral residual diversity by matching the participation ratio of a normalized residual Gram matrix to conditionally independent human-reference draws, giving nu_H. We separately match distributional squared error, giving nu_MSE. Across three ChaosNLI tasks, the same 32-judge panels have nu_H=4.24--6.50 but nu_MSE=2.30--3.75. A spectral identity separates the eigenvalues, member energies, and averaging-direction weights that determine error. Realizable hard-label panels show that greater spectral diversity can accompany worse distribution recovery even with equal member energies and nonnegative correlations. In the observed panels, within-size ranking agreement varies sharply by task; some member additions produce conflicting changes that persist across two item halves. The consensus-direction share of centered residual variance is gamma_co=43.8% on MNLI-m and 33.7% on SNLI, quantifying shared variation retained by averaging. We provide aligned votes and analysis protocols for auditing these distinctions. Effective size is therefore a target-specific measurement: spectral diversity and distribution recovery should not be treated as interchangeable measures of panel quality or as general human-replacement rates.

AI.tldr: 论文提出评估语言模型评审团相当于多少人类判断，取决于匹配目标；同一评审团在谱多样性口径下有效规模较高，但在分布恢复口径下较低，二者不可互换。
AI.motivation: 现有将语言模型作为人类评审替代时，往往忽略人类标注中的分歧，且用单一指标衡量评审团质量。作者希望区分“谱多样性”和“分布恢复”两种有效规模，审计模型评审团究竟代表多少人类判断。
AI.method: 将分类评审团与真实人类标签分布对比，保留二元错误会忽略的分歧。通过匹配归一化残差Gram矩阵的参与率与条件独立人类参考抽样，得到 nu_H；另通过匹配分布平方误差得到 nu_MSE。使用谱恒等式分解特征值、成员能量和平均方向权重。在三个ChaosNLI任务上分析32个评审员的面板，并检查硬标签可实现面板、同尺寸排序一致性、成员增删影响及共识方向方差占比。
AI.result: 三个ChaosNLI任务中，同一32评审员面板的 nu_H 为4.24–6.50，而 nu_MSE 为2.30–3.75。谱多样性更高不一定分布恢复更好，即使成员能量相同且相关性非负。同尺寸排序一致性随任务变化明显，某些成员增删导致跨两个项目半样本持续冲突。共识方向占中心化残差方差比例为：MNLI-m上43.8%，SNLI上33.7%。
AI.conclusion: 有效规模是目标特定的测量：谱多样性与分布恢复不应视为可互换的面板质量指标，也不应作为通用的人类替代率。作者提供对齐投票和分析协议以支持此类审计。

title: OpenSAL360: Open-Source Crowdsourcing Platform for Omnidirectional Video Saliency Collection
summary: Omnidirectional video saliency prediction plays an important role in many immersive multimedia applications, including viewport-adaptive streaming and compression, foveated rendering, mesh simplification, perceptual quality assessment. Yet progress in this area remains constrained by the cost and complexity of collecting eye-tracking data with VR headsets, which makes large-scale dataset creation difficult to extend. We present OpenSAL360, the first open-source platform for scalable, low-cost 360° video saliency collection. Unlike conventional VR-based protocols, it requires only a standard screen, mouse, and internet connection, enabling parallel saliency data collection from common crowdsourcing assessors without specialized hardware. We validate our collection protocol against seven well-established VR eye-tracking datasets and conduct ablation studies on key interface, pre-, and post-processing parameters. To demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of the proposed methodology, we collect and publicly release a saliency dataset covering 500 omnidirectional videos annotated by 2,000+ crowdsourcing assessors, making it, to the best of our knowledge, the largest dataset in this field. We make OpenSAL360 publicly available at https://github.com/msu-video-group/OpenSAL360.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OpenSAL360，一个开源、可扩展、低成本的360°视频显著性数据采集平台，仅需普通屏幕、鼠标和网络即可众包采集，并发布了500个全景视频、2000多名标注者参与的大规模显著性数据集。
AI.motivation: 全向视频显著性预测对沉浸式多媒体应用很重要，但传统基于VR头显和眼动追踪的数据采集成本高、流程复杂，导致大规模数据集难以扩展。
AI.method: 设计OpenSAL360开源众包采集协议，无需专用VR硬件；与7个成熟的VR眼动追踪数据集进行验证，并对界面、预处理和后处理等关键参数开展消融研究；随后采集并公开大规模360°视频显著性数据集。
AI.result: 验证了所提采集协议相对于七个VR眼动追踪数据集的有效性，并完成参数消融；发布了包含500个全向视频、由2000多名众包评估者标注的显著性数据集，据称是该领域目前最大的数据集。
AI.conclusion: OpenSAL360能够以低成本、可扩展的方式采集360°视频显著性数据，有助于推动全向视频显著性预测及相关沉浸式多媒体应用研究，且平台已公开在GitHub上。

title: KnowDemo: Knowledge-Guided Robot Demonstration Generation from Human Videos
summary: Learning robot manipulation policies typically requires substantial demonstration data, which are costly to collect on real robots. Recent methods generate robot demonstrations from human videos by adapting recovered motion and validating the resulting trajectories in simulation. However, methods centered on motion-reference adaptation can limit behavioral diversity by retaining the demonstrated contact strategies and subtask orders, while insufficient understanding of task requirements and scene relations can reduce demonstration generation efficiency by generating invalid candidates. To address these limitations, we propose KnowDemo, a framework that uses structured manipulation knowledge from human videos to generate diverse robot demonstrations for a target workspace. To distinguish task requirements from demonstration-specific choices, we develop a knowledge extraction and reasoning module based on a vision-language model (VLM) that associates object and action descriptions with inferred task conditions, demonstration references, and permissible execution variations. To translate this knowledge into executable demonstrations, we resolve the descriptions against target-scene entities and geometry to guide candidate generation and screening before motion planning and simulation. The resulting demonstrations exhibit multimodal behavior through alternative contact strategies and valid subtask orders, with structured execution labels. Experiments demonstrate additional verified execution modes beyond a reference-only configuration and improved candidate planning success through task-guided grasp sampling. To validate the generated data for policy learning, we fine-tune the pretrained $π_{0.5}$ model on simulation data, achieving sim-to-real transfer across three tasks. Project page: https://zhiyuan-gao.github.io/knowdemo/

AI.tldr: 提出 KnowDemo 框架，利用人类视频中的结构化操作知识为目标工作空间生成多样化机器人演示，并用于策略学习与仿真到真实迁移。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作策略学习通常依赖大量真实演示，采集成本高；现有从人类视频生成演示的方法多基于运动参考适配，限制行为多样性，且对任务要求和场景关系理解不足，导致无效候选多、生成效率低。
AI.method: 开发基于视觉语言模型的知识提取与推理模块，将物体和动作描述与任务条件、演示参考及允许的执行变化关联；再将知识解析到目标场景实体和几何，指导候选生成与筛选，并进行运动规划和仿真；同时使用任务引导抓取采样。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比仅参考配置，方法能产生更多经验证的执行模式；任务引导抓取采样提高了候选规划成功率；在仿真数据上微调预训练 π0.5 模型后，在三个任务上实现了仿真到真实迁移。
AI.conclusion: KnowDemo 通过结构化操作知识提升了机器人演示生成的多样性和效率，并验证了生成数据可用于策略学习及真实机器人迁移。

title: World Modeling in Transformers
summary: Behavioral failures can make a transformer appear to lack a world model even when it has learned faithful representations of its environment. We demonstrate this in TaxiGPT, a transformer trained on random walks through Manhattan whose failures have been interpreted as evidence of an incoherent internal map. Through mechanistic analysis and causal interventions, we show that the model represents intersections and streets, tracks its position, and uses a goal compass to navigate. We trace its failures to interference between superposed intersection features, which disrupts localization within the internal map. Affordance packing, which groups representations of intersections with the same legal moves, helps limit the consequences of these errors. Finally, we propose mechanistic indicators that we use to compare models and show that world-modeling capacities emerge at different stages of training. Our findings motivate a shift from asking whether a model has a world model to mechanistically studying its world modeling: the interacting capacities through which it represents its environment and uses those representations to guide behavior.

AI.tldr: 论文以TaxiGPT为例，表明行为失败并不代表模型没有世界模型；通过机制分析和因果干预，发现模型确实表征了环境并用于导航，失败主要源于叠加交叉口特征之间的干扰。
AI.motivation: 此前研究常根据模型行为失败推断其缺乏连贯的内部世界模型，作者希望检验这种推断是否成立，并推动从“是否有世界模型”转向机制层面研究“如何建模世界”。
AI.method: 训练Transformer模型TaxiGPT在曼哈顿随机游走上导航；使用机制分析和因果干预，识别模型对交叉口、街道、位置和目标的表征，并分析失败来源；提出affordance packing和机制指标进行模型比较。
AI.result: 模型能表示交叉口和街道、追踪自身位置并利用目标罗盘导航；失败源于叠加的交叉口特征干扰内部地图定位；affordance packing可限制这些错误后果；世界建模能力在训练不同阶段出现。
AI.conclusion: 行为失败不等同于缺乏世界模型。应转向机制层面研究世界建模，即模型如何表征环境并利用这些表征指导行为，以及这些能力如何相互作用和逐步涌现。

title: LOInK: Learned Optimal Inverse Kinematics via Structured Neural Surrogate Models
summary: We introduce Learned Optimal Inverse Kinematics (LOInK), a method to generate approximately optimal solutions to an inverse kinematics problem. When trained on data consisting of sampled configurations and associated task variables and a given cost function, LOInK learns a bi-Lipschitz invertible mapping from configuration space to a decoupled task/latent space, and moreover, the latent space is structured so as to place cost-minimizing solutions at the origin. This enables efficient sampling of cost-minimizing solutions via a network-inversion algorithm based on operator splitting. We demonstrate the proposed approach on three problems: an illustrative three degree-of-freedom manipulator problem; a quadrupedal climbing robot for which LOInK can generate near-optimal solutions on average 31 times faster and up to 100 times faster than a constrained optimization approach; and a simulated soft actuator as a purely data-driven example, in which LOInK can explicitly generate high-quality solutions, unlike existing generative approaches that require diverse sampling and evaluation of candidate solutions.

AI.tldr: 提出 LOInK 方法，通过学习双 Lipschitz 可逆映射将配置空间映射到解耦的任务/潜在空间，并将代价最小解置于原点，从而利用基于算子分裂的网络反演高效生成近似最优逆运动学解。
AI.motivation: 传统逆运动学或约束优化求解最优解通常较慢，而现有生成方法需要多样采样并评估大量候选解，因此希望更直接、高效地生成近最优解。
AI.method: 在包含采样配置、对应任务变量和给定代价函数的数据上训练；学习从配置空间到解耦任务/潜在空间的双 Lipschitz 可逆映射；将潜在空间结构化，使代价最小解位于原点；通过基于算子分裂的网络反演算法采样近最优解。
AI.result: 在三个问题上验证：三自由度机械臂示例；四足攀爬机器人上平均比约束优化快 31 倍、最高快 100 倍；软体执行器纯数据驱动示例中能显式生成高质量解，优于需要多样采样和候选评估的现有生成方法。
AI.conclusion: LOInK 能高效生成近似最优逆运动学解，适用于复杂机器人系统和纯数据驱动场景，并优于依赖候选采样评估的生成方法。

title: Stability-aware Residual Reinforcement Learning Framework for Robotic Manipulator Disturbance Compensation
summary: Although conventional controllers and disturbance observers (DOBs) are the standard for precision tracking in manipulators, they suffer from parameter uncertainty, nonlinear friction, and compound disturbances. This study proposes a residual reinforcement learning DOB framework that pairs an analytical observer with an RL policy. The deterministic baseline operates within a reliable region, whereas the RL policy explicitly targets the residuals that the model cannot capture. To make this compensation disturbance-aware, an estimator network aligns the observation history with a privileged disturbance context, organizing the latent space by disturbance regime and enabling rapid adaptation across disturbance transitions. To guarantee stability, we derived and enforced a state-dependent action bound on the RL policy from an input-to-state stability (ISS) analysis such that the closed loop provably confines the tracking error to a certified envelope for arbitrary policy outputs. Experiments on a 6-DOF manipulator demonstrated consistent improvements in disturbance estimation and tracking, including a 27.8% tracking-error reduction on real hardware under zero-shot sim-to-real transfer and a 38.0% reduction under a base-vibration disturbance that was not observed during training.

AI.tldr: 提出一种残差强化学习干扰观测器框架，将解析观测器与强化学习策略结合，用于机械臂在高参数不确定性、非线性摩擦和复合干扰下的精准跟踪。
AI.motivation: 传统控制器和干扰观测器在精密跟踪中易受参数不确定性、非线性摩擦和复合干扰影响，难以补偿模型无法捕捉的残差。
AI.method: 让确定性基线在可靠区域工作，强化学习策略专门补偿残差；通过估计器网络将观测历史与特权干扰上下文对齐，按干扰类型组织潜空间以快速适应干扰切换；基于输入到状态稳定性分析推导并施加状态相关动作约束，保证任意策略输出下闭环跟踪误差有认证包络。
AI.result: 在6自由度机械臂上，干扰估计和跟踪性能一致提升；真实硬件零样本仿真到现实迁移下跟踪误差降低27.8%，在训练中未见的基座振动干扰下降低38.0%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能可证明地限制跟踪误差，并跨干扰快速适应，有效提升机械臂抗扰跟踪性能。

title: ECG Mirage: Revealing and Mitigating the Underutilisation of ECGs in Vision-Language Models for Clinical Prediction
summary: Emergency department (ED) decision-making relies on heterogeneous clinical information, including patient history, vital signs, laboratory results, and electrocardiograms (ECGs). Vision--language models (VLMs) can jointly process these modalities, but strong predictive performance does not necessarily imply meaningful use of the correct patient's ECG. We term this failure mode ECG Mirage: apparent multimodal capability without useful dependence on patient-specific ECG information. We distinguish two forms: ECG neglect, where ECGs provide little predictive benefit, and ECG confusion, where matched ECGs outperform no-image inputs but not mismatched ECGs. To evaluate these behaviours, we compare predictions obtained with matched ECGs, outcome-discordant mismatched ECGs, and no-image inputs while holding the clinical text and prediction targets fixed. Across four VLMs on MDS-ED, matched ECGs provide no consistent advantage for either ICU admission or clinical deterioration prediction. We then train four restricted visual prompts using supervised learning followed by conditional direct preference optimisation, while keeping the VLM backbone frozen. The resulting models achieve balanced accuracies of 70.6% for ICU admission and 67.5% for deterioration and increase the matched-versus-mismatched performance gap to approximately 16.5 and 5.5 percentage points, respectively. Overall, our study identifies ECG Mirage in multimodal clinical prediction and introduces visual prompt tuning as an efficient mitigation strategy.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出急诊多模态预测中的“ECG Mirage”失败模式，即视觉语言模型看似能利用心电图，但实际并未有效依赖患者本人的ECG信息；作者通过匹配、错配和无图像ECG输入比较来评估该问题，并提出视觉提示调优作为缓解策略。
AI.motivation: 急诊决策依赖病史、生命体征、化验和心电图等多源异构信息。视觉语言模型虽可联合处理这些模态，但高预测性能不一定代表模型真正使用了正确的患者ECG，因此需要识别并解决这种多模态能力假象。
AI.method: 在MDS-ED数据上，对四个视觉语言模型比较匹配ECG、结果不一致的错配ECG和无图像输入下的预测表现，同时固定临床文本与预测目标。随后保持VLM主干冻结，训练四个受限视觉提示，采用监督学习后再进行条件直接偏好优化。
AI.result: 在四个VLM中，匹配ECG对ICU入住或临床恶化预测均未带来一致优势，表明存在ECG忽视或ECG混淆。经视觉提示调优后，模型在ICU入住预测上达到70.6%平衡准确率，在恶化预测上达到67.5%，并将匹配与错配之间的性能差距分别提高到约16.5和5.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别了多模态临床预测中的ECG Mirage现象，并证明视觉提示调优是一种在冻结VLM主干条件下高效缓解该问题的策略。

title: Beyond Atomic Tokens: Factorizing Syllables for Language Model Pretraining
summary: Conventional tokenizers represent text as characters or statistically derived subwords, overlooking the internal phonological structure of syllables and often requiring large vocabularies. We introduce \textbf{Phonemic Tokenizer}, a linguistically motivated tokenizer for Vietnamese and Chinese that converts each syllable into IPA and factorizes it into three phonological components: onset, rime, and tone. The three components jointly occupy one contextual position, preserving syllable-level sequence length while enabling representation sharing across phonologically related syllables. Non-phonological and unsupported units are handled through character-level fallback. This deterministic design requires no corpus-dependent vocabulary learning and yields vocabularies of only 112 entries for Chinese and 256 for Vietnamese. Intrinsic evaluation shows that the tokenizer achieves substantially higher Rényi efficiency in both languages, represents every entry in a standard Vietnamese syllable dictionary with a Fertility of exactly one, and generally produces shorter Vietnamese sequences than existing pretrained tokenizers. We further instantiate the tokenizer in \textbf{PhonemicBERT}, which combines factorized component embeddings and reconstructs complete masked syllables using three prediction heads. Under a controlled Chinese pretraining setup, PhonemicBERT-Zh is competitive with or outperforms character, subword, and SubChar alternatives across diverse language-understanding tasks. PhonemicBERT-Vi also achieves competitive or superior results to established Vietnamese and multilingual pretrained models. These results establish phonemic factorization as a compact, efficient, and interpretable alternative to atomic and statistically segmented text representations.

AI.tldr: 提出面向越南语和汉语的音素化分词器，将音节转为IPA并分解为声母、韵母、声调三个音系成分，三者共享一个上下文位置；进一步构建PhonemicBERT，在多项理解任务上表现竞争力强。
AI.motivation: 传统分词器多基于字符或统计子词，忽略音节内部音系结构，且常需大词表；作者希望利用语言学的音系分解实现更紧凑、高效、可解释的文本表示。
AI.method: 将每个音节转为IPA，并分解为onset、rime、tone三部分，共同占用一个位置；非音系或无法支持单元采用字符级回退。该确定性设计无需语料相关词表学习，中文词表仅112项，越南语256项。再实例化PhonemicBERT，结合因子化成分嵌入和三个预测头重建被掩码的完整音节。
AI.result: 内在评估显示，该分词器在两种语言中Rényi效率显著更高；对标准越南语音节词典中每个词条的Fertility恰为1，且越南语序列通常短于现有预训练分词器。受控中文预训练下，PhonemicBERT-Zh在多种语言理解任务上达到或超过字符、子词和SubChar方法；PhonemicBERT-Vi也达到或优于已有越南语和多语言预训练模型。
AI.conclusion: 音系因子化是一种紧凑、高效且可解释的替代方案，可替代原子式或统计式文本表示。

title: VoxelTTO: Voxel-Aligned Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Test-Time Optimization
summary: Recent feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods typically regress pixel-aligned Gaussian primitives, often causing excessive overlap and artifacts, while inaccuracies in predicted camera poses can lead to misalignment in novel-view synthesis (NVS). We present VoxelTTO, a feed-forward framework for reconstructing geometrically accurate 3DGS scenes from an arbitrary number of images and optional camera parameters. VoxelTTO aggregates dense image features into a global voxel representation and decodes Gaussians from voxel features, breaking the pixel-to-Gaussian correspondence. To exploit known camera parameters while keeping the pretrained visual foundation model (VFM) parameters frozen, we introduce test-time optimization (TTO) that adapts lightweight LoRA modules using pose supervision. We further replace vanilla 3DGS rasterization with stochastic solid volume rendering during training and inference, improving geometric fidelity. Training updates only the voxel-aligned Gaussian reconstruction modules, requiring 80 GPU hours. Experiments on Replica, Tanks and Temples, and DTU demonstrate improved RGB-D NVS and camera-pose estimation relative to prior methods.

AI.tldr: VoxelTTO 是一个前馈 3D Gaussian Splatting 框架，可从任意数量图像和可选相机参数中重建几何精确的 3DGS 场景，并在多个数据集上提升 RGB-D 新视角合成与相机位姿估计。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈 3DGS 方法通常回归像素对齐的高斯基元，容易造成高斯过度重叠和伪影；同时预测相机位姿不准确会导致新视角合成中的错位问题。
AI.method: VoxelTTO 将密集图像特征聚合到全局体素表示，并从体素特征解码高斯，打破像素到高斯的对应关系。为利用已知相机参数并保持预训练视觉基础模型冻结，引入测试时优化来适配轻量 LoRA 模块，并使用位姿监督。训练和推理阶段用随机实体体积渲染替代原始 3DGS 光栅化，以提升几何保真度。训练仅更新体素对齐的高斯重建模块，约需 80 GPU 小时。
AI.result: 在 Replica、Tanks and Temples 和 DTU 数据集上的实验表明，该方法在 RGB-D 新视角合成和相机位姿估计方面优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过体素特征解码高斯、测试时优化 LoRA 模块以及随机实体体积渲染，VoxelTTO 能有效提升 3DGS 重建的几何精度、新视角合成质量和相机位姿估计性能。

title: Prediction Dynamics in Depth-Recurrent Language Models
summary: Depth-recurrent language models refine predictions through repeated latent updates. Why can intermediate answers agree with the endpoint while their scores continue to change? We derive a sharp margin characterization that decomposes the conservatism of a magnitude bound into common translation, direction relative to the winner, and the pairing of each competitor's update with its score gap. Across Huginn-3.5B and Ouro-1.4B, accounting for update direction and competitor pairing reduces the mean earliest qualifying depth by a further 22.5-34.4% of the total depth beyond translation removal under full answer-text scoring. This retrospective comparison uses completed trajectories. Substantial contributions also occur under label scoring. For shared predictive distributions, we separate common and contrast motion orthogonally and express the common component through candidate-set mass and within-set concentration. Common and contrast energies can attenuate at different rates, allowing a growing preference-change share to coexist with shrinking absolute updates. These findings explain finite-depth answer preservation through the geometry and composition of observed score changes.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究深度循环语言模型为何在中间答案与最终答案一致时分数仍持续变化，并给出边际分解来刻画有限深度下答案保持的机制。
AI.motivation: 深度循环模型通过重复潜在更新细化预测；已有幅度约束较保守，作者希望解释中间答案可一致而分数变化的原因，并更精确刻画答案保持现象。
AI.method: 推导尖锐的边际刻画，将幅度约束的保守性分解为共同平移、相对获胜者的方向、以及每个竞争者更新与其分数差距的配对；在 Huginn-3.5B 和 Ouro-1.4B 上分析完整轨迹，并在全答案文本评分与标签评分下比较。对共享预测分布，正交分离共同运动与对比运动，并用候选集质量和集合内集中度表示共同部分。
AI.result: 在完整答案文本评分下，考虑更新方向和竞争者配对后，平均最早合格深度相比仅移除平移进一步降低总深度的 22.5%–34.4%；标签评分下也有显著贡献。共同与对比能量可不同速率衰减，因而偏好变化占比上升可与绝对更新缩小并存。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现从观测分数变化的几何结构与组成出发，解释了深度循环语言模型中的有限深度答案保持现象。

title: NaViRrator: Robot Navigation from Human-Readable Maps through a Learned Visual Route
summary: Human-readable maps provide an intuitive interface for specifying robot destinations, but connecting their schematic geometry to egocentric observations remains challenging. We present NaViRRator, a framework that translates user-specified start and goal locations on such maps into navigation instructions for a pretrained vision-and-language navigation (VLN) policy. Its core method, RouteScribe, separates route inference from verbalization by first generating an explicit route scaffold in map-image coordinates, which a pretrained vision-language model (VLM) converts into a navigation instruction. We construct the scaffold with start--goal line conditional flow matching (SGL-CFM), which deforms a straight start--goal waypoint sequence into a map-conditioned route. During execution, the VLN policy receives only the instruction and egocentric observations, while the map and scaffold remain upstream, allowing executor replacement without retraining the map-to-language modules. Real-world experiments show higher success rates and success weighted by path length (SPL) than direct map-to-instruction generation, A*-based scaffolding, and Gaussian-source conditional flow matching. Qualitative results further show clearer salient turns and better preservation of the intended maneuver sequence, supporting route-grounded language as a modular interface between human-readable maps and pretrained navigation policies.

AI.tldr: 提出 NaViRRator 框架，将人类可读地图上的起终点转换为导航指令，供预训练 VLN 策略执行。核心 RouteScribe 先生成地图坐标中的路线脚手架，再由 VLM 转为语言指令，其中 SGL-CFM 将直线路径变形为地图条件路线。
AI.motivation: 人类可读地图是直观的机器人目的地指定接口，但将地图的示意几何结构与机器人自我中心观测相连接仍具挑战，需要一种模块化方式把地图起终点转化为预训练导航策略可执行的指令。
AI.method: NaViRRator 将地图上的起终点翻译为 VLN 指令。RouteScribe 分离路线推断与语言表达：先用 start-goal line conditional flow matching（SGL-CFM）将起终点直线路点序列变形为地图条件路线脚手架，再用预训练 VLM 转成导航指令。执行时 VLN 策略只接收指令和自我中心观测，地图与脚手架保留在上游，从而可替换执行器而无需重训地图到语言模块。
AI.result: 真实世界实验显示，该方法比直接地图到指令生成、基于 A* 的脚手架和 Gaussian-source conditional flow matching 取得更高成功率和 SPL。定性结果还表明，其显著转向更清晰，能更好保持预期动作序列。
AI.conclusion: 以路线为基础的语言可作为人类可读地图与预训练导航策略之间的模块化接口，兼顾地图接口的直观性与 VLN 策略的执行能力。

title: Adaptive World Memory 3D Foundation Model for Scalable 3D Mapping, Localization, and Rendering
summary: Recent 3D foundation models enable generalizable geometric reasoning from RGB images but remain limited in persistent memory, scalability, and renderable scene modeling. We present a memory-centric 3D foundation model for scalable robotic localization, reconstruction, and Gaussian rendering. Its core is an adaptive world memory mechanism that combines transformer-based gated updates with test-time temporal-spatial regulation. Learned gates control recurrent memory propagation, while temporal state evolution and spatial observation-state consistency regulate token-wise updates and forgetting over long image sequences. To support large-scale mapping, we organize memory into local submaps and integrate progressive mapping and tracking, loop closure, and SL(4)-based global refinement to maintain local accuracy and global consistency. A Gaussian reconstruction head decodes memory-enhanced features into renderable primitives, unifying camera pose estimation, dense point-cloud reconstruction, and photorealistic rendering within a single model. Experiments on public benchmarks and self-collected datasets from diverse robotic platforms demonstrate improved trajectory accuracy, reconstruction completeness, and rendering quality over existing 3D foundation reconstruction and SLAM baselines. These results support adaptive memory as a foundation for persistent robotic world modeling. The dataset and code will be made publicly available at \href{https://github.com/dtc111111/AWM-3DFM}{https://github.com/dtc111111/AWM-3DFM}.

AI.tldr: 提出一种以记忆为中心的3D基础模型，用于可扩展的机器人定位、重建与高斯渲染，核心是自适应世界记忆机制，统一了位姿估计、稠密点云重建和逼真渲染。
AI.motivation: 现有3D基础模型虽能从RGB图像进行泛化几何推理，但在持久记忆、可扩展性和可渲染场景建模方面仍存在局限。
AI.method: 采用自适应世界记忆机制：基于Transformer的门控更新与测试时时空调节，学习门控控制循环记忆传播，时间状态演化和空间观测-状态一致性调节长序列中token级更新与遗忘；通过局部子图组织内存，集成渐进式建图与跟踪、回环检测及基于SL(4)的全局优化；高斯重建头将记忆增强特征解码为可渲染图元，统一相机位姿估计、稠密点云重建和逼真渲染。
AI.result: 在公开基准和多种机器人平台的自采数据集上，轨迹精度、重建完整性和渲染质量均优于现有3D基础重建和SLAM基线。
AI.conclusion: 自适应记忆可作为持久机器人世界建模的基础，数据集和代码将公开。

title: LLM-Generated Feature Pools for Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: We study how far a simple statistical pipeline can go on univariate time series anomaly detection under a strict selection protocol. The method extracts a small pool of statistics over sliding windows, scores each window with a transductive robust (MAD) model, and selects a feature subset per domain on a held-out tuning split. On TSB-AD-U it reaches $0.529$ per-series VUS-PR, above the best neural ($0.45$) and statistical ($0.44$) entries on the public leaderboard and within $0.06$ of the strongest pretrained foundation model, several of which use more supervision than ours. Ablations locate the cause: across three selection strategies and a hindsight oracle the score moves by $0.031$, and across the aggregation grid by $0.096$, while changing the candidate pool moves it by $0.226$. The candidate pool sets the ceiling; the search over it is second-order. We therefore generate a pool per domain by prompting a multimodal LLM with in-context example windows from that domain. The generated pools match the hand-crafted one under matched selection, and the two cover different domains: selecting over their union improves on the generated pool in all twelve generator-seed pairs and lifts the pipeline to $0.588$, matching the performance of the best entry on the leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 该研究考察在严格选择协议下，简单统计流程在单变量时间序列异常检测中的表现，并通过消融定位性能瓶颈，最终利用多模态LLM生成域相关候选统计池，将性能提升至榜单最佳水平。
AI.motivation: 探究简单统计方法能否媲美神经网络或预训练基础模型，并明确候选统计池、特征选择策略和聚合方式各自对性能的影响程度。
AI.method: 在滑动窗口上提取少量统计量，用转导鲁棒MAD模型对每个窗口打分，并在留出调参集上按域选择特征子集；通过消融比较不同选择策略、聚合网格和候选池；再用多模态LLM结合域内示例窗口生成候选统计池，并与手工池取并集进行选择。
AI.result: 在TSB-AD-U上达到每序列VUS-PR 0.529，高于公开榜单最佳神经方法0.45和统计方法0.44，距最强预训练基础模型仅差0.06；消融显示选择策略仅使分数变动0.031，聚合网格变动0.096，而候选池变动0.226；LLM生成池与手工池在匹配选择下相当且覆盖不同域，二者并集在全部12个生成器种子对上均提升，最终达到0.588，匹配榜单最佳条目。
AI.conclusion: 候选池决定性能上限，池上的搜索只是二阶因素；LLM可生成有效的域相关候选池，并与手工池互补，使简单统计流程通过并集选择达到领先水平。

title: LEMCA: LLM-Guided Synthesis of Efficient Mode-Switching Control Architectures
summary: Physical control tasks in the natural world, such as driving or object manipulation, frequently exhibit dramatic variations in sensory and compute complexity over time. Correspondingly, a natural resource-efficient choice for robot control is to dynamically switch between control modes with varying resource allocations. However, such "mode-switching controllers" (MSCs) have historically required laborious, expert-driven design and synthesis for each new task. Driven by these design difficulties, modern robotic control architectures often fall back to a wasteful "monolithic" one-size-fits-all structure, where resource allocation is permanently anchored to the hardest, most resource-intensive task phases. To facilitate the design of performant yet efficient MSCs, we propose LLM-Guided synthesis of Efficient Mode-Switching Control Architectures (LEMCA). LEMCA represents MSC designs as interpretable programs to be iteratively refined in an evolutionary loop. To evaluate design fitness, we propose MSC-compatible extensions of automated controller synthesis approaches, such as reinforcement learning in simulation. LEMCA then leverages the semantic priors, reasoning, and coding capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to iteratively edit controller modes, their corresponding sensory-compute resource allocations, and mode transitions. Our experiments across diverse control benchmarks show that LEMCA consistently discovers strategies that surpass the Pareto frontier of monolithic designs by reclaiming wasted resources during "easy" task phases. LEMCA thus presents an automated, low-effort path to synthesize resource-efficient MSC designs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LEMCA，利用大语言模型引导合成高效的模式切换控制架构，将控制器设计表示为可解释程序并在进化循环中迭代优化，从而在不同任务阶段动态分配资源。
AI.motivation: 自然物理控制任务（如驾驶、操作）的感知与计算复杂度会随时间剧烈变化。理想方案是按需切换控制模式以节省资源，但模式切换控制器通常需要专家为每个新任务进行繁琐设计和综合，导致现代机器人控制常退回到资源浪费的单体式一刀切架构。
AI.method: LEMCA 将模式切换控制器设计表示为可解释程序，在进化循环中迭代改进；提出兼容模式切换的自动控制器合成扩展（如仿真中的强化学习）来评估设计适应度；并利用大语言模型的语义先验、推理和编码能力，迭代编辑控制器模式、对应的感知-计算资源分配以及模式切换。
AI.result: 在多种控制基准实验中，LEMCA 持续发现优于单体设计帕累托前沿的策略，能够回收“简单”任务阶段中被浪费的资源。
AI.conclusion: LEMCA 为自动、低努力地合成资源高效的模式切换控制器设计提供了一条可行路径。

title: ArenaFlow: From Trajectory Ranking to Hierarchical Credit Propagation for Open-Ended Agent RL
summary: Reinforcement learning has substantially improved large language model (LLM) agents in verifiable domains, but remains difficult to apply to open-ended agent tasks, where solutions are diverse and reliable scalar rewards are hard to obtain. Recent pairwise evaluation methods alleviate reward discrimination collapse by replacing pointwise scoring with relative preferences. However, they still compress rich comparative feedback into a single trajectory-level reward, obscuring decisive intermediate steps and preventing successful behaviors from being consolidated into reusable skills. We propose ArenaFlow, a hierarchical credit propagation framework for open-ended agent reinforcement learning. ArenaFlow leverages tournament-based relative ranking to derive trajectory-level reward signals. Each comparison is further equipped with structured reflective evaluation, which reveals three types of supervision: pivotal success steps, reusable strategy skills, and usage attribution of retrieved skills. At the step level, ArenaFlow propagates trajectory-level advantages to high-confidence pivotal steps according to tournament survival depth, enabling more targeted optimization of local reasoning behaviors. At the skill level, ArenaFlow estimates skill utility from group-level usage attribution and maintains a global skill memory through utility-aware updating, pruning, and retrieval. The resulting high-utility skills further serve as policy priors for future exploration. Extensive experiments validate ArenaFlow's effectiveness on open-ended agent tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出ArenaFlow，一种用于开放式智能体强化学习的分层信用传播框架，通过锦标赛式相对排名和结构化反思评估，在步骤和技能两个层面传播奖励信号，并在开放式任务上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在可验证领域显著提升了LLM智能体，但在开放式任务中难以应用，因为解决方案多样且难以获得可靠的标量奖励。现有成对评估方法虽通过相对偏好缓解奖励判别崩溃，但仍将丰富的比较反馈压缩为单一轨迹级奖励，掩盖了关键中间步骤，阻碍成功行为固化为可复用技能。
AI.method: ArenaFlow采用基于锦标赛的相对排名获取轨迹级奖励信号。每次比较辅以结构化反思评估，提供三类监督：关键成功步骤、可复用策略技能、检索技能的使用归因。在步骤层面，根据锦标赛存活深度将轨迹级优势传播到高置信度的关键步骤；在技能层面，从组级使用归因估计技能效用，通过效用感知的更新、剪枝和检索维护全局技能记忆，并作为未来探索的策略先验。
AI.result: 大量实验验证了ArenaFlow在开放式智能体任务上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ArenaFlow通过分层信用传播有效解决了开放式智能体强化学习中奖励信号稀疏和技能复用问题。

title: 2D GauSS-MI: Efficient Active Scene Reconstruction with Balanced Visual and Geometric Quality
summary: Active reconstruction requires efficient active view selection to achieve high-quality reconstruction within limited onboard computational resources. Existing methods face challenges in adequately balancing visual and geometric quality with the computational efficiency required for real-time operation. In this work, we present an active reconstruction framework based on 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS). We develop an efficient online 2DGS mapping pipeline for incremental RGB-D observations and introduce a probabilistic reliability model that characterizes the view-dependent reconstruction quality of individual 2D Gaussian splats. Building on this model, we formulate 2D Gaussian Splatting Shannon Mutual Information (2D GauSS-MI), a mutual-information-based metric that exploits the explicit surface orientation of 2DGS to evaluate the expected information gain of candidate views. The proposed metric enables active view selection to account for both visual and geometric reconstruction quality. We evaluate the proposed system against three state-of-the-art baselines on eight Replica scenes. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves a favorable balance between visual and geometric reconstruction quality with substantially lower computational cost and competitive model storage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于2D Gaussian Splatting的主动重建框架，通过在线增量RGB-D建图与概率可靠性模型，定义2D GauSS-MI互信息指标进行主动视角选择，在有限算力下兼顾视觉与几何重建质量。
AI.motivation: 主动重建需要在有限机载计算资源下实现高质量重建，但现有方法难以在视觉与几何质量、实时计算效率之间取得良好平衡。
AI.method: 构建面向增量RGB-D观测的高效在线2DGS建图流程；提出表征单个2D高斯溅射视角相关重建质量的概率可靠性模型；利用2DGS显式表面朝向，提出基于互信息的2D GauSS-MI指标，评估候选视角的期望信息增益并用于主动视角选择。
AI.result: 在八个Replica场景上与三种先进基线方法对比，所提方法在视觉与几何重建质量之间取得良好平衡，同时计算成本显著更低，模型存储具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 基于2DGS的互信息主动视角选择能同时考虑视觉和几何重建质量，并在有限计算资源下实现高效主动重建。

title: Consistent Relexicalization of Clinical Documents using Graph-Based Approach
comment: Accepted for presentation at the Sixth International Conference on AI ML Systems (AIMLSystems 2026), Lake Como, Italy, October 6-9, 2026
summary: Relexicalization is a pivotal technique in clinical NLP, as it facilitates robust masking of sensitive information while synthesizing datasets that retain high-fidelity, real-world characteristics. However, preserving structural integrity, relational coherence, and temporal consistency during transformation remains a significant challenge. Existing approaches frequently rely on independent entity replacement, which results in clinical inconsistencies across longitudinal records. This reduces the value of such relexicalized datasets for downstream scientific analysis. To address these limitations, we introduce G-RELIC (Graph Based Contextual Relexicalization with Improved Consistency) which combines the power of LLMs with graphs. G-RELIC implements a graph-based mapping mechanism which optimizes for one-to-one correspondence between original and surrogate entities. It also introduces a deterministic temporal repositioning algorithm to preserve temporal consistency. Empirical evaluations on diverse, real-world clinical datasets validate that G-RELIC significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. G-RELIC yields a 30.4 percentage point improvement in relational integrity (62.1% to 92.5%) and 45.9 percentage point improvement in temporal coherence (46% to 91.9%) without compromising on the recognized privacy benchmarks for clinical datasets. This maximizes the analytical utility of relexicalized datasets while minimizing re-identification risk.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 G-RELIC，一种结合大语言模型与图结构的临床文本重词化方法，通过图映射和确定性时间重定位，在保护隐私的同时提升临床记录的关系完整性与时间一致性。
AI.motivation: 临床 NLP 中重词化对敏感信息掩码和合成高保真数据至关重要，但现有方法多依赖独立实体替换，易导致纵向记录中的临床不一致，降低重词化数据集的下游分析价值。
AI.method: G-RELIC 结合 LLM 与图结构，采用基于图的映射机制优化原始实体与替代实体的一对一对应，并引入确定性时间重定位算法以保持时间一致性。
AI.result: 在多样真实临床数据集上的实验表明，G-RELIC 显著优于现有基线：关系完整性提升 30.4 个百分点（62.1% 至 92.5%），时间一致性提升 45.9 个百分点（46% 至 91.9%），且未损害临床数据集的隐私基准。
AI.conclusion: G-RELIC 在降低重识别风险的同时，最大化重词化数据集的分析效用，为临床 NLP 提供更一致、可用的隐私保护数据生成方案。

title: MIST: Multimodal Survival Prediction with Genomic-Guided Histology Attention
comment: Accepted at the COMPAYL 2026 Workshop on Computational Pathology and Multimodal Data at MICCAI 2026. 11 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables
summary: Multimodal survival models can combine complementary prognostic information from whole-slide images and genomic profiles, but effective fusion remains challenging amid external cohort shift and computational complexity. To address these challenges, we propose MIST, multimodal survival prediction with genomic-guided histology attention. MIST represents genomic features as tokens and allows them to query compact foundation-model-derived histology context tokens before survival prediction. This design enriches molecular information with histology context rather than merging separately encoded modalities only at the final stage. Training combines discrete-time survival prediction with genomic feature masking, WSI dropout, and paired WSI-genomics contrastive alignment. Across four external evaluations in colon, renal, lung, and glioblastoma cohorts, MIST improves external C-index over standard fusion baselines in the primary comparisons. These results support genomic-guided histology attention as a compact and effective strategy for multimodal oncology outcome prediction. Our code is available at https://github.com/samiyavuuz/MIST .

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MIST，一种基因组引导的组织学注意力多模态生存预测方法，通过让基因组特征作为查询来关注紧凑的病理基础模型上下文令牌，从而提升外部队列上的生存预测性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态生存模型可融合全切片图像与基因组信息，但有效融合仍受外部队列偏移和计算复杂度挑战。
AI.method: MIST将基因组特征表示为令牌，并在生存预测前用其查询由基础模型得到的紧凑组织学上下文令牌；训练结合离散时间生存预测、基因组特征掩码、WSI丢弃以及配对的WSI-基因组对比对齐。
AI.result: 在结肠癌、肾癌、肺癌和胶质母细胞瘤四个外部评估中，MIST在主要比较中相对标准融合基线提升了外部C-index。
AI.conclusion: 基因组引导的组织学注意力是一种紧凑且有效的多模态肿瘤结局预测策略，代码已开源。

title: VidOmni-Bench: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Video Understanding via Spatio-Temporal Event Verification across Complexity and Duration
summary: While Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) have recently demonstrated strong performance, reliably evaluating their fine-grained video understanding remains challenging. Existing benchmarks often rely on question answering or ground-truth caption matching, where models may succeed through superficial cues and incomplete annotations. To this end, we introduce VidOmni-Bench, a benchmark that requires models to verify whether each event in dense video captions is supported by the video. VidOmni-Bench consists of 500 videos spanning five complexity types and diverse durations from 4 seconds to 90 minutes. After collecting videos along these axes, we use diverse Video-LLMs to generate dense captions and obtain human-verified sentence-level labels, where sentences containing incorrect events serve as hard negatives for evaluation. Our experiments on VidOmni-Bench reveal three key findings: (i) Video-LLMs frequently generate hallucinated descriptions in dense video captioning; (ii) they also struggle as verifiers, failing to reliably detect plausible but incorrect event descriptions; and (iii) model weaknesses vary across video complexity and duration, revealing diverse, model-specific bottlenecks in current Video-LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VidOmni-Bench，一个通过密集视频描述中的事件是否被视频支持来评估 Video-LLM 细粒度视频理解能力的基准，并发现模型存在幻觉、验证能力不足及瓶颈差异等问题。
AI.motivation: 现有视频大模型评测多依赖问答或真实描述匹配，模型可能借助表面线索或利用不完整标注取得高分，难以可靠评估其细粒度视频理解能力。
AI.method: 构建 VidOmni-Bench：包含 500 个视频，覆盖五种复杂度类型和 4 秒到 90 分钟的视频时长；使用多种 Video-LLM 生成密集描述，并人工验证句子级标签，将包含错误事件的句子作为困难负样本，要求模型判断每个事件是否被视频支持。
AI.result: 实验发现三点：(i) Video-LLM 在密集视频描述中经常产生幻觉；(ii) 作为验证器时也难以可靠识别看似合理但错误的事件描述；(iii) 模型在不同视频复杂度和时长下表现出的弱点不同，暴露出模型特定的瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: VidOmni-Bench 能更严格地评估 Video-LLM 的细粒度视频理解，并揭示当前模型在描述与验证方面仍存在显著不足，且瓶颈因模型和视频特性而异。

title: The EventCV Library for Event-Based Robotic Vision
summary: Event cameras detect per-pixel brightness changes asynchronously on microsecond timescales, with high dynamic range and low power draw. These are desirable properties for robots that move fast or work in difficult lighting conditions. However, integrating an event camera into a real-world robotic pipeline still requires substantial effort: plug-and-play drivers do not exist, event streams are recorded in a variety of incompatible file formats, and most projects rely on custom research-grade code. Here, we present EventCV, an open-source and extensible Rust library with OpenCV-style Python bindings that lowers the entry barrier to working with event cameras. EventCV provides a wide range of features: denoising filters and geometric transforms, augmentations, corner detection and unsupervised feature learning, contrast-maximization motion estimation, a video-to-events simulator, and Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) inference for deployment in robotic stacks. EventCV integrates the Neuromorphic Drivers package, allowing an event camera stream to be processed directly in real time. No existing toolkit covers this range of operations in one package, and EventCV builds representations and decodes files 1.1x to 3.7x faster than the currently available libraries. We deploy EventCV on a Jetson Orin AGX and present three robotics case studies spanning object detection, on-device model inference, and localization. Project webpage: https://eventcv.net.

AI.tldr: EventCV 是一个开源、可扩展的 Rust 事件相机库，提供 OpenCV 风格的 Python 绑定，集成了去噪、变换、角点检测、运动估计、仿真和 ONNX 推理等功能，并在机器人场景中验证。
AI.motivation: 事件相机对快速运动机器人和困难光照条件有吸引力，但实际集成困难：缺少即插即用驱动、事件流文件格式不兼容、多数项目依赖定制研究级代码。
AI.method: 开发 EventCV 库，提供 Rust 实现与 Python 绑定，包含去噪滤波、几何变换、数据增强、角点检测、无监督特征学习、对比度最大化运动估计、视频到事件仿真、ONNX 推理，并集成 Neuromorphic Drivers 以实时处理事件流。
AI.result: EventCV 在单一工具包中覆盖广泛操作，构建表示和解码文件比现有库快 1.1 到 3.7 倍；在 Jetson Orin AGX 上部署，并完成目标检测、设备端模型推理和定位三个机器人案例研究。
AI.conclusion: EventCV 降低了使用事件相机的门槛，能够支持实时机器人流水线，并推动事件相机在真实机器人系统中的应用。

title: FAN: Foresight Action Normalization for Continual Adaptation of Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models pre-trained on large-scale, closed datasets have demonstrated remarkable success across diverse robotic manipulation tasks. However, their long-term real-world deployment necessitates continuously acquiring new skills while retaining previously learned capabilities. While pioneering works have explored continual VLA adaptation using techniques such as experience replay and reinforcement fine-tuning, they overlook a foundational mechanism: action normalization, which determines the underlying coordinate system in which policies perceive and execute physical actions. To bridge this gap, we systematically evaluate five normalization strategies across four real-world task streams covering single-arm and bimanual manipulation. Our analysis reveals that existing protocols induce severe failure modes due to inter-task coordinate drift, limited motion coverage, or train-test coordinate mismatches. Motivated by these insights, we formulate three core design principles: consistency, coverage, and causality (3C), and introduce foresight action normalization (FAN). FAN estimates normalization statistics once from a small, task-independent calibration set prior to continual learning and freezes them throughout adaptation. Across all evaluated streams, FAN achieves the highest performance and demonstrates consistent robustness, providing insightful guidance for building stable action representations in achieving effective lifelong VLA adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究持续视觉-语言-动作（VLA）适配中的动作归一化问题，系统评估五种归一化策略，并提出基于一致性、覆盖性和因果性三项原则的FAN方法，以提升长期机器人操作中的稳定适应能力。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型虽在大规模闭数据集上表现优异，但长期真实部署需持续学习新技能并保留旧能力。已有持续VLA适配方法多关注经验回放和强化微调，却忽视了动作归一化这一决定策略动作坐标系统的基础机制。
AI.method: 在四个真实世界任务流（涵盖单臂和双臂操作）上系统评估五种动作归一化策略，分析其失败模式；据此提出一致性、覆盖性和因果性（3C）设计原则，并引入前瞻动作归一化（FAN）。FAN在持续学习前从少量且任务无关的校准集中估计一次归一化统计量，并在整个适配过程中冻结。
AI.result: 分析发现现有归一化协议会因任务间坐标漂移、运动覆盖不足或训练-测试坐标不匹配而引发严重失败模式。在所有评估任务流中，FAN取得了最高性能，并表现出稳定的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 动作归一化是持续VLA适配的关键基础机制；遵循3C原则的FAN能为构建稳定的动作表征、实现有效的终身VLA适配提供重要指导。

title: AutoRecLab: Describe the Experiment, Get the Code!
comment: Accepted at the 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys '26), Demo Track. 4 pages, 2 figures
summary: Empirical evaluation is central to recommender-systems (RecSys) research, but turning experimental designs into executable code remains a manual and error-prone task. We present AutoRecLab, a Python-based autonomous RecSys lab that automates RecSys experiments from natural-language prompts. Given a research idea, AutoRecLab derives explicit experiment requirements, builds and validates a prototype, and iteratively expands it into the requested full experiment. The workflow combines retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for documentation lookup, static type verification, and execution-steered tree search. In our demonstration, AutoRecLab autonomously implements an explicit-to-implicit feedback conversion study. In a baseline comparison across six algorithms and three datasets, 8 of 9 runs succeed at an average cost of approx- imately $1 per run with GPT-5.4-mini.

AI.tldr: AutoRecLab 是一个基于 Python 的自主推荐系统实验平台，可根据自然语言提示自动完成推荐系统实验的设计、实现与迭代扩展。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统研究高度依赖实证评估，但将实验设计转化为可执行代码通常需要人工完成，过程繁琐且容易出错。
AI.method: AutoRecLab 首先从研究想法中提取明确的实验需求，构建并验证原型，再迭代扩展为完整实验；其工作流结合了检索增强生成（RAG）用于文档查询、静态类型验证以及执行引导的树搜索。
AI.result: 在演示中，AutoRecLab 自主实现了显式反馈到隐式反馈转换研究；在六种算法和三个数据集上的基线比较中，9 次运行有 8 次成功，使用 GPT-5.4-mini 时平均每次运行成本约 1 美元。
AI.conclusion: AutoRecLab 能够自动化推荐系统实验流程，降低人工实现实验的门槛和错误率，展现出自主实验平台的可行性。

title: Omni Demand Understanding: A Benchmark for Contextual User-Intent Inference in Multimodal Interaction
summary: Natural audio-visual interaction is emerging as an important interface for AI assistants, allowing users to communicate through speech and vision rather than carefully composed text prompts. However, existing benchmarks of interactive capabilities still focus primarily on response quality, leaving a more fundamental question underexplored: can a model correctly infer the user's underlying demand from complex multimodal interaction? Real-world user demands are often underspecified in speech and must be inferred from multimodal cues and dialogue history. This inference is further complicated by ambiguous or disfluent expression and noisy acoustic environments. Conversely, request-like speech may not constitute a demand to the assistant, leading to false triggers.
