We establish Omni Demand Understanding (ODU) as a distinct multimodal contextual inference problem: given an interaction stream, a model must detect whether a user demand is present and infer intent from multimodal and conversational context. ODU evaluates this capability along five dimensions, covering both single-turn and multi-turn interactions. We construct ODU-Bench using a challenge-driven taxonomy, taxonomy-guided agentic video generation, and human-recorded interactions, followed by media-grounded annotation and human verification. We evaluate 14 native MLLMs. Even the strongest, Gemini 3.1 Pro, recovers only 44.7% of key information that must be inferred from visual, acoustic, or conversational context. Moreover, 11 of the 14 models exhibit false-trigger rates above 50% on non-demand scenarios. These results reveal a systematic capability gap in current MLLMs' ability to infer contextual user demands. We hope ODU can establish the evaluation of a previously underexplored yet essential capability in multimodal interaction: correctly understanding user demands before generating an appropriate response.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Omni Demand Understanding (ODU) 这一多模态上下文推断任务及 ODU-Bench 基准，用于评估多模态大模型从音视频交互流中检测并推断用户真实需求的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有交互能力基准主要关注回复质量，忽视了更根本的问题：模型能否从复杂多模态交互中正确推断用户潜在需求。真实需求常在语音中表述不充分，需结合多模态线索与对话历史推断，并受歧义、不流畅表达和噪声环境影响；同时请求式语音未必代表真实需求，容易导致误触发。
AI.method: 将 ODU 定义为多模态上下文推断问题：给定交互流，模型需检测是否存在用户需求，并基于多模态与对话语境推断意图。从五个维度覆盖单轮与多轮交互进行评估。通过挑战驱动分类法、分类引导的智能体视频生成和真人录制交互构建 ODU-Bench，并进行媒体锚定标注与人工验证。共评测 14 个原生多模态大模型（MLLM）。
AI.result: 即使是表现最强的 Gemini 3.1 Pro，也只能恢复 44.7% 必须从视觉、声学或对话上下文推断的关键信息；14 个模型中有 11 个在非需求场景下的误触发率超过 50%。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态大模型在推断上下文用户需求方面存在系统性能力差距。作者希望 ODU 能推动评估多模态交互中此前未被充分探索但至关重要的能力：在生成合适回复之前正确理解用户需求。

title: Refine Then Fusion: Training-Free 3D Point Cloud Adaptation with Priority Refinement and Multi-Modal Knowledge Fusion
summary: Recent pre-trained foundation models provide rich multi-modal priors for downstream 3D vision tasks. However, the effectiveness of these representations in few-shot scenarios is limited by two fundamental challenges: High-dimensional features often contain substantial channel redundancy and task-irrelevant noise, while the reliability of different modalities varies across samples. Consequently, direct aggregation of heterogeneous representations overlooks sample-dependent modality reliability and may obscure the discriminative cues essential. To address these limitations, we propose Refine Then Fusion(RTF), a training-free framework for few-shot 3D recognition. RTF first identifies discriminative feature channels by jointly modeling inter-class similarity and intra-class stability, thereby decoupling domain-specific knowledge refinement from the cached representations of pre-trained models. It then introduces a reliability-aware fusion mechanism that estimates sample-wise modality reliability from the distribution shifts induced by feature refinement, enabling adaptive aggregation of multi-modal representations. Furthermore, RTF constructs a memory cache that integrates instance-level support features with class-level prototypes to infer query labels. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks demonstrate that RTF consistently outperforms single-modal baselines, partial-fusion variants, and existing lightweight adaptation methods, achieving state-of-the-art few-shot 3D recognition performance without gradient optimization, additional training data, auxiliary training, or parameter updates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出无需训练的 Refine Then Fusion（RTF）框架，用于少样本 3D 识别；通过先精炼判别性特征通道，再进行可靠性感知的多模态融合，在五个基准上取得最优性能，且无需梯度优化、额外数据或参数更新。
AI.motivation: 预训练基础模型虽提供丰富的多模态先验，但在少样本 3D 场景中，高维特征常含通道冗余和任务无关噪声，且不同模态在不同样本上的可靠性不同；直接聚合异构表征会忽略样本级模态可靠性，并可能掩盖关键判别线索。
AI.method: RTF 首先联合建模类间相似性与类内稳定性，识别判别性特征通道，从预训练模型缓存表征中解耦并精炼领域特定知识；然后引入可靠性感知融合机制，根据特征精炼引起的分布偏移估计样本级模态可靠性，实现自适应多模态聚合；最后构建融合实例级支持特征与类级原型的内存缓存，用于推断查询标签。
AI.result: 在五个基准上的大量实验表明，RTF 持续优于单模态基线、部分融合变体及现有轻量适配方法，在无需梯度优化、额外训练数据、辅助训练或参数更新的条件下，取得了最先进的少样本 3D 识别性能。
AI.conclusion: RTF 是一种有效的免训练少样本 3D 识别框架，通过判别性特征精炼与样本级可靠性感知融合，能够更充分地利用预训练多模态表征，并在不更新参数的情况下实现优越性能。

title: EnterpriseVal: Quantifying the Efficacy, Reliability and Value of Generative AI in the Enterprise
summary: Frontier language models now produce professional deliverables that expert graders judge to match human work on a substantial share of economically valuable tasks, yet most enterprise GenAI initiatives fail to show a measurable business effect and a large fraction of agentic projects are expected to be cancelled. We argue that this is substantially a measurement problem: public benchmarks answer "what can the model do?", whereas a deployment decision requires "is this workflow fit, reliable, safe and worth scaling - here, on our data, under our controls?". We present EnterpriseVal, a use-case-level evaluation system that closes this gap. It comprises (i) a formal specification of the use case and of the frozen socio-technical configuration under test, model, prompts, retrieval, tools, guardrails and human oversight, with an autonomy level and consequence tier that jointly set the required evaluation intensity; (ii) a metric catalogue spanning fidelity, utility, efficiency, reliability, assurance and oversight; (iii) a grading protocol that scales blinded expert judgement with calibrated LLM-as-judge scoring through prediction-powered inference; (iv) a two-tier threshold gate, stated as an executable algorithm, that maps metric vectors with confidence bounds to REJECT/CONDITIONAL/SCALE decisions; and (v) a value-and-risk model in which the reviewer catch rate is a measured parameter. We report a pilot across three workflows in a global bank. In credit-memo drafting, human-graded citation precision reached 88% and hallucination rate 1.6% for the best model against gates of 70% and 5%; in procedure transformation, analyst refinement effort fell from an estimated 27.4 to 2.9 hours per document. We separate established results, documented pilot evidence, the proposed system and open hypotheses, and specify the experiments required for full validation

AI.tldr: 提出 EnterpriseVal，一个面向企业用例的生成式AI评估系统，旨在弥合公共基准与部署决策之间的差距。该系统包括用例与冻结社会技术配置规范、指标目录、结合专家判断与校准LLM评分的分级协议、两级阈值决策门以及价值-风险模型。某全球银行三个工作流试点显示：信贷备忘录撰写中最佳模型引用精确率88%、幻觉率1.6%；流程改造中分析师精修工作量从估计27.4小时/文档降至2.9小时/文档。
AI.motivation: 前沿模型已能产出专家认为可匹配人类工作的专业交付物，但多数企业生成式AI项目未能显示可衡量业务效果，且大量代理项目预计将被取消。作者认为这主要是测量问题：公共基准回答“模型能做什么”，而部署决策需要回答“该工作流在本地数据和控制下是否适用、可靠、安全且值得扩展”。
AI.method: EnterpriseVal 包含五部分：(i) 用例和冻结社会技术配置的形式化规范，涵盖模型、提示、检索、工具、护栏和人工监督，并以自主水平和后果等级共同设定评估强度；(ii) 覆盖保真度、效用、效率、可靠性、保证和监督的指标目录；(iii) 通过预测驱动推断，以校准的LLM-as-judge扩展盲审专家判断的分级协议；(iv) 以可执行算法表述的两级阈值门，将带置信界的指标向量映射为REJECT/CONDITIONAL/SCALE决策；(v) 将审查者捕获率作为可测量参数的价值-风险模型。
AI.result: 在某全球银行三个工作流中开展试点。信贷备忘录撰写：最佳模型的人类评分引用精确率达88%，幻觉率1.6%，对应门槛为70%和5%。流程改造：分析师精修工作量从估计的每文档27.4小时降至2.9小时。论文区分了已确立结果、记录在案的试点证据、所提系统和开放假设，并指定了全面验证所需实验。
AI.conclusion: EnterpriseVal 通过面向用例、指标化、分级校准和可执行决策门的方法，试图解决企业GenAI部署中的测量缺口。试点结果初步支持其可用性，但完整验证仍需按论文指定的实验进行，当前证据应谨慎区分为试点证据与待验证假设。

title: Purification and Regulation: Comorbidity-Aware Multi-Label Few-Shot Learning for Medical Image Classification
summary: Multi-label few-shot learning (MLFSL) remains a significant challenge in medical image analysis (MIA). Current metric-based meta-learning methods face two critical limitations in MIA. First, conventional prototype generation often entangles irrelevant disease information, leading to contaminated prototypes and degraded performance. Second, prior studies typically enforce inter-class separability in embedding space, largely neglecting the inherent correlations among diseases. To overcome these challenges, we propose Prototype Purification and Regulation (PPR), a novel MLFSL framework for MIA. PPR first performs prototype purification by leveraging sample-level comorbidity scores to emphasize disease-specific features, producing purified prototypes that better characterize each disease. Building upon these purified prototypes, PPR further addresses the underexplored problem of inter-class prototype distance in MIA by incorporating disease-level comorbidity statistics to adaptively regulate inter-class similarity, forming a comorbidity-aware embedding space. Overall, PPR sequentially enables the model to capture pure disease features and inter-class relationships for reliable MLFSL in MIA. Extensive experiments across four chest X-ray benchmark datasets, including cross-domain evaluation, show that PPR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, significantly improving disease detection while demonstrating robust generalization and clinical applicability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Prototype Purification and Regulation (PPR) 框架，用于医学图像分析中的多标签小样本学习，通过原型净化和类间关系调控提升疾病检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多标签小样本医学图像方法存在两个关键局限：传统原型易混入无关疾病信息，导致原型污染；同时过于强调类间可分性，忽视了疾病之间的内在相关性。
AI.method: PPR 首先利用样本级共病分数进行原型净化，突出疾病特异性特征，生成更纯净的原型；随后引入疾病级共病统计，自适应调控类间相似度，构建共病感知的嵌入空间，以同时建模纯疾病特征和类间关系。
AI.result: 在四个胸部 X 射线基准数据集及跨域评估中，PPR 持续优于现有最先进方法，显著提升疾病检测效果，并展现出较强的泛化能力和临床适用性。
AI.conclusion: PPR 能有效解决医学图像多标签小样本学习中的原型污染和类间关系建模不足问题，为可靠的多标签小样本医学图像分析提供了新框架。

title: MicroHookACT: Monocular Microscopic Vision Guided Visuomotor Policy for Flexible Microelectrode Hooking
summary: Automated needle-loop hooking is a critical step in flexible microelectrode (FME) implantation. This paper presents MicroHookACT, an imitation learning-based visuomotor policy for automated 3D hooking under monocular microscopic vision. First, a unidirectional hooking strategy exploits defocus cues and optical-axis guidance to enable palpation-free precise alignment and contact-rich threading. Second, an action-supervised object attention module built on a frozen ViT backbone learns to focus on the micro-needle tip and micro-loop directly from human demonstrations, without requiring manual visual annotations for training. Third, attention-centered global coarse and local fine features are dynamically weighted according to predicted action progress, enabling a single ACT policy to adapt to changing defocus blur and visual requirements throughout the operation. In the experiments, visuomotor policies were trained on 60 human demonstrations and evaluated under five setups with varying difficulties. Our MicroHookACT framework achieved the highest overall success rate of 96.7\% with an average execution time of 11.5 s. These results demonstrate the potential of visuomotor policy learning for micron-level control under varying operating conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MicroHookACT，一种基于模仿学习的视觉运动策略，用于单目显微视觉下的自动化 3D 针环钩取。
AI.motivation: 自动针环钩取是柔性微电极植入的关键步骤，但显微视觉下实现无触诊精确对准与接触式穿线仍具挑战，且需适应散焦模糊和不同操作条件。
AI.method: 采用单向钩取策略，利用散焦线索和光轴引导实现精确对准与接触式穿线；构建基于冻结 ViT 主干的动作监督对象注意力模块，从人类演示中直接学习关注针尖和微环，无需人工视觉标注；将注意力为中心的全局粗特征与局部细特征按预测动作进度动态加权，使单一 ACT 策略适应操作过程中的散焦模糊和视觉需求变化。使用 60 个人类演示训练，并在五种不同难度设置下评估。
AI.result: MicroHookACT 取得了最高 96.7% 的总体成功率，平均执行时间为 11.5 秒。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，视觉运动策略学习在不同操作条件下实现微米级控制具有潜力。

title: What Should We Ask Next? Retrieval-Aware Question Learning under Partial Evidence
summary: Interactive retrieval under partial evidence is a sequential information-acquisition problem: an agent must decide which question will create the most useful evidence for the next retrieval update. Existing systems train this decision by imitating an offline ordering of candidate QA pairs, although question value is determined by the response it elicits and its downstream effect on retrieval. We establish that candidate discriminativeness and perceived usefulness provide weak supervision for this objective, then introduce RAVEL, a retrieval-aware online reinforcement learning framework for interactive person re-identification. RAVEL initializes from supervised question generation, observes the current Top-4 candidates directly, and optimizes the question policy with rank feedback from the full question-answer-retrieval loop. Experiments on Interactive-PEDES show that RAVEL delivers progressively stronger retrieval performance across five interaction rounds. Further analysis shows that RAVEL reallocates the questioning budget toward localized open-ended attributes, which provide more useful retrieval evidence and yield the largest gains on initially difficult queries.

AI.tldr: 本文研究部分证据下的交互式检索，提出检索感知的在线强化学习框架RAVEL，用于交互式行人重识别，通过完整问答-检索循环的排序反馈优化提问策略。
AI.motivation: 现有系统多通过模仿离线候选QA对排序来训练提问决策，但问题的价值实际取决于其引发的回答以及对后续检索的下游影响，离线模仿监督不足。
AI.method: RAVEL从监督式问题生成初始化，直接观察当前Top-4候选，并利用完整问答-检索循环产生的排序反馈，以在线强化学习优化问题策略。
AI.result: 在Interactive-PEDES上，RAVEL在五轮交互中逐步提升检索性能；分析表明其将提问预算重新分配到局部化开放式属性，提供更有用的检索证据，并在初始困难查询上取得最大增益。
AI.conclusion: 候选区分度和感知有用性只是弱监督，检索感知的在线强化学习能更有效决定提问，从而持续改善交互式检索，尤其有利于困难查询。

title: MIRAGE: Multi-Perspective Creative Language Model Reasoning with Reinforcement Learning Guidance
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the ICML 2025 Workshop on Multi-Agent Systems in the Era of Foundation Models: Opportunities, Challenges and Futures (MAS-2025)
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized artificial intelligence and how human interact with AIs. Despite impressive advancements, LLMs struggle with complex mathematical, scientific, and logical tasks. Inspired by human cognitive flexibility - our ability to dynamically switch mental perspectives - we propose MIRAGE (Multi-perspective Inference-time Reasoning via Agent-Guided Exploration), a novel inference-time creative thinking framework. MIRAGE includes a Selector that prioritizes effective conceptual perspectives (e.g., algebraic, probabilistic) and a Reasoner that sequentially solves tasks until a confident solution emerges, otherwise aggregating multiple perspectives. Tested on GSM8K, MATH500, MMLU-Pro, and Game-of-24 benchmarks, MIRAGE consistently outperforms methods like Chain-of-Thought and diverse prompting ensembles, significantly boosting accuracy with minimal inference overhead, providing a scalable solution for practical applications.

AI.tldr: 提出MIRAGE框架，通过多视角推理提升大语言模型在复杂任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在数学、科学和逻辑任务上表现不佳，受人类认知灵活性启发。
AI.method: MIRAGE包含选择器（优先有效概念视角）和推理器（顺序求解直至自信，否则聚合多视角）。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、MATH500、MMLU-Pro和Game-of-24基准上，MIRAGE持续优于思维链和多样提示集成方法，显著提升准确率且推理开销极小。
AI.conclusion: MIRAGE为实际应用提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: Talking Past the Machine: Morality, Politeness, and Alignment in Human-AI Dialogue
comment: Accepted at the 60th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (HICSS-60)
summary: Conversational AI systems produce fluent, socially appropriate responses, yet whether they participate in cooperative communication or merely simulate its surface forms remains unclear - a question central to how these systems are evaluated, trusted, and designed. This study investigates how morality, politeness, and alignment - three dimensions central to cooperative dialogue - function in human-AI interaction compared to human-human conversation. We analyze 15,881 human-ChatGPT and 10,784 human-human multi-turn dialogues, using mixed-effects models to identify which features predict turn-to-turn alignment. We observe a consistent dissociation: AI produces the surface features of cooperative communication without the underlying social architecture. Moral output appears preconfigured rather than negotiated; warmth is generated without face sensitivity; linguistic convergence declines persistently. Most strikingly, the cooperative mechanisms themselves reverse direction: hedging and softening associated with greater accommodation between humans are associated with reduced alignment when produced by AI, and purity framing associated with human divergence coincides with users converging toward the AI. Agency - giving users room to shape the exchange - is the most consistent predictor of alignment across both interaction types, while lower moral assertiveness in more recent models is not accompanied by better cooperation. Together these patterns suggest that AI reproduces the surface of cooperation without the mutual adaptation that grounds it between humans - and, more surprisingly, that mechanisms sustaining human accommodation can run in reverse with AI, suggesting a turn-level view may be insufficient for interaction-level success.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析人类-ChatGPT与人类-人类多轮对话，发现AI虽能产生合作交流的表面特征，但缺乏深层社会架构，且部分合作机制在AI交互中反向作用，表明需从交互层面而非仅轮次层面评估合作。
AI.motivation: 探究对话AI是真正参与合作交流还是仅模拟其表面形式，这对AI系统的评估、信任和设计至关重要。研究聚焦道德、礼貌和对齐三个合作对话的核心维度，比较人机交互与人际对话的差异。
AI.method: 分析15,881段人类-ChatGPT对话和10,784段人类-人类多轮对话，使用混合效应模型识别预测轮次间对齐的特征。
AI.result: 发现一致分离：AI产生合作交流的表面特征而无深层社会架构。道德输出预先配置而非协商；温暖无面子敏感性；语言趋同持续下降。合作机制反向：人际中促进顺应的模糊/缓和语在AI中降低对齐；人际分歧的纯洁框架在AI中令用户趋同。给予用户塑造空间的能动性是人机与人际中对齐的最一致预测因子；近期模型道德断言降低但未带来更好合作。
AI.conclusion: AI复现了合作的表面，却缺乏人际合作赖以形成的相互适应。更意外的是，维系人类顺应的机制在AI交互中可能反向运行，表明仅从轮次层面视角不足以确保交互层面的成功。

title: ProTracer: Proprioception-Guided Failure Diagnosis in Robot Manipulation
summary: This paper presents a comprehensive framework for robot manipulation failure analysis that includes binary failure detection, failure categorization, explanation generation, and the additional capability of failure onset localization, which aims to identify the earliest moment at which a robot execution deviates from a valid task-completion trajectory and is ultimately followed by task failure. To address these tasks, we propose ProTracer, a training-free framework that leverages existing Vision-Language Models (VLMs) together with proprioceptive signals for failure analysis. Our method uses proprioceptive dynamics to identify temporally informative action boundaries and converts richer robot-state signals into structured natural-language descriptions that can be jointly analyzed together with visual observations by the VLM. This design combines the temporal precision of proprioceptive signals with the multimodal reasoning capabilities of modern VLMs without requiring additional model training. We further introduce FailTime, a benchmark with synchronized visual and proprioceptive observations for evaluating conventional failure diagnosis tasks as well as failure onset localization. Experiments demonstrate that ProTracer achieves strong performance across both conventional failure diagnosis tasks and the newly introduced failure onset localization task, highlighting the importance of proprioceptive reasoning for fine-grained temporal failure analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出机器人操作失败分析综合框架，涵盖二值失败检测、失败分类、解释生成，以及新增的失败起始定位任务；并给出免训练方法ProTracer与基准FailTime。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作失败分析通常缺乏细粒度时间定位，且现有方法多需额外训练；作者希望结合本体感知的时间精度与视觉语言模型的多模态推理能力，实现无需训练的失败诊断。
AI.method: 提出ProTracer：利用现有VLM和机器人本体感知信号，通过本体动力学识别具有时间信息的动作边界，并将机器人状态转为结构化自然语言描述，与视觉观察共同输入VLM进行分析；同时构建FailTime基准，同步采集视觉与本体感知数据以评估传统失败诊断和失败起始定位。
AI.result: ProTracer在传统失败诊断任务和新增的失败起始定位任务上均取得较强性能，表明本体感知推理对细粒度时间失败分析很重要。
AI.conclusion: 结合本体感知与VLM可在无需额外训练的情况下有效完成多类机器人操作失败分析，并推动失败起始定位这一新任务的发展。

title: Benchmarking Gender Bias in Machine Translation Evaluation Metrics across Occupations
comment: Accepted for publication at the 11th Conference of Machine Translation (WMT26), co-located with EMNLP 2026
summary: Gender bias remains a persistent concern in machine translation (MT), affecting both generated translations and their automatic evaluation. When a source text leaves a person's gender unspecified, translations may realize that person using masculine or feminine forms, and both MT systems and evaluation metrics may exhibit systematic preferences between these alternatives despite the source providing no basis for such a distinction. We study this behavior in the WMT 2026 Automated Translation Quality Evaluation Systems Shared Task using an occupation-balanced subset of GAMBIT+. We consider seven English-source language pairs, six from the original dataset, targeting Arabic, Czech, Greek, Icelandic, Russian, and Ukrainian, and extend the original resource with German. The subset contains 1,308 masculine/feminine translation pairs per target language, with three examples for each of the 436 ISCO-08 occupational groups. We evaluate shared-task submissions and baselines for score prediction and error annotation, examining the direction, magnitude, and frequency of gender-related differences. We find an overall tendency for masculine translations to receive higher scores, as well as differences per occupation following stereotypical gender representations, although the strength and consistency of this preference vary considerably across evaluators and languages. Our results show that gender bias remains present in MT evaluation, but that capturing its extent requires looking beyond a single aggregate measure to complementary dimensions of evaluator behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文研究机器翻译评估中的性别偏见，使用基于GAMBIT+的职业平衡子集，在WMT 2026自动翻译质量评估系统共享任务中评估七种英语源语言对，发现男性化翻译总体得分更高，且不同职业的差异符合性别刻板印象，但偏好强度和一致性因评估者和语言而异。
AI.motivation: 机器翻译中的性别偏见持续存在，影响生成的翻译及其自动评估。当源文本未指定人物性别时，翻译可能使用男性或女性形式，而翻译系统和评估指标可能在没有依据的情况下表现出系统性偏好。
AI.method: 在WMT 2026自动翻译质量评估系统共享任务中，使用基于GAMBIT+的职业平衡子集进行研究。涵盖七个英语源语言对（阿拉伯语、捷克语、希腊语、冰岛语、俄语、乌克兰语，并新增德语）。每个目标语言包含1,308对男/女翻译，覆盖436个ISCO-08职业组，每组三个示例。评估共享任务提交和基线在分数预测与错误标注上的表现，考察性别相关差异的方向、幅度和频率。
AI.result: 总体上，男性化翻译倾向于获得更高分数，且不同职业的差异符合性别刻板印象，但这种偏好的强度和一致性因评估者和语言而有很大差异。
AI.conclusion: 性别偏见在机器翻译评估中依然存在，但捕捉其程度需要超越单一聚合指标，关注评估者行为的多个互补维度。

title: From Retrieval to Recognition:How Vision--Language Models Become OCR Specialists
summary: Does a general vision--language model acquire specialized OCR ability by developing a new reading circuit or by reusing an existing mechanism? We address this question in the setting of full-sequence OCR, rather than local-answer retrieval. Using an evidence-grounded protocol with held-out causal interventions, we identify sparse and stable OCR-head sets in GLM-OCR, MinerU2.5, and PaddleOCR-VL-1.6. We then investigate the mechanistic origin of these OCR heads by comparing them with independently identified textual retrieval/copy heads in general VLMs. Across two general VLMs, visual OCR heads strongly overlap independently identified textual retrieval/copy heads, yielding untuned top-20 intersections of 73.3% and all-head Spearman correlations of 0.677-0.886. The overlap and causal interventions suggest that full-sequence OCR operates as dense sequential multimodal copy-and-paste, repeatedly retrieving visual evidence and routing it to the current output position. Finally, we examine how this shared circuit changes as a general VLM becomes an OCR specialist. Matched base-to-specialized comparisons show that OCR specialization largely preserves head identity, retaining 17-20 of the top 20 heads per task with all-head rank correlations of 0.874-0.942, while redistributing their functional and causal strengths.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究通用视觉语言模型获得专门OCR能力时，是形成新阅读回路还是复用已有机制。结果表明，全序列OCR主要复用并重塑通用的文本检索/复制回路，表现为密集的序列化多模态复制粘贴。
AI.motivation: 已有研究多关注局部答案检索，尚不清楚通用VLM的OCR能力是来自全新专用电路，还是复用通用文本检索/复制机制。
AI.method: 在全序列OCR设定下，采用基于证据且带留出因果干预的协议，识别GLM-OCR、MinerU2.5和PaddleOCR-VL-1.6中的稀疏稳定OCR头；并与通用VLM中独立识别的文本检索/复制头进行比较。还进行基座到专用模型的匹配比较。
AI.result: 在两个通用VLM中，视觉OCR头与文本检索/复制头高度重叠，未调优的top-20交集达73.3%，全头Spearman相关为0.677-0.886；OCR专用化后，每个任务top-20头中保留17-20个，全头秩相关为0.874-0.942，但功能与因果强度被重新分配。
AI.conclusion: 全序列OCR可理解为密集的序列化多模态复制粘贴：反复检索视觉证据并路由到当前输出位置。通用VLM转向OCR专家时，主要保留原有头身份而非重建新阅读电路，同时重新分配其功能与因果强度。

title: Learning Cardiac Features: ECG Biometrics Across Time and~Exercise
summary: Electrocardiograms (ECGs) carry subject-specific patterns enabling reliable individual discrimination, forming the basis of ECG biometrics. Beyond authentication, this paradigm holds significant potential to secure sensitive cardiac data and to serve as a pretext task in self-supervised learning. Yet, most studies remain confined to singlesession, resting data, leaving robustness to temporal and physiological variations largely untested. We address this gap by evaluating ECG biometrics under realistic conditions involving exercise-induced stress and cross-session variability. A Siamese ResNet with late multi-lead fusion strategy is trained on a large ECG dataset extracted from cardiopulmonary exercise tests and evaluated with a exercise-and time-aware protocol, as well as on public benchmarks. This first extensive assessment of ECG biometrics under combined physiological and temporal variability achieves an intra-session rest-to-peak EER of 1.7% and stateof-the-art 3.9% on the CYBHi dataset. Findings support the presence of an intrinsic cardiac signature resilient to physiological and temporal drift.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了在运动诱发生理压力和跨会话变化条件下，基于心电图的生物特征识别方法的鲁棒性，并在多个数据集上取得了领先或较低的错误率。
AI.motivation: 现有心电图生物特征识别研究多局限于单次会话、静息状态数据，尚未充分验证其在时间变化和生理变化下的鲁棒性；同时该范式在保护敏感心脏数据和自监督学习预训练任务方面具有潜力。
AI.method: 使用来自心肺运动试验的大型心电图数据集训练一个采用后期多导联融合策略的孪生ResNet，并设计结合运动与时间因素的评估协议，同时在公开基准数据集上进行评测。
AI.result: 在生理与时间变化联合条件下进行了首次广泛评估，取得会话内静息到峰值状态的EER为1.7%，在CYBHi数据集上取得当前最优的3.9%。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持存在一种对生理和时间漂移具有鲁棒性的内在心脏特征签名，表明心电图生物特征识别在现实变化条件下具有可行性。

title: MarineCraft: Enabling Rapid Prototyping of Underwater Robots via Modular Construction
summary: Underwater robot development is often hindered by the complexities of waterproofing and wiring, which significantly delay the rapid prototyping process. This paper presents MarineCraft, a modular toolkit designed to accelerate the development cycle through structural reconfiguration. The system features self-contained, waterproof propulsion modules that integrate power, wireless communication, and actuation. By eliminating centralized wiring and the need for repeated sealing, MarineCraft allows diverse robot geometries to be assembled and tested in minutes rather than days. Experimental results demonstrate that this reconfigurable architecture enables fast, iterative design cycles while maintaining reliable operation and leak-free performance at depths of up to 2.5 meters. Our toolkit effectively lowers the barrier to underwater robotics by transforming modularity into a vehicle for rapid physical prototyping.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MarineCraft模块化工具包，通过自包含防水推进模块和结构重构，加速水下机器人的快速原型开发。
AI.motivation: 水下机器人开发常受防水和布线复杂性的阻碍，导致快速原型制作周期显著延长。
AI.method: 设计集成了电源、无线通信和驱动功能的独立防水推进模块，消除集中布线和重复密封需求，支持在数分钟内组装并测试不同几何构型的水下机器人。
AI.result: 实验表明，该可重构架构支持快速迭代设计，并在最深2.5米处保持可靠运行和无泄漏性能。
AI.conclusion: MarineCraft工具包通过将模块化转化为快速物理原型的手段，有效降低了水下机器人研发的门槛。

title: AutoViewMem: Self-Configuring Orthogonal Views for Conversational Long-Term Memory
summary: Long-term memory is essential for large language model (LLM) agents to maintain consistency and personalization over extended interactions. Existing memory systems typically rely on fixed granularities or static schemas, but these designs struggle when heterogeneous information, such as preferences, events, constraints, and temporal updates, is embedded in a single mixed representation. The resulting semantic interference makes top-K retrieval sensitive to noise and often leaves relevant evidence poorly ranked. We present AutoViewMem, a data-driven framework that organizes long-term conversational memory into self-configuring, low-overlap semantic views before indexing. AutoViewMem discovers candidate views from interaction traces, selects a compact complementary view set, and uses these views to guide write-time structured extraction of provenance-grounded memories. This representation-first design moves semantic disentanglement from retrieval time to write time, allowing standard top-K similarity search to retrieve focused evidence without explicit routing or iterative retrieval. We further apply offline consolidation to improve memory compactness and consistency. Experiments on the LoCoMo and PersonaMem benchmarks, under both Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B backbones, show that AutoViewMem improves long-horizon question answering and personalization over strong memory baselines while preserving a simple inference pipeline.

AI.tldr: 提出AutoViewMem，一种数据驱动框架，将长期对话记忆组织为自配置、低重叠的语义视图，在写入时进行结构化提取，从而提升LLM代理的长程问答与个性化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆系统依赖固定粒度或静态模式，难以处理混合表示中的异构信息（偏好、事件、约束、时间更新），导致语义干扰，使top-K检索对噪声敏感且相关证据排名靠后。
AI.method: AutoViewMem从交互轨迹中发现候选视图，选择紧凑互补视图集，指导写入时结构化提取基于来源的记忆；将语义解耦从检索时移到写入时，支持标准top-K相似检索；并应用离线整合提升记忆紧凑性与一致性。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和PersonaMem基准上，使用Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-14B主干，AutoViewMem在长程问答和个性化上优于强记忆基线，同时保持简单推理流程。
AI.conclusion: 表示优先的设计能有效提升长程问答与个性化，且无需复杂检索路由或迭代检索。

title: Evaluating In-Context Learning and Retrieval Strategies for Devanagari Post-OCR Correction
summary: In-context learning using Large Language Models (LLMs) offers a compelling path to training-free post-OCR correction, yet its effectiveness for Devanagari script remains entirely unexplored. We present the first systematic evaluation of LLMs (3B-32B) for post-OCR correction in Hindi and Marathi, comparing three in-context example retrieval strategies: domain-random selection, dense semantic retrieval, and our proposed CharBM25, which retrieves examples by character n-gram BM25 similarity over OCR inputs to target shared error patterns with the test sentence. Across a 20,000-sentence benchmark spanning five news domains, retrieval strategy is the decisive factor in correction quality: CharBM25 outperforms domain-random selection by 2.8-4.0pp absolute WER on Hindi and 2.9-3.8pp on Marathi, using character trigrams, which consistently outperform bigrams and unigrams. Scale dominates performance: Gemma-3-27B achieves WER reductions of 55.0% for Hindi and 33.3% for Marathi under CharBM25-5. Few-shot gains are capacity-gated: models below 8B do not reliably improve over the OCR baseline, and on Marathi the smallest models (3B) degrade more sentences than they improve. Marathi is persistently harder to correct than Hindi across all scales, reflecting its greater morphological complexity. These findings establish CharBM25 as an effective, GPU-free retrieval strategy that matches or exceeds dense retrieval at negligible computational cost, and show that combining it with a general-purpose LLM of 12B+ parameters delivers reliable, training-free Devanagari post-OCR correction without task-specific fine-tuning. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/AbhishekBhandari/Devanagari-OCR-ICL-Benchmark

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评估了3B至32B大语言模型在印地语和马拉地语OCR后校正中的上下文学习能力，并提出基于字符n-gram BM25的示例检索策略CharBM25。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型的上下文学习有望实现无需训练的OCR后校正，但其在天城文（Devanagari）脚本中的有效性尚未被探索。
AI.method: 构建涵盖五个新闻领域、2万句的基准，比较三种上下文示例检索策略：领域随机选择、稠密语义检索，以及提出的CharBM25。CharBM25根据OCR输入与测试句子的字符n-gram BM25相似度检索示例，以匹配共享错误模式。评估3B至32B参数的大语言模型，并分析检索策略、模型规模、n-gram类型及语言差异的影响。
AI.result: 检索策略是校正质量的决定性因素：CharBM25在印地语上比领域随机选择绝对WER低2.8至4.0个百分点，在马拉地语上低2.9至3.8个百分点；字符三元组始终优于二元组和一元组。规模主导性能：Gemma-3-27B在CharBM25-5下印地语WER降低55.0%，马拉地语降低33.3%。少样本增益受模型容量限制：低于8B的模型无法稳定优于OCR基线，马拉地语上3B模型甚至使更多句子变差。马拉地语在所有规模下都比印地语更难校正，反映其更高的形态复杂性。CharBM25无需GPU且计算成本可忽略，性能匹配或超过稠密检索。
AI.conclusion: CharBM25是一种有效、无GPU的检索策略，与12B以上通用大语言模型结合，可在无需任务特定微调的情况下实现可靠的天城文OCR后校正。数据集已公开：https://huggingface.co/datasets/AbhishekBhandari/Devanagari-OCR-ICL-Benchmark。

title: GestureFAR: Streaming Co-Speech Gesture Generation with Flow Autoregression
summary: Generating natural co-speech gestures from streaming speech is essential for embodied conversational agents, where motion must be produced while a user is still speaking. Recent streaming gesture systems make online generation possible by autoregressing over discrete motion tokens, but this design compresses high-dimensional continuous motion into finite codebooks and can limit the realism and diversity of generated gestures. To preserve both causality and continuous expressiveness, we propose \textbf{GestureFAR}, a flow-autoregressive framework for streaming co-speech gesture generation. First, GestureFAR autoregresses over causal continuous motion latents, using a transformer to model streaming audio-motion context and a per-token flow-matching head to sample the next latent from a continuous distribution. Second, we introduce a head-only flow distillation strategy that freezes the causal backbone and distills the multi-step per-token flow head into a single network evaluation using consistency and distribution-matching objectives. This keeps the model token-causal while removing the main latency bottleneck for live interaction. Experiments on BEAT2 show that GestureFAR significantly improves the quality--latency trade-off among streaming-capable methods, preserving strong gesture quality while enabling real-time token-causal generation. Project Page: https://andypinxinliu.github.io/GestureFAR

AI.tldr: 提出 GestureFAR，一种面向流式共语手势生成的流自回归框架：在因果连续运动潜变量上自回归，并用逐 token 流匹配头采样，再通过 head-only 流蒸馏实现实时生成。
AI.motivation: 现有流式手势系统多依赖离散运动 token 自回归，虽能在线生成，但将高维连续运动压缩到有限码本，限制生成手势的真实性与多样性；因此需要同时保持因果性和连续表达力。
AI.method: 1）在因果连续运动潜变量上自回归，用 transformer 建模流式音频-运动上下文，并用逐 token 流匹配头从连续分布采样下一潜变量；2）提出 head-only 流蒸馏策略，冻结因果主干，将多步逐 token 流头蒸馏为单次网络评估，使用一致性目标与分布匹配目标，保持 token 因果性并消除实时交互的主要延迟瓶颈。
AI.result: 在 BEAT2 数据集上，GestureFAR 在支持流式生成的方法中显著改善质量-延迟权衡，在保持较强手势质量的同时实现实时 token 因果生成。
AI.conclusion: GestureFAR 通过连续潜变量自回归与流蒸馏，兼顾流式手势生成的因果性与连续表达力，并实现实时生成，有利于具身对话代理中的在线共语手势合成。

title: Stabilizing Trajectory Outputs in End-to-End Autonomous Driving via SC-IMM Based Teacher Signals
summary: End-to-End autonomous driving models commonly predict future waypoints from sensor inputs and convert them into vehicle control commands through a downstream controller. However, conventional waypoint-based imitation learning mainly minimizes coordinate-level errors, making it difficult to capture scene-dependent path-speed changes and temporal instability across waypoint outputs. In this paper, we propose an offline teacher-signal generation and learning method for trajectory-output stabilization based on a Scene-Conditioned Interacting Multiple Model (SC-IMM) to mitigate this issue. The proposed method converts expert trajectories into path-speed states and performs IMM updates conditioned on scene cues to generate path-speed teacher labels and mode posterior probabilities. The generated signals are added to the original trajectory loss as auxiliary supervision during training, while the inference structure and waypoint controller remain unchanged. In closed-loop evaluation on 100 short routes in CARLA Town12, the proposed method improved the driving score by 28.0% and reduced Collision/km by 62.3% compared with the baseline, while also improving jerk and trajectory-variation metrics. These results demonstrate that offline teacher signals embedding scene-conditioned motion-model cues can guide trajectory-output driving models toward more stable closed-loop behavior.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于场景条件交互多模型（SC-IMM）的离线教师信号生成与学习方法，用于稳定端到端自动驾驶模型的轨迹输出，并在CARLA闭环评测中显著提升驾驶性能。
AI.motivation: 传统基于航点的模仿学习主要最小化坐标级误差，难以捕捉依赖场景的路径-速度变化以及航点输出中的时间不稳定性，导致闭环表现不佳。
AI.method: 将专家轨迹转换为路径-速度状态，并基于场景线索进行IMM更新，生成路径-速度教师标签和模式后验概率；训练时将这些信号作为辅助监督加入原始轨迹损失，推理结构和航点控制器保持不变。
AI.result: 在CARLA Town12的100条短路线闭环评测中，相比基线驾驶得分提升28.0%，Collision/km降低62.3%，同时改善了jerk和轨迹变化指标。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入场景条件运动模型线索的离线教师信号能够引导轨迹输出型驾驶模型获得更稳定的闭环行为。

title: AVT-Fabric: Active Visuo-Tactile Perception via Adaptive Evidence Selection for Efficient Robotic Fabric Comparison
summary: Robotic fabric comparison needs to actively combine visual appearance and tactile cues. Here, we present AVT-Fabric, an RGB-first framework that allocates tactile evidence according to the difficulty of each comparison. A dual-scale gate evaluates answer-token confidence and raw logit separation to determine whether another force-tagged GelSight observation is needed. Compact textual memory preserves the executed history, and majority voting consolidates the selected predictions. On 400 held-out comparisons, AVT-Fabric achieves 98.0% accuracy with a compact 7B Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM), surpassing the 94.0% reported by the 90B MLLM-Fabric baseline by 4.0 percentage points while processing only 1.60 of five available stages on average. It improves on matched passive inference by 9.25 percentage points and reduces model-side latency by 61.8%, while also improving on RGB-only accuracy. Four additional MLLM backbones support the generalizability, accuracy, and efficiency of the framework. This framework is also deployed on a real robotic system, achieving 78.1% pairwise ranking accuracy and correct fabric selection in seven of eight application scenarios. AVT-Fabric demonstrates that adaptive evidence selection can improve both the accuracy and efficiency of robotic visuo-tactile reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出AVT-Fabric，一个RGB优先的机器人织物比较框架，根据比较难度自适应决定是否补充触觉证据，以提升视触觉推理的准确率与效率。
AI.motivation: 机器人织物比较需要结合视觉外观和触觉线索，但固定或被动融合多模态信息可能低效且难以兼顾准确率与计算成本，因此需要按需选择触觉证据。
AI.method: 采用RGB优先策略；通过双尺度门控评估答案token置信度和原始logit分离度，决定是否再获取带力标记的GelSight触觉观测；用紧凑文本记忆保存执行历史，并通过多数投票整合预测；在7B MLLM上实现，并部署到真实机器人系统。
AI.result: 在400个留出比较上，AVT-Fabric以7B MLLM达到98.0%准确率，超过90B MLLM-Fabric基线的94.0%达4.0个百分点，平均仅处理5个阶段中的1.60个；相比匹配的被动推理提升9.25个百分点，模型侧延迟降低61.8%，并优于仅RGB方法。四个额外MLLM骨干支持其泛化性、准确性和效率。真机部署达到78.1%成对排序准确率，并在8个应用场景中7个正确选择织物。
AI.conclusion: 自适应证据选择能够同时提升机器人视触觉推理的准确率和效率，表明按难度动态补充触觉信息是有效方向。

title: A Lie Detector Test for Language Models: Reading Knowledge a Model Won't Reveal
summary: Large language models can hold knowledge they do not report. A model may sandbag on a capability evaluation, or answer against what it internally knows, and its outputs alone cannot tell whether it is hiding an answer or simply does not have one. We borrow the Concealed Information Test, a forensic method that identifies guilty knowledge by presenting a suspect with the true detail among plausible decoys and measuring a stronger response to the item they recognize. Our method, Probe of Internal Recognition (PIR), does the same inside a model. It presents a question with its candidate answers and reads, from the model's internal states, which candidate the model recognizes as correct. PIR is reference-free, needing no honest reference model and no labeled truth corpus. Across eight models from five families (Gemma, Qwen, Llama, Mistral, and Phi), PIR recovers the recognized answer at 0.70 to 0.87 balanced accuracy, well above the 0.28 to 0.40 unknown-item baseline and the 0.25 chance rate. It stays readable across every form of concealment we test, from prompted deception and trained sandbagging to external password-locked and circuit-broken checkpoints, with recognition between 0.85 and 0.93. When the model hides a known answer, recognition stays high. When unlearning removes the knowledge, recognition drops to the level of a question the model never knew. PIR therefore separates a model that will not answer from one that cannot, which supports sandbagging audits and unlearning verification. The signal is causal, adds information beyond black-box behavioral cues, and extends from multiple-choice questions to free-form generation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Probe of Internal Recognition（PIR），借鉴犯罪心理学的隐藏信息测试，从模型内部状态判断其是否识别出正确答案，从而区分模型“不愿回答”和“不能回答”。
AI.motivation: 大模型可能隐藏已知知识，例如在能力评估中故意放水或给出与内部知识相悖的答案；仅凭输出无法判断模型是隐藏答案还是根本不知道。
AI.method: PIR 将问题与候选答案一并呈现，读取模型内部表征，判断哪个候选被模型识别为正确。该方法无需参考模型、无需标注真值语料，可跨模型使用。
AI.result: 在 Gemma、Qwen、Llama、Mistral、Phi 五个家族八个模型上，PIR 以 0.70–0.87 的平衡准确率恢复被识别答案，远高于未知项基线 0.28–0.40 和随机水平 0.25。在提示欺骗、训练沙袋、密码锁定和电路破坏等隐藏形式下，识别率仍为 0.85–0.93；知识被遗忘删除后则降至未知问题水平。
AI.conclusion: PIR 能区分模型“不愿回答”与“不能回答”，支持沙袋行为审计和遗忘验证。该信号具有因果性，提供黑盒行为线索之外的信息，并可从多选题扩展到自由生成。

title: Steering LLMs Responses Towards Moral Foundations on the Norwegian MFQ-30
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Awarded best Paper Award at WNNLP 2026 (University of Oslo). Proceedings: https://www.uio.no/studier/emner/matnat/ifi/IN5550/v26/final-exam/wnnlp2026_proceedings.pdf
summary: Recent work applies human psychometric questionnaires to large language models to elicit moral and value profiles, but it is not clear whether these instruments measure anything stable in models or whether the resulting profiles can be moved toward a target human population. We administer the Norwegian Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ-30) to six open-weight LLMs and compare their foundation profiles to a sample of N = 1,282 Norwegian respondents. We test two steering interventions, prompt-level persona steering and activation-level ActAdd. Half the models engage with the questionnaire under our attention check. The other half default to flat or central-tendency outputs that look near-human on average without tracking item content. A neutral Nordic-respondent persona, written without any distributional information from the human sample, brings the engaging models 44-77% closer to the Norwegian mean in Mahalanobis $d^2$. One-pair ActAdd at a fixed mid-layer flattens the foundation profile rather than steering individual foundations. For at least one model the same persona that shifts the profile also induces engagement that was absent at baseline, a concrete instance of the cognitive phantoms that Peereboom et al. (2025) warn about.

AI.tldr: 研究将挪威道德基础问卷 MFQ-30 施测于六个开源大模型，并与1282名挪威受访者比较，测试提示级人格引导与激活级 ActAdd 能否使模型价值画像接近目标人类群体。
AI.motivation: 近期研究用人类心理测量问卷评估大语言模型的道德与价值画像，但这些工具是否测量模型中的稳定特质、以及模型画像能否被引导至目标人群，尚不明确。
AI.method: 对六个开源权重 LLM 施测挪威版 MFQ-30，并与 N=1,282 挪威受访者样本对比；采用两种干预：提示级 persona steering 和激活级 ActAdd。
AI.result: 一半模型通过注意力检查并认真作答；另一半给出平坦或中心趋势输出，平均看似接近人类但不追踪题项内容。中性“北欧受访者”人格提示（未使用人类样本分布信息）使认真作答模型在 Mahalanobis d² 上接近挪威均值的程度提高44–77%。固定中层单对 ActAdd 会压平道德基础画像，而非引导单个基础。至少一个模型中，同一人格提示既改变画像，也诱导出基线不存在的作答参与。
AI.conclusion: 部分大模型可对问卷产生稳定且可被人格提示引导的道德基础画像，但另一些模型只是产生伪近似人类的平坦输出；ActAdd 未实现精细引导，且存在类似“认知幻影”的现象，即引导同时诱发新的作答行为。

title: Learned Parametric Emotion Editing: Real-Time Affective Filtering for On-Device Social Media Video
summary: Problematic internet use affects a growing share of the population, yet common interventions, e.g., time limits, blocking, forced breaks, are coercive and easily circumvented. We explore a less restrictive alternative: adapting the emotional intensity of visual content. Prior work has shown that optimization can steer an image's affective content, but its per-image optimization cost makes it impractical for real-time deployment. We instead learn a model that predicts this transformation in a single forward pass: a MobileNetV4 backbone with FiLM-based emotion conditioning outputs parameters for differentiable global transformations. This replaces prior iterative optimization (80 s per image) with a single 3.7 ms forward pass. In a user study (N = 54), the model reduced viewer-reported arousal relative to unedited images, comparably to the grayscale well-being filter, while being rated higher in perceived quality. We integrate the model into an Android app that adapts Instagram video in real time, sustaining 60 fps on a Samsung Galaxy S23.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种通过调节视觉内容情感强度来干预问题性互联网使用的方法，并开发了可实时部署的轻量模型及安卓应用。
AI.motivation: 常见干预措施（如时间限制、屏蔽、强制休息）具有强迫性且易被规避，因此需要一种更温和、非限制性的替代方案。
AI.method: 使用MobileNetV4骨干网络结合FiLM情感条件化，单次前向传播输出可微全局变换参数，以替代此前每张图像80秒的迭代优化；并开展用户研究（N=54）及开发安卓应用实时适配Instagram视频。
AI.result: 模型单次前向传播仅需3.7毫秒；相比未编辑图像，降低了观看者报告的情绪唤醒度，效果与灰度健康滤镜相当，但感知质量评分更高；在三星Galaxy S23上实现60fps实时处理。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习单次前向传播的图像情感调节模型，可实现高效、低侵入性的问题性互联网使用干预，并具备实时移动端部署能力。

title: CodeMidas: Scaling Agentic Coding RL Environments from Code Itself
summary: Training capable coding agents via reinforcement learning (RL) requires diverse tasks with reliable verifiers. Open-source codebases offer a rich source of such tasks, while existing methods typically rely on development artifacts such as issues and commits, limiting the range of tasks that can be extracted. To better scale RL environments, we present CodeMidas, an agentic pipeline that turns implemented functionality in existing codebases into executable RL environments using source code as its only task-specific input. CodeMidas allocates agentic compute to every stage of environment construction: agents explore implemented functionality to formulate behavioral specifications, construct tests grounded in execution of the original code, and validate and filter candidate tasks through execution checks and repeated solution rollouts. The resulting dataset has 5,545 training tasks from 3,185 open-source codebases spanning 23 programming languages and 15 technical domains. Training MiMo-V2.5 on these tasks with GRPO improves performance on all five diverse benchmarks, covering issue repair (DeepSWE + 11.7%), whole-program construction (ProgramBench +17%), and terminal work (Terminal-Bench v2.1 +8.5%). Ablations show that increasing the number of high-quality training tasks improves performance. Trajectory analysis shows the RL-trained agent demonstrates better behaviors like increasing codebase exploration and more diverse self-verification. These results establish source code as a scalable foundation for constructing RL environments that improve coding agents across diverse software tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 CodeMidas，一种仅以源代码为输入的智能体流水线，将已有代码库中已实现的功能转化为可执行的强化学习环境，构建了包含 5,545 个任务、覆盖 3,185 个代码库的数据集，训练后显著提升多种编码基准表现。
AI.motivation: 通过强化学习训练编码智能体需要大量带可靠验证器的多样化任务；现有方法多依赖 issue、commit 等开发工件，可提取任务范围受限，难以规模化构建 RL 环境。
AI.method: CodeMidas 以源代码为唯一任务特定输入，在各阶段分配智能体算力：探索已实现功能以生成行为规格，基于原始代码执行构建测试，并通过执行检查与多次解答 rollout 验证与筛选候选任务；随后用 GRPO 在生成任务上训练 MiMo-V2.5。
AI.result: 数据集含来自 3,185 个开源代码库的 5,545 个训练任务，覆盖 23 种编程语言和 15 个技术领域；训练后在五个基准上均提升：DeepSWE +11.7%、ProgramBench +17%、Terminal-Bench v2.1 +8.5%；消融显示高质量任务数量增加带来性能提升；轨迹分析表明智能体代码库探索更多、自验证更多样。
AI.conclusion: 源代码可作为构建 RL 环境的可扩展基础，所生成环境能提升编码智能体在多种软件任务上的表现。

title: A benchmark dataset and baseline methods for four-dimensional STEM diffraction patterns
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures. Data and trained model weights: https://doi.org/10.57760/sciencedb.nbsdc.00281. Code: https://github.com/Gaiya69-rgb/4D-ImageNet
summary: Four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) records a two-dimensional diffraction pattern at each electron-probe position, yielding spatially resolved reciprocal-space information but large, heterogeneous data volumes. Here we describe 4D-ImageNet, a collection of 174,000 diffraction patterns comprising 145,000 experimental patterns selected from 29 acquisitions and 29,000 multislice simulations. The experimental data cover acquisition-level labels for Ag, Au, mixed Au-Ag, CoO, Pd and ZnO specimens across multiple fields of view, scan dimensions, camera lengths and exposure times. Each acquisition contributes 5,000 quality-ranked patterns with source scan coordinates and acquisition metadata. A set-prediction detector provides model-derived pseudo-labels for the direct-beam position and Bragg-disk centres, with a confidence score for each disk. The simulation data cover 13 crystal structures and include Euler rotations, reciprocal-space sampling and approximate low-index beam directions. A grouped mixed-domain masked-reconstruction benchmark is provided to assess leakage-resistant loading and evaluation across experimental and simulated data. The dataset is intended for representation learning, disk detection, diffraction-pattern retrieval, orientation analysis and simulation-to-experiment studies.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了4D-ImageNet数据集，包含174,000个4D-STEM衍射图样，其中145,000个实验数据和29,000个多切片模拟数据，并提供伪标签与基准测试，用于表示学习、盘检测、检索和模拟到实验研究。
AI.motivation: 4D-STEM在每个电子探针位置记录二维衍射图，能提供空间分辨的倒空间信息，但数据量大且异质，缺少标准化数据集和可复现基准。
AI.method: 构建4D-ImageNet：从29次采集选取145,000个实验图样，覆盖Ag、Au、Au-Ag混合、CoO、Pd和ZnO等样品，包含视场、扫描尺寸、相机长度和曝光时间等元数据；每采集5,000个按质量排序图样，提供扫描坐标。另含29,000个多切片模拟图样，覆盖13种晶体结构，含Euler旋转、倒空间采样和近似低指数束方向。使用集合预测检测器生成直接束位置和Bragg盘中心伪标签及置信度。还提供分组混合域掩码重建基准，用于防泄漏加载和跨实验/模拟评估。
AI.result: 数据集共174,000个衍射图样，实验数据来自29次采集并带有采集级标签和元数据，模拟数据覆盖13种晶体结构。伪标签包括直接束位置、Bragg盘中心和逐盘置信度。基准支持实验与模拟数据间的混合域评估。
AI.conclusion: 4D-ImageNet面向表示学习、盘检测、衍射图样检索、取向分析以及模拟到实验研究，旨在为4D-STEM数据分析提供大规模、带标注和可基准测试的资源。

title: A Unified Dynamic Force Guidance Framework for Performance-Optimized Kinesthetic Teaching
summary: Collaborative robots are increasingly deployed in industrial scenarios characterized by frequent product changeovers. As an intuitive programming method, kinesthetic teaching facilitates rapid robot deployment. However, users may overlook the configuration of the robot during kinesthetic teaching, leading to degradation in operational performance. Operational performance refers to the capability of the robot to generate motion and can be quantified by the Minimum Singular Value of the Jacobian matrix. To address this issue, this paper proposes an online dynamic force guidance method that integrates performance constraint and optimization mechanisms. Specifically, variable admittance control maintains the operational performance of the robot above a predefined threshold, while a virtual force actively guides the user to drag the robot towards configurations with improved performance. Experiments are conducted on a 6-DOF collaborative robot, comparing three typical paths in the task space. To evaluate the quality of the taught trajectories, trajectory playback experiments are conducted to analyze the relationship between the operational performance of the robot and the work efficiency. The results demonstrate that the proposed method effectively enhances the operational performance of the robot and consequently improves the work efficiency, holding significant value for reducing production takt time in industrial deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种在线动态力引导方法，在拖动示教中通过可变导纳控制和虚拟力引导，将机器人操作性能维持在阈值以上并优化构型，从而提升示教轨迹质量与工作效率。
AI.motivation: 协作机器人常用于产品频繁切换的工业场景，拖动示教虽直观高效，但用户容易忽略机器人构型配置，导致操作性能下降，进而影响后续作业效率。
AI.method: 以雅可比矩阵最小奇异值量化操作性能，提出融合性能约束与优化机制的在线动态力引导方法：可变导纳控制确保操作性能不低于预设阈值，虚拟力主动引导用户将机器人拖向性能更优的构型。
AI.result: 在6自由度协作机器人上针对任务空间三条典型路径进行实验，并通过轨迹回放分析操作性能与工作效率的关系。结果表明，所提方法有效提升了机器人操作性能，并相应提高了工作效率。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有助于减少工业生产部署中的节拍时间，对协作机器人快速部署与效率优化具有重要价值。

title: Chinese Competitive Debating Dataset and Benchmark
summary: Debate adjudication requires tracking how arguments develop through interaction, yet existing datasets rarely combine fine-grained debate transcripts with professional judgments collected during real competitions under a shared rubric. We introduce a dataset and benchmark for evaluating large language models' understanding of competitive Chinese-language debate at the match, stage, and speaker levels. We organized 182 matches and recruited 120 professional judges, with each match independently adjudicated by three judges using a predefined rubric. After excluding matches with incomplete records, the dataset contains 148 matches, 2,698 stages, and 20,542 exchange units, with manually verified transcripts and segmentation. It preserves original stage scores, match votes, best-debater ballots, and adjudication rationales. We define three tasks: winner-tendency prediction, stage-score prediction, and best-debater prediction. Zero-shot evaluation of multiple large language models yields a highest winner-prediction accuracy of 66.2%, a highest Pearson correlation of 0.250 between model stage scores and mean human ratings, and a highest best-debater prediction accuracy of 56.8%. The dataset and benchmark provide a testbed for studying large language models' understanding of interactive argumentation and their agreement with professional judges.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个面向中文竞技辩论的细粒度数据集与基准，用于评估大语言模型在比赛、阶段和辩手层面的理解能力，并定义了胜负预测、阶段得分预测和最佳辩手预测三项任务。
AI.motivation: 辩论裁决需要追踪论点在互动中的发展，但现有数据集很少同时包含细粒度辩论转录文本与真实比赛中由专业评委依据统一评分标准给出的判断。
AI.method: 组织182场比赛，招募120名专业评委，每场由3名评委按预设评分标准独立裁决；剔除记录不完整比赛后，数据集包含148场比赛、2698个阶段、20542个交换单元，并保留人工校验的转录、阶段得分、比赛投票、最佳辩手投票和裁决理由。定义三项任务：获胜倾向预测、阶段得分预测、最佳辩手预测。对多个大语言模型进行零样本评估。
AI.result: 模型最高获胜预测准确率为66.2%，模型阶段得分与人类平均评分的最高Pearson相关系数为0.250，最高最佳辩手预测准确率为56.8%。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集和基准为研究大语言模型对互动式论证的理解及其与专业评委判断的一致程度提供了测试平台。

title: Analysing the Linearity of Linguistic Relations in Language Model Embedding Spaces
comment: 6 pages. Accepted at the Workshop on Scientific Methods for Understanding Deep Learning (Sci4DL) at ICLR 2026
summary: We propose a framework to analyse how strongly different linguistic relations are linearly encoded in language model embedding spaces. We formalise linear encoding via a constrained linear approximation over related and unrelated word pairs and apply this to an extended BATS dataset covering inflectional, derivational, lexicographic, and encyclopedic relations in GloVe, RoBERTa, and ModernBERT. Our experiments show near-perfect linear encodings for inflectional and derivational relations, but substantially higher errors for lexicographic and encyclopedic relations, especially for one-to-many and many-to-many associations. We also find that RoBERTa and ModernBERT generally encode relations more linearly than GloVe. These results indicate that our framework can reveal which relational structures are most linearly accessible in embeddings, offering a compact tool for probing and comparing relational geometry across models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个框架，用于分析不同语言关系在语言模型词嵌入空间中被线性编码的强度，并在扩展BATS数据集上比较GloVe、RoBERTa和ModernBERT。
AI.motivation: 研究不同语言关系在嵌入空间中是否以及如何被线性表示，并希望提供一种紧凑工具来探测和比较不同模型的关系几何结构。
AI.method: 通过一个受约束的线性近似方法，在相关词对和不相关词对上形式化线性编码；将该方法应用于扩展BATS数据集，覆盖屈折、派生、词典学和百科类关系，并测试GloVe、RoBERTa和ModernBERT。
AI.result: 实验显示，屈折和派生关系几乎能被完美线性编码；词典学和百科类关系的误差明显更高，尤其是一对多和多对多关联。RoBERTa和ModernBERT通常比GloVe更线性地编码这些关系。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能揭示哪些关系结构在嵌入中最容易线性访问，可作为探测和比较模型关系几何的紧凑工具。

title: HAT: Hypothesis-Anchored Tracking for Video Monocular Spacecraft Pose Estimation
summary: Monocular 6-DoF pose estimation of non-cooperative targets is important for on-orbit servicing and debris removal. A single-image estimator can confuse near-symmetric spacecraft orientations, and tracking can preserve an incorrect pose. We present Hypothesis-Anchored Tracking (HAT), a causal framework that uses inter-frame motion to select among competing CAD-based pose hypotheses before alignment and fusion. Rather than independently choosing the highest-scoring hypothesis in each image, HAT retains competing orientation histories and selects a pose to anchor the relative trajectory estimated by monocular SLAM. Sparse anchors and pose fusion provide per-frame estimates after initialization without revising past outputs. The method requires only a calibrated RGB sequence, a metric CAD model, and target image regions, which can be supplied by detection or segmentation. The pretrained pose and SLAM networks require no target-specific training or fine-tuning. We evaluate two versions, Mega-HAT and Pico-HAT, using MegaPose and PicoPose, on SPARK-2024, SwissCube and SHIRT, with YCB-Video assessing performance outside the space domain. Using one temporal configuration per method, the arithmetic means of the four dataset-wise comparisons show 9.4% lower mean pose error and 3.76 times the sustained input FPS for Mega-HAT relative to independent MegaPose, and 23.9% lower mean pose error and 2.42 times the FPS for Pico-HAT relative to independent PicoPose. Mega-HAT ablations on SPARK and an offline reference examine component contributions and the effect of revising past estimates.

AI.tldr: 提出 HAT（Hypothesis-Anchored Tracking）因果框架，用于非合作目标的单目 6-DoF 位姿估计；通过帧间运动在多个基于 CAD 的位姿假设中选择锚点，结合单目 SLAM 与稀疏锚点/位姿融合，提升精度与速度，且无需目标特定训练。
AI.motivation: 在轨服务与空间碎片清除需要非合作目标的单目 6-DoF 位姿估计。单图像估计器容易混淆近似对称的航天器朝向，而跟踪方法可能保持错误位姿。因此需要一种利用帧间运动来消除歧义并保持正确位姿的框架。
AI.method: HAT 在配准与融合前，利用帧间运动在竞争性 CAD 位姿假设中进行选择；保留多个竞争朝向历史，并选择位姿来锚定单目 SLAM 估计的相对轨迹。采用稀疏锚点和位姿融合，在初始化后提供逐帧估计且不修改过去输出。只需标定 RGB 序列、公制 CAD 模型和目标图像区域（可由检测或分割提供），预训练位姿与 SLAM 网络无需目标特定训练或微调。
AI.result: 评估 Mega-HAT 与 Pico-HAT（基于 MegaPose 和 PicoPose），在 SPARK-2024、SwissCube、SHIRT 及 YCB-Video 上测试。四种数据集比较的算术平均显示：Mega-HAT 相对独立 MegaPose 平均位姿误差降低 9.4%，持续输入 FPS 为 3.76 倍；Pico-HAT 相对独立 PicoPose 平均位姿误差降低 23.9%，FPS 为 2.42 倍。SPARK 消融与离线参考分析考察了各组件贡献及修正过去估计的影响。
AI.conclusion: HAT 能有效利用时序信息解决近对称目标位姿歧义，提高非合作空间目标位姿估计的精度与效率，并避免目标特定训练；在空间领域外也具一定泛化能力。

title: When Steering Fails in Latent Reasoning: A Latent-to-Language Transition Gap
summary: Activation steering has become a widely used approach for controlling language models during explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, motivating its extension to latent CoT. However, we find that steering continuous thoughts produces substantially weaker effects on subsequent language generation than steering explicit CoT, even when the hidden representations are moved by comparable amounts. We first show that task information remains identifiable in continuous thoughts. Hence, we hypothesize a \textbf{latent-to-language transition gap}, in which an intervention effect in latent space fails to transfer to language generation. Two further results support this hypothesis: the output distribution changes abruptly at the transition boundary, and task-related directions exert much weaker bidirectional control in latent CoT than in explicit CoT. These findings identify the transition interface as a central target for evaluating and designing future latent-steering methods.

AI.tldr: 论文发现，对连续思维（latent CoT）进行激活引导对后续语言生成的影响明显弱于对显式思维链（explicit CoT）的引导，并提出“潜在到语言转换缺口”来解释这一现象。
AI.motivation: 激活引导已被广泛用于控制语言模型的显式思维链推理，研究者希望将其扩展到潜在思维链。但作者发现，即使隐藏表示被移动了相近幅度，引导连续思维对后续语言生成的效果仍远弱于引导显式思维链，因此需要探究其原因。
AI.method: 作者首先验证连续思维中仍可识别任务信息；随后通过分析输出分布在转换边界处的突然变化，以及任务相关方向在潜在思维链与显式思维链中的双向控制效果差异，来检验所提出的“潜在到语言转换缺口”假设。
AI.result: 连续思维中任务信息仍然可识别，但对其施加干预后效果难以传递到语言生成；输出分布会在转换边界处发生突变；任务相关方向在潜在思维链中的双向控制能力显著弱于显式思维链。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果支持存在“潜在到语言转换缺口”，说明潜在空间中的干预效果不能有效传递到语言生成，并指出潜在思维链到语言生成的转换界面是未来评估和设计潜在引导方法的关键目标。

title: Designer-RSI: Evolving Procedural Memory from User Traffic for Agentic Graphic Design
summary: Professional graphic design is a long-horizon agentic task in which structured, editable artifacts emerge from many interdependent actions, yet outcomes admit no reliable programmatic oracle. We introduce a continual adaptation framework in which a frozen frontier model operates professional design software through more than 230 tools, while an external procedural memory of natural-language skills accumulates and refines reusable design procedures from experience. The memory widens by acquiring procedures for recurring uncovered subtasks and deepens by revising existing procedures against their own successful and failed executions, while a matched replay gate admits only changes that repair failures without regressing observed successes. Five rounds over 1,406 real user briefs and 1,869 automatically graded trajectories, with no weight updates and no human labels, grow the bank from 76 documentation-derived skills to 139 and raise GenEval2 execution success on Claude-Sonnet-4 from 72.7% to 99.3% (+11.99 points in generation quality), with 61.8% and 67.6% win rates against the no-skill agent across four specialized design benchmarks on Claude-Sonnet-4 and Claude-Opus-4.6. We further show the two mechanisms are effective in combination: on 200 held-out briefs from user-traffic benchmark, widening or deepening alone reaches a 49.4% / 48.6% win rate over the no-skill agent, while their combination reaches 58.5% (p = 0.025). Procedural memory offers a practical route to continual adaptation of agents under noisy, unverifiable feedback.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向专业平面设计的持续自适应框架：冻结的前沿模型通过230多个工具操作设计软件，外部程序性记忆以自然语言技能形式积累并优化可复用设计流程，从而在无权重更新、无人工标签条件下提升设计执行成功率与生成质量。
AI.motivation: 专业平面设计是长周期智能体任务，结构化可编辑成果由大量相互依赖动作产生，但结果缺乏可靠程序化评判标准，因此需要一种能在噪声、不可验证反馈下持续自适应的机制。
AI.method: 框架让冻结模型操作专业设计软件，并维护外部自然语言程序性记忆；记忆通过“拓宽”获取未覆盖重复子任务的新流程，通过“加深”基于自身成功与失败执行修订已有流程；匹配回放门控仅允许修复失败且不导致已观测成功回退的变更。
AI.result: 在1,406个真实用户简报和1,869条自动评分轨迹上进行五轮迭代，无权重更新、无人工标签，技能库从76个文档衍生技能增至139个；Claude-Sonnet-4上GenEval2执行成功率从72.7%升至99.3%，生成质量提升11.99分；在四个专业设计基准上对无技能智能体的胜率为61.8%和67.6%。在200个用户流量基准留出简报上，单独拓宽或加深胜率为49.4%/48.6%，两者结合达58.5%（p=0.025）。
AI.conclusion: 程序性记忆为智能体在噪声且不可验证反馈下实现持续自适应提供了一条实用路径，且拓宽与加深两种机制结合使用效果更佳。

title: Robotic Multiphase Interaction: Manipulating Coupled Liquid and Solid Dynamics with a World Model
summary: This work presents \textit{Robotic Multiphase Interaction (RMI)}, a setting in which liquid enters a porous material and interacts mechanically with its deforming solid skeleton. Manipulation can therefore change pore volume, expel or redistribute retained liquid, and alter grasp stability at the same time. Spilled liquid can also create safety risks in domestic and manufacturing settings. This differs from most manipulation of solid objects and from tasks that involve both liquid and solid while keeping the phases spatially separate. We study a sponge filled with water as the first RMI example. We use implicit incompressible porous flow with smoothed particle hydrodynamics as the dynamics engine and enable robotic manipulation by adding Coulomb contact memory, hybrid velocity and force regulation, and a stability gate for lifting. The resulting environment connects robot commands to changes in the coupled liquid and solid state. A world model conditioned on actions predicts how this state evolves under candidate commands, while a temporal UNet generates actions using either Diffusion Policy or rectified flow matching. Our world model reduces retained water prediction error by more than $60\%$ compared with the baseline. The best action sequence selected by the world model from policy proposals further reduces the predicted terminal water error by about half. These improvements show that modelling the coupled liquid and solid state helps the robot predict how its actions affect both the porous object and the liquid held inside.

AI.tldr: 提出机器人多相交互（RMI）设定：液体进入多孔材料并与变形固体骨架机械耦合。以水浸海绵为示例，采用隐式不可压缩多孔流与SPH动力学引擎，通过库仑接触记忆、混合速度/力调节和提升稳定性门实现操作。世界模型预测液固耦合状态演化，时序UNet用Diffusion Policy或rectified flow matching生成动作。
AI.motivation: 多数操作任务针对固体，或涉及液固但保持两相空间分离。液体渗入多孔材料会改变孔隙体积、排出或重分布液体，并同时影响抓取稳定性；溢出的液体还可能带来安全风险，因此需要研究这类耦合交互的机器人操作。
AI.method: 使用隐式不可压缩多孔流与平滑粒子流体动力学（SPH）作为动力学引擎；加入库仑接触记忆、混合速度和力调节，以及用于提升的稳定性门；构建以动作为条件的世界模型预测耦合状态演化；采用时序UNet生成动作，可选Diffusion Policy或rectified flow matching。
AI.result: 世界模型将保水预测误差较基线降低超过60%；世界模型从策略提议中选出的最佳动作序列进一步将预测终端水误差减少约一半。
AI.conclusion: 对液固耦合状态建模有助于机器人预测其动作如何影响多孔物体及内部保持的液体，从而改善操作预测与决策。

title: Detection is solved, delineation is not: what governs tooth segmentation on panoramic radiographs
summary:
Automatic tooth segmentation and FDI numbering on panoramic radiographs underpins computer-assisted dental diagnosis, yet which factors govern performance remains unclear. We assemble a corpus of 1,422 panoramic radiographs containing 42,142 expert-delineated tooth polygons across the 32-class FDI taxonomy, annotated by 30 dental practitioners and independently reviewed by two others, and use it to isolate input resolution, architecture and anatomical priors under a single evaluation protocol.
  First, resolution dominates: across a controlled 640/1024/1280 ablation, mask mAP50-95 rises 0.656 -> 0.710 -> 0.717 while mAP50 stays flat at ~0.982. Both gains are significant under a paired bootstrap over images (p < 0.001, p = 0.024); neither mAP50 change is distinguishable from zero. Added resolution buys boundary precision, not detection. Second, architecture is nearly irrelevant in-domain: a query-based transformer with 2.1x the parameters is statistically equivalent to a one-stage detector (95% CI [-0.0064, +0.0064]), only marginally better under domain shift, 5.5x slower on CPU and not executable under standard ONNX runtimes. Third, three targeted interventions fail: a LoRA-adapted self-supervised encoder underperforms, a promptable foundation segmenter degrades masks by 39%, and globally optimal anatomical label assignment yields +0.0007 despite correcting a constraint violated in 40% of out-of-domain predictions.
  Zero-shot transfer to an independent multi-centre cohort, verified overlap-free, costs 62% of mask mAP50-95 but only 18% of mAP50, reproducing the dissociation. Decomposing masks along the tooth axis localises the residual error to the apical third. Boundary precision is therefore the binding constraint, and effort is better directed at resolution and acquisition diversity than at architectural novelty.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了包含1,422张全景片、42,142个专家标注牙齿多边形和32类FDI编号的大型数据集，在统一协议下系统评估分辨率、模型架构和解剖先验对牙齿分割与编号的影响。
AI.motivation: 自动牙齿分割和FDI编号是计算机辅助牙科诊断的基础，但哪些因素真正决定性能仍不明确，因此需要受控实验来识别关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 使用30名牙科从业者标注、2名独立审核者复核的数据集；在统一评估协议下进行640/1024/1280分辨率消融、不同架构对比，以及LoRA自监督编码器、可提示基础分割模型、全局最优解剖标签分配等干预；并开展无重叠的多中心零样本迁移评估。
AI.result: 分辨率主导性能：mask mAP50-95从0.656升至0.710再到0.717，而mAP50稳定在约0.982；架构影响很小，查询式Transformer与单阶段检测器统计等价，但CPU慢5.5倍且ONNX运行受限；三种干预均失败。零样本迁移使mask mAP50-95下降62%，但mAP50仅下降18%，误差主要位于牙根尖三分之一。
AI.conclusion: 边界精度是主要约束，提升性能应优先关注输入分辨率和采集多样性，而非模型架构创新。

title: AtomEgo: Exploring Ego-Robot Integration for Embodied Foundation Model Pretraining
summary: Embodied foundation models are constrained by the limited scale and diversity of robot demonstrations, motivating the use of large-scale egocentric human interaction data. However, how to effectively incorporate such data into embodied-model pre-training remains unclear because of substantial embodiment and action-space gaps between humans and robots. We present AtomEgo, a systematic study of ego--robot co-training supported by a curated corpus of approximately 2,659 hours and a scalable data processing pipeline. Across vision--language--action and world--action model architectures, we investigate three representative paradigms: joint co-training with domain-specific action heads, progressive ego-to-robot transfer through embodiment alignment, and joint video--action modeling. We evaluate these paradigms through multi-task real-robot experiments and language-conditioned cross-embodiment representation analysis. Our results reveal a simple principle: Data Scale * Alignment Quality --> Capability Gain; egocentric data can improve generalization, but their value depends on how effectively they are aligned and utilized. This principle can provide practical guidance for scalable ego--robot pre-training.

AI.tldr: 提出 AtomEgo，系统研究以自我中心人类交互数据辅助机器人具身基础模型预训练的 ego-robot 协同训练方法，并基于约 2,659 小时数据和可扩展数据处理管线，在多种模型架构与训练范式下验证其效果。
AI.motivation: 具身基础模型受限于机器人演示数据规模小、多样性不足，而大规模自我中心人类交互数据有潜力弥补这一缺口；但人类与机器人在具身形态和动作空间上存在显著差异，如何有效将其用于预训练仍不清晰。
AI.method: 构建约 2,659 小时的精选语料和可扩展数据处理管线；在视觉-语言-动作与世界-动作模型架构下，研究三类代表性范式：带领域特定动作头的联合协同训练、通过具身对齐的渐进式 ego-to-robot 迁移、联合视频-动作建模；并通过多任务真实机器人实验和语言条件跨具身表示分析进行评估。
AI.result: 实验揭示一个简单原则：Data Scale × Alignment Quality → Capability Gain。自我中心数据能够提升泛化能力，但其价值取决于数据与机器人之间的对齐质量及利用方式。
AI.conclusion: 该原则可为可扩展的 ego-robot 预训练提供实践指导，强调在扩大数据规模的同时，必须重视跨具身对齐与有效利用。

title: Rethinking Human-Aligned Evaluation: An Analysis of Semantic Metrics Beyond WER
summary: Word Error Rate (WER), the most commonly used metric for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), treats every lexical deviation from the reference as equally costly, regardless of whether it changes meaning. This raises the question: does WER actually track how humans judge ASR transcript quality? We introduce HATS-en, an English dataset for human-centered ASR evaluation. Using this dataset, we benchmark lexical metrics against several configurations of BERTScore and SemDist, varying the language model, layer, and pooling strategy. We find that WER agrees least with human judgment among all metrics tested, that the best-performing SemDist configurations achieve the highest overall agreement, ahead of CER and BERTScore, and that no single model is best across settings. CER, despite its simplicity and low cost, remains remarkably close to these best configurations. In line with prior recommendations, our results support shifting ASR evaluation toward CER both for English and for morphosyllabic writing systems as it is a more interpretable and low-cost metric for what evaluation should actually capture, and using SemDist as a complementary evaluation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出面向人类评价的英语ASR数据集HATS-en，并比较WER、CER、BERTScore和SemDist等指标与人类判断的一致性，发现WER最不一致，SemDist最佳配置整体一致性最高，但CER简单低成本且表现接近最优，建议将CER作为主要指标、SemDist作为补充。
AI.motivation: WER是ASR最常用指标，但它将所有词汇偏差视为同等代价，不考虑是否改变语义，因此需要检验WER是否真正反映人类对ASR转写质量的判断。
AI.method: 构建HATS-en英语数据集用于以人为中心的ASR评估；用不同语言模型、层和池化策略配置BERTScore与SemDist，并将其与词汇指标和人类判断进行基准比较。
AI.result: 在所有测试指标中，WER与人类判断一致性最低；最佳SemDist配置整体一致性最高，优于CER和BERTScore；没有单一模型在所有设置下最佳；CER虽简单低成本，但与最佳配置表现非常接近。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将ASR评估转向CER，对英语和词素音节文字系统都更具可解释性且成本低，更符合评估应捕捉的内容；同时建议将SemDist作为补充评估指标。

title: 2nd Place Solution to the HANDS 2026 Workshop Challenge-Dexterous Grasp Motion Track: Single-Shot Trajectory Warping for Grasp Motion Generation
summary: This report describes our 2nd place solution to the HANDS 2026 workshop challenge (Dexterous Grasp Motion track) in conjunction with ECCV 2026. In this challenge, we address grasp motion generation for the 12-DoF LinkerHand O6, aiming to produce physically plausible reach-and-lift trajectories for unseen objects from randomized initial hand poses in simulation. This task is particularly challenging because each grasp requires a per-step policy to make approximately $70$ twelve-dimensional decisions, with errors accumulating over time, while test objects and physical dynamics may differ from those encountered during training. To address these challenges, we propose editing a single successful GraspM3 demonstration instead of generating the motion step by step: a policy observes the object once and outputs a 12-D warp of the demonstration, which is then replayed open-loop. Moreover, we train the warp policy with one-step PPO over all $4{,}824$ training objects in parallel. As a result, our method achieved success rates of $94.61\%$ on the easy track, the highest of all submissions, and $57.18\%$ on the hard track of the private test set.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HANDS 2026 双手抓取运动挑战赛（ECCV 2026）的亚军方案，针对 12 自由度 LinkerHand O6，通过编辑单个成功 GraspM3 演示而非逐帧生成运动，实现未见物体的抓取运动生成。
AI.motivation: 该挑战要求从随机初始手部姿态出发，为未见物体生成物理合理的伸手与抬升轨迹。难点在于每步策略需做出约 70 个 12 维决策，误差会随时间累积，且测试物体与物理动力学可能与训练时不同。
AI.method: 方法不逐步生成动作，而是编辑一个成功的 GraspM3 演示：策略仅观察物体一次，输出一个 12 维演示形变（warp），随后以开环方式重放该形变轨迹；并使用 one-step PPO 在全部 4,824 个训练物体上并行训练形变策略。
AI.result: 在私有测试集上，方法在 easy track 达到 94.61% 成功率，为所有提交中最高；在 hard track 达到 57.18% 成功率。
AI.conclusion: 通过单次物体观测输出演示形变并开环重放，可有效避免逐步决策的误差累积，在所设挑战中取得优异成绩，并获得 HANDS 2026 挑战赛第二名。

title: Learning Distance-Conditioned Object Transport for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from a Single Motion Clip
summary: Motion tracking can reproduce humanoid loco-manipulation from a single retargeted motion clip, but a policy trained on a fixed reference primarily reproduces its demonstrated transport outcome. Although the source trajectory visits intermediate object displacements, transport termination is demonstrated only at its endpoint. We identify this mismatch as the termination-versus-passage gap: intermediate displacements are observed as passage states rather than termination-complete outcomes. We introduce Distance-Conditioned Reference Recomposition (DCRR), which relocates the demonstrated termination segment to intermediate transport states. A frozen tracking teacher replays the recomposed references under closed-loop dynamics, and the retained trajectories are relabeled by their achieved object placements and distilled into a reference-free policy. This procedure constructs distance-conditioned supervision from the interaction behavior encoded in the source motion. Across Carry, Kick-Push, Crouch-Push, and Drag, DCRR-BC produces command-dependent transport with an overall normalized distance mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.15, compared with 0.28 for source-only behavior cloning. RL fine-tuning further improves the command response and execution robustness in the training simulator and under sim-to-sim transfer. Finally, hardware experiments demonstrate transport-distance modulation across all four interaction modes.

AI.tldr: 论文研究从单个重定向运动片段训练人形机器人搬运/操作策略时，固定参考导致策略只能复现演示终点的运输结果。作者提出距离条件参考重组（DCRR），将演示终止片段迁移到中间运输状态，并用冻结跟踪教师生成闭环轨迹，再按实际物体放置重新标注并蒸馏为无参考策略。
AI.motivation: 现有运动跟踪方法虽能从单个重定向运动片段复现人形移动操作，但策略主要复现演示的最终运输结果。源轨迹虽经过中间物体位移，却只在终点演示运输终止，因此存在“终止与经过”不匹配：中间位移只是经过状态，而非终止完成结果。
AI.method: 提出 Distance-Conditioned Reference Recomposition（DCRR）：把演示中的终止片段重新定位到中间运输状态；使用冻结的跟踪教师策略在闭环动力学下重放重组参考；保留成功轨迹，并根据其达到的物体放置结果重新标注；最后蒸馏为无参考策略。RL微调进一步优化命令响应与执行鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在 Carry、Kick-Push、Crouch-Push、Drag 上，DCRR-BC 实现了随命令变化的运输，总体归一化距离 MAE 为 0.15，而仅用源行为的 BC 为 0.28。RL 微调在训练仿真器和 sim-to-sim 迁移中进一步提升了命令响应与鲁棒性。硬件实验表明四种交互模式均可实现运输距离调制。
AI.conclusion: DCRR 能利用源运动中的交互行为构造距离条件监督，将单片段演示扩展为可控制运输距离的技能，并在仿真与真实硬件上验证了有效性。

title: Adaptive Rollout Truncation Based on Epistemic Uncertainty for Efficient Offline World Model Training
comment: 8 pages, 12 figures. Accepted at the IEEE/RSJ IROS 2026 Workshop "Rethinking Uncertainty for Modern Robotics Paradigms"
summary:
Accurate neural world models are central to model-based robotics, where they enable robots to predict future states from previously observed trajectories. Multi-step autoregressive training improves long-horizon prediction, but fixed rollout horizons also increase computational cost and can amplify early training errors when the model is still inaccurate. Existing training schemes typically use the same rollout length throughout optimization, independent of the model's current predictive reliability.
  We propose an epistemic uncertainty-driven adaptive rollout strategy for offline world model training following an auto-curriculum training scheme. Instead of always unrolling to a fixed horizon, the model terminates autoregressive rollouts once epistemic uncertainty exceeds a threshold calibrated from a warm-up phase. We study two uncertainty estimators: a five-head ensemble with a shared recurrent backbone and Monte Carlo Dropout. A two-stage warm-up procedure stabilizes uncertainty estimates before we enable adaptive truncation.
  Experiments on ANYmal-D and ANT show that ensemble-based adaptive truncation matches or improves the prediction accuracy of fixed-horizon training and the RWM-U baseline while requiring substantially fewer cumulative rollout steps. Training a world model on ANYmal-D following the presented approach reaches comparable final performance with the baselines with roughly 72% less rollout computation. These results indicate that epistemic uncertainty is useful not only for downstream policy regularization, but also for making world model training itself more compute-efficient.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于认知不确定性的自适应展开策略，用于离线世界模型训练。当认知不确定性超过预热阶段校准的阈值时，提前终止自回归展开，从而在保持或提升预测精度的同时大幅减少计算量。
AI.motivation: 多步自回归训练能提升长时程预测能力，但固定展开长度会增加计算成本，并在模型尚不准确时放大早期训练误差。现有训练方案在整个优化过程中使用相同展开长度，未考虑模型当前的预测可靠性。
AI.method: 采用自动课程训练框架，提出认知不确定性驱动的自适应展开。使用两种不确定性估计器：共享循环骨干的五头集成和蒙特卡洛丢弃。通过两阶段预热稳定不确定性估计，再根据预热校准的阈值启用自适应截断。
AI.result: 在ANYmal-D和ANT上的实验表明，基于集成的自适应截断在预测精度上匹配或优于固定长度训练和RWM-U基线，同时所需累计展开步数显著减少。在ANYmal-D上训练世界模型达到与基线相当的最终性能，展开计算量减少约72%。
AI.conclusion: 认知不确定性不仅可用于下游策略正则化，还能使世界模型训练本身更高效。自适应展开策略在离线世界模型训练中有效平衡了精度与计算成本。

title: Potential-Field Action Representation for Reinforcement Learning in Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Model-free reinforcement learning can acquire contact-rich robotic manipulation skills through trial-and-error interaction, but it often requires the policy to learn both task strategy and low-level motion generation. In this setting, the action representation is critical because it determines how policy outputs are converted into robot motion, shaping both exploration and physical execution. Direct Cartesian command interfaces require the policy to generate motion at every decision step, coupling task-level adaptation with continuous low-level control and increasing the learning burden. We propose PA-RL, a reinforcement-learning framework that uses artificial potential fields as the action representation. Instead of commanding motion directly, the policy adapts the parameters of an energy-like potential field, which generates a state-dependent guidance direction executed through a Cartesian impedance controller. We evaluate PA-RL on peg-in-hole insertion, a representative contact-rich task with nonlinear dynamics and discontinuous contact transitions. In simulation, PA-RL is compared with Cartesian velocity, Cartesian pose, and variable-impedance action spaces using the same RL algorithm. PA-RL is the only method to reach a 100% evaluation success rate within the allotted training time, while the best baseline reaches 92.6%. It also reduces joint-torque variation by 55.4% and Cartesian acceleration variation by 70.8% relative to the best baseline, without explicit motion-quality penalties in the reward. The simulation-trained policy further completes 9/9 real-robot insertions without fine-tuning, demonstrating the deployment feasibility of the learned potential-field interface.

AI.tldr: 提出PA-RL框架，用人工势场作为动作表示，让策略调节势场参数而非直接输出运动指令，并通过笛卡尔阻抗控制器执行，在轴孔装配任务中取得优于常见动作空间的成功率、运动平滑性和真机部署效果。
AI.motivation: 无模型强化学习可用于接触丰富的机器人操作，但策略常需同时学习任务策略和底层运动生成；动作表示决定策略输出如何转化为机器人运动，直接影响探索和物理执行。直接笛卡尔指令要求每步生成运动，耦合了任务适应与连续底层控制，增加学习负担。
AI.method: PA-RL将人工势场作为动作表示：策略不直接命令运动，而是调节类能量势场的参数，势场生成状态相关的引导方向，再由笛卡尔阻抗控制器执行。在轴孔插入这一典型接触丰富任务中，与笛卡尔速度、笛卡尔位姿和变阻抗动作空间使用相同RL算法进行仿真对比。
AI.result: PA-RL是唯一在限定训练时间内达到100%评估成功率的方，最佳基线为92.6%。相比最佳基线，关节力矩变化降低55.4%，笛卡尔加速度变化降低70.8%，且奖励中未加入显式运动质量惩罚。仿真训练的策略无需微调即可完成9/9次真机插入。
AI.conclusion: 以势场为动作表示的接口能有效减轻策略学习负担，提高接触丰富任务的成功率与运动平滑性，并展现出从仿真到真机部署的可行性。

title: PRISM-BN: A Controlled Corpus and Benchmark for Text-to-Parameterized Bayesian Network Extraction
summary: Probabilistic Graphical Models (PGMs), especially Bayesian Networks (BNs), expose directed structure and probabilistic parameters, making them natural symbolic targets for neurosymbolic AI. Yet training text-to-parameterized-BN systems requires paired text-to-BN resources unavailable at scale. We introduce PRISM-BN, a controlled corpus of 5054 BN-grounded descriptions paired with discrete reference BNs containing variables, states, directed edges, root priors, and full multi-parent CPDs across five domains. The instances are derived from 50 Wikipedia-seeded backbones, and their probabilities are internally constructed benchmark targets rather than externally validated causal estimates. PRISM-BN is built with PRISM, a marginal-first pipeline that elicits marginal and local joint distributions, analytically recovers normalized CPDs, and constructs locally reparameterized subgraphs. We define a benchmark with semantic node and state alignment, conditional structural scoring, and strict full-CPD evaluation. Across six LLM extractors, Node F1 ranges from 0.56 to 0.83, conditional Edge F1 from 0.90 to 0.97, and CPD-KL from 1.11 to 3.14. Conditional state and edge recovery remain consistently strong, whereas strict full-CPD agreement remains challenging. These trends persist with independently generated GPT-5.5 references, and a human pilot corroborates structural recoverability and similar probabilistic interpretations. PRISM-BN supports separate evaluation of structural recovery and probabilistic parameter estimation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 PRISM-BN：一个包含 5054 条 BN 接地描述与离散参考贝叶斯网络配对的可控语料，用于评估神经符号 AI 从文本抽取参数化贝叶斯网络的能力。
AI.motivation: 概率图模型尤其是贝叶斯网络具有显式有向结构和概率参数，适合作为神经符号 AI 的符号目标，但训练文本到参数化 BN 系统所需的大规模配对文本-BN 资源稀缺。
AI.method: 构建 PRISM-BN 语料与 PRISM 流水线：基于 50 个 Wikipedia 种子骨架生成五个领域的 BN 描述，先抽取边缘分布和局部联合分布，再解析恢复归一化 CPD，并构建局部重参数化子图。基准包含语义节点/状态对齐、条件结构评分和严格全 CPD 评估。
AI.result: 在六个 LLM 抽取器上，Node F1 为 0.56–0.83，条件 Edge F1 为 0.90–0.97，CPD-KL 为 1.11–3.14；条件状态与边恢复稳定较强，但严格全 CPD 一致性仍具挑战。使用独立生成的 GPT-5.5 参考和人工试点也显示类似趋势。
AI.conclusion: PRISM-BN 支持将结构恢复与概率参数估计分开评估，揭示了当前 LLM 在 BN 结构抽取上表现较好，但在完整 CPD 精确恢复上仍困难。

title: Extending Decoupled Attention to Dense Prediction and Masked Training for Multi-Channel Images
summary: Multi-Channel imaging (MCI) data differs fundamentally from natural images, as each channel records a semantically distinct signal rather than a colour band. To adapt vision encoders to MCI data, Multi-Channel Vision Transformers (MC-ViTs) tokenize each channel independently and concatenate the resulting tokens into one sequence, and the channel count is no longer fixed by the architecture. Self-attention is then computed across all channel-patch tokens with no restriction on which channels attend to which, which dilutes the features of individual channels. The Decoupled Vision Transformer (DC-ViT) regulates this by separating updates computed within a channel from updates computed across channels, and by forming a representation per channel before the channels are combined. Its formulation, however, pairs tokens by spatial position, and thus requires the same visible tokens in every channel. Correspondence under independent per-channel masking is recovered by solving a linear assignment between the retained patches of each channel, which allows decoupled attention to be combined with current masked multi-channel training in its standard configuration rather than a restricted one. Across three classification and three segmentation benchmarks spanning fluorescence microscopy, imaging mass cytometry and satellite imaging, including dense prediction at high channel counts, the resulting formulation outperforms the strongest MC-ViT baseline.
