AI.tldr: 针对多通道成像（MCI）数据，现有多通道ViT将各通道token拼接后进行全局自注意力会稀释单通道特征。本文改进Decoupled Vision Transformer，通过通道内/通道间解耦注意力，并用线性分配恢复独立逐通道掩码下的空间对应，从而兼容标准掩码多通道训练，在多个分类与分割基准上超越最强MC-ViT基线。
AI.motivation: MCI数据不同于自然图像，每个通道记录语义独立的信号而非颜色波段。MC-ViT虽可处理可变通道数，但无限制的跨通道自注意力会稀释各通道特征；DC-ViT虽通过解耦注意力缓解该问题，却按空间位置配对token，要求每个通道具有相同的可见token，难以适配独立逐通道掩码训练。
AI.method: 分离通道内更新与跨通道更新，并在通道合并前为每个通道形成独立表示；针对独立逐通道掩码导致各通道保留patch不一致的问题，通过求解各通道保留patch之间的线性分配来恢复对应关系，从而将解耦注意力与标准配置的掩码多通道训练结合。
AI.result: 在荧光显微、成像质谱流式和卫星成像三个领域，共3个分类和3个分割基准上，包括高通道数密集预测任务，所提方法均优于最强的MC-ViT基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过线性分配恢复独立逐通道掩码下的空间对应，该方法可在不限制掩码配置的情况下将解耦注意力用于标准掩码多通道训练，并有效提升多通道成像的分类与分割性能。

title: DRT: Dense Reasoning Trace for Efficient and Grounded Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Despite the remarkable progress in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), prevailing Chain-of-Thought (CoT) paradigms remain confined to the natural-language expression space. Consequently, they inherently incur excessive linguistic overhead, leading to information dilution and weak visual grounding. To address this challenge, we propose Dense Reasoning Trace (DRT), a paradigm that departs from natural-language-centered CoT by expressing reasoning as compact structured traces, which include concise intermediate states with symbolic connectors and disentangle visual observations from logical deductions. First, we introduce the Dense Trace Initialization to internalize the DRT reasoning mode into the model, substantially improving token efficiency while preserving visual evidence. To further enable the model to faithfully capture the logical relations within traces, we propose the Trace-Grounded Reinforcement Learning framework, which builds reference traces through a tri-perspective verification pipeline and employs Trace-Grounded GRPO with structured rewards, encouraging the model to generate concise DRT-style traces with reduced hallucination and stronger logical grounding. Extensive experiments on challenging reasoning benchmarks show that DRT achieves 5.5$\times$ token efficiency improvement while improving 1.3 accuracy points over the Qwen3-VL baseline. These findings suggest that complex multimodal reasoning may not require verbose natural-language traces, opening a more efficient path for next-generation MLLMs. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/HIT-leaderone/DRT

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Dense Reasoning Trace（DRT）范式，用紧凑的结构化推理轨迹替代自然语言 Chain-of-Thought，以降低语言冗余并增强视觉 grounding，从而提升多模态大模型推理的效率与准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 的 CoT 范式局限于自然语言表达空间，导致过度的语言开销、信息稀释和较弱的视觉 grounding，因此需要更高效且更贴近视觉证据的推理表达方式。
AI.method: 提出 DRT 范式：用包含简洁中间状态、符号连接词的结构化轨迹表达推理，并分离视觉观察与逻辑推导；引入 Dense Trace Initialization 将 DRT 推理模式内化到模型中；进一步提出 Trace-Grounded Reinforcement Learning 框架，通过三视角验证流程构建参考轨迹，并采用 Trace-Grounded GRPO 与结构化奖励进行训练。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的推理基准上，DRT 相比 Qwen3-VL baseline 实现了 5.5 倍 token 效率提升，同时准确率提高 1.3 个百分点，并减少了幻觉、增强了逻辑 grounding。
AI.conclusion: 复杂多模态推理可能并不需要冗长的自然语言推理轨迹；DRT 为下一代 MLLM 提供了更高效、更可靠的推理路径。

title: Configurable Multi-Stage Vision Pipeline for Crop Disease and Pest Diagnosis
summary:
Farmer.Chat is Digital Green's farm advisory service for smallholder farmers. When something looks wrong with a crop, the farmer takes a photograph and sends it, and that photograph is the whole question: no symptom described, no crop named, often no text at all. The service has to determine whether the picture can be used, what crop it shows, and what is wrong with it, from images taken on cheap phones in a field, in poor light and with a moving camera. The system doing this today cannot be adjusted. It has no adjustable thresholds for photograph rejection, crops and problems cannot be added, and there is no confidence cut-off to set.
  We study about 1.16 million photographs sent to Farmer.Chat from Ethiopia, India, Kenya and Nigeria. The production quality gate rejected 46.8% of the images it judged, over a quarter of those reaching diagnosis returned no crop name, and 35.8% of the labelled problems filed under "disease" are pests, identifiable without the crop. We therefore split the work into three stages: a quality gate (M0), a crop detector (M1), and a disease or pest detector (M2). Route A fills all three with one fine-tuned vision-language model (Qwen3-VL-4B) answering in a single call. Route B fills each with a small specialist model (DaViT, YOLO26).
  We replace our production GPT-4o quality gate with a small MobileNetV3 gate at 86.9% F1 in 12 ms. On one test set scored the same way for every system, a hierarchical DaViT-Base achieves 95.41% crop accuracy against 91.46% for the production baseline. It also leads on diagnosis and never declines to answer, while every language model in the comparison leaves a large share of rows with no diagnosis. The fine-tuned model retains two capabilities the specialists do not have: one call for all three stages, and a request for a better photograph when the image cannot support an answer.

AI.tldr: 研究基于Farmer.Chat约116万张农田照片，将农作咨询流程拆为质量门、作物检测、病害/虫害诊断三阶段，并比较单一大视觉语言模型与小型专家模型方案。
AI.motivation: 现有生产系统不可调整：没有照片拒收阈值，无法新增作物和问题，也没有置信度截断；同时质量门拒图多、诊断常缺作物名、疾病标签中混入害虫，需改进。
AI.method: 分析埃塞俄比亚、印度、肯尼亚和尼日利亚约116万张照片，分为M0质量门、M1作物检测、M2病害/虫害检测。Route A用Qwen3-VL-4B单次调用完成三阶段；Route B用DaViT、YOLO26等小型专家模型；并用MobileNetV3替换GPT-4o质量门。
AI.result: MobileNetV3质量门达86.9% F1、12 ms；分层DaViT-Base作物准确率95.41%，高于生产基线91.46%；诊断领先且不拒答，而语言模型常留下无诊断记录。微调模型保留单次调用三阶段和请求更好照片的能力。
AI.conclusion: 小型专家模型在质量门和作物识别上高效准确，分层方案诊断强且不拒答；微调视觉语言模型具备统一调用与主动要求重拍能力，可替代不可调的生产系统并支持按需调整。

title: FORTE: Task-Adaptive Force Capability Optimization for Mobile Manipulators
summary: Effective physical interaction control in robotic manipulation requires not only kinematically feasible motion but also sufficient force-interaction capability. Existing redundancy resolution methods often ignore task-specific force demands or maximize the force capability indiscriminately, sacrificing dexterity when large force margins are unnecessary. We propose a task-oriented force capability optimization framework for redundant mobile manipulators. A Vision-Language Model (VLM) infers object physical properties from an RGB image and a task description, generating a desired task-force sequence that captures gravitational and inertial demands. We then define a task-oriented force capability metric as the signed distance between a task-force uncertainty ball and the dynamic residual force polytope (RFP), quantifying compatibility between task demands and the robot's remaining actuation capacity. This metric is incorporated, alongside manipulability, joint-limit avoidance, trajectory smoothness, and base-oscillation suppression, into a whole-body multi-objective trajectory-optimization problem. Experiments on a mobile manipulator performing lifting and single-point-holding tasks under varying payload conditions demonstrate that the proposed method provides sufficient force capability for heavy loads while preserving high manipulability for light loads. This yields a task-adaptive balance that fixed capability-maximizing baselines (RFP inscribed radius, RFP cone) and manipulability-only optimization fail to achieve. The core implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/yeying256/FORTE.

AI.tldr: 提出面向任务的冗余移动机械臂力能力优化框架，利用视觉语言模型推断物体属性并生成期望任务力，结合动态残余力多面体定义任务力能力指标，进行全身多目标轨迹优化，实现重载有力、轻载灵巧的任务自适应平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有冗余度分解方法常忽略任务特定力需求，或盲目最大化力能力，在不需要大力余量时牺牲灵巧性；因此需要一种能根据任务需求自适应平衡力能力与灵巧性的方法。
AI.method: 使用VLM从RGB图像和任务描述推断物体物理属性，生成包含重力和惯性需求的任务力序列；定义任务力不确定性球与动态残余力多面体（RFP）之间的有符号距离作为任务力能力指标；将其与可操作度、关节限位避免、轨迹平滑和基座振荡抑制一起纳入全身多目标轨迹优化。
AI.result: 在移动机械臂执行不同负载下的举升和单点保持任务中，方法对重载提供足够力能力，对轻载保持高可操作度，实现任务自适应平衡；固定能力最大化基线（RFP内切半径、RFP锥）和仅可操作度优化无法实现该平衡。
AI.conclusion: 面向任务的力能力优化可有效协调移动机械臂的力交互能力与灵巧性，优于固定能力最大化或仅可操作度方法；核心实现已公开。

title: SynthDemo-RL: Breaking the Zero-Reward Barrier in VLA Adaptation with LLM-Guided Synthetic Demonstrations
summary: Fine-tuning Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models commonly relies on human teleoperation demonstrations, while reinforcement learning (RL) with sparse binary rewards faces an exploration challenge when successful trajectories are rarely sampled. We propose SynthDemo-RL, a teacher-student framework in which an automated teacher converts simulator-privileged state into successful manipulation trajectories, a VLA student is distilled from them by supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and PPO with binary task-success rewards refines the student. We study reward coverage, the fraction of tasks for which at least one success is observed under the fixed evaluation protocol, as a complement to the average success rate. On LIBERO-PRO, a public benchmark of perturbed LIBERO tasks for which no demonstrations exist, 27 of 57 scored tasks are at exactly 0% success for a pi_0.5 policy fine-tuned on the original LIBERO tasks. Direct PPO from this policy, under the same PPO recipe and the same RL compute as SynthDemo-RL's refinement stage, rescues 10 of these 27 tasks and leaves 17 at 0%. SynthDemo-RL, with 50 synthesized trajectories per task and no new human demonstrations, rescues all 27 and reaches average success rates of 97.8% and 97.1% on the Position and Task axes of LIBERO-PRO, respectively. On standard LIBERO, the same pipeline reaches 96.0% with no human demonstrations, within 1.7 points of pi_0.5 trained on 50 human demonstrations per task. We further validate the pipeline on RoboTwin 2.0 and verify that trajectories from a policy trained in a MuJoCo twin execute open-loop on a physical robot.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SynthDemo-RL 师生框架：自动教师利用仿真器特权状态生成成功操作轨迹，VLA 学生通过 SFT 蒸馏，再用二值任务成功奖励的 PPO 精炼，从而在无新人类演示下提升稀疏奖励任务的成功率与覆盖度。
AI.motivation: 微调 VLA 模型通常依赖人类遥操作演示，而稀疏二值奖励强化学习在成功轨迹稀少时面临探索困难，因此需要一种无需大量人类演示即可获得成功轨迹并有效强化学习的方法。
AI.method: 提出 SynthDemo-RL 教师-学生框架：自动教师将仿真器特权状态转换为成功操作轨迹；VLA 学生通过监督微调 SFT 从合成轨迹中蒸馏；再用 PPO 和二值任务成功奖励精炼学生。同时引入 reward coverage，衡量固定评估协议下至少观测到一次成功的任务比例。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-PRO 上，基于原始 LIBERO 微调的 pi_0.5 策略有 27/57 个计分任务成功率为 0%；直接 PPO 仅挽救其中 10 个，仍有 17 个为 0%。SynthDemo-RL 每任务用 50 条合成轨迹且无新人类演示，挽救全部 27 个任务，Position 和 Task 轴平均成功率分别达 97.8% 和 97.1%。标准 LIBERO 上达 96.0%，与每任务 50 条人类演示训练的 pi_0.5 相差 1.7 个百分点。RoboTwin 2.0 上进一步验证，MuJoCo 孪生中训练的策略轨迹可在物理机器人上开环执行。
AI.conclusion: SynthDemo-RL 表明，利用仿真器特权状态自动生成演示并结合 SFT 与 PPO，可在无需新人类演示的情况下显著提升稀疏奖励 VLA 任务的成功率和覆盖度，并具备迁移到真实机器人的潜力。

title: CIBuzzBench: A Benchmark for Cross-Lingual Understanding of Chinese Internet Buzzwords
summary: Chinese social media has generated a vast and continually evolving lexicon of internet buzzwords whose meanings are often non-literal and deeply rooted in local cultural and pragmatic contexts. Existing research has primarily focused on interpreting these buzzwords within Chinese, leaving largely unexplored whether LLMs can transfer such culturally grounded knowledge across languages and accurately convey the intended meanings in English. This cross-lingual capability is also critical for safety, as harmful expressions may obscure their offensive content through culture-specific homophony, euphemism, irony, or coded language. In this paper, we investigate the ability of advanced LLMs to understand Chinese internet buzzwords across languages. To this end, we introduce CIBuzzBench, the first benchmark for cross-lingual Chinese-to-English understanding of Chinese internet buzzwords. CIBuzzBench comprises 3,001 Chinese internet buzzwords annotated with English meaning explanations, English equivalents, category labels, and harmfulness labels. Based on these annotations, we design three evaluation tasks: Meaning Explanation, Cross-lingual Equivalent Matching, and Culturally Grounded Harmfulness Detection. We evaluate representative state-of-the-art proprietary and Chinese LLMs under both English- and Chinese-prompting settings. Our results show that LLMs continue to struggle with the cross-lingual understanding of Chinese internet buzzwords, particularly in fine-grained non-literal interpretation, robust equivalent matching under option perturbations, and calibrated harmfulness detection. These findings highlight the persistent challenges posed by culturally grounded language phenomena for multilingual LLMs and safety-oriented evaluation. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/SuperYFan/CIBuzzBench.

AI.tldr: 论文研究LLM跨语言理解中文网络流行语的能力，提出首个中英跨语言基准CIBuzzBench，包含3001个流行语及英文释义、等价表达、类别和有害性标注，并设计三类评测任务，发现LLM仍面临显著困难。
AI.motivation: 中文社媒流行语含义常非字面且深植于本土文化与语用语境；现有研究多限于中文内部解释，尚不清楚LLM能否跨语言迁移此类文化知识并准确传达英文含义。该能力对安全也很关键，因为有害表达可能借文化特定谐音、委婉、反讽或暗语隐藏冒犯内容。
AI.method: 构建CIBuzzBench，包含3001个中文网络流行语，标注英文释义、英文等价表达、类别标签和有害性标签；设计三个任务：含义解释、跨语言等价匹配、文化情境有害性检测；在英文和中文提示设置下评测代表性先进专有LLM与中文LLM。
AI.result: 实验显示LLM在中文网络流行语的跨语言理解上仍表现不佳，尤其在细粒度非字面解释、选项扰动下的稳健等价匹配以及校准有害性检测方面存在明显困难。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现表明，文化根植型语言现象对多语言LLM和面向安全的评测构成持续挑战；数据集与代码已公开。

title: Per-Aetiology Contrastive Severity Embeddings with Phonological Pseudo-Labelling for Multilingual Dysarthric Speech
comment: Accepted at IEEE SLT 2026, 13-16 December 2026, Palermo, Sicily
summary: Most multilingual dysarthria-severity systems either train on a single aetiology-language pair or pool heterogeneous aetiologies into one label space. We test that pooling assumption with four matched HuBERT-base contrastive embedding models under a shared backbone, training recipe, corpus registry and held-out evaluation: one mixed-aetiology baseline and three aetiology-specific models for cerebral palsy (CP), Parkinson's disease (PD) and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Training combines clinically labelled speech with ordinal pseudo-labels from a training-free phonological profiling method [1], [2]. On speaker-disjoint, leakage-filtered held-out subsets, the per-aetiology models outperform the mixed baseline across all three target aetiologies: CP (macro F1 0.829 vs 0.676, +22.6 % relative), PD (0.715 vs 0.511, +40.0 %) and ALS (0.788 vs 0.596, +32.3 %). On CP, adding 144 SAP and 44 CDSD pseudo-labelled speakers lifts macro F1 from 0.786 to 0.829 over a clinical-only CP model (+4.3 percentage points). Training data span three to seven languages per aetiology. We position this as a controlled comparison of label-space design choices and discuss pseudo-label calibration, split hygiene, and confidence-thresholded deployment as important limitations for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了混合病因与病因特异性标签空间对多语言构音障碍严重程度识别的影响，发现按病因分别建模普遍优于混合建模。
AI.motivation: 现有多语言构音障碍严重程度系统多采用单一病因-语言对训练，或将异质病因合并到同一标签空间；作者希望检验这种合并假设是否合理。
AI.method: 在共享 HuBERT-base 主干、训练流程、语料注册和留出评估下，训练四个匹配的对比嵌入模型：一个混合病因基线，以及脑瘫（CP）、帕金森病（PD）和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）三个病因特异性模型。训练结合临床标注语音与无需训练的语音学画像方法生成的序数伪标签，并在说话人分离、去泄漏的留出子集上评估。
AI.result: 病因特异性模型在三个目标病因上均优于混合基线：CP 宏 F1 0.829 对 0.676（相对提升 22.6%），PD 0.715 对 0.511（+40.0%），ALS 0.788 对 0.596（+32.3%）。在 CP 上，额外加入 144 名 SAP 和 44 名 CDSD 伪标签说话人后，宏 F1 从 0.786 提升到 0.829（+4.3 个百分点）。每种病因的训练数据涵盖 3 至 7 种语言。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将结果定位为对标签空间设计选择的受控比较，并指出伪标签校准、数据划分卫生以及基于置信度阈值的部署是未来工作的重要局限。

title: SignGPT: Toward LLM-Mediated Sign Language Interaction through Gloss-Free Translation and Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) provide limited support for sign language interaction. Unifying sign language translation (SLT) and generation (SLG) to enable sign language as both input and output can reduce switching between separate models during sign-text interaction. We present SignGPT, a unified, pose-based framework for gloss-free SLT and SLG. SignGPT integrates part-aware hierarchical representations of body, hand, and facial motion into a shared language model and employs asymmetric multi-token prediction and progressive training for bidirectional modeling. We evaluate SignGPT on How2Sign (ASL) and Phoenix-2014T (DGS) through benchmark comparisons, qualitative analyses, and component ablations. An exploratory study with 12 Deaf ASL signers assesses an LLM-mediated sign-to-sign response pipeline, highlighting the potential of unified modeling to support sign language conversation (SLC).

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SignGPT，一个统一的、基于姿态的无 gloss 手语翻译与生成框架，可将手语同时作为输入和输出，并在 ASL 和 DGS 数据集上评估，探索其支持手语对话的潜力。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型对手语交互支持有限，手语翻译与生成通常依赖分离模型，导致手语-文本交互中频繁切换模型。研究希望统一手语翻译与生成，减少模型切换，推动手语对话应用。
AI.method: SignGPT 将身体、手部和面部运动的部位感知分层表示整合到共享语言模型中，采用非对称多 token 预测和渐进式训练进行双向建模，实现无 gloss 的手语翻译和生成。
AI.result: 在 How2Sign（ASL）和 Phoenix-2014T（DGS）上进行基准比较、定性分析和组件消融；并用 12 名聋人 ASL 手语者进行探索性研究，评估 LLM 介导的手语到手语响应流程。
AI.conclusion: 统一建模在支持手语翻译与生成方面具有效果，并展现出支持手语对话的潜力。

title: Balanced Prompt Adaptation against Entropy-Induced Collapse for Test-Time Binary Segmentation
summary: Entropy minimization is a standard objective for test-time adaptation (TTA), but it can fail in imbalanced binary segmentation. Unlike image classification, dense segmentation aggregates thousands of pixel predictions, allowing the larger predicted class to dominate the update, pull minority predictions toward itself, and produce a degenerate mask as predictions saturate and their entropy gradients vanish. We theoretically establish this collapse in a shared-shift model. This analysis motivates Balanced-Anchor Prompt Adaptation (BAPA), which combines two complementary modules. The Class-Balanced Anchors (CBA) module selects high-confidence anchors separately from each predicted class and gives foreground and background equal total loss weight, preventing the larger region from dominating the update. Dynamic Prompt Adaptation (DPA) refreshes these anchors after each prediction update and optimizes only text-side prompt residuals while keeping the vision-language encoders frozen. This prompt-only update refines the foreground-background decision boundary without altering the pretrained dense visual representation. Across experiments from four domains, BAPA achieves the highest mean Dice among the evaluated methods. Factorized ablations further validate the complementary roles of CBA and DPA, supporting balanced prompt adaptation as an effective alternative to entropy minimization for test-time binary segmentation.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对测试时自适应中熵最小化在类别不平衡二值分割任务中容易崩溃的问题，提出了 Balanced-Anchor Prompt Adaptation（BAPA）方法，并在多个领域取得最高平均 Dice。
AI.motivation: 熵最小化是测试时自适应的常用目标，但在不平衡二值分割中，大量像素预测会让较大预测类主导更新，把少数类预测拉向自身，最终导致掩码退化且熵梯度消失。
AI.method: 论文在共享偏移模型下从理论上分析了这种崩溃现象，并提出 BAPA。BAPA 包含两个互补模块：Class-Balanced Anchors（CBA）分别从每个预测类中选择高置信锚点，并给前景和背景相同总损失权重；Dynamic Prompt Adaptation（DPA）在每次预测更新后刷新锚点，仅优化文本侧 prompt 残差，同时冻结视觉语言编码器。
AI.result: 在四个领域的实验中，BAPA 在评估方法中取得了最高平均 Dice。因子消融实验进一步验证了 CBA 和 DPA 的互补作用。
AI.conclusion: 平衡的 prompt 自适应可以作为测试时二值分割中熵最小化的有效替代方案。

title: Diffusion-Based Tumor Inpainting for Renal Segmentation under Clinical Data Scarcity
summary: Deep learning segmentation of renal tumors requires large annotated datasets, yet clinical deployments typically offer only a handful of tumor-positive cases from the target site. We propose a diffusion-based inpainting framework that synthesizes anatomically plausible renal tumors within healthy CT scans, requiring no additional annotation, and provide the first systematic comparison of 2D, 2.5D, and full 3D (MAISI) synthesis strategies for this task. Training the diffusion model on public data (KiTS23, KIRC) and evaluating nnU-Net segmentation on a internal cohort across three low-data regimes, we find that 2.5D and 3D augmentation substantially reduce false positives (from $\sim$18--20\% to $\sim$3--6\%) while maintaining Dice, whereas 2D provides no consistent benefit. Crucially, the proposed 2.5D method matches full 3D synthesis on every metric at substantially lower computational cost, indicating that local volumetric consistency alone is sufficient for effective augmentation in data- and resource-scarce clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 提出基于扩散修复的肾脏肿瘤合成框架，在健康CT中生成解剖合理的肿瘤，无需额外标注；并首次系统比较2D、2.5D与全3D合成策略用于低数据肾脏肿瘤分割。
AI.motivation: 深度学习肾脏肿瘤分割依赖大规模标注数据，但临床部署中目标站点通常只有少量肿瘤阳性病例。
AI.method: 使用扩散模型在公开数据KiTS23和KIRC上训练，在健康CT中合成肿瘤；在内部队列的三种低数据设置下，用nnU-Net评估2D、2.5D和全3D（MAISI）合成增强策略。
AI.result: 2.5D和3D增强将假阳性从约18-20%显著降至约3-6%，同时保持Dice；2D无一致收益；2.5D在所有指标上匹配全3D且计算成本显著更低。
AI.conclusion: 局部体积一致性已足以实现有效数据增强，适合数据和资源稀缺的临床场景。

title: Outcome-Conditioned End-Effector Geometry Across Vision-Language-Action Policies
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables, 23 references. Submitted to ICRA 2027
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies solve the same manipulation task through different action interfaces, but task success alone does not establish whether their physical executions agree. We study cross-policy end-effector geometry in 15,000 closed-loop LIBERO rollouts from four policies. The primary clean-condition analysis forms 3,600 configuration-matched, and therefore dependent, policy pairs. Both-success pairs have a median normalized dynamic time warping distance of 0.0120 m versus 0.0380 m when exactly one policy succeeds. This ordering holds in every task, every policy pair, and nine sampling and band-limited representations; however, the ratio varies severalfold across representations, so we report the direction rather than a fixed multiple. Both-failure pairs are more separated again but rest on thin, uneven support, so we report them as exploratory. Within successful executions, partner replacements separate more across tasks than across initial states. A matched baseline still reveals measurable, heterogeneous residual policy differences, so a low cross-policy distance does not imply interchangeability. Successful executions sit about as far from same-task demonstrations as those demonstrations sit from each other, compatible with task-associated geometry without separating training-data overlap from task constraints. A common 72-action window preserves the ordering but reduces its magnitude; endpoint and duration adjustment likewise leaves a positive mixed-outcome coefficient relative to both-success pairs, though its magnitude is specification-dependent. Under composite visual stress, policy rankings and pair composition change together.

AI.tldr: 本文研究不同视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在相同操作任务中的末端执行器几何一致性，通过15,000次LIBERO闭环rollout比较跨策略轨迹距离，并检验成功等级、任务、表示和扰动等因素下的差异。
AI.motivation: 仅用任务成功率无法判断采用不同动作接口的VLA策略是否产生一致的物理执行，因此需要分析跨策略末端执行器轨迹几何。
AI.method: 使用四个策略在LIBERO中生成15,000次闭环rollout；主分析构建3,600个配置匹配且相互依赖的策略对；计算归一化动态时间规整距离；在任务、策略对、九种采样与带限表示、72步窗口、端点与时长调整及复合视觉压力下比较。
AI.result: 双成功策略对的中位归一化DTW距离为0.0120 m，而仅一方成功时为0.0380 m；该排序在所有任务、策略对和九种表示中成立，但比值随表示变化数倍，故报告方向而非固定倍数。双失败对分离更大但样本支持薄弱，仅作探索性结果。成功执行中，替换伙伴造成的差异大于不同初始状态；匹配基线仍显示可测且异质的残余策略差异；成功执行与同任务演示的距离约等于演示彼此距离；72步窗口保持排序但降低幅度；复合视觉压力下策略排名与配对组成同时变化。
AI.conclusion: 低跨策略距离并不代表策略可互换；成功执行呈现任务相关几何，但仍无法区分训练数据重叠与任务约束的贡献，且视觉压力会改变策略比较结果。

title: RheoSampling: Resolving the One-Hot Dilemma in Stochastic Dynamic-Tree Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by drafting multiple tokens in parallel, with tree-based methods further improving efficiency through hierarchical structures. Dynamic-tree methods such as EAGLE-3 perform well under greedy decoding via deterministic top-K expansion and global pruning. However, in stochastic decoding (T>0), this mechanism collapses the draft distribution into one-hot probabilities, causing a severe drop in acceptance rate. This creates a dilemma: dynamic-tree methods sacrifice stochastic sampling to preserve context-aware topology, while static-tree methods preserve stochastic sampling with context-agnostic structures. The issue arises because the same probability distribution is used for two conflicting tasks: constructing the tree and verifying tokens. This coupling makes direct injection of randomness challenging due to the resulting stochastic process. We resolve this by decoupling these roles: RheoSampling assigns a token sampled from the draft distribution a proxy probability for tree expansion and pruning alongside its true sampling probability for verification. Specifically, we inject a sampled token among the deterministic top-K slots and treat it with different probabilities during construction and verification, making RheoSampling the first dynamic-tree method with both context-aware top-K construction and stochastic sampling while maintaining losslessness. We establish the lossless guarantee through an equivalence-class analysis that compresses the stochastic tree space into tractable classes. An OT-based verification strategy and a sparse draft mechanism ensure that theoretical gains translate into practical efficiency. Experiments across LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate improvements in acceptance rate and speedup over state-of-the-art dynamic tree methods. This framework may provide a template for analyzing stochastic tree structures.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RheoSampling，通过解耦动态树推测解码中树构建与令牌验证的概率角色，使动态树方法在随机采样下仍保持无损，并提升接受率与加速比。
AI.motivation: 动态树方法（如 EAGLE-3）在贪心解码中表现良好，但在随机解码（T>0）时，确定性 top-K 扩展和全局剪枝会将草稿分布坍缩为 one-hot，导致接受率严重下降。动态树牺牲随机采样以保留上下文感知拓扑，静态树则保留随机采样但结构上下文无关。问题根源在于同一概率分布被同时用于建树和验证，二者目标冲突，直接注入随机性困难。
AI.method: RheoSampling 解耦两个角色：对从草稿分布采样的令牌，分配代理概率用于树扩展和剪枝，同时保留其真实采样概率用于验证；将采样令牌注入确定性 top-K 槽位，并在构建与验证阶段使用不同概率。通过等价类分析将随机树空间压缩为可处理类别，证明无损性；并采用基于最优传输（OT）的验证策略和稀疏草稿机制提升实际效率。
AI.result: 实验跨多个 LLM 和基准测试表明，RheoSampling 相比最先进的动态树方法在接受率和加速比上均有提升。它是首个同时具备上下文感知 top-K 构建和随机采样且保持无损的动态树方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，解耦树构建与验证的概率角色可让动态树推测解码在随机采样下保持无损并实现高效加速，同时为分析随机树结构提供了通用模板。

title: Skel-WAM: A Hand-Skeleton-Conditioned World Action Model for Human-to-Robot Manipulation Transfer
summary: Robot demonstrations are expensive to collect and often provide limited distributional coverage of task variations. Human videos offer a low-cost source of complementary manipulation experience, but learning from them requires bridging embodiment gaps in visual appearance and action spaces. We introduce Skel-WAM, a world action model that bridges these differences through a unified hand-skeleton motion interface. The key insight is to align human and robot motion through a common hand topology, combining skeleton overlays that ground motion in the scene with structured 2.5-D keypoints that encode explicit hand kinematics. Video and Keypoint Experts jointly learn visual and skeletal dynamics through a Mixture-of-Transformers, while a separate robot-trained Action Expert maps these predictions to executable controls. This separation enables human and robot demonstrations to directly supervise shared dynamics without requiring robot action labels for human videos. Across four real-world bimanual tasks and seven simulated tasks, Skel-WAM achieves average success rates of 79.86% and 63.29%, surpassing the strongest baseline by 22.22 and 8.28 percentage points, respectively. Human-robot cotraining more than doubles real-world success on task variations absent from robot training data, from 38.89% to 86.11%. These results demonstrate that a shared skeletal interface enables joint learning across human and robot data and expands robot task coverage through complementary human demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 提出Skel-WAM世界动作模型，通过统一手部骨骼运动接口桥接人类视频与机器人演示，实现人机数据协同训练并提升操作任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人演示采集成本高且任务变化覆盖有限；人类视频是低成本补充经验，但存在视觉外观和动作空间上的具身差距，难以直接用于机器人学习。
AI.method: Skel-WAM以统一手部拓扑对齐人和机器人运动，结合骨骼叠加将运动定位到场景，并用结构化2.5D关键点编码手部运动学；Video与Keypoint Experts通过Mixture-of-Transformers联合学习视觉和骨骼动力学，独立的机器人训练Action Expert将预测映射为可执行控制，使人类视频无需机器人动作标签即可监督共享动力学。
AI.result: 在4个真实双臂任务和7个仿真任务上，平均成功率达79.86%和63.29%，分别超过最强基线22.22和8.28个百分点；人机协同训练使机器人训练数据未覆盖任务变体的真实世界成功率从38.89%提升至86.11%，提升超过一倍。
AI.conclusion: 共享骨骼接口能够实现人类与机器人数据的联合学习，并利用互补的人类演示扩展机器人任务覆盖范围。

title: Reusing Latent Speech Representations for Query-Conditioned Topic Localization in Transcripts
summary: Long transcripts are costly inputs for downstream NLP systems and often contain irrelevant context. We study query-conditioned topic localization: predicting the sentence span in a transcript that best addresses a topic-title query. To improve span localization, we reuse ASR encoder states as sentence-level representations and fuse them with textual embeddings. This lets lightweight span locators exploit speech information without running a separate audio encoder. Experiments on two public datasets show consistent gains over text-only baselines, especially under strict boundary-matching criteria. Cross-dataset experiments further indicate that the benefits are strongest for structured or semi-structured speech, while gains on spontaneous speech are limited and mixed.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究查询条件下的主题定位任务，即在长转录文本中预测最能回答主题标题查询的句子跨度。方法复用ASR编码器状态作为句子级表示，并与文本嵌入融合，从而在不额外运行音频编码器的情况下利用语音信息。
AI.motivation: 长转录文本作为下游NLP系统输入成本高，且常包含无关上下文，因此需要更高效地定位与查询相关的句子跨度。
AI.method: 提出查询条件下的主题定位任务，预测转录文本中应对主题标题查询的句子跨度；复用ASR编码器状态作为句子级表示，并与文本嵌入融合，使轻量级跨度定位器能够利用语音信息而无需单独运行音频编码器。
AI.result: 在两个公开数据集上，该方法相比纯文本基线取得一致提升，在严格边界匹配标准下尤为明显。跨数据集实验表明，结构化或半结构化语音受益最大，而自发语音上的提升有限且结果混合。
AI.conclusion: 通过复用ASR编码器状态融合语音与文本表示，可有效提升查询条件下的主题定位，尤其适用于结构化或半结构化语音；对自发语音的泛化收益仍有限。

title: DPed-VLN: A Benchmark for Socially Compliant Vision-and-Language Navigation in Dynamic Pedestrian Environments
summary: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) has advanced rapidly in static indoor environments, but robots operating in human-populated spaces must ground language while responding to moving pedestrians and social-safety constraints. We present DPed-VLN, a Habitat 3.0 benchmark for dynamic-pedestrian VLN that couples 33,093 navigation episodes with paired global and prior-augmented instructions, ORCA-controlled humanoid pedestrians, socially constrained expert paths, and metrics that jointly assess navigation efficiency and social safety. DPed-VLN separates ordinary goal-oriented route guidance from prior-augmented instructions that expose dynamic-pedestrian cues for controlled analysis. To instantiate the benchmark, we introduce DPet (Dynamic Pedestrian-aware Network), a pedestrian-aware policy network trained with reinforcement learning and imitation learning. We further adapt representative state-of-the-art VLM-based navigation models, including NaVILA and StreamVLN, to DPed-VLN through LoRA fine-tuning. Experiments show that LoRA adaptation improves zero-shot VLM baselines in several success and safety metrics, especially reducing StreamVLN's collision rate. Among the evaluated methods, DPet-RL achieves the highest SR, SPL, and STL.

AI.tldr: 提出DPed-VLN动态行人视觉语言导航基准，包含33,093个导航回合、配对指令、ORCA行人、社交安全指标，并引入DPet网络和LoRA适配VLM模型；DPet-RL在SR、SPL、STL上最优。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言导航在静态室内环境进展快，但真实机器人需在有人群动态环境中理解语言并响应移动行人及社会安全约束，缺少相应基准。
AI.method: 构建基于Habitat 3.0的DPed-VLN基准，含33,093个导航回合、全局与先验增强配对指令、ORCA控制人形行人、社会约束专家路径及联合评估指标；提出DPet行人感知策略网络，用强化学习和模仿学习训练；通过LoRA微调将NaVILA、StreamVLN等VLM导航模型适配到该基准。
AI.result: LoRA适配在多个成功与安全指标上提升零样本VLM基线，尤其降低StreamVLN碰撞率；所有评估方法中DPet-RL取得最高SR、SPL和STL。
AI.conclusion: DPed-VLN为动态行人视觉语言导航提供可控基准，DPet-RL表现最佳，LoRA微调可有效适配VLM模型，推动社交安全导航研究。

title: SABER: Learning Attention-based Semantic Affordance for Legged Locomotion
summary: Perceptive legged locomotion has advanced rapidly by integrating terrain geometry into learned policies, yet the integration of terrain meaning remains sparse: a pipe, a patch of grass, or a fragile box may be geometrically traversable while being inappropriate for contact. In industrial environments, where legged robots increasingly operate, a single misplaced step can damage fragile equipment, destabilize the robot, or endanger the site. To address this, we introduce SABER, a planner-free reinforcement-learning policy that jointly reasons about terrain geometry and semantic contact permission. The policy consumes a unified terrain-affordance map, where each cell encodes local 3D geometry and a semantic contact cost. We augment cross-attention with a learned, signed semantic bias: an additive term on the attention logits, gated by the contact cost, that reweights flagged cells by their distance from the nearest foot. A hazard therefore reshapes attention where it can still affect the next foothold, and its influence fades where it cannot. The resulting policy selects footholds on permitted support and keeps the leg clear of forbidden regions throughout the swing phase. We perform a systematic ablation that isolates the contribution of each architectural component; removing the semantic bias alone increases forbidden contacts by 55% while velocity tracking is unchanged. We validate the policy on a Unitree B2, demonstrating sim-to-real semantic contact selection across indoor and outdoor environments and four semantic obstacle classes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SABER，一种无规划器的强化学习策略，将地形几何与语义接触许可联合推理，使四足机器人能在工业环境中避免踩踏脆弱或禁止接触的物体。
AI.motivation: 现有感知型四足运动虽已融入地形几何，但缺乏对地形语义的理解。管道、草地或脆弱箱子可能几何上可通行，却不适合接触；误踩可能导致设备损坏、机器人失稳或场地危险。
AI.method: SABER使用统一的地形可供性地图，每个网格同时编码局部3D几何和语义接触代价。策略在交叉注意力中加入可学习的带符号语义偏置：该偏置加在注意力logits上，并由接触代价门控，根据离最近足端的距离重新加权被标记网格。危险区域只在能影响下一步落脚点时改变注意力，影响随距离衰减。
AI.result: 消融实验表明，仅移除语义偏置就会使禁止接触增加55%，而速度跟踪性能不变。在Unitree B2上验证，实现了室内外环境及四类语义障碍的仿真到现实语义接触选择。
AI.conclusion: 联合几何与语义接触许可可使四足机器人选择允许支撑的落脚点，并在摆动阶段避开禁区，从而提升工业场景中的安全性和语义感知运动能力。

title: ForceTwin: Physics-informed Digital Twins for Robotic Manipulation from Instrumented Human Interaction
summary: Manipulating objects requires understanding not only their motion, but also the physical properties that determine it. For articulated objects, these include inertia, friction, and mechanisms such as springs or door closers, whose effects can vary with configuration and velocity. Such properties are not directly observable from appearance: visually identical doors may require very different effort to manipulate. Existing digital-twin pipelines recover primarily kinematics or assign static physical parameters from visual and language priors, which can yield physically implausible estimates. As a result, state-dependent mechanism dynamics remain unidentified and are not represented in standard asset formats. We present ForceTwin, a system for identifying physics-informed digital twins of articulated objects from instrumented human interaction. A person probes an object using a handheld force-sensing gripper, providing synchronized poses and interaction forces from which we estimate the articulation, parametric dynamics including inertia, Coulomb friction, viscous damping, and a structured neural residual capturing state-dependent mechanism forces. ForceTwin nearly halves the inertial-parameter error of a VLM prior. As a feedforward dynamics model for impedance control on a Spot and a Franka FR3, ForceTwin achieves 87% goal completion across nine object-embodiment pairs, compared with 60% using VLM-prior and 57% using kinematics-only twins, with the largest gains on objects whose strong mechanisms cause both baselines to stall. We further use the identified twins to train whole-body door-traversal policies and deploy them in the real world. Project Page: https://timengelbracht.github.io/forcetwin-website/

AI.tldr: ForceTwin 通过手持力传感夹爪采集人类交互中的位姿与力，识别包含惯性、摩擦、阻尼及状态相关机构力的物理信息数字孪生，并用于机器人阻抗控制与开门策略。
AI.motivation: 操作铰接物体需要理解惯性、摩擦、弹簧/闭门器等物理属性，但这些属性无法仅从外观获知；现有数字孪生流程主要恢复运动学或依赖视觉语言先验设定静态物理参数，导致估计不合理且无法建模状态相关机构动力学。
AI.method: 使用带力传感的手持夹爪让人探测物体，获取同步位姿和交互力；估计铰接结构、参数化动力学（惯性、库仑摩擦、粘性阻尼）以及一个结构化神经残差，用于捕捉状态相关的机构力。
AI.result: 相比 VLM 先验，ForceTwin 将近乎减半惯性参数误差；作为 Spot 和 Franka FR3 阻抗控制的前馈动力学模型，在九种物体-本体组合上达到 87% 目标完成率，而 VLM 先验为 60%、仅运动学孪生为 57%，在强机构物体上提升最大。
AI.conclusion: 基于力交互识别的物理信息数字孪生能更准确表示铰接物体动力学，显著提升机器人操作性能，并可进一步训练全身开门穿越策略并部署到真实世界。

title: ZYT-World: A Real-Time Controllable World Model for Closed-Loop Autonomous-Driving Simulation
comment: Technical Report. Videos and additional results are available at zyt-aim.github.io/ZYT-World
summary: Generative world models offer controllable and repeatable closed-loop simulation for end-to-end and vision-language-action driving policies, but production deployment exposes three unresolved requirements: faithfully reproducing a mixed fisheye-pinhole rig at native resolutions; reconciling causal, per-timestep interaction with long-horizon stability and low latency; and preserving scene identity when a location is revisited. We present ZYT-World, a single architecture that natively generates four fisheye views with field of view > 180° and three pinhole views. Projection-specific Plucker adapters encode camera geometry, ego-motion adaptive layer normalization provides global motion control, and a lightweight pixel-aligned layout conditions traffic participants and signals through instance-level boxes, headings and colors. Heterogeneous training combines full-rig geometric coverage with high-resolution detail. Teacher forcing, causal consistency distillation, self-rollout distribution matching distillation, and RigCritic transform a 40-step bidirectional teacher into a one-step, per-latent streaming generator, with RigCritic evaluating the seven-view rig jointly. A 19M-parameter variational autoencoder decoder (TinyVAE), W8A8 quantization, and our inference engine reduce decoding, backbone, and incremental-execution costs, respectively. Finally, cross-trajectory pairs derived from real captures train a plug-in implicit-memory module that preserves place-specific evidence. On the internal multi-view test set, the one-step model retains more than 90% of the teacher's PSNR and SSIM, while FID, FVD, and LPIPS stay within 11% of the teacher. Under the generator-only timing in Figure 2, it is 107.7 times faster than the 40-step bidirectional teacher. TinyVAE decodes 59.8 times faster than Wan. 30s rollouts and cross-trajectory revisits show the intended long-horizon and memory behavior.

AI.tldr: ZYT-World 是一个面向生产部署的生成式世界模型，可原生生成混合鱼眼-针孔多相机视图，并通过一步流式生成、长时稳定与隐式记忆机制支持闭环仿真。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式世界模型在生产部署中面临三个未解决问题：在原生分辨率下忠实复现混合鱼眼-针孔相机系统；同时满足因果逐步交互、长时稳定和低延迟；以及在重访同一地点时保持场景身份。
AI.method: 提出单一架构 ZYT-World，原生生成四个视场角大于180°的鱼眼视图和三个针孔视图。使用投影特定的 Plucker 适配器编码相机几何，自车运动自适应层归一化提供全局运动控制，轻量像素对齐布局通过实例框、朝向和颜色条件化交通参与者与信号。采用异构训练结合全 rig 几何覆盖与高分辨率细节。通过教师强制、因果一致性蒸馏、自 rollout 分布匹配蒸馏和 RigCritic，将40步双向教师模型转化为一步、按潜变量流式的生成器，并由 RigCritic 联合评估七视图 rig。引入19M参数 TinyVAE 解码器、W8A8 量化和推理引擎降低解码、骨干和增量执行成本。最后，用真实采集的跨轨迹对训练插件式隐式记忆模块以保留地点特定证据。
AI.result: 在内部多视图测试集上，一步模型保留教师模型超过90%的 PSNR 和 SSIM，FID、FVD 和 LPIPS 保持在教师模型的11%以内。按图2的仅生成器计时，比40步双向教师模型快107.7倍。TinyVAE 解码比 Wan 快59.8倍。30秒 rollout 和跨轨迹重访展示了预期的长时程和记忆行为。
AI.conclusion: ZYT-World 通过一体化架构、蒸馏流式生成、量化与推理优化以及隐式记忆模块，实现了高效的原生多视图生成，并满足长时稳定、低延迟和重访场景身份保持的生产部署需求。

title: Do Personality-Tuned LLMs Make Better Social Agents?
summary: LLMs are increasingly used in social simulations for socially interactive agents and robots, offering more flexibility than rule-based systems. However, even though they mimic human behaviour very well, there is a persistent alienness to them. This work investigates whether personality-aware fine-tuning can reduce this gap by improving the consistency and controllability of personality-conditioned dialogue generation compared with instruction prompting alone. We fine-tune two small open-weight LLMs, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Ministral-8B-Instruct, using a corpus that combines personality-labelled social media posts and dialogues to create a personality-based dialogue engine for social simulation. The resulting models are evaluated across multiple social interaction scenarios using three independent LLM judges, which assess personality fidelity and provide evidence-based behavioral interpretations. We additionally quantify inter-rater agreement and lexical characteristics of the generated dialogue. Results indicate that fine-tuned models are not better at role-playing different personalities than their respective baseline models. However, low inter-rater agreement limits the confidence with which these results can be interpreted. Concerning the quality of generated texts, fine-tuned models are mostly comparable to the baselines, with fine-tuning improving the linguistic diversity of the Qwen models. While the results appear generally usable and the baseline models offer the best overall performance, future studies should place greater emphasis on the quality and domain alignment of training data for accurate personality role-playing.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨人格感知微调能否缩小LLM在社交模拟中与人类行为的疏离感，通过微调Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Ministral-8B-Instruct，比较其与指令提示在人格条件对话生成上的一致性、可控性和角色扮演表现。
AI.motivation: LLM increasingly用于社交互动代理和机器人社交模拟，虽能模仿人类行为，但仍存在持久的“异类感”。研究希望验证人格感知微调是否能优于单纯指令提示，提升人格条件对话的一致性与可控性，从而减少这一差距。
AI.method: 使用结合人格标签社交媒体帖子和对话的语料，对两个小型开放权重LLM（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Ministral-8B-Instruct）进行人格感知微调，构建面向社交模拟的人格对话引擎。随后在多个社交互动场景中，用三个独立LLM评判者评估人格保真度并提供基于证据的行为解释，同时量化评分者间一致性和生成对话的词汇特征。
AI.result: 微调模型在扮演不同人格方面并不优于各自的基线模型；但评分者间一致性较低，限制了结论的可信度。生成文本质量上，微调模型大多与基线相当，其中微调提升了Qwen模型的语言多样性。总体而言结果看似可用，但基线模型表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 人格感知微调未能证明可稳定提升人格角色扮演效果，且评估一致性不足。未来研究应更重视训练数据的质量与领域对齐，以实现准确的人格角色扮演。

title: SFVO: Decoupled Confidence-Guided Stereo-Flow Visual Odometry with Bidirectional PnP
summary: Deep learning-based visual odometry (VO) has achieved significant progress, yet most existing methods focus on a monocular approach, which suffers from scale ambiguity. Stereo VO provides real metric by its nature, but remains less studied in deep learning VO due to its high computational cost and modeling complexity. Recent advances in stereo matching and optical flow estimation have made dense visual correspondence increasingly accurate and reliable, but their complementary geometric information has not been fully exploited for VO. In this paper, we present SFVO, a correspondence-driven stereo VO framework that directly builds upon pretrained stereo matching and optical flow models. SFVO exploits pretrained stereo matching and optical flow models to estimate stereo and temporal correspondences. Instead of learning pose directly from images, SFVO maps learned correspondences into geometric constraints and predicts which points are trustworthy. To improve the reliability of visual correspondence-based geometric constraints, we introduce decoupled confidence maps for rotation and translation. This design better aligns the characteristics of visual correspondence and 6-DoF transformations. Extensive experiments on outdoor and indoor datasets demonstrate that SFVO achieves robust and accurate pose estimation with strong generalization capability. The code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出SFVO，一个对应关系驱动的双目视觉里程计框架，基于预训练双目匹配和光流模型，将对应关系转化为几何约束并预测可信点，引入旋转与平移解耦置信图，在室内外数据集上实现鲁棒准确的位姿估计。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习视觉里程计多采用单目方法，存在尺度模糊；双目视觉里程计天然提供真实尺度，但因计算成本高和建模复杂而研究较少。同时，预训练双目匹配与光流模型已能提供稠密可靠对应，其互补几何信息在视觉里程计中尚未被充分利用。
AI.method: SFVO利用预训练双目匹配和光流模型估计双目及时间对应关系；不直接从图像学习位姿，而是将学习到的对应关系映射为几何约束，并预测哪些点可信。为提升基于视觉对应几何约束的可靠性，引入分别针对旋转和平移的解耦置信图，以更好匹配视觉对应与6自由度变换特性。
AI.result: 在室外和室内数据集上的大量实验表明，SFVO能够实现鲁棒且准确的位姿估计，并具有较强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: SFVO表明，通过对应关系驱动、几何约束建模以及旋转和平移解耦置信度设计，可有效提升双目深度视觉里程计的可靠性、精度和泛化能力，为双目视觉里程计提供了一种有效框架。

title: Benchmarking the Explanatory Quality of Open-Weight Vision-Language Models in Face Recognition
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have recently been proposed as promising tools for face recognition, as they can produce natural language explanations alongside similarity scores. This capability is considered appealing for face comparisons in forensic contexts, which require decisions to be transparent and auditable. However, existing evaluations of VLMs for that use case focus mostly on recognition accuracy, while the validity of generated explanations remains unquantified. In this work, we introduce a benchmarking framework for VLM-based face recognition that treats explanation quality as a core evaluation axis. We propose two criteria that explanations should satisfy: relevance, i.e., reliance on identity-stable facial features; and faithfulness, i.e., alignment with the visible image content without hallucinated features. We jointly develop a methodology enabling the quantification of relevance and faithfulness of evaluated models, based on constraining model outputs to a structured explanation format that supports automated querying and auditing. Using this framework, we benchmark several families of open-weight VLMs, jointly evaluating face verification accuracy and explanation quality. Our results highlight remaining shortcomings of produced explanations, and emphasize the need for such explanation quality metrics to get a complete picture of model performance. The proposed benchmark and open-source evaluation harness provide a foundation for proper benchmarking and future fine-tuning of explainable face recognition systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向视觉语言模型（VLM）人脸识别的基准框架，将解释质量作为核心评价维度，并联合评估人脸验证准确率与解释质量。
AI.motivation: VLM 可用于人脸识别并生成自然语言解释，这对需要透明与可审计的司法场景很有吸引力，但现有评估多关注识别准确率，未量化生成解释的有效性。
AI.method: 提出解释应满足的两个标准：相关性（依赖身份稳定的面部特征）和忠实性（与可见图像内容一致、无幻觉特征）；设计结构化解释格式以支持自动化查询与审计，并基于此量化评估多个开放权重 VLM 家族的人脸验证准确率与解释质量。
AI.result: 基准测试显示，当前 VLM 生成的解释仍存在不足，仅看识别准确率无法全面反映模型性能，解释质量指标十分必要。
AI.conclusion: 该基准与开源评估工具为可解释人脸识别系统的规范评测和后续微调提供了基础。

title: TrialAtlas: Multi-Agent Research Organization for Clinical Trial Design and Optimization
summary: Nearly 90% of drugs entering clinical development ultimately fail, despite billions of dollars in investment. Pharmaceutical companies therefore rely on clinical development planning (CDP) and probability of technical and regulatory success assessment to anticipate development risks, yet these decisions remain labor-intensive and subjective, requiring experts across clinical science, statistics, regulatory affairs, and competitive intelligence to jointly acquire, synthesize, and reason over heterogeneous evidence. Here, we introduce TrialAtlas, a memory-augmented multi-agent research organization for CDP that mirrors this collaborative process by coordinating specialized agents for literature synthesis, competitive trial intelligence, regulatory precedent analysis, and integrated reasoning over trial design and development risk. TrialAtlas further learns from historical clinical trials and regulatory outcomes, including prior New Drug Applications (NDAs), to ground its decisions in accumulated development experience. To evaluate these capabilities in an authentic regulatory setting, we introduce TrialAtlasBench, constructed from 291 FDA Complete Response Letters and spanning three practical tasks: detecting trial design deficiencies, recommending actionable design improvements, and predicting technical and regulatory success. TrialAtlas achieves an F1 score of 50.0% for deficiency detection, outperforming the strongest baseline by 6.1 points, and reaches 85.3% balanced accuracy and 84.7% F1 for prediction of technical and regulatory success, improving over the best baselines by 6.7 points in balanced accuracy and 12.0 points in Cohen's kappa. In expert evaluation, 86.4% of TrialAtlas-generated concerns were judged valid, compared with 83.1% for OpenAI DeepResearch and 59.3% for Gemini DeepResearch.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 TrialAtlas，一个记忆增强的多智能体研究组织，用于临床开发规划（CDP），通过协调文献合成、竞争试验情报、监管先例分析和综合推理等专门智能体，模拟专家协作过程，并基于历史临床试验和监管结果学习。论文同时构建了 TrialAtlasBench 基准，基于 291 份 FDA 完整回复函，评估试验设计缺陷检测、改进建议和技术与监管成功预测三项任务。
AI.motivation: 近 90% 进入临床开发的药物最终失败，尽管投入巨大。药企依赖 CDP 和成功概率评估来预判开发风险，但现有决策过程劳动密集且主观，需要临床科学、统计、监管事务和竞争情报等多领域专家共同获取、综合并推理异构证据。因此需要一种能模拟该协作过程、并利用历史开发经验辅助决策的方法。
AI.method: 提出 TrialAtlas，一个记忆增强的多智能体研究组织，协调面向文献合成、竞争试验情报、监管先例分析以及试验设计与开发风险综合推理的专门智能体。它从历史临床试验和监管结果（包括既往 NDA）中学习，以累积开发经验支撑决策。为评估，构建 TrialAtlasBench，基于 291 份 FDA Complete Response Letters，涵盖三项任务：检测试验设计缺陷、推荐可操作的设计改进、预测技术与监管成功。
AI.result: TrialAtlas 在缺陷检测上 F1 为 50.0%，比最强基线高 6.1 个百分点；在技术与监管成功预测上达到 85.3% 平衡准确率和 84.7% F1，分别比最佳基线提高 6.7 个百分点（平衡准确率）和 12.0 个百分点（Cohen's kappa）。专家评估中，TrialAtlas 生成关注点 86.4% 被判定有效，OpenAI DeepResearch 为 83.1%，Gemini DeepResearch 为 59.3%。
AI.conclusion: TrialAtlas 能有效模拟临床开发规划中的多专家协作与证据推理，在真实监管场景下的试验设计缺陷检测、改进建议和成功预测任务中优于强基线，且生成的关注点具有较高专家认可度。该工作展示了记忆增强多智能体系统在药物临床开发风险评估与监管决策支持中的潜力。

title: NemotronLabs VoiceChat: An Open Full-duplex Speech-to-Speech Model with Tool Calling Capabilities
summary: We introduce NemotronLabs VoiceChat, an open full-duplex speech-to-speech model with native tool-calling capabilities. NemotronLabs VoiceChat combines a streaming speech encoder and decoder-only language model with parallel specialized output streams for agent text and structured function calls, an auxiliary RNN-T branch for incremental user transcription, and a streaming TTS decoder. This design enables the model to listen, transcribe, reason, invoke tools, and speak within a unified streaming architecture while preserving the temporal behavior required for natural conversation. On Full-Duplex-Bench 1.0, NemotronLabs VoiceChat achieves the lowest pause-handling takeover rates among evaluated open-weight systems, 100\% takeover following user interruptions, and a 4.33/5 post-interruption response-quality score. On Full-Duplex-Bench 1.5, it resumes its response after user backchannels in 93\% of cases. NemotronLabs VoiceChat obtains a 55.1 normalized average on VoiceBench and, on Full-Duplex-Bench 3.0 (FDB 3.0), achieves 82.5\% tool-selection F1, while argument accuracy and end-to-end tool execution remain areas for improvement. These results demonstrate that full-duplex interaction, speech recognition and generation, general language capabilities, and external tool use can be integrated in a single open speech-to-speech model without sacrificing real-time conversational behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出 NemotronLabs VoiceChat，一个开源全双工语音到语音模型，原生支持工具调用，将流式语音编码器、仅解码器语言模型、并行文本与函数调用输出流、RNN-T 转录分支和流式 TTS 解码器统一在一个流式架构中。
AI.motivation: 现有语音对话系统难以同时实现自然全双工交互、实时语音识别与生成、语言推理以及外部工具调用；研究旨在不牺牲实时对话行为的前提下，将这些能力集成到单一开源语音到语音模型中。
AI.method: 采用流式语音编码器与仅解码器语言模型结合，设置面向 agent 文本和结构化函数调用的并行专用输出流，加入用于增量用户转录的辅助 RNN-T 分支，并使用流式 TTS 解码器，使模型能边听、边转录、边推理、调用工具并说话。
AI.result: 在 Full-Duplex-Bench 1.0 上取得所评估开源权重系统中最低的暂停处理接管率、用户打断后 100% 接管率，打断后回复质量 4.33/5；在 Full-Duplex-Bench 1.5 上 93% 情况下可在用户反馈后恢复回复；VoiceBench 归一化平均 55.1；Full-Duplex-Bench 3.0 工具选择 F1 为 82.5%，但参数准确率和端到端工具执行仍有改进空间。
AI.conclusion: 全双工交互、语音识别与生成、通用语言能力及外部工具使用可以集成在一个开源语音到语音模型中，同时保持实时对话行为。

title: A High-Payload Wall-Climbing Robot Using Passive Bistable Suction Cups
comment: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics & Automation (ICRA)
summary: Wall-climbing robots capable of scaling vertical surfaces could help automate hazardous or labor intensive tasks such as window washing, inspection, maintenance, and construction. Active adhesion methods achieve higher payload capacities, but require power to maintain their grip. Passive adhesion devices such as suction cups are an attractive option for such robots because they do not require power to maintain their grip, but they are limited by their payload capacity. This work presents a novel high-payload wall-climbing robot that utilizes passive bistable suction cups to generate adhesion without needing to be pushed into the wall. The robot features a track-based system that automatically engages and disengages bistable suction cups to achieve locomotion on smooth surfaces. The robot is able to achieve vertical wall climbing on glass, wood, metal, and painted surfaces, sideways and upside-down climbing, and is able to tow a payload of 7.940 kg (with a payload-to-weight ratio of 2.25).

AI.tldr: 提出一种高负载壁面爬行机器人，利用被动双稳态吸盘和轨道式自动接合/脱离机构，在无需持续供电维持吸附的情况下实现垂直、侧向和倒置爬行，并能拖动7.940 kg负载。
AI.motivation: 壁面爬行机器人可用于窗户清洗、检测、维护和建筑等危险或劳动密集任务；主动吸附负载高但需持续供能，被动吸盘无需供能维持吸附但负载能力有限。
AI.method: 采用被动双稳态吸盘产生吸附力，无需将其压向墙面；设计轨道式系统自动接合与脱离吸盘，实现光滑表面上的运动。
AI.result: 机器人可在玻璃、木材、金属和涂漆表面垂直爬壁，也可侧向和倒置爬行；可拖动7.940 kg负载，负载重量比为2.25。
AI.conclusion: 被动双稳态吸盘结合轨道式接合/脱离机构，可在不持续供能维持吸附的条件下实现高负载壁面爬行，为高危或劳动密集壁面作业提供有前景方案。

title: CounterPlay: Counterfactual Post-Training for Self-Play Driving Policies
summary: Self-play in high-throughput simulators yields driving policies with robust closed-loop performance, but improvement per unit of simulation diminishes as training scales. Policies learn to handle common situations early, while further rollouts repeatedly encounter unresolved failures. Post-training offers an opportunity to target these failures, but existing methods primarily evaluate alternative actions or continuations at visited states, although successful recovery may require changing driving style earlier. We propose CounterPlay, a counterfactual self-play post-training approach that backtracks from failed tasks and retries them under alternate driving styles. CounterPlay rests on three key components. First, failure-driven backtracking uses the policy's value estimates to select an earlier stored state from which to retry the task. Second, reward conditioning enables a single policy to retry the task from this state using candidate styles ranging from cautious to aggressive. Third, CounterPlay retains task-completing retries only if no other vehicle incurs a new or earlier collision or off-road event relative to the factual branch. Retries that pass verification with fresh randomness are then distilled into the policy under its deployment condition. On BehaviorBench, CounterPlay achieves state-of-the-art scores on both the Interactive and Random splits across all eight traffic regimes using 1B post-training transitions, which is just 1% of the anchor's 100B self-play training budget. Improvements over the anchor hold across all three evaluated driving styles. CounterPlay resolves a substantial fraction of the anchor's timeout cases on BehaviorBench and achieves a balance between task completion and safety that neither continued self-play nor adopting a more aggressive driving style attains.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CounterPlay，一种反事实自博弈后训练方法，通过从失败任务回溯并在不同驾驶风格下重试，以少量后训练数据显著提升自动驾驶策略性能。
AI.motivation: 高吞吐模拟器中的自博弈能产生闭环性能鲁棒的驾驶策略，但随着训练规模扩大，单位模拟带来的提升递减；策略早期学会常见场景，后续 rollout 反复遇到未解决的失败。现有后训练方法主要在已访问状态评估替代动作或延续，但成功恢复可能需要更早改变驾驶风格。
AI.method: CounterPlay 包含三个关键组件：1）失败驱动回溯，利用策略的价值估计选择更早的存储状态重试任务；2）奖励条件化，使单一策略能从此状态以谨慎到激进的候选风格重试；3）仅当其他车辆相对事实分支没有新增或更早的碰撞/偏离道路事件时，才保留完成任务的重试，并通过新鲜随机性验证后，在部署条件下蒸馏进策略。
AI.result: 在 BehaviorBench 上，CounterPlay 使用 10 亿后训练 transition（仅为基线 1000 亿自博弈预算的 1%）在 Interactive 和 Random 划分的全部八种交通场景中取得 SOTA 分数；改进在三种评估驾驶风格下均成立；解决了基线大量超时案例，并在任务完成与安全性之间取得平衡，优于持续自博弈或采用更激进驾驶风格。
AI.conclusion: 从失败中回溯并以反事实驾驶风格重试，再经安全验证与蒸馏，是一种高效的后训练策略，能在极低模拟预算下提升闭环驾驶性能并改善完成与安全的权衡。

title: Beyond Benchmark Scores: Auditing Medical Vision-Language Models for Chest X-Ray Tuberculosis Screening
comment: 27 pages, 7 figures, and 21 tables; includes extended methods, statistical analyses, and robustness evaluations
summary: A medical model's benchmark score does not establish that the same conclusion holds under a different evaluation. This study tests whether claims about model ranking, score reliability and screening performance survive changes in cohort, prompt, negative spectrum, specified prevalence and operating threshold. We audit three medical vision-language models (BioMedCLIP, CheXficient, and MedSigLIP) and a general-domain OpenCLIP comparator on 12,200 chest radiograph records from four datasets (Montgomery, Shenzhen, TBX11K, and VinDr-CXR). Five fixed prompt families yield 244,000 model--image--prompt scores. No model leads every cohort and reliability criterion. Prompt-family changes alter AUROC in 21 of 48 multiplicity-controlled comparisons. Replacing healthy controls with sick non-tuberculosis controls reduces AUROC by 0.075--0.306 across all four models. On VinDr-CXR, the three medical models distinguish tuberculosis from no-finding controls substantially better than from pneumonia or lung tumor; their AUROC point estimates for both named diseases fall below 0.5. CheXficient has documented VinDr-CXR pretraining exposure, which limits the interpretation of its results. Thresholds chosen for 95\% sensitivity on TBX11K training retain that constraint by point estimate in only four of sixteen target evaluations. A five-seed supervised source model reaches 0.999 AUROC on TBX11K validation but 0.629 on each of two external cohorts. Conservative exclusion of perceptual-overlap candidates narrows this gap without closing it. These retrospective, single-task results show that discrimination, score reliability and threshold retention support different portability claims. Evidence for chest X-ray tuberculosis screening should identify the complete evaluation specification rather than attribute clinical portability to a checkpoint alone.

AI.tldr: 该研究审计三种医学视觉语言模型和一种通用模型在胸片结核筛查中的可移植性，发现模型排名、评分可靠性和筛查阈值表现会随队列、提示词、阴性对照、患病率和操作阈值变化，基准分数不能保证临床可移植。
AI.motivation: 医学模型的基准分数并不能证明在不同评估设定下结论仍然成立，因此需要检验模型排名、评分可靠性和筛查性能是否能在多种评估变化下保持稳定。
AI.method: 审计 BioMedCLIP、CheXficient、MedSigLIP 和 OpenCLIP，在 Montgomery、Shenzhen、TBX11K、VinDr-CXR 四个数据集的 12,200 份胸片记录上评估；使用五个固定提示词家族生成 244,000 个模型-图像-提示词评分，并改变队列、阴性谱、指定患病率和操作阈值，进行多重比较控制，同时比较监督源模型的外部表现。
AI.result: 没有模型在所有队列和可靠性标准中领先；提示词家族变化在 48 个多重控制比较中有 21 个改变 AUROC。将健康对照替换为患病非结核对照后，四个模型 AUROC 下降 0.075–0.306。在 VinDr-CXR 上，三个医学模型区分结核与无异常对照的能力明显好于区分肺炎或肺肿瘤，且对这两种命名疾病的 AUROC 点估计低于 0.5。CheXficient 有 VinDr-CXR 预训练暴露记录，限制其结果解释。TBX11K 训练集上按 95% 灵敏度选择的阈值，仅在 16 个目标评估中的 4 个按点估计保持该约束。五种子监督源模型在 TBX11K 验证集 AUROC 为 0.999，但在两个外部队列均为 0.629；保守排除感知重叠候选可缩小差距但未完全消除。
AI.conclusion: 这些回顾性、单任务结果表明，判别能力、评分可靠性和阈值保持支持不同的可移植性主张。胸片结核筛查证据应明确完整的评估规范，而不能仅凭一个检查点断言临床可移植性。

title: Moral Entropy: Auditing Bias and Uncertainty in Moral Judgment
summary:
Most work in computational ethics treats annotator disagreement on moral content as noise to be voted away, collapsed into majority vote or the more permissive any-annotator rule the moment a single annotator flags an item. We argue this uncertainty should instead be modeled and learned from.
  We introduce Moral Entropy, a Bayesian framework that keeps a full posterior over the true label and decomposes its entropy into aleatoric uncertainty (irreducible disagreement about the moral content) and epistemic uncertainty (from insufficient or noisy annotation) -- and lets any heuristic consensus rule be audited against a calibrated ground truth via entropy methods such as cross-entropy/KL, Brier score, and expected calibration error.
  Across three corpora and fifteen discourse domains, auditing the standard aggregation rules against this posterior reveals bias that no current pipeline reports: the any-annotator rule disagrees with the calibrated posterior on roughly 30% of items -- pooled, almost entirely false positives, though the errors invert at the foundation level (19.9%/38.9% mean FPR/FNR on MFTC) -- while the stricter majority and two-vote rules miss 63-83% of true positives.

AI.tldr: 本文主张在计算伦理学中不应将标注者对道德内容的分歧简单视为噪声并用多数投票或任一标注者规则消除，而应建模并学习这种不确定性。作者提出 Moral Entropy 贝叶斯框架，保留真实标签的后验分布，并将熵分解为偶然不确定性与认知不确定性，进而用交叉熵/KL、Brier 分数和期望校准误差等审计常用共识规则。
AI.motivation: 现有计算伦理研究通常把标注者分歧当作噪声，通过多数投票或任一标注者标记即采纳的宽松规则加以合并，导致不确定性被掩盖而非被建模。作者认为这种分歧本身包含关于道德内容的重要信息，应被显式表示和学习。
AI.method: 提出 Moral Entropy 贝叶斯框架：对真实标签维持完整后验，并将后验熵分解为 aleatoric uncertainty（关于道德内容的不可约分歧）和 epistemic uncertainty（来自标注不足或噪声）。该框架允许用交叉熵/KL、Brier 分数、期望校准误差等熵与校准方法，将任意启发式共识规则与校准后的真实标签进行对比审计。
AI.result: 在三个语料库和十五个话语领域上的审计显示，标准聚合规则存在现有流程未报告的偏差：任一标注者规则与校准后验在约30%的项目上不一致，汇总看几乎全是假阳性；但在 foundation 层面错误反转，MFTC 上平均 FPR/FNR 为 19.9%/38.9%。更严格的多数投票和二票规则则漏掉 63%–83% 的真阳性。
AI.conclusion: 常用标注聚合规则会系统性偏离校准后的道德标签后验，且偏差模式因规则和领域而异。计算伦理学应把标注者分歧作为可建模的不确定性来源，而非投票去除的噪声，并使用校准与熵方法审计和比较聚合规则。

title: XCalib Depth-Guided Geometric Optimization for Dense Thermal-Visible Video Registration
summary: Image registration is a vital preprocessing step in multimodal perception tasks, including image fusion, object detection, and semantic segmentation. In Advanced Driver- Assistance Systems (ADAS), spatial misalignment between visible (RGB) and infrared (IR) cameras -caused by non-coincident optical axes and field-of-view differences- introduces non-uniform parallax and visual ghosting. Classical keypoint-based methods are restricted to global homographies that fail under dynamic depth, while unconstrained dense flow algorithms lack structural regularization and suffer from temporal instability. In this paper, we propose XCalib, an unsupervised dense thermal-visible registration framework that bridges this gap. Rather than serving as an absolute metric calibration tool, XCalib leverages virtual pinhole camera parameterization strictly as a geometric constraint space. By optimizing effective relative pose and intrinsics alongside predicted monocular metric depth, XCalib restricts the search space of spatial displacements to physically valid projection geometries. Our key contributions are: (1) a novel registration paradigm that uses camera parameterization as an implicit regularizer for dense cross-modal warping; (2) Normalized Edges Correlation (NEC), a robust structural similarity metric tailored to cross- spectral alignment; and (3) extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations across public ADAS datasets, demonstrating superior temporal stability and alignment accuracy over unconstrained dense flow baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文提出XCalib，一种无监督密集热可见光配准框架，通过虚拟针孔相机参数化作为几何约束，优化相对位姿、内参和单目深度，实现跨模态对齐。引入归一化边缘相关（NEC）度量，在ADAS数据集上表现优于无约束密集流基线。
AI.motivation: ADAS中RGB与红外相机因光轴不重合和视场差异导致空间错位，产生非均匀视差和视觉重影；经典关键点方法受限于全局单应性，在动态深度下失效；无约束密集流方法缺乏结构正则化，时间稳定性差。
AI.method: 提出XCalib无监督密集热可见光配准框架。将虚拟针孔相机参数化作为几何约束空间，优化有效相对位姿和内参以及预测的单目度量深度，将空间位移搜索限制在物理有效的投影几何中。提出归一化边缘相关（NEC）作为跨光谱对齐的鲁棒结构相似性度量。
AI.result: 在公开ADAS数据集上进行广泛的定量和定性评估，表明与无约束密集流基线相比，XCalib具有更优的时间稳定性和对齐精度。
AI.conclusion: XCalib通过相机参数化作为隐式正则化器，有效解决了跨模态配准中的动态深度和时序不稳定问题，为热-可见光图像配准提供了新范式。

title: Towards Fine-Grained Object Manipulation: SAM3-Guided Visuomotor Policy with Persistent Memory Learning and Focused Visual Conditioning
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027
summary: Fine-grained object (FO) manipulation requires robots to distinguish a specified FO from visually similar objects and execute actions reliably despite scene distractors. However, scene-level visual conditioning lacks explicit object selection, while category-level guidance cannot reliably distinguish FOs within the same category. We present a SAM3-guided visuomotor framework that addresses these challenges through persistent object memory and focused visual conditioning. First, we introduce FO Memory-driven SAM3 (FOM-SAM3), which learns reusable FO memory tokens from limited multi-view registration images while keeping SAM3 fully frozen. Through one-vs-rest learning, these tokens encode persistent memories for localizing target FOs and rejecting similar alternatives, which can be stored in a memory bank. Second, we propose Focused Spatial-Appearance Encoding (FSAE), which combines in-FO local appearance features with explicit bounding-box coordinates to condition action policies including Diffusion Policy (DP) and Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT). The effectiveness of the proposed FOM-SAM3 was validated on the FO-30 dataset comprising 30 physical objects across four coarse categories. Across three real-robot FO manipulation tasks, our FOM-SAM3-guided policies demonstrated robustness against distractors, discrimination ability among similar FOs, and extendibility to new FOs.

AI.tldr: 提出一种SAM3引导的视觉运动框架，通过持久对象记忆与聚焦视觉条件，解决细粒度物体操作中相似物体区分和场景干扰问题。
AI.motivation: 场景级视觉条件缺乏显式物体选择，类别级引导难以可靠区分同类别细粒度物体，而机器人需要准确指定并操作目标细粒度物体，同时抵抗相似物体和场景干扰。
AI.method: 提出FOM-SAM3，在冻结SAM3的情况下，从有限多视角注册图像学习可复用的细粒度物体记忆token，并通过one-vs-rest学习编码持久记忆以定位目标并拒绝相似替代物，存入记忆库；提出FSAE，将细粒度物体内部局部外观特征与显式边界框坐标结合，用于条件化DP和ACT等动作策略。
AI.result: 在包含4个粗类别、30个物理对象的FO-30数据集上验证FOM-SAM3；在三个真实机器人细粒度物体操作任务中，基于FOM-SAM3的策略展现出对干扰物的鲁棒性、对相似细粒度物体的区分能力以及对新物体的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: SAM3引导的视觉运动框架结合持久对象记忆和聚焦视觉条件，能够提升真实机器人细粒度物体操作的鲁棒性、判别能力和可扩展性。

title: DiaVLo: Diagnosing Behaviours of Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) rely on storing and transferring appropriate information across their sub-components. Verifying that the VLMs exhibit desired behaviours, while avoiding harmful ones, is central to their reliable deployment. Yet, methods that identify VLM behaviours remain scarce. We present DiaVLo, a diagnostic framework that leverages human curation and VLMs' generation capabilities to construct specifications of desired and observed VLM behaviours, surfacing potential misalignments. Beyond this, DiaVLo also provides causal estimates to identify the most influential concepts steering VLM behaviours. We evaluate DiaVLo on several open-source VLMs under both classification and generation conditions. Our experiments show that DiaVLo produces behaviour labels that correlate with model performance and provide context for measured performance. DiaVLo surfaced behaviours that are clearly aligned and misaligned, alongside patterns in how VLMs perceive, organise, and prioritise concepts.

AI.tldr: 提出DiaVLo诊断框架，结合人工策划与VLM生成能力构建期望和观察到的行为规范，发现潜在错位，并用因果估计识别影响VLM行为的关键概念。在多个开源VLM的分类和生成任务上验证。
AI.motivation: VLM依赖子组件存储和传递信息，需验证其是否表现出期望行为并避免有害行为，以保证可靠部署；但现有识别VLM行为的方法仍然稀缺。
AI.method: DiaVLo利用人工策划和VLM生成能力构建期望行为与观察行为的规范，揭示潜在错位；同时提供因果估计，识别最能影响VLM行为的概念。在多个开源VLM上于分类和生成条件下进行评估。
AI.result: DiaVLo产生的行为标签与模型性能相关，并为测得的性能提供上下文；它揭示了明显对齐和错位的行为，以及VLM感知、组织和优先排序概念的模式。
AI.conclusion: DiaVLo能够诊断VLM行为，发现对齐与错位现象，并揭示概念组织模式，有助于VLM的可靠部署。

title: PointLAM: Local Attentive Mamba for Efficient Point-based 3D Object Detection
summary: 3D object detection from LiDAR point clouds faces a fundamental dilemma: voxel-based methods achieve efficiency at the cost of geometric quantization, while point-based methods preserve fidelity but suffer from prohibitive computational bottlenecks. Specifically, point-based architectures are crippled by slow downsampling strategies (e.g., FPS) and expensive dynamic neighbor queries (e.g., k-NN) coupled with costly continuous interactions. To tackle these systemic inefficiencies, we propose PointLAM, a highly efficient and powerful point-based architecture driven by two synergistic innovations. First, to resolve the downsampling bottleneck, we develop the Laplacian Point Sampler (LPS). LPS employs an implicit discrete Laplacian high-pass filter and Doubly Sorted Sampling to achieve fast, structure-aware foreground preservation. Second, to overcome local modeling latency, we design the Local Hadamard Aggregator (LHA). LHA decouples spatial indexing from feature representation using transient grids, and replaces complex continuous interactions with a Hadamard Gating mechanism for topology-aware, attentive modulation. By coupling this local gating with Bi-Directional Mamba (BDM) layers for global sequence modeling, we formulate the Local Attentive Mamba (LAM) block. Powered by this architecture, PointLAM achieves competitive performance on nuScenes and Waymo for point-based detectors. It rivals highly optimized voxel competitors while requiring a fraction of the computational footprint, demonstrating marked superiority in detecting small instances and handling extreme sparsity. Project page: https://pointlam.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出PointLAM，一种高效且强大的点云3D检测架构，通过LPS和LHA等创新，在保持点方法几何保真优势的同时大幅提升效率，缓解体素方法与点方法之间的根本矛盾。
AI.motivation: 现有LiDAR 3D检测存在两难：体素方法效率高但会带来几何量化误差；点方法保留几何精度，却受限于慢速下采样（如FPS）、昂贵动态邻域查询（如k-NN）和复杂连续交互导致的严重计算瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出PointLAM，核心包括：Laplacian Point Sampler (LPS)，利用隐式离散拉普拉斯高通滤波和Doubly Sorted Sampling实现快速、结构感知的前景保留；Local Hadamard Aggregator (LHA)，通过瞬态网格解耦空间索引与特征表示，并用Hadamard Gating替代复杂连续交互，实现拓扑感知的注意力调制；再结合Bi-Directional Mamba (BDM)进行全局序列建模，构成Local Attentive Mamba (LAM) block。
AI.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上，PointLAM作为点检测器取得有竞争力的性能，可媲美高度优化的体素检测器，同时计算开销仅为其一小部分，并在小目标检测和极端稀疏场景下表现更优。
AI.conclusion: PointLAM有效解决了点基架构中的系统性低效问题，证明高效点方法能够在性能上竞争体素方法，同时显著降低计算成本，并在困难场景中展现优势。

title: RecreationWorld: Scalable and Verifiable Environments for Hybrid Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) have advanced along two separate lines: graphical interaction and software development through code and the command line. Real digital work requires both, interleaved rather than stacked end to end. We study hybrid CUAs that autonomously decide when to explore an interface, implement software, and run and visually verify their artifacts. We introduce RecreationWorld, a five-platform framework built around recreation: given a running reference, an agent must discover its behavior and build a faithful implementation with no prescribed workflow. RecreationWorld provides reproducible environments on Ubuntu, macOS, Windows, Android, and Web, plus a unified harness with native GUI control and coding tools. The running reference serves as an oracle for hidden behavioral tests, providing execution-grounded rewards. We scale trajectory generation with high-quality open-source applications. Models trained on these trajectories improve across five out-of-distribution coding and hybrid computer-use benchmarks and more frequently verify their rendered outputs, providing evidence of transfer beyond recreation. For held-out evaluation, we introduce RecreationBench, comprising 250 diverse tasks across domains and platforms. Reference-grounded programmatic and visual assertions cover action-conditioned outcomes at multiple interaction depths; each is validated on the reference and by human reviewers before the suite is frozen for automatic scoring. GPT-6 Astra leads at 58.1% overall, but passes all programmatic tests on just 2.8% of tasks. Agents reproduce static interface structure more reliably than interactions and computed outputs, while generated applications remain smaller and more monolithic than their references. We release the benchmark, environments, and test suites.

AI.tldr: 本文研究混合计算机使用智能体，即能自主在界面探索、软件开发、运行并视觉验证之间切换的智能体，并提出 RecreationWorld 框架与 RecreationBench 基准来评估其在五大平台上的复刻能力。
AI.motivation: 真实数字工作往往需要图形界面交互与代码/命令行开发交错进行，而现有计算机使用智能体多沿图形交互或软件开发两条独立路线发展，缺乏对混合工作流的系统研究。
AI.method: 提出 RecreationWorld：围绕“复刻运行中的参考应用”构建五平台框架，覆盖 Ubuntu、macOS、Windows、Android 和 Web；提供原生 GUI 控制与编码工具的统一执行环境。以运行参考作为隐藏行为测试的 oracle，提供执行接地的奖励，并用高质量开源应用扩展轨迹生成。提出 RecreationBench：250 个跨领域跨平台任务，含基于参考的程序化与视觉断言，经参考验证与人工审核后冻结用于自动评分。
AI.result: 在轨迹上训练的模型在五个分布外编码与混合计算机使用基准上均有提升，并更频繁地验证渲染输出，显示复刻任务可迁移。GPT-6 Astra 在 RecreationBench 总体得分 58.1%，但仅 2.8% 任务通过全部程序化测试。智能体复刻静态界面结构比复刻交互和计算输出更可靠，生成应用也比参考更小、更单体化。
AI.conclusion: 混合计算机使用智能体仍是困难问题，尤其在动态交互与计算输出方面；RecreationWorld 与 RecreationBench 提供了可复现评估框架。作者发布基准、环境和测试套件以促进后续研究。

title: A Principled Approach to Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
summary: Traditional unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) methods are designed to flag or localise deviations from a normative distribution, ignoring the underlying generative mechanisms of the anomalies. Yet the nature of an anomaly is often as important as its presence. We reformulate UAD as a Bayesian inverse problem, in which the objective is to infer the most probable corruption responsible for each observation. Our framework yields a probabilistic anomaly score as the energy of the inferred corruption parameters, and serves as a principled recipe for developing new UAD algorithms. We derive several existing methods as instances of the general framework, each corresponding to the same energy score under different modelling choices. Experimentally, we study the framework's components in a controlled setting, and improve object-class AUROC on the MVTec AD dataset by 2.3% by adapting the underlying corruption model. Finally, we validate the framework on a brain MRI benchmark, achieving strong detection performance while producing estimates of pathology intensity, bias, and geometry. Code is available at https://github.com/jgmyles/inverse-uad.

AI.tldr: 本文将无监督异常检测重新表述为贝叶斯逆问题，目标是推断导致每个观测异常的最可能损坏机制，并据此给出基于推断损坏参数能量的概率异常分数。
AI.motivation: 传统无监督异常检测只关注是否偏离正常分布或定位异常区域，而忽略异常背后的生成机制；但异常的性质往往与其存在同样重要。
AI.method: 提出一个贝叶斯逆问题框架，将异常检测转化为推断最可能的损坏参数；以推断出的损坏参数能量作为异常分数，并说明若干现有方法可在不同建模选择下视为该框架的特例。
AI.result: 在受控实验中分析框架各组件；通过调整损坏模型，在 MVTec AD 数据集上使 object-class AUROC 提升 2.3%；在脑部 MRI 基准上实现较强检测性能，同时估计病理强度、偏置和几何信息。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为无监督异常检测提供了原理性通用思路，能够统一现有方法、提升检测性能，并输出更具解释性的异常生成机制估计。

title: When Should a Failing Robot Ask? Initiating Corrective Human-Robot Dialogue from Audited Sensor Evidence
comment: Accepted at the IROS 2026 Workshop on Human-Robot Dialogue
summary: A robot that fails at a task faces the first decision in corrective dialogue: act on its own diagnosis, consult another onboard sensor, or interrupt a person. Choosing well requires knowing how much the robot's sensors reveal about the cause and how reliable the robot's own diagnosis is. We build a simulated benchmark in which every failure's true cause is known, because we injected it, and measure what each sensor reveals, with explicit checks against data leakage. Some failures are diagnosable from camera images; others only from the robot's force data (0.99 from force data, no image method above 0.55). We then test six open vision-language models. Their behavior tracks the surface of the prompt, not the evidence: moving the refusal option from last to first in the answer list collapses refusal rates from 78-100% to 0-6% in three of the six swept model-and-family pairs. Accuracy from frames stays at or below a majority-class baseline under every prompt variant, with or without worked examples, and stated confidence carries no information about correctness. Handing the same models the force data as ten lines of text produces the first above-baseline diagnoses, in four of the six models: much of the failure reflects missing sensor data, not missing ability. We pose the choice as a three-action decision problem, act, consult your own sensors, or ask a human, whose optimal policy follows from measured accuracy. The models do not follow it, and their ask rates ignore a fourfold change in question cost. One question to a human still lifts them from that baseline to roughly the answerer's own reliability (0.70-0.81 when they ask). The decision to ask should be tied to measured accuracy and stated costs, not to the model's confidence.

AI.tldr: 论文研究机器人任务失败后，应在自主诊断、查询自身传感器或询问人类之间如何选择。作者构建可注入真实故障原因的仿真基准，测量不同传感器的可诊断性，并测试六个开放视觉语言模型。结果显示模型行为受提示表面影响而非证据，缺少力传感器数据是重要原因；是否提问应依据测量准确率和成本，而非模型置信度。
AI.motivation: 机器人失败后需要决定：相信自身诊断、调用其他传感器，还是打断人类。做出好决策需要知道传感器能揭示多少故障原因，以及机器人自身诊断有多可靠。现有视觉语言模型可能被用作决策者，但其是否依据证据、能否权衡提问成本尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建仿真基准，故障真实原因已知，通过注入故障并显式检查数据泄漏，测量相机、力传感器等对故障原因的可诊断性；测试六个开放视觉语言模型，改变提示中拒答选项位置、是否给示例、置信度等；将力数据转为十行文本输入；把问题形式化为三动作决策问题：行动、咨询自身传感器、询问人类，并由测量准确率推导最优策略，同时改变提问成本。
AI.result: 部分故障只能从力数据诊断，力数据准确率达0.99，而图像方法不超过0.55。六个模型中，拒答选项从最后移到最前，使三组模型拒答率从78-100%降至0-6%；基于帧的准确率不超过多数类基线，模型置信度与正确性无关。给模型力数据文本后，六个模型中有四个首次超过基线，说明失败部分源于缺少传感器数据。模型不遵循最优策略，提问率无视四倍提问成本变化；当它们询问人类时，准确率可提升至回答者自身可靠性0.70-0.81。
AI.conclusion: 是否询问人类应取决于测量准确率和明确成本，而不是模型置信度。视觉语言模型对提示表面敏感，不能可靠地按证据决策；其失败部分来自缺少传感器输入，而非完全缺少能力。

title: QuranicMMLU: A Cognitively-Aware Benchmark for Evaluating Generative AI Solutions on Quranic Linguistic Knowledge
summary: We introduce QuranicMMLU, a benchmark for evaluating generative AI on Quranic Arabic across multiple dimensions of linguistic complexity. Existing Quranic benchmarks center on general question answering and semantic retrieval, without probing specific linguistic competencies or stratifying by cognitive demand and verse difficulty. We construct a five-pillar Quranic taxonomy spanning Phonology, Morphology, Syntax, Semantics, and Pragmatics, with 31 leaves covering phenomena from tajwīd and root-and-pattern morphology to occasions of revelation and inter-surah coherence. For each leaf we generate questions stratified by Bloom's cognitive level and verse perplexity, then have LLM as a judge to independently answer and score every item and route the annotations to manual review. The resulting dataset comprises 980 human-reviewed questions, each issued in both open-ended and multiple-choice form. We benchmark 12 systems on these items and find that the Islamic-specialized model leads, yet every system scores higher on multiple-choice accuracy (average 84%) than open-ended answer quality (average 60%): the two rankings agree closely (Kendall's τ=0.73), but multiple-choice scoring hides failures that surface only once answer choices are removed. QuranicMMLU thus offers a rigorous, linguistically grounded framework for evaluating Arabic NLP in the Quranic domain.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 QuranicMMLU，一个从多维度语言学复杂度评估生成式 AI 的古兰经阿拉伯语基准。它构建五支柱分类体系，生成并人工审核 980 道题目，以开放式和多项选择形式评测 12 个系统。
AI.motivation: 现有古兰经基准多聚焦通用问答和语义检索，未专门探测具体语言能力，也未按认知需求和经文难度分层，因此需要更严格、语言学基础的评估框架。
AI.method: 构建涵盖音系、形态、句法、语义、语用五大支柱、31 个叶节点的古兰经分类体系；按 Bloom 认知层级和经文困惑度生成问题；用 LLM 作为评委独立作答与打分，再转人工审核；最终得到 980 道人工审核题，每题含开放式和多项选择两种形式；对 12 个系统进行基准测试。
AI.result: 伊斯兰专门化模型表现领先；所有系统在多项选择上的准确率平均为 84%，高于开放式回答质量平均 60%；两种评测排名高度一致（Kendall's τ=0.73），但多项选择评分会掩盖去掉选项后才暴露的失败。
AI.conclusion: QuranicMMLU 为古兰经领域的阿拉伯语 NLP 提供了一个严格且以语言学为基础的评估框架。

title: NeuRIO: A Streaming Neural Estimator for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Multi-Robot Relative Inertial Odometry
summary: We present NeuRIO, a streaming neural estimator for anchor-free 6-DoF relative inertial odometry using only identified inter-robot bearings, ranges, and IMU measurements. NeuRIO canonicalizes measurements into gravity-aligned coordinates, represents robots as nodes and mutual observations as factors, and uses attention for spatial reasoning and GRUs for temporal modeling. As a graph network, NeuRIO applies shared node-wise and factor-wise operators throughout the network, enabling it to handle different team sizes and time-varying observation graphs. NeuRIO is trained on a simulator that couples various motion patterns, device-level sensor characteristics, and diverse, realistic modeled, and temporally persistent sensor corruptions. In this way, NeuRIO achieves zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. Across $24$ real-world sequences, NeuRIO achieves $14.1\,\mathrm{cm}$ position RMSE and $3.9^\circ$ rotation RMSE. More importantly, NeuRIO demonstrates strong computational scalability, maintaining an update cost below $20\,\mathrm{ms}$ with up to $400$ robots in simulation, while optimization-based methods exceed $20\,\mathrm{ms}$ at only $24$ robots. Moreover, even trained on limited team sizes, NeuRIO transfers directly to unseen larger teams without architectural or parameter changes.

AI.tldr: NeuRIO 是一种无需锚点的流式神经相对惯性里程计，仅利用机器人间可识别的方位、距离和 IMU 测量，实现 6-DoF 相对位姿估计，并支持零样本 sim-to-real 迁移。
AI.motivation: 多机器人协同中，传统优化方法在团队规模增大和观测图时变时计算扩展性差；研究希望构建无需锚点、可适应不同团队规模与动态观测图，并能从仿真直接迁移到真实世界的相对惯性里程计。
AI.method: 将测量统一到重力对齐坐标系；把机器人表示为节点、相互观测表示为因子；用注意力进行空间推理，用 GRU 进行时序建模；采用共享节点级和因子级算子的图网络，以适应不同团队规模和时变观测图；在耦合多种运动模式、设备级传感器特性和持久传感器损坏的模拟器上训练。
AI.result: 在 24 个真实世界序列上，NeuRIO 达到 14.1 cm 位置 RMSE 和 3.9° 旋转 RMSE；计算扩展性强，仿真中最多 400 个机器人时更新耗时低于 20 ms，而优化方法在仅 24 个机器人时已超过 20 ms；即使仅用有限团队规模训练，也能无需改变架构或参数直接迁移到更大的未见团队。
AI.conclusion: NeuRIO 实现了高精度、强泛化且可扩展的实时相对惯性里程计，具备零样本 sim-to-real 迁移能力，并能直接推广到更大规模团队。

title: AgenticSwarm: Semantic Perception and Adaptive Task Allocation for Heterogeneous Multi-UAV Missions
summary: Multi UAV missions in complex environments require the system to understand both the surrounding scene and the intent of a human operator while maintaining feasible task allocation as mission conditions change. This paper presents AgenticSwarm, an agentic framework for semantic perception and adaptive task allocation in heterogeneous multi UAV missions. An agent interprets aerial imagery and natural language instructions to construct a grounded mission representation that links perceived objects and regions with task requirements, capability constraints, and mission dependencies. This information augments a constrained task allocation process in which obstacle aware path feasibility, energy consumption, and protected return home requirements are incorporated before assignment. During execution, changes such as UAV failure, battery degradation, or task modification trigger residual mission reconstruction from the current system state, while completed work and reconnaissance progress are retained. AgenticSwarm is evaluated across five diverse Gazebo environments and an indoor real test environment, demonstrating its ability to connect semantic reasoning with constrained allocation and adaptive multi UAV mission execution. Compared with a Grounding DINO+SAM~2.1 perception baseline, the SAM3-based pipeline improves class-aware recall by 25.2 percentage points (pp) and semantic label accuracy by 29.5 pp. Ablating residual mission replanning increases mean repeated work from 0% to 61.7% and post-event recovery time by 58.6%, highlighting the contribution of adaptive replanning to mission execution.

AI.tldr: 提出AgenticSwarm智能体框架，用于异构多无人机任务的语义感知与自适应任务分配，并在仿真和真实环境中验证。
AI.motivation: 复杂环境下多无人机任务需要同时理解场景和人类操作员意图，并在任务条件变化时保持可行的任务分配。
AI.method: 智能体解释航空图像和自然语言指令，构建接地任务表示；将障碍物感知路径可行性、能量消耗和返航要求纳入约束任务分配；执行中遇到故障、电量下降或任务修改时，基于当前状态重构剩余任务并保留已完成工作和侦察进度。
AI.result: 在五个Gazebo环境和室内真实环境评估中，SAM3流程比Grounding DINO+SAM2.1基线在类感知召回率上提升25.2个百分点，语义标签准确率提升29.5个百分点；消融剩余任务重规划后，平均重复工作从0%增至61.7%，事件后恢复时间增加58.6%。
AI.conclusion: AgenticSwarm能将语义推理与约束分配及自适应多无人机任务执行结合，自适应重规划对任务执行有重要贡献。

title: Visual Proactivity: Enhancing Human-Robot Collaboration Through Intent Communication
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
